paras.en: You may be searching for the best air purifiers for allergies, pets, mold, wildfire smoke, or exhaust—such as from cars or industrial buildings—to protect yourself and your home from potentially harmful air pollutants, especially as the seasons change.
paras.zh: 您可能正在寻找针对过敏、宠物、霉菌、野火烟雾或废气（例如汽车或工业建筑废气）的最佳空气净化器，以保护您自己和您的家免受潜在有害空气污染物的影响，尤其是在季节变化时。

paras.en: As winter creeps in and the outside air gets colder, having a good air purifier for your living space (especially your bedroom) is essential to reducing airborne particles. Closed windows and older heating systems often trap stale air and indoor pollutants, and microscopic allergens like pet dander and dust mites circulate your home instead of wafting outside. Plus, heating devices like fireplaces, furnaces, and heaters can create soot, dust, and other potentially harmful odors.
paras.zh: 随着冬天的来临，室外空气变得越来越冷，为您的生活空间（尤其是卧室）配备一台好的空气净化器对于减少空气中的颗粒物至关重要。关闭的窗户和旧的供暖系统经常会滞留污浊的空气和室内污染物，而宠物皮屑和尘螨等微小过敏原会在您的家中循环，而不是飘到外面。此外，壁炉、熔炉和加热器等加热设备会产生烟灰、灰尘和其他潜在有害的气味。

paras.en: If you don't want to break the bank on a large, expensive whole-house air purifier, a smaller, more portable one can still be extremely beneficial to your health. You can move it around your house and keep it in your bedroom to help keep the air healthy and germs at bay as you sleep.
paras.zh: 如果您不想花太多钱购买一台大型、昂贵的全屋空气净化器，那么一台更小、更便携的空气净化器仍然对您的健康极其有益。您可以将它搬到您的房子周围，并将其放在您的卧室中，以帮助您在睡眠时保持空气健康并远离细菌。

paras.en: These on-sale, WIRED-tested air purifiers below can help make your home healthier this winter for less. All of these picks have HEPA filtration options, which capture microscopic airborne viruses, bacteria, and respiratory droplets that increase the likelihood of illness, especially when people spend more time indoors together during the colder months. Keeping the air continually filtered and circulating also helps ease asthma triggers, congestion, and allergy flare-ups that often get worse as the temperature drops.
paras.zh: 以下这些在售、经过 WIRED 测试的空气净化器可以帮助您以更少的成本在这个冬天让您的家变得更健康。所有这些选择都具有 HEPA 过滤选项，可捕获微小的空气传播病毒、细菌和呼吸道飞沫，这些病毒、细菌和呼吸道飞沫会增加患病的可能性，尤其是当人们在寒冷的月份在室内呆得时间更长时。保持空气不断过滤和流通还有助于缓解哮喘触发、充血和过敏发作，这些症状通常会随着气温下降而恶化。

This is Blueair’s small-room model with coverage up to 175 feet, so it’s ideal for bedrooms. It stands less than 2 feet tall and includes built-in heating and a cooling fan, so it can be used year-round as temperatures rise and fall. This combo air purifier also offers an easy-to-use connected app, HEPA filtration and electrostatic technology to capture pollutants, and a built-in air quality index indicator light that lets you check air quality at a glance. It's 55 percent off on Amazon right now, and at Shop it's $150 off when you sign in at checkout.
paras.zh: 随着冬天的临近，气温下降，这款加热器空气净化器组合可能会满足您的祈祷。这是 Blueair 的小房间型号，覆盖范围达 175 英尺，因此非常适合卧室。它的高度不到 2 英尺，配有内置暖气和冷却风扇，因此可以在气温升降时全年使用。这款组合空气净化器还提供易于使用的连接应用程序、HEPA 过滤和静电技术来捕获污染物，以及内置空气质量指数指示灯，让您一目了然地检查空气质量。目前在 Amazon 上可享受 55% 的折扣，而在 Shop 结账时登录可享受 150 美元的折扣。

paras.en: A Bedroom Air Purifier for Pet Allergies

paras.en: I first bought this little air purifier when I was moving into my small Brooklyn apartment with two cats and a roommate who has allergies. It can exchange air the recommended 4.8 times per hour in a 219-square-foot area, so a roughly 15- by 14-foot room or smaller is best for it. It's also got an adjustable nightlight and clock functions. If you're like me and short on space, or have been wanting to try a sunrise alarm clock and want cleaner air, this purifier can do it all.

articles.title: Binance Says Hackers Used Well-Known Tricks to Carry Out a $6.34 Billion Heist
articles.author: Matt Burgess

paras.en: For almost a decade, North Korean cybercriminals have targeted the cryptocurrency industry—large and small. While these hacks have been frequent, the country’s hackers allegedly made off with their biggest heist to date last week when $6.34 billion was siphoned from the wallets belonging to crypto exchange Binance.
paras.zh: 近十年来，朝鲜网络犯罪分子一直瞄准大大小小的加密货币行业。虽然这些黑客攻击很频繁，但据称该国黑客上周实施了迄今为止最大的抢劫，从加密货币交易所币安的钱包中窃取了 63.4 亿美元。

paras.en: In a new security update issued on Tuesday, Binance detailed its initial findings into how the company was compromised and hackers were able to steal billions in just 20 minutes. The hack, according to Binance, was the result of an engineer falling for a fake job interview and downloading malicious software. The hackers were then able to move through the company’s network, exploit an internal AI tool, and gain access to a wallet signing service that allowed them to make transactions outside of normal withdrawal procedures.
paras.zh: 在周二发布的新安全更新中，币安详细介绍了其初步调查结果，说明公司如何受到损害，黑客如何在短短 20 分钟内窃取数十亿美元。据币安称，此次黑客攻击是一名工程师接受虚假工作面试并下载恶意软件的结果。然后，黑客能够通过公司的网络，利用内部人工智能工具，并访问钱包签名服务，从而允许他们在正常提款程序之外进行交易。

paras.en: “This should not have happened, and we apologize for the concern, disruption and uncertainty it caused our users, partners and the wider industry,” Binance wrote in its security update, where it also says it has set aside funds to cover the losses and has “rebuilt or replaced” internal systems impacted in the attack. “It was not a single isolated breach or a simple phishing incident,” the company says.
paras.zh: 币安在安全更新中写道：“这种情况不应该发生，我们对它给我们的用户、合作伙伴和更广泛的行业带来的担忧、干扰和不确定性表示歉意。”该公司还表示，已拨出资金来弥补损失，并“重建或更换”了受攻击影响的内部系统。该公司表示：“这不是一次孤立的违规行为或简单的网络钓鱼事件。”

paras.en: Although more than $6 billion was stolen from Binance accounts, almost half of this—where it was possible to do so—was frozen by parts of the cryptocurrency industry, meaning the hackers could not access the funds. However, that still leaves billions controlled by North Korea’s hackers, who have been trying to launder the stolen money into a form where it can be accessed and cashed out. That process could take months.
paras.zh: 尽管超过 60 亿美元从币安账户被盗，但其中几乎一半（如果有可能）被加密货币行业的部分部门冻结，这意味着黑客无法获取这些资金。然而，这仍然让朝鲜黑客控制了数十亿美元，他们一直试图将赃款洗钱成可以访问和兑现的形式。这个过程可能需要几个月的时间。

paras.en: Binance’s analysis says the hack was the accumulation of months of work by hackers, with the ultimate attack taking place on October 29. Shortly after funds started to be moved from Binance’s hot wallets, across more than 10 different blockchains, multiple cryptocurrency tracing firms attributed the attacks to the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s (DPRK) hackers, in particular the sophisticated TraderTraitor group that previously stole more than $1.5 billion in a separate hack last year. The FBI quickly linked TraderTraitor to the Binance hack on October 31.
paras.zh: 币安的分析称，这次黑客攻击是黑客数月工作的积累，最终的攻击发生在 10 月 29 日。在资金开始从币安的热钱包转移到 10 多个不同的区块链后不久，多家加密货币追踪公司将这些攻击归咎于朝鲜民主主义人民共和国 (DPRK) 的黑客，特别是复杂的 TraderTraitor 组织，该组织此前在去年的一次单独黑客攻击中窃取了超过 15 亿美元。 FBI 迅速将 TraderTraitor 与 10 月 31 日的币安黑客攻击联系起来。

paras.en: “Binance’s account aligns with what we know about the TraderTraitor playbook,” says Rafe Pilling, a senior director of threat intelligence at security company Sophos. “The attackers didn’t simply steal a wallet key. They compromised engineers, used that access to understand and move through the environment, and ultimately subverted the systems used to authorize transactions.”
paras.zh: 安全公司 Sophos 威胁情报高级总监 Rafe Pilling 表示：“币安的账户与我们对 TraderTraitor 剧本的了解相符。” “攻击者不仅仅是窃取钱包密钥。他们还侵入了工程师，利用该访问权限来了解和移动环境，并最终颠覆了用于授权交易的系统。”

paras.en: Binance stops short of directly blaming the TraderTraitor hackers itself; however, the company points to the FBI’s attribution to North Korea and acknowledges a prior targeting by DPRK’s cybercriminals. “Throughout 2026, Binance's security team detected and prevented 57 suspected North Korea-linked cyber threat cases,” the company’s update says.
paras.zh: 币安并没有直接指责 TraderTraitor 黑客本身；然而，该公司指出联邦调查局将其归咎于朝鲜，并承认朝鲜网络犯罪分子之前曾将其作为攻击目标。该公司的更新称：“2026 年，币安安全团队检测并阻止了 57 起疑似与朝鲜有关的网络威胁案件。”

paras.en: Binance says activity linked to the hack can first be traced back to June this year. At the time, its update says, an engineer the company refers to as Engineer A downloaded a “tampered Homebrew installation” they found searching online. While the company says this was detected and dealt with, information about the employee was later “exposed to the hacker.”
paras.zh: 币安表示，与黑客攻击相关的活动首先可以追溯到今年 6 月。其更新称，当时，该公司称为工程师 A 的工程师下载了他们在网上搜索到的“被篡改的 Homebrew 安装”。虽然该公司表示已检测到并处理了这一情况，但有关该员工的信息后来“暴露给了黑客”。

paras.en: At the start of September, Binance says another software engineer, identified only as Engineer B, was contacted on “a legitimate job-hunting platform” and then attended a video interview where the fake recruiter shared legitimate-looking social media accounts and personal photos to make them seem real. The Binance engineer progressed, unsurprisingly, to a second-round interview that was conducted using an online chat. “Near the end of the interview, Engineer B was instructed to download an ‘assignment’ containing a malicious code repository onto his work computer,” Binance’s report says.
paras.zh: 9 月初，币安表示，在“一个合法的求职平台”上联系了另一名仅被称为工程师 B 的软件工程师，然后他参加了一次视频面试，在面试中，假招聘人员分享了看似合法的社交媒体帐户和个人照片，使它们看起来很真实。不出所料，这位币安工程师通过在线聊天方式进入了第二轮面试。币安的报告称：“在采访即将结束时，工程师 B 被指示将包含恶意代码存储库的‘作业’下载到他的工作计算机上。”

paras.en: “The malware employed sophisticated obfuscation and evasion techniques, including replacing a legitimate development tool component with a malicious version to execute commands and establish communication with an attacker-controlled external server,” the company writes. It adds that hackers took steps to hide their activity, a common practice.
paras.zh: 该公司写道：“该恶意软件采用了复杂的混淆和规避技术，包括用恶意版本替换合法的开发工具组件来执行命令并与攻击者控制的外部服务器建立通信。”它补充说，黑客采取措施隐藏他们的活动，这是一种常见的做法。

paras.en: Toward the end of October, a little more than a week before the hack, Binance says, the attackers used their access to the engineer’s machine to “gain control” over the wallet of Engineer A, who had been compromised months earlier, and “another Wallet Software Engineer C.” Then on October 29, Binance says, the attackers logged in to the computer of another staff member, Software Engineer C, and used stolen login details before launching the attack. On the evening of the theft, according to Binance, the attack unfolded quickly. “The attacker exploited unauthorized access to an internal wallet signing service to initiate transactions outside the normal withdrawal process,” the company writes.
paras.zh: 币安表示，10 月底，即黑客攻击发生前一周多一点的时间，攻击者利用对工程师计算机的访问权限，“控制”了工程师 A（几个月前就已被入侵）和“另一位钱包软件工程师 C”的钱包。币安表示，随后，10 月 29 日，攻击者登录了另一名员工软件工程师 C 的计算机，并在发起攻击之前使用窃取的登录详细信息。据币安称，盗窃案发生当晚，袭击迅速展开。该公司写道：“攻击者利用对内部钱包签名服务的未经授权的访问，在正常提款流程之外发起交易。”

paras.en: Sophos’s Pilling says TraderTraitor “excels” in its attacks through detailed planning and being able to understand how the services of those it hacks operate. “The initial compromise is just a foothold,” he says. “The real attack is carefully engineered around how the victim actually moves money.”
paras.zh: Sophos 的 Pilling 表示，TraderTraitor 通过详细的计划并能够了解被攻击者的服务如何运作，在攻击中“表现出色”。 “最初的妥协只是一个立足点，”他说。 “真正的攻击是围绕受害者实际转移资金的方式精心设计的。”

paras.en: While Binance says its findings are only the initial step of its investigation, security and crypto tracing experts say that the hackers are undertaking efforts to launder and cash out the stolen cryptocurrency. Since the start of 2017, according to analysis by TRM Labs, North Korean–linked hackers have stolen around $12 billion in cryptocurrency—with more than half of that coming from heists this year.
paras.zh: 虽然币安表示其调查结果只是调查的第一步，但安全和加密追踪专家表示，黑客正在努力洗钱并将被盗的加密货币兑现。根据 TRM Labs 的分析，自 2017 年初以来，与朝鲜有关的黑客已经窃取了约 120 亿美元的加密货币，其中一半以上来自今年的抢劫。

paras.en: Despite the astronomical sums, it is unclear how much of this money makes it back to North Korea. As in the Binance case, some cryptocurrencies can be frozen and made inaccessible, while other transactions can be blocked by some cryptocurrency exchanges. Crypto tracing company Elliptic has said the laundering from the Binance attack has been “highly complex” and likely to be automated. “In its first three and a half days it used about 12,000 wallets across 11 blockchains, roughly one new wallet every 25 seconds, and more than 40,000 transactions,” Elliptic cofounder and chief scientist Tom Robinson wrote in a blog post.
paras.zh: 尽管数额巨大，但尚不清楚其中有多少资金返回朝鲜。与币安的情况一样，某些加密货币可能会被冻结并无法访问，而其他交易可能会被某些加密货币交易所阻止。加密追踪公司 Elliptic 表示，币安攻击造成的洗钱活动“高度复杂”，并且很可能是自动化的。 Elliptic 联合创始人兼首席科学家汤姆·罗宾逊 (Tom Robinson) 在博客文章中写道：“在最初的三天半内，它使用了 11 个区块链上的约 12,000 个钱包，大约每 25 秒一个新钱包，以及超过 40,000 笔交易。”

paras.en: If the money can be laundered successfully, there is a chance it will be converted to cash and used to bolster the development of North Korea’s nuclear weapons program and ballistic missile systems, according to a report published last year from the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team, which includes experts from the United States, South Korea, and nine other countries. “They are highly reliant on Chinese underground banking and China-based facilitators, though they sometimes rely upon facilitators in other countries.”
paras.zh: 包括来自美国、韩国和其他九个国家的专家在内的多边制裁监测小组去年发布的一份报告称，如果这些钱能够成功洗钱，就有可能转换成现金并用于支持朝鲜核武器计划和弹道导弹系统的发展。 “他们高度依赖中国的地下钱庄和中国的协助者，尽管他们有时也依赖其他国家的协助者。”

articles.title: Virginia brothers split $200,000 Powerball prize

paras.en: Nov. 3 (UPI) -- A pair of Virginia brothers are splitting a $200,000 prize after buying a Powerball ticket at their local Kroger store.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日（合众国际社）——弗吉尼亚州的一对兄弟在当地的克罗格商店购买强力球彩票后，将瓜分 20 万美元的奖金。

paras.en: The brothers told Virginia Lottery officials they were shopping together at the Kroger store on Rutgers Street in Roanoke when one of them stopped at the lottery vending machine to buy a Powerball ticket.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩告诉弗吉尼亚州彩票官员，他们当时正在罗阿诺克罗格斯街的克罗格商店购物，其中一人在彩票自动售货机前停下来购买强力球彩票。

paras.en: "Don't forget to buy the winning numbers," the other sibling said at the time.
paras.zh: “别忘了买中奖号码，”另一个兄弟姐妹当时说道。

paras.en: His brother turned out to have followed the instruction, and scored $200,000 in the Sept. 30 drawing.
paras.zh: 事实证明，他的兄弟遵循了指示，在 9 月 30 日的抽奖中赢得了 20 万美元。

paras.en: The ticket matched four of the first five numbers plus the Powerball in the drawing, earning a $50,000 prize that was quadrupled thanks to the Power Play option.
paras.zh: 该彩票匹配了前五个号码中的四个，再加上抽奖中的强力球，赢得了 50,000 美元的奖金，由于强力投注选项，奖金翻了四倍。

paras.en: The brothers said they will split the cash prize down the middle.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩表示，他们将平分奖金。

articles.title: Trump says U.S. cutting off $4B in aid to Israel at end of year

paras.en: Nov. 3 (UPI) -- U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the United States will cut off aid to Israel at the end of the year, saying that the country no longer needs it.
paras.zh: 11月3日，美国总统特朗普周二表示，美国将在年底停止对以色列的援助，称该国不再需要援助。

paras.en: "We were giving them $4 billion -- we are -- but it gets cut off at the end of the year," Trump said to Fox News. The president said the aid included "things and money."
paras.zh: 特朗普对福克斯新闻表示：“我们本来给了他们 40 亿美元——确实是——但到了年底就被切断了。”总统表示，援助包括“物品和金钱”。

paras.en: Trump said that he and Israeli President Benjamin Netanyahu had "reached an agreement" and that Netanyahu had first raised the idea.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他和以色列总统本杰明·内塔尼亚胡已经“达成协议”，并且是内塔尼亚胡首先提出了这个想法。

paras.en: "They don't need it," Trump said. "Israel's our number one. We give them more than anybody else, and they no longer need it. Israel is a very thriving country."
paras.zh: “他们不需要它，”特朗普说。 “以色列是我们的第一。我们给他们的比其他任何人都多，但他们不再需要它。以色列是一个非常繁荣的国家。”

paras.en: The United States gives Israel $13.8 billion of military aid each year through an agreement set to last through 2028. Much of that money goes back to U.S. weapons manufacturers, and Trump said Tuesday that Israel can still buy American weapons.
paras.zh: 美国通过一项为期至 2028 年的协议，每年向以色列提供 138 亿美元的军事援助。其中大部分资金又回到美国武器制造商手中，特朗普周二表示，以色列仍然可以购买美国武器。

paras.en: "They can buy whatever they want," he said.
paras.zh: “他们可以买任何他们想要的东西，”他说。

paras.en: The president made his comments early on Election Day in the United States and tied the announcement to politics more explicitly as well. He said U.S. aid to Israel is a "bad talking point."
paras.zh: 总统在美国选举日早些时候发表了评论，并将这一声明与政治更明确地联系起来。他说，美国对以色列的援助是一个“糟糕的话题”。

paras.en: "Why should we suffer the slings" from candidates such as Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan, when Israel doesn't need aid, Trump said. However, he also said that if Israel did need the aid, it would continue.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，当以色列不需要援助时，“为什么我们要遭受密歇根州民主党参议员候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德等候选人的攻击”。不过，他也表示，如果以色列确实需要援助，它将继续下去。

paras.en: Trump made the announcement a week after Israel's elections, in which Netanyahu lost his majority in the government -- although his main challenger, Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the opposition Yashar party, also does not have a majority.
paras.zh: 特朗普在以色列选举一周后宣布了这一消息，内塔尼亚胡在选举中失去了在政府中的多数席位，尽管他的主要挑战者、反对派亚沙尔党领袖加迪·艾森科特也没有获得多数席位。

paras.en: The Israeli president has said the election was "stolen" by Arab parties in the country. Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies have 53 seats in the government, and Eisenkot's Yashar party and its allies have 48, with 61needed for a majority.
paras.zh: 以色列总统表示，这次选举被该国的阿拉伯政党“窃取”。内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团及其盟友在政府中拥有53个席位，艾森科特的亚沙尔党及其盟友拥有48个席位，其中需要61个席位才能获得多数席位。

paras.en: Arab parties representing Israel's Palestinian population won 19 seats. In recent days, thousands of people have rallied in Jerusalem demanding a Jewish-Arab government partnership.
paras.zh: 代表以色列巴勒斯坦人民的阿拉伯政党赢得了 19 个席位。最近几天，数千人在耶路撒冷集会，要求犹太-阿拉伯政府建立伙伴关系。

articles.title: Watch: Detroit man's 11,578-pound rubber band ball is the world's largest

paras.en: Nov. 3 (UPI) -- A Detroit man spent over 10 years assembling an 11,578-pound rubber band ball that has now been certified as the largest in the world.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日（合众国际社）——一名底特律男子花了 10 多年的时间组装了一个重达 11,578 磅的橡皮筋球，该球现已被认证为世界上最大的橡皮筋球。

paras.en: Claude P. Moore said he started making rubber band balls during his frequent doctor appointments to check up on his blood disorder hemophilia, and in 2015 some coworkers challenged him to make a massive version.
paras.zh: 克劳德·P·摩尔 (Claude P. Moore) 表示，他在经常去看医生检查自己的血液病血友病期间开始制作橡皮筋球，2015 年，一些同事向他发起挑战，要求他制作一个大型版本。

paras.en: The ball eventually grew so large he had to move it out of his garage and into a dedicated storage unit.
paras.zh: 球最终变得太大了，他不得不将它从车库移到一个专用的存储单元中。

paras.en: In August, he and dozens of helpers rolled the ball out of the storage unit and had it hoisted by a crane so it could be taken to Belle Isle and officially weighed.
paras.zh: 八月，他和数十名助手将球从存储单元中滚出，并用起重机将其吊起，以便将其带到贝尔岛并正式称重。

paras.en: A Guinness World Records adjudicator witnessed the weighing ceremony and confirmed the 11,578-pound project is the world's largest rubber band ball.
paras.zh: 吉尼斯世界纪录评审员见证了称重仪式，并确认这个重达11,578磅的项目是世界上最大的橡皮筋球。

paras.en: He took the record from Florida man Joel Waul, who completed his 9,032-pound rubber band ball in 2008.
paras.zh: 他打破了佛罗里达州男子乔尔·沃尔 (Joel Waul) 的纪录，乔尔·沃尔于 2008 年完成了 9,032 磅的橡皮筋球。

articles.title: Usher Previews Sultry Remix of Drake & Loe Shimmy’s ‘I’m Spent’: ‘Got So Many Hits I Damn Near Almost Forget’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Drake and Usher are yet to officially collaborate, but that might be changing soon. While there have long been rumors of a team-up, a mutual respect has always remained between the pair of music titans.
paras.zh: 德雷克和亚瑟小子尚未正式合作，但这种情况可能很快就会改变。尽管长期以来一直有合作的传闻，但这对音乐巨头之间始终保持着相互尊重。

paras.en: The R&B legend previewed a remix of Drizzy and Loe Shimmy’s “I’m Spent” during an IG Live studio session on Monday night (Nov. 2).
paras.zh: 这位 R&B 传奇人物在周一晚上（11 月 2 日）的 IG Live 工作室会议上预览了 Drizzy 和 Loe Shimmy 的《I'm Spent》的混音版。

paras.en: Usher sprinkles in his signature croon to the woozy R&B cut. “All I was tryna do was spazz out on this remix/ Got so many hits I damn near almost forget/ That’s why I’m doing something new/ It’s gon’ be some s–t on there that you can f–k to/ It’s gonna be some s–t on there to make love to too,” he sings.
paras.zh: 亚瑟小子在昏昏欲睡的 R&B 音乐中加入了他标志性的低吟。 “我所做的就是在这个混音中大放异彩/得到了这么多我该死的几乎忘记的热门歌曲/这就是为什么我正在做一些新的事情/那里会有一些你可以操的东西/那里也会有一些可以做爱的东西，”他唱道。

paras.en: It’s unclear if the remix will ever see the light of day with an official release or land on Usher’s next album. His last project arrived with COMING HOME ahead of his Super Bowl Halftime Show performance in February 2024. The LP earned a Grammy nomination for best R&B album and peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚混音版是否会正式发行或出现在亚瑟小子的下一张专辑中。他的最后一个项目是《COMING HOME》，在 2024 年 2 月超级碗中场表演之前发布。这张唱片获得了格莱美最佳 R&B 专辑提名，并在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: “I’m Spent” served as a standout from Drake’s HABIBTI album in May, which reached No. 34 on the Billboard Hot 100 (No. 34) and marked Shimmy’s first top 40 hit.
paras.zh: 《I'm Spent》是 Drake 5 月份的 HABIBTI 专辑中的佼佼者，该专辑在 Billboard Hot 100 中排名第 34 位（第 34 位），也是 Shimmy 首次进入前 40 名单曲。

paras.en: Back in 2014, Drake brought Usher out at OVO Fest and promised a collaboration in the works. However, the rumored collab titled “Slow Motion” never landed on either of the artists’ projects and leaked in 2020. Usher also made an appearance at the Atlanta show of Drizzy and Future’s Summer Sixteen Tour.
paras.zh: 早在 2014 年，Drake 就在 OVO Fest 上邀请了亚瑟小子，并承诺将进行合作。然而，传闻中的名为“Slow Motion”的合作从未出现在两位艺术家的项目中，并于 2020 年泄露。亚瑟小子还出现在 Drizy 和 Future 的夏季十六人巡回演唱会的亚特兰大演出中。

paras.en: Usher is still on the road with Chris Brown for the R&B Tour, which resumes on Thursday (Nov. 5) with the first of five shows in Atlanta, before heading to L.A.’s SoFi Stadium, New Orleans and Houston the rest of November.
paras.zh: 亚瑟小子仍在与克里斯·布朗一起参加 R&B 巡演，该巡演将于周四（11 月 5 日）恢复，五场演出中的第一场将在亚特兰大举行，然后在 11 月剩余时间前往洛杉矶的 SoFi 体育场、新奥尔良和休斯顿。

paras.en: According to Billboard Boxscore, the R&B Tour was the highest-grossing and best-selling tour of September, grossing $77.4 million and sold 423,000 tickets across 10 shows throughout the month. Usher and C. Breezy became the first co-headlining acts to share the No. 1 spot on the Top Tours chart.
paras.zh: 根据 Billboard Boxscore 的数据，R&B 巡演是 9 月份收入最高、销量最高的巡演，收入达 7,740 万美元，整个月共 10 场演出，售出 423,000 张门票。亚瑟小子 (Usher) 和 C. Breezy 成为首个在热门巡演排行榜上并列第一的联合领衔乐队。

paras.en: Listen to Usher’s “I’m Spent” remix, which he’s seemingly titling “U Spent” below.
paras.zh: 听听亚瑟小子的“I'm Spent”混音版，他似乎在下面将其命名为“U Spent”。

articles.title: Anderson .Paak & Cordae’s ‘Heavy Is the Crown’ Reigns on Top Rap Albums Chart
articles.author: Trevor Anderson

paras.en: Anderson .Paak and Cordae combine forces on their first collaborative set to reign on Billboard’s Top Rap Albums chart with Heavy Is the Crown. For each artist, the project becomes a first leader on the list.
paras.zh: Anderson .Paak 和 Cordae 在他们的第一张合作专辑中联手，以《Heavy Is the Crown》统治了 Billboard 的最佳说唱专辑排行榜。对于每位艺术家来说，该项目都成为名单上的第一名。

paras.en: Heavy Is the Crown launches with 30,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States for the tracking week of Oct. 23-29, according to Luminate. Album sales contributed 19,000 units to the total, streaming activity brought in 11,000 units, and there was a negligible amount of track-equivalent sales activity. (One unit equals the following levels of consumption: one album sale, 10 individual tracks sold from an album, or 1,000 paid/subscription tier or 2,500 ad-supported tier of official on-demand audio and video streams for a song on the album.)
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，《Heavy Is the Crown》在 10 月 23 日至 29 日的追踪周内在美国发行，获得了 30,000 份同等专辑销量。专辑销量为总销量贡献了 19,000 份，流媒体活动带来了 11,000 份，而与曲目相当的销售活动则微乎其微。 （一个单位等于以下消费水平：一张专辑销量、一张专辑中售出的 10 首单曲、或专辑中一首歌曲的 1,000 付费/订阅层或 2,500 层广告支持的官方点播音频和视频流。）

paras.en: Before the Crown coronation, Anderson .Paak reached Top Rap Albums with Yes Lawd!, under Nxwrries, his duo with producer Knxwledge, which reached No. 3 in November 2016, and Oxnard, which peaked at No. 5 in December 2018. The performer, whose music spans hip-hop, R&B and other genres, has also been a consistent R&B presence with his own albums, including Malibu and Ventura and via his Silk Sonic collaboration with Bruno Mars, whose An Evening With Silk Sonic album debuted at No. 1 on the Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart.
paras.zh: 在皇冠加冕之前，Anderson .Paak 凭借 Nxwrries 旗下的 Yes Lawd! 登上了顶级说唱专辑榜，Nxwrries 是他与制作人 Knxwledge 合作的二人组，该专辑于 2016 年 11 月达到了第 3 名，而 Oxnard 则在 2018 年 12 月达到了第 5 名。这位表演者的音乐跨越了嘻哈、R&B 和其他流派，在他自己的专辑中也一直保持着 R&B 风格，包括 Malibu 和Ventura 以及他与 Bruno Mars 的 Silk Sonic 合作，后者的《An Evening With Silk Sonic》专辑首次在顶级 R&B/Hip-Hop 专辑排行榜上排名第一。

paras.en: For Cordae, Heavy Is the Crown follows The Lost Boy, a No. 6 success in August 2019, and From a Birds Eye View, which earned a No. 4 best in January 2022.
paras.zh: 对于 Cordae 来说，《Heavy Is the Crown》是继 2019 年 8 月获得第六名的《迷失的男孩》和 2022 年 1 月获得第四名的《鸟瞰》之后推出的。

paras.en: Elsewhere, the new collaborative album opens at No. 2 on Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums and No. 11 on the all-genre Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 此外，这张新的合作专辑在热门 R&B/Hip-Hop 专辑中排名第 2，在所有类型的 Billboard 200 专辑中排名第 11。

paras.en: “Airbender” leads the album’s 11 tracks in terms of songs performance, with a No. 21 debut on Hot Rap Songs. With 2.4 million official U.S. on-demand streams, it was the album’s most-streamed song of the week. The entrance secures Anderson .Paak’s first entry on Hot Rap Songs, while Cordae lands his fourth; he first arrived when he and Jack Harlow featured on Eminem’s “Killer,” a No. 16 hit in August 2021, and followed with a NF collaboration (“Careful,” No. 20 in April 2023) and a teamup with Lyrical Lemonade and Juice WRLD (“Doomsday.,” No. 15 in July 2023).
paras.zh: 《Airbender》在歌曲表现方面领先专辑中的 11 首歌曲，首次亮相就在热门说唱歌曲中排名第 21 位。该专辑在美国官方点播流媒体播放量达到 240 万次，成为本周播放量最多的歌曲。此次入场让 Anderson .Paak 首次登上热门说唱歌曲，而 Cordae 则获得了第四次；他第一次出现是在与 Jack Harlow 合作出演 Eminem 的《Killer》（2021 年 8 月排名第 16 名），随后与 NF 合作（《Careful》，2023 年 4 月排名第 20），以及与 Lyrical Lemonade 和 Juice WRLD 合作（《Doomsday.》，2023 年 7 月排名第 15）。

articles.title: Notorious B.I.G. Estate Ruling, My Chemical Romance Case, Drake Lawsuit & More Music Law News
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: THE BIG STORY: A messy lawsuit over The Notorious B.I.G. got a final ruling, but a broader legal war over the rap legend’s estate is far from over.
paras.zh: 大故事：针对臭名昭著的 B.I.G. 的一场混乱诉讼。得到了最终裁决，但围绕这位说唱传奇人物遗产的更广泛的法律战争还远未结束。

paras.en: A judge ruled last week that Biggie’s widow Faith Evans must immediately distribute $14 million in estate profits to a trust set up by his late mother, Voletta Wallace, before she died last year. Much of the disputed money came from the estate’s landmark 2025 catalog deal with Primary Wave, which acquired a stake in the iconic rapper’s copyrights and likeness rights.
paras.zh: 法官上周裁定，比吉的遗孀费思·埃文斯 (Faith Evans) 必须立即将 1400 万美元的遗产利润分配给他已故母亲沃莱塔·华莱士 (Voletta Wallace) 在去年去世前设立的信托基金。大部分有争议的资金来自该遗产管理机构与 Primary Wave 达成的具有里程碑意义的 2025 年目录协议，Primary Wave 收购了这位标志性说唱歌手的版权和肖像权的股份。

paras.en: The monetary judgment resolved a case filed by Wayne Barrow, Biggie’s former manager who runs that trust, that claimed Evans was refusing to recognize that the group had inherited Voletta’s 25 percent cut of estate profits. It followed an August ruling in which the judge sided decisively with Barrow on that dispute — even quoting from Biggie’s posthumous track “Ten Crack Commandments.”
paras.zh: 这项货币判决解决了比吉的前经理韦恩·巴罗（Wayne Barrow）提起的诉讼，该经理负责管理该信托基金，该诉讼声称埃文斯拒绝承认该集团继承了沃莱塔 25% 的遗产利润。八月份的一项裁决中，法官在这一争议上果断地站在了巴罗一边，甚至引用了比吉死后的歌曲《十条完美戒律》。

paras.en: “Wallace presciently cautioned: ‘Keep your family and business completely separated,’” wrote the judge. “After Wallace’s tragic death, however, his mother and widow did exactly the opposite.”
paras.zh: “华莱士有先见之明地告诫说：‘让你的家庭和事业完全分开，’”法官写道。 “然而，华莱士惨死后，他的母亲和遗孀却做了完全相反的事情。”

paras.en: Barring reversal on appeal, last week’s ruling will end the lawsuit between Barrow and Evans. But it won’t resolve a separate case, filed by Biggie’s son CJ, that claims Barrow manipulated Voletta into giving him complete control of her estate before she died. The manager has denied those accusations and claimed CJ’s lawsuit was engineered by Evans, which her lawyers deny.
paras.zh: 除非上诉推翻，上周的裁决将结束巴罗和埃文斯之间的诉讼。但这并不能解决比吉的儿子 CJ 提起的另一起案件，该案件声称巴罗操纵沃莱塔在她去世前完全控制了她的财产。经理否认了这些指控，并声称 CJ 的诉讼是埃文斯策划的，但她的律师否认了这一点。

paras.en: That case remains in the earliest stages, meaning that even after last week’s big ruling, we still have months or years of legal battles ahead over the final affairs of The Notorious B.I.G. Stay tuned.
paras.zh: 该案仍处于早期阶段，这意味着即使在上周的重大裁决之后，我们仍然需要数月或数年的时间来围绕臭名昭著的 B.I.G. 的最终事务展开法律斗争。敬请关注。

paras.en: — Following Lil Durk’s murder-for-hire acquittal, Jay-Z and J. Cole urged a judge to release the rapper on bail as he awaits a second trial on racketeering charges: “Release would allow [Durk] to support his family and continue the work in his community that I saw firsthand,” Hov wrote.
paras.zh: — 在 Lil Durk 的雇佣谋杀案被无罪释放后，Jay-Z 和 J. Cole 敦促法官将这位说唱歌手保释，等待他因敲诈勒索指控进行的第二次审判：“释放将使 [Durk] 能够养活他的家人，并继续在我亲眼所见的社区中开展工作，”Hov 写道。

paras.en: — A lawsuit filed against My Chemical Romance by the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders quickly ended after the band promised it wouldn’t use look-alike uniforms in future shows. But later court filings claimed that had actually always been the plan — and that the lawsuit didn’t factor in.
paras.zh: — 达拉斯牛仔啦啦队对 My Chemical Romance 提起的诉讼很快就结束了，因为乐队承诺在未来的演出中不会使用相似的制服。但后来的法庭文件声称，这实际上一直是计划——而且诉讼并未考虑在内。

paras.en: — The headline-grabbing copyright case accusing Drake of stealing the chorus of his smash single “Janice STFU” was abruptly dropped, two weeks after it was filed and after Drake’s team accused the plaintiff of fabricating evidence. Nothing to see here, surely.
paras.zh: — 指控德雷克窃取其热门单曲“Janice STFU”副歌的引人注目的版权案在立案两周后以及德雷克团队指控原告伪造证据后突然被撤销。当然，这里没什么可看的。

paras.en: — A judge ruled Universal Music Group (UMG) has legal standing to keep pursuing a legal battle demanding the return of what the label has called the “first known” recording of The Beatles from the estate of a famed Abbey Road sound engineer.
paras.zh: — 一名法官裁定环球音乐集团 (UMG) 拥有法律地位，可以继续提起法律诉讼，要求归还来自著名艾比路音响工程师遗产的披头士乐队所谓的“第一张已知”唱片。

paras.en: — The war between Michael Jackson’s daughter Paris and estate executor John Branca heated up — first with her accusation that he wants to pay himself more than $100 million, then with her demand that the estate distribute $600 million to a family trust. Those are … big numbers.
paras.zh: — The war between Michael Jackson’s daughter Paris and estate executor John Branca heated up — first with her accusation that he wants to pay himself more than $100 million, then with her demand that the estate distribute $600 million to a family trust.这些都是……很大的数字。

paras.en: — Timbaland sued his former manager and business manager — both well-known industry professionals — in a $15 million lawsuit that claims the pair committed widespread misconduct in order to “enrich themselves” at the star’s expense.
paras.zh: — 蒂姆巴兰在一场价值 1500 万美元的诉讼中起诉了他的前经理和业务经理（两位都是知名的行业专业人士），声称两人犯下了广泛的不当行为，以便以牺牲这位明星的利益为代价“丰富自己”。

paras.en: — Florida prosecutors dropped a felony charge over domestic violence accusations against Rick Ross, though he still faces a misdemeanor battery charge over the alleged August incident involving then-girlfriend Jazzma Kendrick.
paras.zh: - 佛罗里达州检察官撤销了对里克·罗斯的家庭暴力指控的重罪指控，但他仍然因涉嫌八月份涉及当时女友贾兹玛·肯德里克的事件而面临轻罪殴打指控。

paras.en: — As UMG and Sony Music continue battling Suno in court over AI training, both sides have fought legal skirmishes to gather evidence from other key market players, including Apple Music, the Mechanical Licensing Collective and Suno’s VC investors.
paras.zh: — 随着 UMG 和索尼音乐继续在法庭上就 AI 培训与 Suno 展开斗争，双方展开了法律冲突，以从其他主要市场参与者（包括 Apple Music、Mechanical Licensing Collective 和 Suno 的风险投资者）收集证据。

articles.title: Chris Rock Gets Real on Giving Up Porn and Moving Past the “Crazy Night” of the Oscar Slap
articles.author: Chris Gardner

paras.en: Chris Rock covers a lot of ground in his new GQ cover story — the first of the magazine’s Men of the Year honorees to be unveiled this year — opening up on the dissolution of his marriage and what porn had to do with it, why he makes smaller, tailored films like his new one, Misty Green, the future of his stand-up career and, of course, the infamous Oscar incident when he was slapped by Will Smith onstage.
paras.zh: 克里斯·洛克 (Chris Rock) 在他的新《GQ》封面故事中涵盖了​​很多内容，这是今年即将揭晓的该杂志年度最佳男性获奖者中的第一个，讲述了他的婚姻破裂以及色情片与此有何关系，为什么他会制作规模较小、量身定制的电影，例如他的新电影《迷雾绿》(Misty Green)，他的单口喜剧生涯的未来，当然还有臭名昭著的奥斯卡事件，当时他在台上被威尔·史密斯(Will Smith)扇了一巴掌。

paras.en: Of the latter subject, he’s just ready to be done talking about it. “Yeah. Something happened. It wasn’t cool. And I would like to move on. I would like to — I had a nice career before it, and I know there’s a part of that that’s going to follow me the rest of my life,” Rock told GQ’s senior special correspondent Zach Baron. “I got jokes. I got scripts. I got movie scripts. I got TV shows. I’m writing a book. I’m doing shit. I have a plethora of art I’m trying to get out, and that’s what I want you to pay attention to, not some crazy night.”
paras.zh: 对于后一个话题，他正准备说完。 “是的。发生了一些事情。这并不酷。我想继续前进。我想——我之前有过一份不错的职业生涯，我知道其中一部分将伴随我一生，”洛克告诉《GQ》高级特约记者扎克·巴伦。 “我有笑话。我有剧本。我有电影剧本。我有电视节目。我正在写一本书。我正在做狗屎。我有大量的艺术作品我想摆脱，这就是我希望你关注的，而不是某个疯狂的夜晚。”

paras.en: That said, Rock has come to accept being asked personal questions these days due to living in a “gossipy” culture. “We live in a world where Andy Cohen is Norman Lear and Ryan Murphy is Steven Spielberg. That is the world we live in. So people want gossip. We’re righteous people that follow nine commandments. And the one commandment we don’t follow is thou shall not spread false witness. We are all about spreading false witness now. That is the world we live in. And that’s what journalism, or at least entertainment journalism, has become,” he explained.
paras.zh: 也就是说，由于生活在“八卦”文化中，洛克现在已经开始接受被问到个人问题。 “我们生活在一个安迪·科恩是诺曼·李尔，瑞安·墨菲是史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的世界。这就是我们生活的世界。所以人们想要八卦。我们是遵守九诫的正义之人。我们不遵守的一条诫命是你不得散布假证。我们现在都在散布假证。这就是我们生活的世界。这就是新闻业，或者至少是娱乐新闻业，已经变成了这样，”他解释道。

paras.en: And he played the game with Baron, dishing on his divorce from ex-wife Malaak Compton-Rock after 19 years of marriage.
paras.zh: 他还与巴伦玩起了游戏，对自己与前妻马拉克·康普顿-洛克结婚19年后离婚表示不满。

paras.en: “Nobody has a successful divorce, so that takes time. Then once it’s done, you’re not sitting on the money you had before, so now you got to really make some money. So you go on tour, or two tours. So there was a lot of stand-up. There was a lot of getting my life together. You got a pandemic, you got a bunch of nonsense going on there,” he revealed as he also took responsibility for the fracture. “I was not a great husband. I watched a lot of porn. I don’t watch porn anymore. I haven’t watched porn in five, six years.”
paras.zh: “没有人能成功离婚，所以这需要时间。一旦离婚，你就不能坐拥以前的钱了，所以现在你必须真正赚到一些钱。所以你要去巡演，或者两次巡演。所以有很多单口相声。有很多让我的生活恢复正常的事情。你遇到了流行病，那里发生了一堆废话，”他透露，他也对骨折负责。 “我不是一个好丈夫。我看了很多色情片。我不再看色情片了。我已经五六年没看过色情片了。”

paras.en: He did more work on himself than just cutting porn from his life, too, by going to therapy in an emotional state. “We do have this thing where everybody’s like — they brag about their therapy. Put it this way, my personal life wasn’t what I wanted it to be, and I’ll leave it at that. And that’s my relationship with everybody. So yeah, I went in there crying like a bitch. Like: What the fuck is going on?”
paras.zh: 他还通过在情绪状态下接受治疗，对自己做了更多的工作，而不仅仅是将色情内容从他的生活中剔除。 “我们确实有这样的事情，每个人都喜欢——他们吹嘘自己的治疗。这样说吧，我的个人生活不是我想要的，我就这样吧。这就是我和每个人的关系。所以，是的，我进去时哭得像个婊子。就像：他妈的到底发生了什么事？”

paras.en: Looking ahead to the future, Rock, whose new film Misty Green hits Netflix on Nov. 9 after debuting in theaters via A24 last month, has plans to direct more feature films and possibly hit the stage again at some point.
paras.zh: 展望未来，洛克的新片《迷雾绿》上个月通过 A24 在影院首映，并于 11 月 9 日登陆 Netflix。洛克计划执导更多故事片，并可能在某个时候再次登上舞台。

paras.en: “I got like six, seven specials, man. That’s a lot. So I don’t know. I’m not announcing anything or anything, but if I do it, I want to do it right. In sports, especially in football, they always talk about separation. ‘Can he get separation?’ You know what I mean? ‘Yeah, he’s fast, but is he fast enough? Can he get separation?’ And that’s the way I feel, like, as far as stand-up. As long as I can get separation, I’ll do it,” he noted. “I’m going to write. That’s basically what it boils down to. Wake up, write. That’s it. Just write, write, write, write, write. Get it all out.”
paras.zh: “我有六、七个特别节目，伙计。那很多了。所以我不知道。我不会宣布任何事情或任何事情，但如果我这样做，我想做得对。在体育界，尤其是在足球界，他们总是谈论分离。‘他能分离吗？’你知道我的意思吗？‘是的，他很快，但他足够快吗？他能分离吗？’这就是我的感觉，就像单口喜剧一样。只要我能分开，我就会这么做，”他指出。 “我要写。基本上就是这样。醒醒，写。就这样。写，写，写，写，写。把它全部写出来。”

paras.en: Rock’s full interview with Baron, which is also featured in the writer’s interview series “One More Question,” can be found here.
paras.zh: 洛克对巴伦的完整采访也出现在作者的采访系列“还有一个问题”中，可以在这里找到。

articles.title: Nicolas Cage Says He’s “a Little Bit Homeless” After Sinkhole Damaged His Malibu Home
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Nicolas Cage is sharing an update on his living situation after a massive sinkhole damaged his $10.5 million beachfront mansion in Malibu in September, leading him to stay in hotels.
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯·凯奇 (Nicolas Cage) 分享了他在马里布价值 1,050 万美元的海滨豪宅 9 月份发生的巨大天坑损坏后的最新生活状况，导致他只能住在酒店里。

paras.en: The sinkhole opened on Sept. 8, reaching about 25 feet deep and measuring 30 by 60 feet. The collapse swallowed part of the driveway and damaged the deck of the Spider-Noir actor’s property. The damage also prompted the evacuation of 31 properties in the area, including Cage’s, after the collapse restricted access for residents and emergency responders.
paras.zh: 天坑于 9 月 8 日打开，深约 25 英尺，尺寸为 30 x 60 英尺。倒塌吞没了部分车道，并损坏了这位《黑蜘蛛》演员房产的甲板。由于倒塌限制了居民和紧急救援人员的出入，此次破坏还促使该地区 31 处房产（包括 Cage 的房产）撤离。

paras.en: On Saturday, Cage attended a panel at Los Angeles Comic Con, where he was asked about his Halloween plans. “I’m currently a little bit homeless,” he said. “Something happened to my house in Malibu, so I’m just sort of living in hotels, so I don’t have normal trick-or-treaters I would like to enjoy tonight.”
paras.zh: 周六，凯奇参加了洛杉矶动漫展的一个小组，会上他被问及他的万圣节计划。 “我现在有点无家可归，”他说。 “我在马里布的房子发生了什么事，所以我只是住在酒店里，所以今晚我不想玩普通的“不给糖就捣蛋”游戏。”

paras.en: The collapse also prompted concerns about a gas leak in the area. Malibu officials declared a local emergency, warning that conditions could worsen because of high tides and rain associated with Hurricane Marie. No injuries were reported.
paras.zh: 倒塌事件还引发了对该地区煤气泄漏的担忧。马里布官员宣布当地进入紧急状态，并警告说，由于飓风玛丽带来的涨潮和降雨，情况可能会恶化。没有人员受伤的报告。

paras.en: Despite the unusual Halloween circumstances, Cage still planned to celebrate the holiday with his 4-year-old daughter, August Francesca Coppola Cage.
paras.zh: 尽管万圣节情况不寻常，凯奇仍然计划与他 4 岁的女儿奥古斯特·弗朗西斯卡·科波拉·凯奇一起庆祝这个节日。

paras.en: “I’ll take my daughter out trick-or-treating somewhere in Santa Monica, but I am going to watch a movie where the director was actually nominated for worst director at the Razzies — called The Shining,” Cage said at L.A. Comic Con. “He directed the hell out of that movie. I’m going to watch that tonight. After I put my daughter to bed, I’m going to put on The Shining.”
paras.zh: “我会带我女儿去圣莫尼卡的某个地方玩“不给糖就捣蛋”的游戏，但我会看一部导演实际上被提名为金酸莓奖最差导演的电影——《闪灵》，”凯奇在洛杉矶动漫展上说道。 “他导演了那部电影。我今晚要去看那部电影。让我女儿上床睡觉后，我要去看《闪灵》。”

articles.title: ‘Prep’ Series Based on Curtis Sittenfeld Bestseller a Go at Netflix
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: Netflix is expanding its YA slate with a straight-to-series order for Prep, based on the best-selling novel by Curtis Sittenfeld.
paras.zh: Netflix 将根据柯蒂斯·西滕菲尔德 (Curtis Sittenfeld) 的畅销小说改编的《Prep》直接订购剧集，以扩大其青少年版剧目。

paras.en: Nicole Taylor (One Day) will adapt the novel and serve as showrunner on the series, which centers on a girl from Indiana who attends a prestigious boarding school in Massachusetts. Taylor will executive produce with Will Ferrell, Jessica Elbaum, and Alix Taylor of Gloria Sanchez Productions and Sittenfeld.
paras.zh: 妮可·泰勒（《一日》）将改编这部小说并担任该剧的制片人，该剧以一名来自印第安纳州的女孩在马萨诸塞州一所著名寄宿学校就读为中心。泰勒将与格洛丽亚·桑切斯制作公司和西滕菲尔德的威尔·法雷尔、杰西卡·艾尔鲍姆和阿利克斯·泰勒一起担任监制。

paras.en: “Prep is my all time favorite novel, and I have longed to adapt it for the entire 20 years since I first read it and found myself reflected uncannily back,” said Nicole Taylor in a statement. “There is no more acute depiction of the introspective, bookish self-conscious adolescent girl and no more truthful or excoriating take on the perils of social mobility than in Curtis Sittenfeld’s beautiful first novel. I am overjoyed to be adapting for Netflix.”
paras.zh: 妮可·泰勒在一份声明中表示：“《准备》是我一直以来最喜欢的小说，自从我第一次读到它以来，我整整 20 年都渴望改编它，并发现自己不可思议地得到了反映。” “柯蒂斯·西滕菲尔德优美的第一部小说对内省、书卷气、自我意识强烈的青春期女孩进行了最尖锐的描述，对社会流动性危险的真实或严厉的描述也没有比这更真实或严厉的了。我很高兴能够改编成 Netflix 的作品。”

paras.en: Prep was published in 2005 and became a bestseller while also earning critical acclaim. The novel and the series center on Lee Fiora, a scholarship student at the Ault school, as she makes her way through high school as an outsider among more privileged classmates.
paras.zh: 《Prep》于 2005 年出版，成为畅销书，同时也赢得了评论界的好评。这部小说和剧集以奥尔特学校的奖学金生李·菲奥拉为中心，她以局外人的身份在更有特权的同学中度过了高中生活。

paras.en: “I’m overjoyed that Netflix is making Prep as a TV show — the 22-year wait was worth it! Alix Taylor at Gloria Sanchez has guided the project forward with such intelligence and enthusiasm, and Nicole Taylor’s scripts are truly brilliant. Nicole’s adaptation makes me understand my own novel, and myself, better. My 51-year-old self can’t wait to see what they do with this story of privilege, longing, and teen angst.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴 Netflix 能够将《Prep》制作成电视剧，22 年的等待是值得的！格洛丽亚·桑切斯的阿利克斯·泰勒以如此智慧和热情指导了这个项目的发展，而妮可·泰勒的剧本确实非常出色。妮可的改编让我更好地了解了我自己的小说，也让我更好地了解了我自己。我 51 岁的我迫不及待地想看看他们如何处理这个关于特权、渴望和青少年焦虑的故事。”

paras.en: Prep looks to be the first adaptation of one of Sittenfeld’s novels to reach the screen. New Line and Hello Sunshine are developing a film based on her 2024 book Romantic Comedy. Hulu in 2020 took a run at Rodham, a novel in which Hillary Rodham never marries Bill Clinton, but the project didn’t move past the development stage.
paras.zh: 《准备》似乎是第一部改编自西滕菲尔德小说的电影。新线影业和你好阳光正在根据她 2024 年出版的《浪漫喜剧》一书制作一部电影。 2020 年，Hulu 与罗德姆（Rodham）进行了竞争，该小说中希拉里·罗德姆（Hillary Rodham）从未与比尔·克林顿（Bill Clinton）结婚，但该项目并未超越开发阶段。

articles.title: Sen. Chris Murphy still hospitalized after suffering a stroke over the weekend

paras.en: Sen. Chris Murphy remained hospitalized Tuesday after suffering a stroke over the weekend, his office confirmed.
paras.zh: 参议员克里斯·墨菲的办公室证实，他在周末中风后于周二仍在医院接受治疗。

paras.en: "He's continuing to improve and heartened by the outpouring of well wishes," Josh Sorbe, Murphy's communications director, told CNBC in an emailed statement. "He early voted in Connecticut, and he encourages everyone to make their voices heard today by voting and sending a message in this defining election."
paras.zh: 墨菲的公关总监乔什·索布 (Josh Sorbe) 在一份电子邮件声明中告诉 CNBC：“他的进步不断提高，人们的良好祝愿让他深受鼓舞。” “他很早就在康涅狄格州投票，他鼓励每个人今天通过投票并在这场决定性的选举中发出信息来表达自己的声音。”

paras.en: His office did not offer additional details when asked about his status or his expected recovery.
paras.zh: 当被问及他的状况或预期康复情况时，他的办公室没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: The Senate is due back in session Monday following Tuesday's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 参议院将于周二中期选举后于周一重新开会。

paras.en: Murphy began experiencing stroke symptoms on Saturday while at his son's hockey game, his chief of staff Allison Herwitt said in a statement Sunday.
paras.zh: 墨菲的幕僚长艾莉森·赫威特周日在一份声明中表示，墨菲于周六在儿子的曲棍球比赛中开始出现中风症状。

paras.en: "He was taken to a local hospital, where it was discovered he had experienced a stroke. He was transferred to Johns Hopkins for further monitoring and is responding well to treatment," Herwitt said.
paras.zh: 赫威特说：“他被送往当地一家医院，在那里发现他中风了。他被转移到约翰·霍普金斯大学接受进一步监测，并且对治疗反应良好。”

paras.en: Herwitt said at the time that Murphy was "awake and alert."
paras.zh: 赫威特当时表示墨菲“清醒且警觉”。

paras.en: Johns Hopkins Hospital's main campus is in Baltimore, though it has other locations in and around Washington.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯医院的主院位于巴尔的摩，但在华盛顿及其周边地区也有其他地点。

paras.en: Murphy is not up for reelection on Tuesday but had been traveling extensively this fall in support of Democratic candidates. Murphy came to the Senate in 2013 after a six-year stint in the U.S. House. He's also been mentioned as a potential 2028 presidential candidate.
paras.zh: 墨菲周二不会竞选连任，但今年秋天一直在广泛旅行以支持民主党候选人。墨菲在美国众议院任职六年后于 2013 年进入参议院。他还被认为是 2028 年总统候选人的潜在候选人。

articles.title: Midterm elections 2026 live updates: Economy, inflation and other voter concerns

paras.en: Voters are at the polls on Tuesday, Nov. 3 to decide control of Congress, in an election that could define President Donald Trump's final years in office.
paras.zh: 选民将于 11 月 3 日星期二进行投票，决定国会的控制权，这场选举可能决定唐纳德·特朗普总统的最后几年任期。

paras.en: All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are at stake, as Republicans try to defend narrow majorities in both chambers despite strong headwinds. Voter frustration with Trump's war in Iran, inflation, perceived government corruption and immigration policy could weigh down Republicans this cycle. But Republicans have the bulk of billionaire campaign spending, and Democrats have faced drama in the Alaska and Michigan Senate races in the waning days of campaigning.
paras.zh: 尽管面临强大的阻力，共和党仍试图捍卫参众两院的微弱多数席位，所有 435 个众议院席位和 35 个参议院席位都岌岌可危。选民对特朗普的伊朗战争、通货膨胀、政府腐败和移民政策感到沮丧，可能会给共和党带来压力。但共和党人拥有亿万富翁竞选开支的大部分，而民主党人在竞选活动的最后几天在阿拉斯加州和密歇根州参议员竞选中面临着戏剧性的局面。

paras.en: FiftyPlusOne projects Democrats have a significant edge in the House and are favored in the Senate, with key races tightening in recent weeks.
paras.zh: FiftyPlusOne 预计民主党在众议院拥有显着优势，并在参议院受到青睐，最近几周关键竞选愈演愈烈。

paras.en: In the Senate, races in deep-red states such as Kansas, South Carolina and Nebraska could be in play, according to recent projections. Republicans could win in traditional Democratic strongholds such as Minnesota and New Hampshire. And toss-up races in states including Alaska, Iowa, Maine, Michigan, Ohio and Texas will determine who wins the gavels next Congress.
paras.zh: 根据最近的预测，在参议院，堪萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州和内布拉斯加州等深红色州的竞选可能会进行。共和党可能会在明尼苏达州和新罕布什尔州等民主党传统据点获胜。阿拉斯加州、爱荷华州、缅因州、密歇根州、俄亥俄州和德克萨斯州等州的激烈角逐将决定谁赢得下届国会的木槌。

paras.en: In the House, Republicans will find out if partisan redistricting in states including Texas and Florida that they'd hoped would net them nine seats actually pans out. And Democrats, who are hoping for a blue wave year, will try to knock off GOP candidates in districts that in past cycles were seen as out of reach.
paras.zh: 在众议院，共和党人将了解德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州等州的党派重新划分是否能够真正实现，他们希望这能让他们获得九个席位。希望迎来蓝色浪潮年的民主党人将试图在过去周期中被认为遥不可及的地区击败共和党候选人。

paras.en: A Democratic win in either or both chambers would end unified Republican rule in Washington, disrupt the president's legislative agenda and begin a period of Democratic oversight and investigations aimed at the Trump administration, his associates and companies that have cozied up over the past two years.
paras.zh: 民主党若在参众两院取得胜利，将结束共和党在华盛顿的统一统治，扰乱总统的立法议程，并开始一段时期的民主党监督和调查，目标是特朗普政府、他的同伙以及过去两年里一直合作的公司。

paras.en: The Trump administration's monthslong campaign to challenge how states conduct elections and push back against those efforts come to a head as well. The Justice Department said Tuesday it's sending about 1,000 election observers and monitors to all 50 states, a broader effort than the agency has ever deployed before.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府长达数月的挑战各州选举方式并抵制这些努力的运动也达到了紧要关头。美国司法部周二表示，将向全美 50 个州派遣约 1,000 名选举观察员和监察员，这一力度比该机构以往部署的范围更广。

paras.en: The Associated Press provides vote data and race projections for CNBC. Polls will begin to close at 6 p.m. ET, with Alaska being the last to close at 1 a.m. ET. Check back for Election Day updates and race calls throughout the night as results come in.
paras.zh: 美联社为 CNBC 提供投票数据和竞选预测。投票将于下午 6 点开始结束。东部时间，阿拉斯加是最后一个收盘时间为东部时间凌晨 1 点。当结果出来时，请整夜查看选举日更新和比赛电话。

articles.title: Crude oil prices fall for second day as market hopes for diplomatic resolution to Iran war

paras.en: Crude oil prices fell Tuesday for a second consecutive session, as the market hopes the U.S. and Iran will reach a diplomatic settlement to the conflict that has disrupted global energy supplies for eight months.
paras.zh: 周二原油价格连续第二个交易日下跌，因市场希望美国和伊朗能够就这场已扰乱全球能源供应八个月的冲突达成外交解决方案。

paras.en: U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures lost 37 cents to close at $96.09 a barrel after dipping below $95 earlier in the session. Brent crude, the international benchmark, shed $1.17 to settle at $103.60.
paras.zh: 美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货下跌 37 美分，收于每桶 96.09 美元，此前盘中曾跌破 95 美元。国际基准布伦特原油下跌 1.17 美元，收于 103.60 美元。

paras.en: The move lower came after rumors circulated the U.S. and Iran were making progress toward a deal.
paras.zh: 在有传言称美国和伊朗正在达成协议方面取得进展之后，油价下跌。

paras.en: Oil sold off more than 7% on Monday after Washington and Tehran signaled they were both open to discussions to reach a settlement. President Donald Trump told reporters Tehran wants "to make a deal and that could happen."
paras.zh: 在华盛顿和德黑兰表示愿意进行讨论以达成和解后，周一石油价格下跌逾 7%。唐纳德·特朗普总统告诉记者，德黑兰希望“达成协议，这可能会发生”。

paras.en: Qatar is continuing to mediate talks between the U.S. and Iran, the Gulf state's foreign ministry said Tuesday. A delegation from Qatar held talks in Tehran in an effort to reach an agreement that prevents further escalation in the region and ends the U.S.-Iran conflict, the foreign ministry said.
paras.zh: 海湾国家外交部周二表示，卡塔尔正在继续斡旋美国和伊朗之间的谈判。外交部表示，卡塔尔代表团在德黑兰举行会谈，以期达成一项协议，防止该地区局势进一步升级并结束美伊冲突。

paras.en: However, Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Emsaeil Baqaei said Tuesday that Tehran will not accept diplomacy based on coercion, according to the state-owned media outlet Islamic Republic News Agency. It was unclear where talks actual stand.
paras.zh: 然而，据国有媒体伊斯兰共和国通讯社报道，伊朗外交部发言人埃姆萨伊尔·巴卡伊周二表示，德黑兰不会接受基于胁迫的外交。目前尚不清楚谈判的实际进展。

paras.en: The market had been pricing in the risk of escalation after the U.S. midterm elections, as reports circulated that Washington was drafting plans for strikes on Iran. Crude prices gained more than 10% in October in response.
paras.zh: 由于有报道称华盛顿正在起草针对伊朗的打击计划，市场一直在消化美国中期选举后局势升级的风险。作为回应，10 月份原油价格上涨超过 10%。

paras.en: The situation in the Middle East remains volatile and there's still substantial risk that fighting could break out. Washington attacked Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, U.S. officials told The Wall Street Journal, adding that the U.S. has been carrying out "limited strikes" against the country in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 中东局势依然动荡，爆发战斗的风险仍然很大。 Washington attacked Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, U.S. officials told The Wall Street Journal, adding that the U.S. has been carrying out "limited strikes" against the country in recent weeks.

paras.en: The military campaign against Iran has been kept deliberately low-profile to avoid signaling plans for a major escalation in fighting, the report said, quoting an unnamed official.
paras.zh: 报道援引一位未透露姓名的官员的话称，针对伊朗的军事行动一直刻意保持低调，以避免发出战斗大幅升级计划的信号。

paras.en: And commercial ships continue to come under attack in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman. At least four ship attacks have been reported since the start of the month, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Centre.
paras.zh: 波斯湾、霍尔木兹海峡和阿曼湾的商船继续受到攻击。据英国海事贸易运营中心称，自本月初以来，已报告至少发生四起船舶袭击事件。

paras.en: Despite these attacks, the Trump administration has also been touting a possible diplomatic solution to the conflict, with Vice President JD Vance telling CNN, "The president and I both feel really good about the prospect of potentially coming to a negotiated settlement."
paras.zh: 尽管有这些攻击，特朗普政府也一直在宣扬可能通过外交手段解决冲突，副总统 JD 万斯告诉 CNN，“总统和我都对通过谈判达成解决方案的前景感到非常满意。”

paras.en: On Sunday, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Trump would like to resolve the Iranian war "diplomatically," and prefers not to use military force.
paras.zh: 周日，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，特朗普希望通过“外交”方式解决伊朗战争，并且不愿使用军事力量。

paras.en: High oil prices have contributed substantially to inflation and high gasoline prices in the U.S., which have become a cause of concern for Trump ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 高油价严重推高了美国的通货膨胀和汽油价格，成为中期选举前特朗普担忧的一个问题。

paras.en: Last week, two Federal Reserve presidents said interest rates will need to move higher to rein in inflation. Higher rates generally crimp growth and raise costs for consumers, but help to bring down inflation.
paras.zh: 上周，两位美联储主席表示，需要提高利率以抑制通胀。较高的利率通常会抑制经济增长并增加消费者的成本，但有助于降低通货膨胀。

paras.en: — CNBC's Priyanka Salve contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Priyanka Salve 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Inca children were given hallucinogens before they were sacrificed to the gods

paras.en: The ancient Inca sacrificed children who were drugged with cocaine, a powerful hallucinogen and, in some cases, alcohol, according to a new study in Antiquity. The discovery reveals new macabre details of how these ancient peoples chose to honor their gods.
paras.zh: 根据《古代》杂志的一项新研究，古代印加人会宰杀那些服用了可卡因（一种强致幻剂）的儿童，在某些情况下还服用了酒精。这一发现揭示了这些古代民族如何选择尊崇他们的神祇的新的令人毛骨悚然的细节。

paras.en: During the reign of the Inca Empire, which spanned a large territory in western South America from the 13th to the 16th centuries, children and young women were regularly sacrificed to important gods in a ceremony known as capacocha. They were meant to act as messengers between the living and the deities. The rituals were conducted in an effort to restore stability after events such as a famine or drought. Before they were killed, those chosen for sacrifice were taken to Cusco, the capital of the Inca Empire, or to temples or oracles scattered throughout the territory.
paras.zh: 印加帝国从 13 世纪到 16 世纪横跨南美洲西部大片领土，在其统治期间，儿童和年轻妇女会定期在名为“capacocha”的仪式中祭祀重要的神灵。他们的作用是充当生者与神灵之间的使者。举行这些仪式是为了在饥荒或干旱等事件发生后恢复稳定。在被杀之前，那些被选中作为祭品的人会被带到印加帝国的首都库斯科，或者分散在各地的寺庙或神谕处。

paras.en: As they were prepared, the children were given an array of psychoactive plants. Though previous studies had found that these included coca leaves—from which cocaine is derived—tests for other substances had been largely inconclusive or negative.
paras.zh: 当他们做好准备时，孩子们得到了一系列具有精神活性的植物。尽管之前的研究发现这些物质中包括古柯叶（可卡因就是从古柯叶中提取出来的），但对其他物质的测试基本上没有结论或呈阴性。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “Our aim was to identify a broader range of psychoactive substances administered to the children and to determine whether patterns in their use could provide new insights into how capacocha ceremonies were conducted at different locations,” said Dagmara Socha, an archaeologist at the University of Warsaw, in a statement. “Recent advances in toxicology now allow for the identification of low concentrations of such substances.”
paras.zh: 华沙大学考古学家达格马拉·索查（Dagmara Socha）在一份声明中表示：“我们的目的是确定给儿童服用的更广泛的精神活性物质，并确定其使用模式是否可以为了解不同地点如何举行卡帕科查仪式提供新的见解。” “毒理学的最新进展现在可以识别低浓度的此类物质。”

paras.en: When Socha and his team conducted toxicology exams on hair and nail samples from eight bodies discovered near several Inca sacrificial sites in Peru and Argentina, they found that each body had at least one intoxicant present. All the bodies contained traces of cocaine and benzoylecgonine, a chemical produced by the body as it metabolizes the drug. Cocaine may have been given to the children to help them deal with altitude sickness and fatigue as they climbed the mountains where the sacrifices took place.
paras.zh: 当索查和他的团队对在秘鲁和阿根廷的几个印加祭祀地点附近发现的八具尸体的头发和指甲样本进行毒理学检查时，他们发现每具尸体都至少含有一种麻醉剂。所有尸体都含有微量可卡因和苯甲酰爱康宁，苯甲酰爱康宁是人体代谢药物时产生的化学物质。孩子们可能被给予可卡因，以帮助他们在爬上举行祭祀的山峰时缓解高原反应和疲劳。

paras.en: Four of the mummified corpses also tested positive for alcohol, which likely came from drinking chicha, a beer made out of maize. Historical records show the drink was given to the children in order to calm them during the final parts of the ceremony.
paras.zh: 其中四具木乃伊尸体的酒精检测也呈阳性，这可能是因为喝了一种用玉米制成的啤酒“奇恰”。历史记录显示，在仪式的最后阶段，给孩子们喝这种饮料是为了让他们平静下来。

paras.en: One of the bodies contained traces of harmine—it has been found at one of the sites before, alongside a compound called harmaline. Both chemicals are found in the hallucinogen ayahuasca. “Harmine is an alkaloid associated with Banisteriopsis species, one of the principal plants traditionally used in the ayahuasca beverage,” Socha said. “It may indicate that a harmine-containing beverage had a specific role in ceremonies connected with this particular sacred mountain.”
paras.zh: 其中一具尸体含有去氢骆驼蓬碱的痕迹——以前曾在其中一个地点发现过这种物质，旁边还有一种名为骆驼蓬碱的化合物。这两种化学物质都存在于致幻剂死藤水中。 “Harmine 是一种与 Banisteriopsis 物种相关的生物碱，Banisteriopsis 是传统上用于死藤水饮料的主要植物之一，”Socha 说。 “这可能表明，一种含有去氢骆驼蓬碱的饮料在与这座特定圣山有关的仪式中具有特定的作用。”

paras.en: In the study, Socha and his colleagues didn’t rule out that additional substances that aren’t detectable with current technology may have also been given. But the differences in results in the bodies do show that the capacocha ceremony wasn’t uniform and could vary by geography and by which god was being venerated.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，索查和他的同事并不排除可能还给予了现有技术无法检测到的其他物质。但尸体结果的差异确实表明，卡帕科查仪式并不统一，可能会因地理位置和所崇拜的神而有所不同。

paras.en: “Five hundred years after these children were sacrificed during one of the most important Inca rituals, new technologies are allowing us to uncover details of their lives and Inca religious practices,” Socha said. “What we are seeing is that the capacocha was not a single standardized ritual, but rather, the Incas appear to have adapted it to different cults and local religious traditions.”
paras.zh: “这些孩子在最重要的印加仪式之一中被牺牲五百年后，新技术使我们能够揭示他们的生活和印加宗教习俗的细节，”索查说。 “我们看到的是，卡帕科查并不是一个单一的标准化仪式，印加人似乎已经将其适应了不同的邪教和当地宗教传统。”

articles.title: The most impractical calculator in the world only has two buttons

paras.en: In the past, calculating complex values such as the logarithm of a number required a great deal of time and patience, as well as the appropriate reference material. This work, though sometimes tedious, led to unexpected discoveries. For example, while leafing through tables of logarithms, astronomer Simon Newcomb noticed that the pages for values starting with the digit 1 were significantly more worn than the others. This observation ultimately led to the so-called Benford’s law, which describes how certain random numbers are distributed.
paras.zh: 过去，计算数字的对数等复杂值需要大量的时间和耐心，以及适当的参考材料。这项工作虽然有时很乏味，但却带来了意想不到的发现。例如，天文学家西蒙·纽科姆（Simon Newcomb）在翻阅对数表时注意到，以数字 1 开头的值的页面比其他页面磨损得更严重。这一观察结果最终导致了所谓的本福德定律，该定律描述了某些随机数是如何分布的。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Had calculators existed back then, Benford’s law might never have been discovered. Still, I personally am grateful that I didn’t have to wrestle with logarithm tables or other formula collections during my school years or university studies, or in my job. In fact, I wouldn’t want to be without my scientific calculator. It not only has important values such as pi or Euler’s number programmed in, but it also can calculate more complicated operations, such as the cube root or logarithm of a number, with just one press of a button.
paras.zh: 如果当时存在计算器，本福德定律可能永远不会被发现。尽管如此，我个人还是很庆幸的是，在我的学生时代、大学学习或工作中，我不必与对数表或其他公式集合作斗争。事实上，我不想没有我的科学计算器。它不仅可以编程输入圆周率或欧拉数等重要值，而且只需按一下按钮即可计算更复杂的运算，例如数字的立方根或对数。

paras.en: As physicist Andrzej Odrzywołek of Jagiellonian University in Poland explains in a preprint from March 2026, however, calculators could be designed much more simply: two buttons alone are sufficient to perform the elementary calculations and functions of a scientific calculator. Whether tangent, square root, pi or exponentiation, all these functions can be encoded using only the number 1 and the operator eml(x,y) = exp(x) − ln(y). His work has since been verified by a so-called proof checker, a computer program that goes through the logical conclusions step-by-step and checks whether everything is correct.
paras.zh: 然而，正如波兰雅盖隆大学的物理学家 Andrzej Odrzywołek 在 2026 年 3 月的预印本中所解释的那样，计算器的设计可以更加简单：仅两个按钮就足以执行科学计算器的基本计算和功能。无论是正切、平方根、pi 还是指数，所有这些函数都可以仅使用数字 1 和运算符 eml(x,y) = exp(x) − ln(y) 进行编码。此后，他的工作得到了所谓的证明检查器的验证，这是一种计算机程序，可以逐步检查逻辑结论并检查一切是否正确。

paras.en: Depending on the model, a calculator can perform tasks of varying complexity. Some models only handle the four basic arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Others are capable of evaluating trigonometric functions, extracting roots and calculating logarithms. I had access to such a calculator during my school years, for example. But I wasn’t allowed to use graphing calculators, which can also independently solve equations and represent functions geometrically.
paras.zh: 根据型号的不同，计算器可以执行不同复杂程度的任务。有些模型只处理四种基本算术运算：加法、减法、乘法和除法。其他人能够评估三角函数、提取根和计算对数。例如，我在上学期间就可以使用这样的计算器。但我不被允许使用图形计算器，它也可以独立求解方程并以几何方式表示函数。

paras.en: Odrzywołek, in his work, refers to 36 quantities and operations found on conventional scientific school calculators—including the aforementioned trigonometric functions, exponentiation, and so on. “Higher mathematics reveals that many of these [functions] are redundant: for example, trigonometric ones reduce to the complex exponential. How far can this reduction go?” he asks in his paper.
paras.zh: Odrzywołek 在他的著作中提到了传统科学学校计算器上的 36 个量和运算，包括前面提到的三角函数、指数函数等。 “高等数学表明，其中许多[函数]都是多余的：例如，三角函数可以简化为复指数。这种简化可以达到多远？”他在论文中问道。

paras.en: The physicist suspected that one function and one number might suffice to construct all 36 functions and quantities. “That sounds plausible,” says mathematician Manuel Kauers of Johannes Kepler University Linz in Austria, who was not involved in the current work. “The class of elementary functions is not particularly rich.”
paras.zh: 这位物理学家怀疑一个函数和一个数字可能足以构造所有 36 个函数和数量。 “这听起来似乎有道理，”奥地利林茨约翰内斯·开普勒大学的数学家曼努埃尔·考尔斯说道，他没有参与当前的工作。 “初等函数的类别并不是特别丰富。”

paras.en: This assumption is supported from a technical perspective, too. As early as 1913, mathematician Henry Sheffer proved that digital calculations can be performed using a single logical operator, the “NAND gate.” This discovery allowed for extremely complex computer calculations to be performed using one type of transistor.
paras.zh: 这一假设也从技术角度得到了支持。早在 1913 年，数学家 Henry Sheffer 就证明可以使用单个逻辑运算符“与非门”来执行数字计算。这一发现允许使用一种类型的晶体管执行极其复杂的计算机计算。

paras.en: To find the single function needed for his calculator, Odrzywołek first turned to the instruction set of the widely used algebraic computer program Wolfram Mathematica. This instruction set uses only seven functions to derive the elementary operations. It “served as a reference for an already-optimized [system] ... thoroughly tested for almost 40 years,” he writes.
paras.zh: 为了找到计算器所需的单一函数，Odrzywołek 首先求助于广泛使用的代数计算机程序 Wolfram Mathematica 的指令集。该指令集仅使用七个函数来导出基本操作。他写道，它“为已经优化的[系统]提供了参考……经过了近 40 年的彻底测试。”

paras.en: To further reduce this set of instructions, the physicist designed a computer program to assist him in the systematic search. Given a candidate for universal operations, this program systematically explores all possibilities to express the 36 elementary functions, numbers and important constants. After many attempts, he concluded that 1 in combination with eml(x, y)—“eml” is an exponential-minus-logarithm function—could be the basis for reconstructing the elementary functions.
paras.zh: 为了进一步减少这组指令，物理学家设计了一个计算机程序来辅助他进行系统搜索。给定通用运算的候选者，该程序系统地探索了表达 36 个基本函数、数字和重要常数的所有可能性。经过多次尝试，他得出结论：1 与 eml(x, y) 结合——“eml”是一个指数减对数函数——可以作为重构初等函数的基础。

paras.en: For example, to generate Euler’s number e, one simply needs to calculate eml(1,1) because exp(1) − ln(1) = e. To perform subtractions or calculate trigonometric functions, however, the eml operator must be nested multiple times—in other words, that eml must be plugged into an operation repeatedly. For the sine function, for example, it must be nested more than 10 times in succession, a more cumbersome task.
paras.zh: 例如，要生成欧拉数 e，只需计算 eml(1,1)，因为 exp(1) − ln(1) = e。然而，要执行减法或计算三角函数，eml 运算符必须嵌套多次，换句话说，必须将 eml 重复插入到运算中。例如，对于正弦函数，必须连续嵌套10次以上，这是一个比较麻烦的任务。

paras.en: And other difficulties quickly arise. Even with real-world mathematics, you may need to engage with complex numbers, which involve the square roots of negative values. But the logarithm of a complex number is not uniquely defined, which is why you must choose a “branch,” or specific segment where the logarithm takes on a definite value. Therefore, Odrzywołek writes, great care must be taken when implementing the eml structure to obtain the correct results.
paras.zh: 其他困难很快就会出现。即使使用现实世界的数学，您也可能需要处理复数，其中涉及负值的平方根。但复数的对数并不是唯一定义的，这就是为什么您必须选择一个“分支”或对数具有确定值的特定段。因此，Odrzywołek 写道，在实现 eml 结构时必须非常小心才能获得正确的结果。

paras.en: Furthermore, eml and 1 are not the only combinations of function and number from which elementary operations can be derived. As the physicist discovered, a fully functional scientific calculator can be designed using an exponent-divided-logarithm edl(x,y) and e. There could be other solutions as well.
paras.zh: 此外，eml 和 1 并不是可以导出初等运算的函数和数字的唯一组合。正如物理学家发现的那样，可以使用指数除对数 edl(x,y) 和 e 来设计功能齐全的科学计算器。也可能有其他解决方案。

paras.en: Although I find Odrzywołek’s result quite interesting from a theoretical perspective, it seems to offer few practical applications. A calculator with just two buttons, for example, would be incredibly compact but hardly user-friendly. To generate the number 0, you would have to perform the following calculation: eml(1, eml(eml(1, 1), 1)) = eml(1, eml(e, 1)) = eml(1, ee) = e – e × ln(e) = 0. Even entering the simplest numbers therefore requires a lot of time and patience (as well as a certain aptitude for arithmetic).
paras.zh: 尽管我发现 Odrzywołek 的结果从理论角度来看非常有趣，但它似乎提供的实际应用很少。例如，只有两个按钮的计算器将非常紧凑，但用户很难使用。要生成数字 0，您必须执行以下计算： eml(1, eml(eml(1, 1), 1)) = eml(1, eml(e, 1)) = eml(1, ee) = e – e × ln(e) = 0。因此，即使输入最简单的数字也需要大量时间和耐心（以及一定的算术能力）。

paras.en: Odrzywołek also suggested another application in the field of neural networks. These AI algorithms are based on elementary functions that can be represented by an eml structure. This could offer advantages: Instead of maintaining several different functional units and lookup tables for the conventional arithmetic operations of neural networks such as ReLU, tanh, GELU or sine, identical eml cells could be used, much like the NAND gates on computer chips.
paras.zh: Odrzywołek 还提出了神经网络领域的另一种应用。这些 AI 算法基于可以用 eml 结构表示的基本函数。这可以提供优势：可以使用相同的 eml 单元，而不是为神经网络的传统算术运算（例如 ReLU、tanh、GELU 或正弦）维护多个不同的功能单元和查找表，就像计算机芯片上的 NAND 门一样。

paras.en: Eymen Ipek, a researcher at the Graz University of Technology in Austria, tested this in a preprint posted to the server arXiv.org in April 2026. Ipek replaced part of a neural network used to calculate electric vehicle powertrains with an eml structure. But while the code architecture may appear simpler, it requires significantly more computational operations, he found. ReLU, tanh and similar functions represent only one operation, but executing an eml function requires 111 operations. Therefore, it will be a long time before an eml computer is used in practice—if ever.
paras.zh: 奥地利格拉茨科技大学的研究员 Eymen Ipek 在 2026 年 4 月发布到服务器 arXiv.org 的预印本中对此进行了测试。Ipek 用 eml 结构替换了用于计算电动汽车动力系统的部分神经网络。但他发现，虽然代码架构可能看起来更简单，但它需要更多的计算操作。 ReLU、tanh 和类似函数仅表示一次操作，但执行一个 eml 函数需要 111 次操作。因此，eml 计算机要投入实际应用还需要很长时间（如果有的话）。

paras.en: This article originally appeared in Spektrum der Wissenschaft and was reproduced with permission. It was translated from the original German version with the assistance of artificial intelligence and reviewed by our editors.
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于 Spektrum der Wissenschaft 并经许可转载。它是在人工智能的帮助下从德语原文翻译而来，并由我们的编辑审阅。

articles.title: How hackers are turning grocery store freezers into heaters

paras.en: The hacking era has hit supermarket freezer shelves.
paras.zh: 黑客时代已经席卷了超市的冰柜货架。

paras.en: In October attackers went after the refrigeration systems at hundreds of grocery stores in France. On the night of November 1 a second wave struck stores in Belgium, Sweden, the Netherlands, Ireland, Estonia, Finland and Luxembourg. Both sets of attacks followed a similar string of freezer failures at U.S. military bases back in August that the Pentagon now suspects was the work of hackers. In the worst cases, freezers flipped from cooling food to heating it to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight.
paras.zh: 十月，袭击者袭击了法国数百家杂货店的制冷系统。 11 月 1 日晚，第二波疫情袭击了比利时、瑞典、荷兰、爱尔兰、爱沙尼亚、芬兰和卢森堡的商店。这两起袭击都是在八月份美国军事基地发生一系列类似的冰箱故障之后发生的，五角大楼现在怀疑这是黑客所为。在最糟糕的情况下，冰箱会在一夜之间从冷却食物转变为将食物加热至 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度）。

paras.en: This type of attack has proved much more devastating than simply cutting the power. Unless someone caught the problem in time, the heat ruined the food before anyone had a chance to salvage it. Jonathan Sogin, a food science researcher at Cornell University, says this made the window to preserve food “way shorter than if you were to take something out to defrost it on your counter.” Retailers say they’ve lost millions of euros’ worth of produce and frozen goods so far.
paras.zh: 事实证明，这种类型的攻击比简单地切断电源更具破坏性。除非有人及时发现问题，否则在人们有机会挽救食物之前，高温就会毁掉食物。康奈尔大学食品科学研究人员乔纳森·索金 (Jonathan Sogin) 表示，这使得保存食物的时间“比你把东西拿出来在柜台上解冻要短得多”。零售商表示，到目前为止，他们已经损失了价值数百万欧元的农产品和冷冻商品。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Some of the companies involved say the hackers went after the freezers’ evaporators, the coils where liquid refrigerant turns into gas, soaking up heat from the air inside the freezers as it does. To prevent frost from building up on the coils and stopping them from working, heating elements warm them every so often, in what’s called a defrost cycle.
paras.zh: 一些参与其中的公司表示，黑客攻击的是冰箱的蒸发器，即液态制冷剂变成气体的盘管，从冰箱内的空气中吸收热量。为了防止线圈上结霜并阻止其工作，加热元件经常对线圈进行加热，这就是所谓的除霜循环。

paras.en: The attackers hijacked this defrost cycle remotely, keeping the heating element on until the whole freezer warmed up. The problem is, these freezers are online, and so are the controls that run them. “There are tiny computers running there, figuring out what temperature to keep the refrigerator,” says Swarun Kumar, an electrical engineering professor at Carnegie Mellon University. These types of machines are often called smart devices, but Kumar says the small computers inside tend to be “dumb,” unable to discern when they’re being misused.
paras.zh: 攻击者远程劫持了这个除霜周期，保持加热元件打开，直到整个冰箱变暖。问题是，这些冰柜是在线的，运行它们的控制装置也是在线的。卡内基梅隆大学电气工程教授斯瓦伦·库马尔 (Swarun Kumar) 表示：“那里运行着微型计算机，计算出冰箱的温度。”这些类型的机器通常被称为智能设备，但库马尔表示，内部的小型计算机往往是“愚蠢的”，无法辨别何时被滥用。

paras.en: Worryingly, nobody knows yet what the attackers want. No one has claimed responsibility, and it’s not even clear whether the same group is behind the rolling hacks. Nor has anyone asked for a ransom, though a demand would likely just prompt a store to send someone to turn the heating element off rather than pay up.
paras.zh: 令人担忧的是，目前还没有人知道攻击者想要什么。没有人声称对此负责，甚至不清楚是否是同一组织幕后黑手。也没有人要求赎金，尽管这一要求可能只会促使商店派人关闭加热元件而不是付款。

paras.en: "Because they are tiny computers, they're also dumb," says CMU professor Swarun Kumar. "They're ripe for attack."
paras.zh: “因为它们是微型计算机，所以它们也很笨，”卡耐基梅隆大学教授斯瓦伦·库马尔说。 “他们的攻击时机已经成熟。”

paras.en: This kind of attack could come to American grocers more widely, according to Amir Preminger, chief technology officer of cyberphysical security company Claroty, whose researchers flagged security flaws in this kind of refrigeration controller in August. Because the U.S. is so much larger, he’s especially concerned that attackers could move up the supply chain to target refrigeration systems in distribution centers, potentially knocking out many grocery stores in an area at once. “We’re going to be witnessing different types of attacks that have the same end result on damaging the food supply availability for customers,” he says.
paras.zh: 网络物理安全公司 Claroty 的首席技术官阿米尔·普雷明格 (Amir Preminger) 表示，这种攻击可能会更广泛地发生在美国杂货店，该公司的研究人员在 8 月份指出了这种制冷控制器的安全缺陷。由于美国幅员辽阔，他特别担心攻击者可能会沿着供应链向上移动，以配送中心的制冷系统为目标，从而可能同时摧毁一个地区的许多杂货店。他说：“我们将目睹不同类型的攻击，这些攻击的最终结果相同，都会破坏客户的食品供应。”

paras.en: Still, these hacks may be more limited in scope than they first appear. One of the control systems reportedly targeted has had an advisory out for this kind of security vulnerability since May 2025. According to Keith Stouffer, a cybersecurity expert at the National Institute of Standards and Technology, updating outdated equipment and putting it behind better firewalls could have stopped attacks like these and could stop them going forward.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些黑客攻击的范围可能比最初出现的更加有限。据报道，自 2025 年 5 月以来，其中一个目标控制系统就已针对此类安全漏洞发出了警告。美国国家标准与技术研究所的网络安全专家 Keith Stouffer 表示，更新过时的设备并将其置于更好的防火墙后面可以阻止此类攻击并阻止其继续发展。

paras.en: It may be tempting to cut off the freezers from the internet entirely, but there are real benefits to keeping them connected. “If you have a centralized management system, everything becomes smart and easy to manage,” Preminger says. “So all of a sudden, these devices that used to be standalone machines have Wi-Fi capabilities.”
paras.zh: 完全切断冰柜与互联网的连接可能很诱人，但保持它们的连接确实有好处。 “如果你有一个集中管理系统，一切都会变得智能且易于管理，”普雷明格说。 “突然间，这些曾经是独立机器的设备都具备了 Wi-Fi 功能。”

paras.en: Sogin dealt with a malfunctioning freezer of his own at home. “I put in a little thermometer, and it’s connected to some Wi-Fi thing, and so I get a notification if it goes off,” he says. Grocery store owners could, in theory, do the same, he suggests: hook up just the monitoring system online and send someone in whenever a problem turns up.
paras.zh: 索金处理了他家中一台出现故障的冰箱。 “我放了一个小温度计，它连接到一些 Wi-Fi 设备，所以如果它响起我会收到通知，”他说。他建议，理论上杂货店老板也可以这样做：仅将监控系统连接到网上，并在出现问题时派人过来。

paras.en: Each of those fixes costs money, though, and so does throwing out millions in food. Grocery stores run on notoriously thin profit margins (1 to 3 percent, by most estimates), and there are only so many freezer catastrophes the industry can take.
paras.zh: 然而，每一项修复都需要花钱，而且扔掉数百万美元的食物也是如此。众所周知，杂货店的利润率极低（大多数人估计为 1% 到 3%），而且该行业能承受的冰柜灾难也有限。

articles.title: This Halloween, amateur astronomers may be in for a dwarf planet treat
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: The outer solar system is yielding its secrets to the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
paras.zh: 外太阳系正在向维拉·C·鲁宾天文台透露其秘密。

paras.en: Less than five months into the observatory’s decade-long survey of the sky, a potential new dwarf planet has already popped up in its data, astronomers reported this week at a meeting of the American Astronomical Society’s Division of Planetary Sciences in Spokane, Wash.
paras.zh: 天文学家本周在华盛顿州斯波坎举行的美国天文学会行星科学部会议上报告说，天文台对天空进行了长达十年的调查不到五个月，一颗潜在的新矮行星已经出现在其数据中。

paras.en: Another team reported a handful of new Neptune Trojans, icy objects that share an orbit with Neptune, at the meeting and in the Astrophysical Journal Letters. The findings are filling in astronomers’ picture of the Kuiper Belt at the solar system’s frigid fringes.
paras.zh: 另一个团队在会议上和《天体物理学杂志快报》上报告了一些新的海王星特洛伊木马，它们是与海王星共享轨道的冰冷物体。这些发现填补了天文学家对太阳系寒冷边缘柯伊伯带的想象。

paras.en: “It feels a little bit like we’re replicating the 1800s and early 1900s, discovering what the solar system even looks like in general,” says Sam Deen, an amateur astronomer based in Simi Valley, Calif. “We’re finding out what there even is in the first place that makes up most of the Kuiper Belt.”
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州西米谷的业余天文学家萨姆·迪恩 (Sam Deen) 表示：“感觉有点像我们正在复制 1800 年代和 1900 年代初期，探索太阳系的总体面貌。我们正在寻找构成柯伊伯带大部分区域的物质。”

paras.en: A possible dwarf planet hid in historical data
paras.zh: 历史数据中隐藏着一颗可能的矮行星

paras.en: Perched on a mountaintop in Chile, the Vera Rubin Observatory is on a mission to map the entire southern sky every couple of nights, searching for faint and fast-moving cosmic objects. The observatory took its first images in June 2025 and officially began a decade-long survey in June 2026.
paras.zh: 维拉鲁宾天文台坐落在智利的山顶上，其任务是每隔几个晚上绘制整个南部天空的地图，寻找微弱且快速移动的宇宙物体。该天文台于 2025 年 6 月拍摄了第一张图像，并于 2026 年 6 月正式开始为期十年的调查。

paras.en: Even before the official survey started, Rubin had detected the motion of an object orbiting billions of kilometers beyond Pluto. Rubin observed the object 30 times on 20 nights from March 4 to July 11. But no one knew it was there until October 13, when astrophysicist Matt Holman of the Smithsonian Astronomical Observatory in Cambridge, Mass., ran a search for moving dots of light in the data.
paras.zh: 甚至在官方调查开始之前，鲁宾就探测到了一个绕冥王星数十亿公里运行的物体的运动。从3月4日到7月11日，鲁宾在20个晚上观察了这个物体30次。但直到10月13日，马萨诸塞州剑桥史密森天文台的天体物理学家马特·霍尔曼在数据中寻找移动的光点时，才有人知道它在那里。

paras.en: The object, called 2026 ED138, appeared to be about 47 times as far from Earth as Earth is from the sun. Its brightness suggests it’s between 600 and 1,500 kilometers wide, potentially as large as other dwarf planets like Ceres and Makemake. That’s probably big enough to be spherical, making it a dwarf planet.
paras.zh: 这个被称为 2026 ED138 的天体距离地球的距离似乎是地球距离太阳距离的 47 倍。它的亮度表明它的宽度在 600 到 1,500 公里之间，可能与谷神星和鸟神星等其他矮行星一样大。它可能足够大，成为球形，使其成为一颗矮行星。

paras.en: “It’s really big. It’s damn huge,” Deen says. “No matter what you call it, it’s still the biggest thing we’ve found in the entire solar system in 19 years.”
paras.zh: “它真的很大。真是太大了，”迪恩说。 “不管你怎么称呼它，它仍然是 19 年来我们在整个太阳系中发现的最大的东西。”

paras.en: When Holman realized what he had found, he was thrilled but doubtful. “It’s quite an exciting thing,” Holman said in a news briefing at the meeting on October 27. “But one of the things that you need to do when you discover something potentially of this size is to try to verify that it’s true.”
paras.zh: 当霍尔曼意识到他的发现时，他很兴奋，但也很怀疑。 “这是一件非常令人兴奋的事情，”霍尔曼在 10 月 27 日的会议新闻发布会上说。“但是，当你发现这种规模的潜在东西时，你需要做的事情之一就是尝试验证它的真实性。”

paras.en: Holman and colleagues were able to find observations of the same object in archived data from the Dark Energy Camera, located on an adjacent mountaintop in Chile, taken in 2016.
paras.zh: 霍尔曼和同事能够在 2016 年拍摄的位于智利邻近山顶的暗能量相机的存档数据中找到对同一物体的观察结果。

paras.en: Deen was able to trace it back even farther, to photographic plates taken as part of a sky survey at Palomar Observatory in California in 1954. Other amateur astronomers independently found the same sightings.
paras.zh: 迪恩能够追溯到更远的地方，追溯到 1954 年在加利福尼亚州帕洛玛天文台进行天空调查时拍摄的照片底片。其他业余天文学家独立发现了相同的目击事件。

paras.en: “They took an image from Palomar in 1954, and another about half an hour after the first one, that both by pure chance happen to point at where ED138 is,” Deen says. “And it’s really obvious. If you know it’s supposed to be there, it’s not particularly faint.”
paras.zh: “他们于 1954 年在帕洛玛拍摄了一张照片，在第一张照片拍摄后大约半小时又拍摄了一张照片，这两张照片都纯属偶然地指向了 ED138 所在的位置，”迪恩说。 “而且它真的很明显。如果你知道它应该在那里，它就不会特别微弱。”

paras.en: So why didn’t anybody notice it until now? It’s partly because ED138 practically crawls across the sky, orbiting the sun once every 280 years. It was also moving against a dense background of Milky Way stars, where it blended in.
paras.zh: 那么为什么直到现在还没有人注意到它呢？部分原因是 ED138 几乎在天空中爬行，每 280 年绕太阳一周。它也在密集的银河系恒星背景下移动，并融入其中。

paras.en: By combining observations spanning decades, astronomers can calculate the object’s orbit with more precision.
paras.zh: 通过结合数十年的观测结果，天文学家可以更精确地计算该物体的轨道。

paras.en: Deen is hoping to observe the potential new dwarf planet pass in front of a distant star on Halloween. That sort of observation, called an occultation, can help reveal more details of the putative dwarf planet’s size and shape, and even whether it has moons or rings. Usually, it takes years to understand an object’s orbit well enough to predict an occultation, Deen says. “Getting to do it immediately is like being a kid in a candy shop, really.”
paras.zh: 迪恩希望在万圣节观察到潜在的新矮行星从一颗遥远的恒星前面经过。这种被称为掩星的观察可以帮助揭示假定的矮行星的大小和形状的更多细节，甚至它是否有卫星或环。迪恩说，通常需要数年时间才能充分了解物体的轨道以预测掩星。 “立即开始做这件事就像是一个在糖果店里的孩子，真的。”

paras.en: Icy objects could offer clues to solar system beginnings
paras.zh: 冰冷的物体可以为太阳系的起源提供线索

paras.en: A crop of newly spotted Neptune Trojans were masked by the Milky Way, too. These asteroids gather in the same orbit as Neptune, but offset from the planet at 60 degrees. Astronomers think they were some of the original building blocks of the solar system and contain an ancient record of planetary formation and evolution.
paras.zh: 一批新发现的海王星特洛伊人也被银河系掩盖了。这些小行星聚集在与海王星相同的轨道上，但与海王星的偏移角度为 60 度。天文学家认为它们是太阳系的一些原始组成部分，并且包含行星形成和演化的古老记录。

paras.en: Other planets have Trojans, too. Jupiter has thousands. Astronomers think Neptune has many more, but so far they have seen only 30 in the cluster of space objects that orbit ahead of Neptune, and just two in the cluster behind it.
paras.zh: 其他行星也有特洛伊人。木星有数千个。天文学家认为海王星还有更多，但到目前为止，他们在海王星前面的空间物体星团中只看到了 30 个，而在海王星后面的星团中只看到了 2 个。
