articles.title: NAPA Apprentice Program Builds a New Path Into the Service Bay
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: As repair shops across the country struggle to recruit qualified technicians, the NAPA Auto Care Apprentice Program offers participating businesses a structured way to develop new talent inside their own service bays.

More than 700 NAPA Auto Care centers nationwide participate in the program, which combines technical education, hands-on experience and mentorship. Its mission is to educate and cultivate the next generation of automotive repair professionals by providing a broad learning experience that combines online and classroom training.

For shop owners, the program offers an alternative to waiting for experienced technicians to appear in an increasingly competitive labor market. A participating shop can identify someone with the right attitude and work ethic, then help that person build technical skills through a defined training path.

“NAPA is committed to finding solutions that address the national shortage of skilled automotive technicians,” said Jason Rainey, vice president of Auto Care. “Our apprenticeship program is one of several key NAPA initiatives that help pave the way for young people to launch long and fruitful careers in our industry.”

The NAPA Apprentice Program uses a nine-stage curriculum designed to give participants a broad understanding of the systems and components found on modern vehicles. Most apprentices can complete the program in two years or less.

However, the curriculum is competency-based rather than tied strictly to a calendar. Apprentices can progress through each stage at a pace that matches their learning style and demonstrated abilities. A participant who quickly masters a subject can move forward, while someone who needs additional practice can spend more time developing that competency.
Training is 100% technical and is delivered through several formats:
- Classroom training videos exclusive to the Apprentice Program provide in-depth instruction from experienced master technicians.
- NAPA Autotech classes offer instructor-led training taught by experienced ASE Master Certified instructors.
- Autotech eLearning provides web-based instruction targeting specific systems, procedures and diagnostic topics.
- Hands-on training allows apprentices to apply what they have learned while working in the shop under the guidance of a mentor.

This combination helps connect classroom theory with real repairs. Apprentices do not just learn how a component operates; they also gain experience inspecting, testing and servicing that component on vehicles.

The curriculum will continue to evolve as vehicle technology and industry standards change. Planned enhancements include updated training modules and specialized certification options covering emerging service areas, giving apprentices additional opportunities for career advancement.

Apprentices earn the work experience requirement for three Automotive Service Excellence certifications as they advance through the program: Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5). They also gain the practical know-how to pass the EPA Section 609 refrigerant recovery and recycling credential test administered through ASE.

That distinction is important: G1, A4 and A5 are ASE professional certifications, while Section 609 is an EPA-required credential for technicians who service motor-vehicle air-conditioning systems. Together, these credentials provide outside validation of the knowledge and skills developed during the apprenticeship.

Because the program is registered with the U.S. Department of Labor, graduates also finish with a nationally recognized journey-level credential in automotive repair. This gives apprentices evidence of completing a structured combination of education and supervised on-the-job training.

The program provides the curriculum and training materials, but its success inside a repair facility depends heavily on the shop’s involvement. An apprentice needs an experienced technician who can explain procedures, demonstrate good work habits, supervise repairs and provide constructive feedback.

“We need their mentorship, their participation,” said Hannah Klausman, account marketing manager for Auto Care. “We want to support them by providing the materials for their technicians to go through this program, but we need their buy-in by having them provide a mentor and really put their time into taking a chance on these new technicians.”

For a shop owner, that requires a real commitment. Mentoring can temporarily affect the productivity of an experienced technician, especially during an apprentice’s first months. The potential return is a technician trained around the shop’s procedures, quality standards and culture.

The program can also create a clearer career ladder. Instead of hiring someone as an entry-level employee with no defined next step, a shop can show the apprentice how training, demonstrated competencies and certifications lead to greater responsibilities.

“The success of the apprentice program is a reflection not only of the investment NAPA has made but also of its collaboration with Auto Care centers across the country,” said Ryan Ouellette, director of strategic accounts at NAPA. “We are committed to developing future professionals at NAPA, and we look forward to continuing to educate and support the talent in the industry.”
Applicants must be at least 17 years old. Applicants who are 17 require written parental consent, and there is no maximum age.

Previous professional repair experience is not the program’s defining qualification. Shops should look for candidates who have a positive attitude, arrive ready to work and take initiative beyond their assigned tasks.

Successful apprentices must also be able to build relationships. Automotive repair is increasingly collaborative, particularly when diagnostic information, specialized equipment and technical knowledge must be shared among technicians. An apprentice must be willing to ask questions, accept coaching and learn from the people around them.
Most importantly, candidates need to embrace continuous learning. Vehicle technology does not stand still, and neither can a technician’s education.

For aspiring technicians, the program provides an opportunity to learn the trade without taking on the expense of a traditional trade-school program. Apprentices receive a paycheck while learning in an operating repair facility, and the training itself is provided at no cost to the participant.
Additional information about the program is available at NAPA Auto Care Training.
Sidebar: Addressing the Cost of a Technician’s First Tools

Tools represent one of the largest entry barriers for a new automotive technician. Even a basic professional set can require a substantial investment before the technician earns a full professional wage.

To help address that barrier, Carlyle Tools developed an Apprentice Set containing professional-quality tools considered essential for a new technician’s career. NAPA Auto Care makes the exclusive set, which has a stated retail value of $6,566, available for participating Auto Care centers to purchase for their apprentices.

Providing or helping finance an appropriate starter set can make a shop’s apprenticeship opportunity more attractive. It also helps ensure that the apprentice begins with tools capable of withstanding daily professional use.

articles.title: Autel Integrates ALLDATA Repair With MaxiSYS Tablets
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Autel U.S. has partnered with ALLDATA to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with ALLDATA Repair on select MaxiSYS tablets. ALLDATA provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) repair information. The integration connects vehicle fault codes with corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and repair procedures together on one screen.
Autel Connects MaxiSYS Diagnostics With ALLDATA
Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2. The integration also supports the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.

More than 400,000 technicians use ALLDATA, which provides access to original diagnostic and repair information from vehicle manufacturers. ALLDATA Repair covers more than 44,000 engine-specific vehicles, representing approximately 95% of vehicles on the road.
It includes OEM repair procedures, diagnostic flowcharts, technical service bulletins, component locations, specifications and wiring diagrams.

“Our partnership with Autel is another step toward creating a more connected diagnostic experience for technicians, when vehicle complexity is increasing,” said Satwinder Mangat, president of ALLDATA. “Bringing ALLDATA’s trusted OEM repair information into the diagnostic workflow helps technicians access the OEM information they need when and where they need it.”
Integration Provides Access to OEM Repair Information
The integration connects ALLDATA’s repair information with Autel’s diagnostic capabilities.

From a fault code in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated ALLDATA information for the selected vehicle. They can review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures.
A split-screen view displays MaxiSYS diagnostic results alongside ALLDATA. This allows technicians to consult factory instructions while viewing the fault they are investigating.
Technicians can follow links within ALLDATA to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
ALLDATA Diagnostic Intelligence Adds AI-Assisted Insights

The integration also provides access to ALLDATA Diagnostic Intelligence, ALLDATA’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow.

“Finding a fault code is only the beginning. The next step is knowing how to test the system, identify the cause, and perform the repair correctly,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S. “Connecting MaxiSYS diagnostics with ALLDATA’s OEM repair information gives technicians a direct path to those answers, right on the tablet they are already using at the vehicle.”
Integration Demonstrations at SEMA and AAPEX

- SEMA: South Hall Lower, booth 44175, and South Hall Upper, booth 38179.

articles.title: Think Twice Before Erasing Trouble Codes
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Counter pros should avoid erasing diagnostic trouble codes when customers request it. Clearing codes without fixing the underlying problem will only temporarily turn off the check engine light.

Erasing codes also deletes valuable freeze-frame data that technicians need for accurate diagnosis. Additionally, clearing codes resets emissions readiness monitors, potentially affecting vehicle emissions testing.

articles.title: Astronomers may have been wrong about what ended the 'Cosmic Dark Age'
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: The mysterious force that cleared the cosmic fog at the dawn of the universe may not be what we thought, a new study suggests. The results hint that astronomers may need to rethink a major aspect of cosmological evolution, which led to the universe we clearly see today.

Around 400,000 years after the Big Bang, the fledgling universe finally cooled enough to form atoms — mostly hydrogen. But these neutral, non-electrically charged hydrogen atoms shrouded the cosmos in a fog that made it opaque to ultraviolet (UV) light.

Then, after the first stars flickered to life and gathered into galaxies, bursts of radiation ionized the neutral hydrogen. This turned the impenetrable fog of atoms into electrically charged protons and electrons, allowing light to pass through interstellar space unimpeded and, eventually, reach our observatories. This cosmic curtain parting is known as the Epoch of Reionization, or what a team of researchers studying it call the "last major phase transition in the universe."

"We don't know exactly what objects caused reionization or how it evolved," Cody Carr, an astronomer who focuses on galaxy evolution at the University of Michigan and first author of a new study of the epoch, said in a statement. "We know that it took place, but we don't have complete answers to those questions."
Astrophysicists previously thought that this fog-clearing effect depended on supernovas, the violently explosive deaths of stars around eight to 50 times the mass of the sun.

But in the new study, published Oct. 15 in the journal Nature Astronomy, Carr and colleagues presented evidence that supernovas exerted the opposite effect, trapping the so-called Lyman continuum (LyC) photons of ionizing UV radiation that dispelled the celestial fog instead of scattering them.

"The most interesting thing about our paper is the observation that the strongest LyC emitters do not have fast galactic winds," Carr told Live Science via email. "This challenges the notion that galaxies require fast supernova-driven winds to enable LyC escape."
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
The researchers used the Hubble Space Telescope to observe an analogue of the ancient universe in the local cosmos: six star-forming, wind-launching galaxies around 3.5 billion light-years away.

These compact starburst galaxies are generally smaller than 6,500 light-years in diameter and form around 10 solar masses' worth of stars per year. That star-birthing rate is several times higher than that of the Milky Way, which is up to 20 times larger.

The galaxies' spectra, or light-based fingerprints, revealed the origin, chemical composition, speed and direction of their stellar winds, which were whipped up by the radiation from their newly formed stars.

The researchers also described how these processes changed as the massive young stars evolved and died in energetic supernovas several billion years later, with the resultant galactic winds overpowering the stellar winds.
These nearby galaxies highlighted a counterintuitive two-phase process.

In the initial phase, which occurred during the first 3 million years of star formation, the newly formed massive stars' stellar winds carved through their galaxies' neutral gas and dust at nearly 2,000 miles per second (3,000 kilometers per second). This allowed LyC light to escape the galaxy and ionize the neutral gas and dust in intergalactic space.

The second phase, which emerged around 3 million years after star formation, seemed to reverse this process. As O-type stars — the hottest, bluest and most massive stars in the cosmos — lived fast and died young, their expelled stellar guts added to the opaque galactic gas and dust, churning it and loading it with mass, which created a trap for LyC light.
The oldest galaxies in this study — and, therefore, the ones with the fastest supernova-generated galactic winds — allowed the least amount of ionizing radiation to escape their environs.

"In general, our results are in disagreement with most cosmological simulations, which typically show the LyC escape fraction peaking after the launch of supernova-driven winds," Carr explained via email. In other words, supernovas didn't drive the Epoch of Reionization, but they may have dampened it. The intense light of newborn stars now seems like the most viable source of reionization.
Future research could aim to obtain additional galactic samples and higher-resolution observations across other wavelengths.

O., Borthakur, S., Haye, M., Heckman, T., Ji, Z., Komarova, L., Reste, A. L., Leclercq, F., Marques-Chaves, R., . . . Xu, X. (2026). Ivan is a long-time writer who loves learning about technology, history, culture, and just about every major “ology” from “anthro” to “zoo.” Ivan also dabbles in internet comedy, marketing materials, and industry insight articles. An exercise science major, when Ivan isn’t staring at a book or screen he’s probably out in nature or lifting progressively heftier things off the ground. Ivan was born in sunny Romania and now resides in even-sunnier California.

articles.title: Blue whales have gone missing off the Galápagos. Scientists think El Niño could be why.
articles.author: María de los Ángeles Orfila

paras.en: For nine months, a scientific expedition searched for blue whales in the waters around the Galápagos Islands but found none. Between October 2025 and July 2026, the researchers surveyed areas of the Ecuadorian archipelago where the giants had historically been recorded, hoping to attach satellite tags and learn more about the animals' migratory routes. The search ended without the team tagging a single whale.

The absence coincided with unusually warm ocean conditions during an El Niño event. Sea surface temperatures were as high as 82 degrees Fahrenheit (28 degrees Celsius), while at a depth of 330 feet (100 meters) water temperatures ranged from 66 to 67 F (18.9 to 19.4 C) — up to 9 F (5 C) warmer than usual for that time of the year.

This raised the possibility that El Niño changed where blue whales were finding food and, in turn, where they went. The researchers suspect the animals may be seeking colder, more productive waters. However, the whales themselves are still missing.

"The hypothesis is that the whales are staying in areas with greater productivity [more food] farther south, in waters with slightly cooler temperatures," Daniela Alarcón, the expedition's leader and a researcher at the Universidad San Francisco de Quito's Galápagos campus and the Galápagos Science Center, told Live Science.

As to where the missing whales have gone, possibilities include the waters off Peru and offshore areas where the animals could go undetected. In this scenario, the unusually warm waters around the Galápagos Islands would act as a "temperature barrier," Alarcón said, preventing them from feeding in the archipelago's waters.

Blue whales (Balaenoptera musculus) can consume up to 12,100 pounds (5,500 kilograms) of krill — small crustaceans that make up the whales' primary food source — every day. That means they need to find areas with enough food to sustain them.
"These are very large animals that need to move to areas where they can keep feeding," Alarcón said.
It's not yet clear whether this year's El Niño caused a krill shortage in the waters off the Galápagos, but some indirect evidence points that way.

Past expeditions suggested that blue whales tend to feed in water layers around 71 F, which this season was identified around the Galápagos at a depth of about 197 feet (92 m). By contrast, peak chlorophyll concentrations, an indirect indicator of abundance of the krill's food source, phytoplankton — were recorded much higher in the water column, at between 39 and 121 feet (12 to 37 m) below the surface. Because krill abundance wasn't directly measured, that data suggests, but does not establish, that there was a mismatch between the whales' preferred feeding layer and the presence of their food.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "Honestly, we had never encountered such unusual conditions before," Juan Pablo Muñoz, a marine biologist at the Universidad San Francisco de Quito who was also on the expedition, told Live Science.

The whales' absence did not come as a complete surprise to the team. Sightings had already begun to decline before the most recent expedition. Reports submitted through Cetácea Galápagos, a citizen science network, began to dwindle between August and September 2025. There were two isolated reports of blue whales, in May and June 2026, but the team could not confirm either one, despite intensifying its search.

"We knew conditions wouldn't be the same, but we thought that if we put in more effort, we might be able to find some individuals. But we searched, and searched, and searched — and found nothing," Alarcón recalled.

Part of that could be down to the elusive nature of the giant creatures. Humpback whales (Megaptera novaeangliae)are generally easier to spot, Muñoz noted. In some places, they can be seen from the shore or after a half-hour boat ride. Blue whales, by contrast, rarely approach mainland Ecuador's coast and tend to stay far from populated areas in the Galápagos.
Fernando Félix, a marine biologist at the Pontifical Catholic University of Ecuador who was not part of the expedition, was unsurprised by the result.
"We already knew there wouldn't be any blue whales in the Galápagos," said Félix, who is also a researcher at the Whale Museum (Museo de Ballenas).

Félix told Live Science that there are historical precedents for this behavior in the southeastern Pacific. During the 1982-1983 El Niño, which also brought substantial ocean warming, blue whales and other species, including fin whales (Balaenoptera physalus) and Bryde's whales (Balaenoptera brydei), were recorded shifting southward.

"We might think that because they are 'just animals,' they lack memory or don't understand these processes — but we would be wrong," Félix said. "They can clearly sense that when temperatures are unusually high as they travel north from the south, vertical mixing has been disrupted and there is no food in the Galápagos. They perceive environmental conditions and naturally direct their movements toward areas where they believe feeding conditions are better."
Rather than indicating a mass die-off, the whales' disappearance may reflect a shift in their movements in response to changing ocean conditions, Félix said.
"I don't think the whales have died," Felix said. "They simply didn't go to the Galápagos region. They went elsewhere, where conditions were better."

This response to environmental conditions may also have impacted dolphin movements. Pods may have moved toward colder waters, where food could be more abundant, or may have even dispersed, Félix suggested.
When will blue whales return to the Galápagos?

El Niño's effects will likely persist over the coming months. "Between January and May 2027, we'll have warm water coming from the north and warm water coming from the west," Félix warned. "This is going to hit us extremely hard."
- Hundreds of whale calves have mysteriously died in Patagonia — and scientists are racing to find out why
- This psychologist has a new theory for why orcas keep attacking boats
- 'They would come in with a chord change': Composer Jim Nollman has collaborated with turkeys, kangaroo rats and whales. Now he's dropping 'Orcas' Greatest Hits.'

Blue whales, humpback whales and dolphins would likely return to Galápagos waters once El Niño subsides and ocean conditions begin to normalize. He said pelagic fish (species that live in the water column rather than on or near the seafloor) — including tuna, swordfish, anchovies and sardines, which have also moved toward colder waters — would return as well.

Muñoz agreed. Krill populations can rebound just one to three months after cold, nutrient-rich waters begin to rise to the surface. More whale sightings were recorded in the years following the 2015 and 2023 El Niño events. Based on these precedents, he suggested that 2028 could be a promising year if cold water returns to the surface. "The system bounces back," he said.

Félix compared El Niño to a computer restart. "It resets the environment, allowing ecological processes to begin again," he said. He's confident that blue whales will return to the area. "I can guarantee that there will be large numbers of blue whales at this time in 2028," he told Live Science.

articles.title: Lycurgus Cup: A Roman glass goblet made with ancient color-changing nanotechnology
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: The Lycurgus Cup is a Roman-era glass goblet that changes color from jade green to ruby red depending on if a light is shining on its front or back. But experts are unsure where the cup was found, where it was made, or whether the glassblower who made it created the color-changing effect on purpose.

In 1958, the British Museum acquired the cup from the Rothschild banking family, which had owned the artifact since the mid-19th century. Known colloquially as the Lycurgus Cup for its depiction of the mythical king who angered the god Dionysus, the glass is about 6.3 inches (15.9 centimeters) tall and weighs around 1.6 pounds (700 grams).

The glass is a remarkably well-preserved example of a Roman "cage-cup," according to a 1959 study of the artifact by archaeologists D. B. Harden and Jocelyn Toynbee. Only a handful of cage-cups still exist, and experts believe the goblets were made by cutting and grinding decoration into thick glass. Because small bridges were left to ensure the decoration remained on the glass, the overall effect is like a cage. Harden and Toynbee estimated that the Lycurgus Cup was manufactured in the fourth century, likely in Italy, but they noted that the bronze frame that forms the stem and rim of the goblet is probably a 19th-century addition.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Depicted on the cup is the myth of the punishment of Lycurgus, king of the Thracian tribe called the Edoni (also called the Edonians). Lycurgus did not approve of the worship of Dionysus and banished the god into the sea with an ax. But one of Dionysus' priestesses, Ambrosia, decided to fight Lycurgus. Ambrosia changed herself into a vine and wound herself around Lycurgus, who was unable to escape. The other priestesses thronged around them and tormented Lycurgus. Given that Dionysus was a god of wine and merriment, the depiction of Lycurgus' punishment may have been particularly appropriate for this goblet. Additionally, the change in color from green to red may have been meant to mimic the ripening of grapes on the vine.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Color-changing cups, also called dichroic cups, were mentioned in ancient Roman historical records. For example, a second-century letter possibly penned by Emperor Hadrian to his brother-in-law mentions a gift of two dichroic cups to use during banquets. But very few fragments of this mysterious type of glass survive today, a 2007 study noted.

For decades, experts have been working out how ancient Romans produced dichroic cups, and some have even replicated the Lycurgus Cup's color-changing effect. A 1963 study confirmed that the key seems to be the addition of microscopic nanoparticles of gold and silver during glassblowing that produce the appearance of milky-green glass when lit from the front and nearly translucent red glass when lit from behind. The metal nanoparticles are smaller than grains of sand and interact with light, creating the perception of a color change.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: A replica of dichroic glass made by Corning Glassworks in the 1960s went from green to amethyst in the light, the 2007 study reported, and in 2020, researchers included silver and gold nanoparticles in 3D printing to replicate the color-changing properties of the glass.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

More recently, experts at the University of Sheffield in the U.K. reproduced the dichroic glass by reverse-engineering the "recipe" from the original Lycurgus Cup. The team then commissioned a glass artist to create a Lycurgus-inspired design from the replica.

But because so few examples of dichroic glass exist, experts are still unsure whether Roman artisans created the color-changing effect on purpose or whether traces of gold, which would have been available in an ancient craft studio, slipped into the molten glass and made a rare and unusual material that mystified even the most skilled glassblowers.
For more stunning archaeological discoveries, check out our Astonishing Artifacts archives.

Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.

articles.title: Melting Ice in the Italian Dolomites Exposes Hundreds of World War I Munitions, Vestiges of the Vertiginous 'White War'

paras.en: High in the craggy peaks of northern Italy’s Dolomites, record-breaking summer heat has peeled back layers of ice and revealed troves of 20th-century weaponry.
Over the course of the summer, the Italian army recovered and defused some 250 explosive devices dating back to World War I, according to ANSA, an Italian news agency.
The dangerous relics surfaced across high-altitude slopes and melting glaciers in the Trentino-Alto Adige region. They were frequently spotted and reported by mountaineers and hikers.

In one bizarre instance, firefighters found an unexploded 90-millimeter mortar shell while salvaging a car that had rolled into a ravine after the driver forgot to engage the handbrake, Barbie Latza Nadeau reports for CNN.

That unexpected discovery in June was the first of the clean-up season for the Italian Army’s Julia Alpine brigade. Specialists worked until mid-October across dizzying ridgelines, including the Carè Alto and Lares glaciers in the Adamello-Brenta area and near Cima Tre Cannoni and the Livrio glacier in the Stelvio region, according to a statement.
Among the 250 recovered munitions were hand grenades, 75-millimeter artillery rounds and French-made Thevetot mortar shells, according to the Guardian’s Angela Giuffrida.

The weaponry is a chilling vestige of the “White War,” a brutal campaign fought between the Austro-Hungarian and Italian militaries between 1915 and 1918 at elevations at times exceeding 10,000 feet. Soldiers hacked tunnels directly into the ice, hoisted heavy field guns up sheer cliffs and endured chilling temperatures.

The White War claimed an estimated 180,000 lives, largely though hypothermia, sheer falls and catastrophic avalanches, which proved far more lethal than enemy shells. When hostilities ceased in late 1918, both sides abandoned vast arsenals—and fallen soldiers—which were buried under winter snowdrifts and encased in solid glacial ice.

In 2015, thawing ice near the summit of Mount Scorluzzo revealed a wooden barracks built into a natural cavern at 10,154 feet. Sealed since the war ended in November 1918, the shelter was found astonishingly intact—complete with straw bedding, lanterns, uniforms, food tins, postcards and newspapers.

While mountaineers have periodically found wartime relics since the 1990s, the speed and volume of discoveries have accelerated dramatically due to climate change. A combination of low winter snowfall in 2025 followed by scorching summer temperatures in 2026 drove unprecedented glacial loss across northern Italy.

“It is very much a consequence of global heating,” Stefano Morosini, a historian at the University of Bergamo and heritage project coordinator at Stelvio National Park, tells the Guardian. “In recent years, at the end of each summer, these dangerous artifacts emerge, and each year there is a higher number. They have been conserved by the ice for more than 100 years. Some had already exploded, but many hadn’t; so now, when they re-emerge, they are very, very dangerous.”

Disarming century-old explosives in alpine environments was a grave logistical challenge. At one point, a cluster of 75-millimeter shells forced authorities to temporarily shut down a popular climbing route between the Cima del Frate peak and the Forcella Fierollo pass.

The Italian Army notes that the operation required “solid mountaineering skills” to navigate inaccessible cliffs and hazardous rockfalls, per CNN. The missions relied on specialist helicopter crews, volunteer fire services, the Red Cross and the mountain rescue branch of the Guardia di Finanza. In many areas, personnel had to use specialized air-lift equipment and heavy protective gear to safely transport unstable shells to secure detonation sites.

Beyond the dangers of gunpowder, retreating ice is making high-altitude trekking increasingly hazardous, Morosini tells the Guardian, pointing to the 2022 collapse of the Marmolada glacier that killed 11 people.
He adds: “If you come to the area, you can see how fast the glaciers are retreating and how strong the impact of climate change is.”

articles.title: Scientists Feared This Cute but Venomous Primate Had Gone Extinct Nearly 100 Years Ago. It Was Hiding in Plain Sight All Along

paras.en: A small primate that scientists feared might be extinct has been making appearances across an Indonesian island, offering new hope for the elusive species.

The Bangka slow loris was last officially documented by scientists in the 1930s. As a result, in 2015, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) classified the species as critically endangered—and possibly extinct—on its Red List of Threatened Species.

But a new study published in October in the journal Spixiana shows the Bangka slow loris continues to survive in the wild. Scientists report that a local wildlife organization on Bangka Island, Indonesia, has rescued and re-released dozens of Bangka slow lorises in recent years.

While the species still faces numerous threats, the research suggests it’s not yet extinct—rather, it was simply “overlooked by science for nearly a century,” study co-author Timon Glaw, a conservation biologist at the Haus des Meeres Aqua Terra Zoo in Austria, tells Mongabay’s Naina Rao. Based on the findings, Glaw and colleagues recommend a formal reassessment of the species’ status to remove the “possibly extinct” label.

Diminutive, nocturnal and cryptic, the Bangka slow loris is native to the Indonesian island of Bangka, as well as southwestern Borneo. These creatures have huge eyes, stubby tails, reddish-brown fur and distinctive facial markings. They move slowly through trees, likely feeding on bugs, tree gums, nectar and other plant parts.

The Bangka slow loris and some other slow loris species have evolved an unusual way of defending themselves: They produce a toxic secretion from glands on their upper arms. When threatened, they lick these glands, mixing the secretion with proteins in their saliva to create venom. They then transfer the toxin to their specialized front teeth, allowing them to deliver a venomous bite when necessary.

“The venom can cause severe allergic reactions in humans, potentially even life-threatening ones,” Glaw tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “Research on other slow loris species suggests that the venom is used primarily in conflicts with other lorises, although it may also serve defensive functions against predators and parasites.”

The Bangka slow loris has two tongues: the main one and another beneath it, reports Reuters. The second tongue helps clean the animal’s forward-projecting bottom teeth, collectively called the toothcomb. It’s primarily used for grooming—but also for its venomous bite.

For decades, scientists didn’t know whether the species continued to survive on Bangka, a tropical island east of Sumatra with more than a million residents. The last scientific paper to mention the Bangka slow loris was published in 1937, although it may have drawn on specimens collected even earlier, between 1930 and 1932.
To better understand the species’ current status, scientists analyzed data collected by the Alobi Wildlife Rescue Center, a nonprofit conservation and rehabilitation facility on Bangka.

Between 2015 and 2025, the center rescued more than 90 Bangka slow lorises, 86 of which were subsequently released. Some of the animals were discovered inside residents’ homes and gardens, while others were found on roads and in palm oil plantations. A handful were rescued from the local wildlife trade or from captivity, while several had suffered electrical burns, fence entanglements or dog attacks.

Just since 2021, the center rescued 43 individuals from locations across the island, including Pangkalpinang, its largest city. This suggests the species is probably more widely distributed in Bangka than previously thought.

Staff and volunteers at the center have been “quietly rescuing, healing and releasing these animals,” Benji Barca, exploration program manager for the global conservation organization Re:wild, says in a statement. It’s thanks to their diligent record-keeping, he adds, that scientists now know the Bangka slow loris continues to persist in the wild.

The study is “another reminder that conservation depends on the knowledge of local communities, Indigenous peoples and others who know these species and landscapes intimately,” says Barca, who wasn’t involved in the study. “A species can disappear from the scientific record without disappearing from the lives of the people who share its home.”

The findings “clearly demonstrate” that the species is not extinct, the researchers write in the paper. However, its long-term survival remains uncertain. The Bangka slow loris’s forest habitat declined by 62 percent between 2000 and 2012, largely due to illegal tin mining and land clearing for palm oil plantations. Human settlements and infrastructure, including roads and power lines, also threaten the species.

In response to these threats, the researchers are calling for stronger protections for the Bangka slow loris’s remaining habitat, along with the establishment of a conservation breeding program. They also recommend conducting population surveys and genetic studies, as well as monitoring the slow lorises’ survival and adaptation after they are released back into the wild.

“Every species is the result of millions of years of evolution and part of a complex ecological network,” Glaw tells Reuters, “and losing the Bangka slow loris would mean losing something truly irreplaceable.”

articles.title: Engineers Delicately Removed the Masts From This Bomb-Laden World War II Shipwreck in the River Thames. But 1,500 Tons of Explosives Are Still in Place

paras.en: In August 1944, the American military cargo ship SS Richard Montgomery sank at the mouth of the River Thames with roughly 1,500 tons of bombs, ordnances and weapons still aboard. Now, more than eight decades later, officials have taken steps to reduce the risk of an explosion.
paras.zh: 1944年8月，美国军用货船“理查德·蒙哥马利号” （ SS Richard Montgomery ）在泰晤士河口沉没，船上仍有大约1500吨炸弹、军械和武器。80多年后的今天，官员们已经采取措施降低爆炸的风险。

paras.en: Engineers recently removed the vessel’s three masts, which had remained visible above the waterline near Sheerness, a coastal town about 50 miles east of London on the Thames Estuary. They were concerned that the towering steel structures might one day collapse onto the decks below, potentially triggering the World War II munitions still stored inside the Richard Montgomery’s damaged hull.

The masts were taken to the Historic Dockyard Chatham, a maritime museum and heritage site in Kent, for conservation and preservation, according to a statement delivered to Britain’s Parliament on October 19.
“This will help ensure that an important part of the region’s heritage is protected for future generations,” Keir Mather, minister for aviation, maritime and logistics, writes in the statement.
Meanwhile, the wreck will “continue to be subject to continuous monitoring and control,” he adds.

When it sank, the Richard Montgomery was participating in an Allied convoy delivering munitions to the United Kingdom and France. When the ship arrived in the Thames Estuary, it anchored off the coast of Sheerness while waiting to cross the English Channel.

However, on August 20, its anchor dragged in the shallow water and the ship ran aground on a sandbar. Salvage crews immediately began unloading the ship’s cargo, but a crack developed in the hull, allowing water to flood the front of the vessel.

Crews continued removing explosives until September 25, ultimately recovering about half of its explosive cargo. By then, however, the ship was taking on too much water, forcing them to abandon the effort. The vessel sank to the seafloor with its masts protruding from the water.

It’s not clear exactly which munitions were left onboard. However, experts think the ship—nicknamed the Monty—might still be full of 2,000-pound blockbusters, fragmentation bombs and white phosphorus smoke ordnances. The potential impact of an explosion is difficult to predict, with estimates ranging from minor damage to nearby shorelines to a tsunami-style tidal wave that could travel up the Thames. But any scenario would likely put local communities at risk.
In 2022, scientists discovered that the V-1302 John Mahn, a German naval ship sunk by the British Royal Air Force in 1942, was leaking toxic chemicals like arsenic into the North Sea.

Ships aren’t allowed to get close to the wreck, with buoys marking the exclusion zone. However, the Monty is still close to busy shipping lanes and there have been reports of people entering the restricted area. Some officials also fear that the site could be targeted by terrorists or saboteurs, the Washington Post’s William Booth reports.

In recent years, the wreck had begun to “lean and deteriorate,” with some of the structures surrounding the masts starting to fail, Nolan Conway, project leader for Resolve Marine, the Florida-based company hired to remove the masts, tells CBS News’ Simon Ellery.

“The fear is the masts could have fallen onto the cargo itself, causing it to detonate,” he adds. “Some of the munitions are believed to be fused munitions with pressure fuses, so something like an impact could potentially set them off.”

So, the British government spent $12 million to have the masts carefully removed. Before they got to work, Conway’s team completed extensive surveys using radar, magnetometers and sonar to understand the wreck site.

Resolve Marine positioned a high-tech salvage barge by the wreck. Then, crews used a remotely operated diamond-wire saw to carefully cut each mast, per CBS News. The team also used a custom lifting frame to safely raise each mast free from the wreck without swinging or swaying.

Though they’re no longer attached to the Monty, the masts will help keep the vessel’s story alive at the Chatham Historic Dockyard, preserving a tangible connection to its wartime history and the sacrifices made by Allied forces during World War II.

“There’s a lot of interest in that ship,” Paul Barnard, deputy CEO of the Chatham Historic Dockyard, tells the Washington Post. “A lot of history and lore and speculation and, to be honest, rumor about what could happen next.”

articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Uber began as a modern alternative to taxis, letting riders order through a phone app, track the driver’s route in real time, share their location with contacts, and even split the fare in the app—it was the convenience-obsessed answer to the old way of hailing cabs. Then in 2014, Uber leveled up with Uber Eats. Much like Uber was the convenient, modern answer to taxis, Uber Eats was the equivalent for food delivery.
paras.zh: 优步最初是出租车的现代替代方案，可让乘客通过手机应用下单，实时跟踪司机的路线，与联系人分享位置信息，甚至在应用中平分车费。这是对出租车传统叫车方式的便利回答。然后在2014年，优步与Uber Eats优食合作。就像优步是出租车的便捷、现代答案一样， Uber Eats优食相当于送餐服务。

paras.en: Instead of calling a local restaurant and enlisting a delivery driver from that restaurant, Uber Eats draws from hundreds of participating restaurants, cafes, and stores in your area, tailoring deals and picks to your location and preferences. So if you want fresh sushi from your favorite local spot for a date night in, or just need some Advil and Gatorade after a night out, Uber Eats delivers the goods in minutes flat. Whether you’re new to the service or a longtime devotee, we have an Uber Eats promo code and other Uber Eats coupon codes to help you save big—and stay at home.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: One of the easiest ways to save big on Uber Eats is to create a new account. First-time Uber customers can save 30 to 50% on their first order, plus new offers with up to $20 off rides or $15 off Uber Eats orders. You don’t even need an Uber Eats promo code to get this steep discount—this offer applies automatically when you create your account and book your first trip or delivery.
paras.zh: 在Uber Eats优食平台上创建新账号是节省大笔费用的最简单方法之一。首次使用优步的顾客首次订餐可享30%至50%的优惠，此外，还可享受高达$ 20的行程优惠或$ 15的Uber Eats优食订单优惠。您甚至不需要Uber Eats优食优惠码即可享受此大幅折扣。创建账号并预约首次行程或派送行程时，此优惠会自动生效。

paras.en: If you use the rideshare app often or order takeout multiple nights a week, an Uber One membership will pay for itself within a few weeks. At $10 per month, it offers major perks that add up over time if you use the service frequently. You’ll get tons of perks across rides and food delivery, including $0 delivery fees on eligible food, grocery, and retail orders, up to 10% off eligible Uber Eats orders, 5% back in Uber One credits on eligible rides, and automatic surge savings. Uber One members save $29 on average every month.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Uber Eats Promo Code: 50% Off Your First Uber Ride
paras.zh: Uber Eats优食优惠码：首次优步行程可享半价优惠

paras.en: As mentioned above, the simplest way to save big with Uber is to be a first-time user. You’ll save 30 to 50% on your first ride, including up to $20 off all rides or $15 off Uber Eats orders. You don’t even need an Uber promo code. Uber welcome discounts apply automatically once you create your account and book your first trip. Trust me, you’ll get used to the convenience of a rideshare app and a food and delivery service app, all in one place—in the palm of your hand.
paras.zh: 如上所述，通过优步省钱的最简单方法是成为首次使用优步的用户。首次行程可享30%至50%的优惠，包括所有行程最高可享$ 20的优惠，或Uber Eats优食订单最高可享$ 15的优惠。您甚至不需要优步优惠码。创建账号并预约首次行程后，系统会自动应用优步迎宾优惠。相信我，您会习惯共享出行应用和餐点派送服务应用的便利性，一切尽在掌心。

paras.en: Share the Gift of an Uber Eats Gift Card
paras.zh: 分享Uber Eats优食礼品卡礼品卡

paras.en: One of my go-to gifts lately is an Uber Eats gift card. I find it especially thoughtful and useful as a convenience gift, whether that’s after a death, loss, birth, or a big life change. An Uber Eats gift card is more than just a gift card. It takes another thing off someone’s plate and offers an easy, comforting meal, especially during times of grief or celebration. Uber Eats gift cards start at $15 and can be purchased from participating retailers or sent instantly through the app to friends and family.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Being a student often means tight budgets, long nights, and limited kitchen space (and culinary knowledge). Investing in an Uber One account may be a good idea—for only $10 per month, you can get, on average, $30 in savings on Uber rides and Uber grocery and meal delivery. You won’t have to worry about meal planning or expensive takeout bills. With Uber One discounts and promos, you can get multiple meals for the week at a lower cost. And if you’re a student, you can try Uber One for free for four weeks to make sure the service is a fit. After that, the service is half off at only $5 per month. No Uber Eats coupon code necessary. Just verify your student status to get the four weeks for free and $5 per month after.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Get Your Groceries Delivered with Uber Eats
paras.zh: 通过Uber Eats优食订购生鲜杂货，享受派送服务

paras.en: If you’re not in the mood to eat out, stay in and get groceries delivered with Uber Eats. Uber Eats partners with hundreds of grocery stores near you—including your favorite supermarkets—for same-day delivery in as little as 25 minutes. Using your location, Uber Eats offers fast delivery from drugstores, grocery chains, and local stores, so whether you need toilet paper or a gallon of milk, Uber Eats delivers.
paras.zh: 如果您不想外出就餐，不妨留在家中，通过Uber Eats优食订购生鲜杂货并享受派送服务。Uber Eats优食与您附近的数百家生鲜杂货店（包括您最喜爱的超市）合作，可在短短25分钟内提供当日派送服务。Uber Eats优食利用您的位置，为药店、连锁生鲜杂货店和当地商店提供快速派送服务，因此，无论您需要卫生纸还是一加仑牛奶， Uber Eats优食都能为您提供派送服务。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats regularly offers first-order discounts for new customers, often a percentage off or a capped dollar amount (like $15–$25 off) on your first delivery.
paras.zh: 是的， Uber Eats优食会定期为新顾客提供首单优惠，通常会为您的首次派送提供一定百分比的优惠或上限金额（例如$ 15至$ 25的优惠）。

paras.en: In the app, go to your account menu, select "Promotions" (or "Add promo/gift card" at checkout), enter the code, and it should apply automatically if valid and still active.
paras.zh: 在应用中，前往您的账号菜单，选择“优惠” （或结账时选择“添加优惠/礼品卡” ） ，输入优惠码。如果优惠码有效且仍然有效，则会自动应用。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats has expanded beyond restaurants to include grocery, convenience, and retail delivery, and many promo codes apply across these categories
paras.zh: 是的， Uber Eats优食已扩展到餐厅以外的地区，包括生鲜杂货、便利店和零售派送服务，许多优惠码适用于这些类别

paras.en: No. Uber Eats and Uber rides promo codes/credits are generally separate, though Uber One membership benefits apply across both rides and Eats.
paras.zh: 不可以。Uber Eats优食和优步行程优惠码/消费金通常是分开的，但Uber One会员权益同时适用于行程和Uber Eats优食。

articles.title: Teen arrested for fatal Spirit Halloween shooting of pregnant woman

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Police in northern California arrested a 17-year-old boy Monday afternoon on accusations that he fatally shot a pregnant woman and wounded six others in a shooting that erupted Friday at a Halloween costume store.
paras.zh: 11月2日（ UPI ） -加利福尼亚州北部的警方周一下午逮捕了一名17岁的男孩，指控他在周五在万圣节服装店爆发的枪击事件中致命地射杀了一名孕妇并打伤了另外六人。

paras.en: As he is a minor, the suspect's identity was being withheld from the public, but authorities said he was arrested at his residence in neighboring Suisun City and has been charged with murder and attempted murder, though additional offense may follow.
paras.zh: 由于他是未成年人，嫌疑人的身份被隐瞒，但当局表示，他在邻近的Suisun市的住所被捕，并被指控犯有谋杀罪和谋杀未遂罪，但随后可能会有其他罪行。

paras.en: He is accused of killing Constance Hages, a 31-year-old pregnant woman, when he opened fire in a Spirit Halloween store within Solano Town Center shopping mall at about 8:30 p.m. Friday.
paras.zh: 他被指控在周五晚上8:30左右在Solano Town Center购物中心的一家Spirit万圣节商店开火时杀害了31岁的孕妇Constance Hages。

paras.en: Authorities believe the shooting was targeted and followed a previous altercation, though it remained unclear which of the victims was the intended target.
paras.zh: 当局认为枪击事件是有针对性的，并且之前发生过争执，但目前尚不清楚哪名受害者是预定目标。

paras.en: On Sunday, the Fairfield Police Department identified the four injured victims who remained hospitalized as a 19-year-old man who remained in critical condition and a 16-year-old boy, a 23-year-old man and a 32-year-old man who were all in stable condition.
paras.zh: 周日，费尔菲尔德警察局确认了四名受伤的受害者，他们仍在住院治疗，一名19岁的男子仍处于危急状态，一名16岁的男孩，一名23岁的男子和一名32岁的男子均处于稳定状态。

paras.en: The two other victims who received treatment for gunshot wounds and were released from the hospital were both men, a 19-year-old and a 43-year-old.
paras.zh: 另外两名因枪伤接受治疗并从医院出院的受害者均为男性，分别为19岁和43岁。

paras.en: Michelle Belyea, public information officer for the Fairfield Police Department, said during the press conference that the suspect entered the store, spotted a customer believed to have been the intended target, produced a firearm and opened fire before fleeing the scene.
paras.zh: 费尔菲尔德警察局公共信息官员Michelle Belyea在新闻发布会上说，嫌疑人进入商店，发现了一名据信是预定目标的顾客，在逃离现场之前生产了一支枪并开火。

paras.en: Authorities identified the suspect within hours of the shooting, though Fairfield Police Chief Dan Marshall said he was uncertain who the target was.
paras.zh: 当局在枪击事件发生后数小时内确认了嫌疑人的身份，但费尔菲尔德警察局局长丹·马歇尔表示，他不确定目标是谁。

paras.en: The police department said a Fairfield Police school resource officer, reviewing surveillance footage from the store, recognized the suspect as a former student, which led to his arrest.
paras.zh: 警方表示，一名费尔菲尔德警方学校资源官员在查看商店的监控录像时，认出嫌疑人是前学生，导致他被捕。

paras.en: Marshall addressed criticism during the press conference over a supposed lack of information made public about the suspect, stating that because investigators knew who they were looking for, they didn't want to alert the suspect that they were onto him.
paras.zh: 马歇尔在新闻发布会上就所谓的缺乏有关嫌疑人的信息提出了批评，称由于调查人员知道他们在寻找谁，他们不想提醒嫌疑人他们正在调查他。

paras.en: "We were on him pretty quickly as far as following where he is, tracking him down, so we were able to finally make an arrest today. I know there's different thought process there, but we didn't want to compromise the case and we didn't want him out any longer than he could be before we could track him down," Marshall said.
paras.zh: “我们很快就追踪到他的位置，追踪到他，所以我们今天终于能够逮捕他。我知道那里有不同的思考过程，但我们不想妥协这个案子，在我们能够找到他之前，我们不想让他出去的时间比他长，”马歇尔说。

paras.en: The suspect was previously arrested in connection with a shooting that occurred in the parking lot of a local school in 2025 -- a crime for which Marshall said the suspect only served a few months in juvenile hall.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人此前因与2025年在当地学校停车场发生的枪击事件有关而被捕-马歇尔称嫌疑人仅在少年大厅服刑几个月。

paras.en: In announcing the charges, Marshall criticized the judicial system for permitting this minor to commit a second shooting.
paras.zh: 在宣布指控时，马歇尔批评司法系统允许这名未成年人进行第二次射击。

paras.en: "This event shouldn't have even occurred," he said, calling for legislative changes to impose tougher penalties for minors.
paras.zh: 他说： “这件事本不应该发生，”他呼吁修改立法，对未成年人施加更严厉的惩罚。

paras.en: The Spirit Halloween store shooting comes months after a 17-year-old was accused of killing one person and wounding three others in a shooting during a graduation ceremony at Fairfield High School in early June.
paras.zh: 6月初，在费尔菲尔德高中举行的毕业典礼上，一名17岁的男子被指控在枪击事件中杀死一人并打伤另外三人，几个月后，精神万圣节商店发生了枪击事件。

paras.en: "California has gotten extremely soft on accountability with youth, and I think after seeing the homicide at the graduation at Fairfield High School earlier in the year and now this, another juvenile male, it's showing that legislative changes are showing a lack of accountability for our youth.
paras.zh: “加利福尼亚州在对年轻人的问责制方面变得非常软弱，我认为在今年早些时候在费尔菲尔德高中毕业时看到凶杀案，现在又是一名少年男子，这表明立法改革显示出对我们的年轻人缺乏问责制。

paras.en: "We have to see something change," he continued.
paras.zh: “我们必须看到一些变化，”他继续说道。

paras.en: "I don't know how many more people have to die at the hands of youth."
paras.zh: “我不知道还要有多少人死在年轻人手中。”

paras.en: Marshall said the suspect was arrested peacefully.
paras.zh: 马歇尔说，嫌疑人是和平逮捕的。

paras.en: He added that Solano County District Attorney Krishna Abrams was looking into the possibility of charging him with double murder as Hages was pregnant.
paras.zh: 他补充说，由于Hages怀孕， Solano县地方检察官Krishna Abrams正在研究指控他犯有双重谋杀罪的可能性。

articles.title: Trilateral U.S.-Ukraine-Russia talks on ending Moscow's war to resume

paras.en: Nov. 3 (UPI) -- Trilateral talks between the United States, Russia and Ukraine on ending Moscow's nearly five-year-long war will resume next week in Abu Dhabi, U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff said Monday.
paras.zh: 11月3日（合众社）——美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫周一表示，美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰之间关于结束莫斯科近五年战争的三边会谈将于下周在阿布扎比恢复。

paras.en: Witkoff, President Donald Trump's special envoy to the Middle East, announced on social media that the talks were scheduled for Nov. 10-11 in the United Arab Emirates' capital and will focus on "post-war security arrangements, de-escalation, humanitarian effort and next steps toward peace."
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的中东特使威特科夫在社交媒体上宣布，会谈定于 11 月 10 日至 11 日在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都举行，重点讨论“战后安全安排、缓和局势、人道主义努力以及实现和平的下一步”。

paras.en: U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine have waned since February, when the last talks were held in Geneva and when Washington's war with Tehran began.
paras.zh: 自二月份最后一次会谈在日内瓦举行以及华盛顿与德黑兰的战争开始以来，美国结束乌克兰战争的努力已经减弱。

paras.en: Witkoff said American negotiators will meet in Brussels this week with representatives from Britain, France, Germany, the European Union and NATO to discuss "security guarantees for Ukraine, Europe's post-war security architecture and economic opportunities to support Ukraine's reconstruction."
paras.zh: 维特科夫表示，美国谈判代表本周将在布鲁塞尔与英国、法国、德国、欧盟和北约的代表会面，讨论“乌克兰的安全保障、欧洲战后安全架构以及支持乌克兰重建的经济机会”。

paras.en: "We look forward to building on the progress made in Kyiv, Oslo and St. Petersburg toward a comprehensive, durable peace agreement that delivers lasting security for generations to come," he said in the statement.
paras.zh: 他在声明中表示：“我们期待在基辅、奥斯陆和圣彼得堡取得的进展基础上，达成一项全面、持久的和平协议，为子孙后代带来持久的安全。”

paras.en: Trump campaigned on ending the war within 24 hours of being elected. In the two years since his return to office, both sides remain far apart. There have been several rounds of trilateral talks that appear to have made little progress toward peace, with U.S. diplomatic focus shifting to ending its war with Iran since late last winter.
paras.zh: 特朗普在当选后 24 小时内就结束了战争。他复任两年来，双方分歧依然很大。自去年冬末以来，美国外交重点转向结束与伊朗的战争，几轮三边会谈似乎在和平方面几乎没有取得任何进展。

paras.en: The renewed U.S. push to end the war in Ukraine comes after Trump temporarily eased certain U.S. sanctions on Russia and to purchase Russian diesel, and after Witkoff visited Russian leader Vladimir Putin last month, a visit during which he secured the release of American citizen Stephen Hubbard.
paras.zh: 在特朗普暂时放松了美国对俄罗斯的某些制裁并购买俄罗斯柴油之后，以及威特科夫上个月拜访了俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京并促成美国公民斯蒂芬·哈伯德获释之后，美国重新推动结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Putin's aide, Yury Ushakov, said last month during Witkoff's visit that Russia would be "ready in principle" to resume the trilateral talks. Days later, President Volodymyr Zelensky said preparations were underway and that Kyiv was discussing the talks with their European partners to ensure its position was taken into account.
paras.zh: 普京的助手尤里·乌沙科夫上个月在维特科夫访问期间表示，俄罗斯将“原则上准备好”恢复三边会谈。几天后，总统泽伦斯基表示，准备工作正在进行中，基辅正在与欧洲伙伴讨论谈判，以确保其立场得到考虑。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Russia has continued targeting Ukrainian civilian areas and energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯继续瞄准乌克兰平民地区和能源基础设施。

paras.en: According to the Institute for the Study of War, Russian forces have been intensifying their use of jet-powered drones to maximize civilian harm since August. In October, Russia further intensified its long-range strike campaign, the Washington-based institute said in a late Monday report, stating that "Russia's increasingly devastating strikes come against the backdrop of Putin's evolving theory of victory that hinges" on the effectiveness of this strategy "to make Ukrainian civilian life untenable and to disrupt and isolate the Ukrainian economy from Europe."
paras.zh: 据战争研究所称，自八月以来，俄罗斯军队一直在加强对喷气式无人机的使用，以最大程度地伤害平民。总部位于华盛顿的该研究所在周一晚些时候的一份报告中表示，10月份，俄罗斯进一步加强了远程打击行动，并指出“俄罗斯日益具有破坏性的打击是在普京不断演变的胜利理论的背景下进行的，该理论取决于”这一战略的有效性，“使乌克兰平民的生活变得难以维持，并扰乱和孤立乌克兰经济与欧洲。”

paras.en: Zelensky, on Monday, however, called on the United States to do more to restrain Russia, in particular its oil and gas industry.
paras.zh: 然而，泽伦斯基周一呼吁美国采取更多措施来限制俄罗斯，特别是其石油和天然气行业。

paras.en: He said Kyiv has intelligence that Russia was preparing "a new massive attack," primarily targeting energy and logistics infrastructure, suggesting it could occur Tuesday when global attention will be on the midterm elections in the United States.
paras.zh: 他说，基辅有情报显示，俄罗斯正在准备“一场新的大规模袭击”，主要针对能源和物流基础设施，这表明袭击可能会在周二发生，届时全球的注意力将集中在美国中期选举上。

paras.en: "We need signals from the world to Russia that will make them feel that terror is no good, that it will bring no gains and that as long as this war continues, their oil will burn, and they will not be able to make money doing business with the world," he said in a recorded statement.
paras.zh: “我们需要世界向俄罗斯发出信号，让他们觉得恐怖没有好处，不会带来任何好处，只要这场战争继续下去，他们的石油就会燃烧，他们将无法赚钱与世界做生意，”他在一份记录在案的声明中说。

paras.en: "We must not play games with Russia's oil or gas revenues. We must put pressure on Russia in such a way that it has no alternative but to end this war. America can do this."
paras.zh: “我们绝不能玩弄俄罗斯的石油或天然气收入。我们必须对俄罗斯施加压力，使其别无选择，只能结束这场战争。美国可以做到这一点。”

articles.title: Reports: U.S. attacks Iran's Qeshm Island

paras.en: Nov. 3 (UPI) -- The U.S. military attacked Iran's Qeshm Island, according to reports.
paras.zh: 11月3日（UPI）——据报道，美军袭击了伊朗格什姆岛。

paras.en: The limited strikes, reported by NBC News, ABC News and CNN, all citing unidentified U.S. officials, came on the eve of midterm elections in the United States. President Donald Trump had said on Oct. 8 that the United States would not attack Iran "at any time" before Tuesday's midterm elections.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻、ABC 新闻和 CNN 均援引身份不明的美国官员的话说，这次有限的罢工发生在美国中期选举前夕。唐纳德·特朗普总统10月8日曾表示，在周二中期选举之前，美国不会“任何时候”攻击伊朗。

paras.en: Iran's state-run Islamic Republic News Agency reported explosions in Qeshm, an island within the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint on a vital energy shipping route where Iran has restricted traffic through by military force since the war began after the United States and Israel attacked in late February.
paras.zh: 伊朗国营伊斯兰共和国通讯社报道了霍尔木兹海峡内的格什姆岛发生爆炸事件，该岛是一条重要能源运输路线上的咽喉要道，自二月底美国和以色列袭击后战争爆发以来，伊朗一直通过军事力量限制该路线的交通。

paras.en: Reports of the U.S. attack on Monday described the strikes as retaliatory, with an official telling NBC News that "This was a defensive measure for Iranians using surface-to-air missiles against U.S. assets."
paras.zh: 周一有关美国袭击的报道将此次袭击描述为报复性袭击，一名官员告诉 NBC 新闻，“这是伊朗使用地对空导弹攻击美国资产的防御措施。”

paras.en: It was not immediately clear which U.S. assets were targeted by the Iranian missiles.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚哪些美国资产是伊朗导弹的目标。

paras.en: The U.S. military last publicly announced strikes against Iran was on Sept. 8, when U.S. Central Command said its forces had destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeted a U.S. Navy warship with ballistic missiles twice over the previous two days.
paras.zh: 美国军方最后一次公开宣布对伊朗发动打击是在9月8日，当时美国中央司令部表示，在伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队在过去两天内两次用弹道导弹瞄准一艘美国海军军舰后，美国军队摧毁了五艘伊朗原油运输船。

paras.en: U.S. forces had previously paused strikes for about a month between late July and late August, before resuming attacks on Iranian military installations near the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 此前，美军曾在7月下旬至8月下旬期间暂停袭击约一个月，然后才恢复对霍尔木兹海峡附近伊朗军事设施的袭击。

paras.en: ABC News reported that strikes were the latest in a series by the United States in recent weeks in response to Iran increasing its attacks targeting commercial ships trainsiting the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 据美国广播公司新闻报道，美国最近几周针对伊朗加大对霍尔木兹海峡商船的袭击力度，发起了一系列袭击行动，这是其中的最新一次。

paras.en: The unnamed U.S. officials told ABC News that the United States has not been publicizing the attacks to prevent signaling a resumption of major combat operations.
paras.zh: 不愿透露姓名的美国官员告诉美国广播公司新闻，美国尚未公布这些袭击事件，以防止发出恢复重大战斗行动的信号。

articles.title: Kelly Clarkson Compares 13-Year-Old ‘The Voice’ Singer to Whitney Houston
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Kelly Clarkson was moved to tears on The Voice after 13-year-old Brianna Cameron delivered a performance that drew comparisons to Whitney Houston during the show’s new Cut Week round.
paras.zh: 凯莉·克拉克森 (Kelly Clarkson) 在《美国好声音》新一轮剪辑周中，13 岁的布丽安娜·卡梅隆 (Brianna Cameron) 的表演与惠特尼·休斯顿 (Whitney Houston) 的表演相媲美，她感动落泪。

paras.en: Cameron, a member of Team Kelly, performed Natalie Cole’s “Inseparable” during Monday night’s episode, immediately impressing Clarkson and the rest of the coaching panel.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦是凯利队的成员，他在周一晚上的节目中表演了娜塔莉·科尔的《形影不离》，立即给克拉克森和教练小组的其他成员留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: “It’s like we’re watching young Whitney Houston,” Clarkson said after the performance. “You are insane!”
paras.zh: “这就像我们正在观看年轻的惠特尼·休斯顿一样，”克拉克森在表演后说道。 “你疯了！”

paras.en: The performance came during Cut Week, a new twist that forced each coach to cut their team from seven singers down to three ahead of the live shows. Cameron quickly became one of the night’s biggest standouts.
paras.zh: 这场表演是在剪辑周期间进行的，这是一个新的转折，迫使每个教练在现场表演之前将他们的团队从七名歌手减少到三名。卡梅伦很快成为当晚最引人注目的人物之一。

paras.en: “This is almost unfathomable,” Queen Latifah told her, “that you can sing like this with this poise at this age.”
paras.zh: “这几乎是不可思议的，”奎因·拉提法告诉她，“你在这个年纪还能如此泰然自若地唱歌。”

paras.en: “Brianna, you’re by far the most naturally talented person I’ve seen on the show,” he said.
paras.zh: “布莱恩娜，你是迄今为止我在节目中见过的最有天赋的人，”他说。

paras.en: Clarkson returned to the Houston comparison, saying, “I haven’t heard runs like that since Whitney. You’re 13 years old. I just have a really hard time accepting you as a human. You’re like an alien.”
paras.zh: 克拉克森回到休斯顿，说道：“自从惠特尼之后，我就再没有听过这样的跑步了。你才 13 岁。我真的很难接受你作为一个人。你就像一个外星人。”

paras.en: Clarkson ultimately selected Cameron to advance to the live rounds alongside Koumba Diallo and Anna McElroy. Kyle Davis, Brooklyn Marie, Marcus Ladden Jr. and Nina Howland were eliminated from Team Kelly.
paras.zh: 克拉克森最终选择卡梅伦与昆巴·迪亚洛和安娜·麦克埃尔罗伊一起晋级现场比赛。凯尔·戴维斯、布鲁克林·玛丽、小马库斯·拉登和尼娜·霍兰被凯利队淘汰。

paras.en: Cameron’s performance stood out on a night built around unusually steep cuts. Host Carson Daly warned viewers at the beginning of the episode that more than half of the remaining contestants would be sent home.
paras.zh: 卡梅隆的表演在这个以异常陡峭的剪辑为背景的夜晚中脱颖而出。主持人卡森·戴利在剧集开始时警告观众，剩余参赛者中一半以上将被送回家。

paras.en: “After tonight, more than half of our artists are gonna see their journeys come to an end,” Daly said. “We’ve never faced an elimination this big before.”
paras.zh: “今晚之后，我们一半以上的艺术家将看到他们的旅程结束，”戴利说。 “我们以前从未面临过如此大的淘汰。”

paras.en: Elsewhere in the episode, Green advanced Cade Mower and duo Ferryn & Brinkley, then selected Joe Henley for his final spot after Henley performed Keith Whitley’s “Don’t Close Your Eyes.”
paras.zh: 在这一集的其他地方，格林晋级了凯德·莫尔和二人组费林和布林克利，然后在亨利表演了基思·惠特利的《别闭上你的眼睛》后，选择了乔·亨利作为他的最后一个位置。

paras.en: Queen Latifah advanced Mia Knight and BigCountry before choosing Lillie Kolich following her rendition of The Cure’s “Friday I’m in Love.”
paras.zh: Queen Latifah 优先选择了 Mia Knight 和 BigCountry，然后在演绎 The Cure 的《Friday I'm in Love》后选择了 Lillie Kolich。

paras.en: Adam Levine selected Lexi Stephens and Connor Closs, then gave his final live-show spot to Dakota Cohen after her performance of Fuel’s “Hemorrhage (In My Hands).” Levine dubbed Cohen “Baby Miley” following the performance.
paras.zh: 亚当·莱文选择了莱克西·斯蒂芬斯和康纳·克洛斯，然后在表演完 Fuel 的《Hemorrhage (In My Hands)》后，将最后一个现场表演席位让给了达科塔·科恩 (Dakota Cohen)。演出结束后，莱文称科恩为“宝贝麦莉”。

paras.en: The episode marked the first appearance of Cut Week, which is designed to narrow the field before The Voice moves into its live rounds. One eliminated contestant will still be able to return through viewer voting.
paras.zh: 这一集标志着《Cut Week》的首次亮相，旨在在《好声音》进入现场直播之前缩小范围。一名被淘汰的参赛者仍然可以通过观众投票重返赛场。

paras.en: The live shows begin next week, with viewers taking a larger role in deciding which contestants advance toward the season finale on Dec. 14.
paras.zh: 现场表演将于下周开始，观众将在决定哪些参赛者晋级 12 月 14 日的季终决赛中发挥更大的作用。

articles.title: Emilia Explores New Era with ‘Bodypainting’: ‘It Speaks More of Freedom and Sensuality’
articles.author: Jessica Roiz

paras.en: This year, Emilia has collaborated with artists such as Manuel Turizo, Ludmilla, Latto, Carlos Vives, Wisin, and Zara Larson, to name a few. However, on her 30th birthday (Oct. 29) she dropped her first solo single of the year called “Bodypainting.”
paras.zh: 今年，艾米莉亚与 Manuel Turizo、Ludmilla、Latto、Carlos Vives、Wisin 和 Zara Larson 等艺术家合作。然而，在她 30 岁生日那天（10 月 29 日），她放弃了今年的第一首个人单曲《Bodypainting》。

paras.en: The track is also the first taste of the Argentine singer’s forthcoming third studio album.
paras.zh: 这首歌曲也是这位阿根廷歌手即将推出的第三张录音室专辑的初尝。

paras.en: “The truth is, I took a lot of time to work on the new album and decide on the singles,” she says on the latest episode of Billboard’s “Cafecito Con” video series. “Every time I start a new album—a new creative process—I enter a phase of uncertainty. Personally, I feel that .mp3 (her 2023 album) set the bar quite high; so, beyond my own expectations, I’m also trying to meet the expectations of my fans, who are rather demanding. I try to listen to my team, listen to what I want myself, and make sure I don’t lose my way in that process.”
paras.zh: “事实是，我花了很多时间来制作新专辑并决定单曲，”她在公告牌“Cafecito Con”视频系列的最新一集中说道。 “每次我开始一张新专辑——一个新的创作过程——我都会进入一个不确定的阶段。就我个人而言，我觉得 .mp3（她 2023 年的专辑）设定的标准相当高；因此，超出我自己的预期，我也在努力满足粉丝的期望，他们的要求相当高。我试着倾听我的团队的声音，倾听我自己想要的东西，并确保我不会在这个过程中迷失方向。”

paras.en: “Bodypainting” is a progressive fusion of alternative and electronic music, while staying rooted in Emilia’s core pop sound.
paras.zh: “Bodypainting”是另类音乐和电子音乐的渐进融合，同时植根于 Emilia 的核心流行音乐。

paras.en: “I asked myself, what is it that I want? What do I want to hear from myself? And everything kept pointing toward pop—it always has. Lately, I’ve felt very comfortable with the genre, and I wanted to set myself a challenge: how to take it to the next level,” she shares. “I feel like people are seeing a more mature Emilia, one who shares her own experiences and life moments. ‘Bodypainting’ speaks more to themes of freedom and sensuality—I’ve always felt quite comfortable avoiding that side of things, but honestly, I’m super excited about this new phase.”
paras.zh: “我问自己，我想要什么？我想从自己那里听到什么？一切都指向流行音乐——一直如此。最近，我对这种流派感觉非常舒服，我想给自己设定一个挑战：如何将其提升到一个新的水平，”她分享道。 “我觉得人们看到了一个更加成熟的艾米莉亚，她分享了自己的经历和生活时刻。‘人体彩绘’更多地表达了自由和性感的主题——我一直觉得避免这方面的事情很舒服，但说实话，我对这个新阶段感到非常兴奋。”

paras.en: During the “Cafecito Con” episode, Emilia also talked about her collab with Zara Larsson, performing at Coachella, her gym routine, going to Japan with her boyfriend Duki, and many more. Watch it above.
paras.zh: 在“Cafecito Con”节目中，艾米莉亚还谈到了她与扎拉·拉尔森 (Zara Larsson) 的合作、在科切拉音乐节 (Coachella) 的表演、她的健身习惯、与男友杜基 (Duki) 一起去日本等等。请注意上面的内容。

articles.title: 5 Seconds of Summer Bring Out The Wiggles in Melbourne
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: 5 Seconds of Summer gave their Melbourne crowd an unexpected dose of nostalgia on Monday night (Nov. 2), bringing out The Wiggles during the final song of their Rod Laver Arena show.
paras.zh: 周一晚上（11 月 2 日），5 Seconds of Summer 在 Rod Laver Arena 演出的最后一首歌中演唱了 The Wiggles，为墨尔本观众带来了意想不到的怀旧之情。

paras.en: The Australian pop-rock group were closing out the night with “Everyone’s a Star!” when the children’s music icons joined them onstage, turning the finale into a distinctly Australian crossover moment.
paras.zh: 这支澳大利亚流行摇滚乐队以《Everyone's a Star!》结束了当晚的演出。当孩子们的音乐偶像加入他们的舞台时，将结局变成了一个明显的澳大利亚跨界时刻。

paras.en: The surprise appearance featured members of The Wiggles’ current lineup alongside familiar characters including Dorothy the Dinosaur, Wags the Dog, Henry the Octopus and the Tree of Wisdom. Original Purple Wiggle Jeff Fatt also joined the performance.
paras.zh: 此次惊喜亮相的成员包括 The Wiggles 目前的阵容成员以及熟悉的角色，包括恐龙多萝西、狗摇摇摆摆、章鱼亨利和智慧树。原创 Purple Wiggle 杰夫·法特 (Jeff Fatt) 也加入了表演。

paras.en: “We love what they do, and it’s always so special to celebrate incredible Aussie talent,” Yellow Wiggle Tsehay Hawkins said of the collaboration. “We couldn’t wait to jump on stage to bring a little Wiggly magic to their final song of the night. It was so much fun.”
paras.zh: Yellow Wiggle Tsehay Hawkins 谈到此次合作时表示：“我们喜欢他们所做的事情，庆祝澳大利亚不可思议的天才总是那么特别。” “我们迫不及待地跳上舞台，为他们当晚的最后一首歌带来一点 Wiggly 的魔力。太有趣了。”

paras.en: Fan-shot footage from the arena quickly began circulating online following the performance, capturing the two Australian acts sharing the stage during the closing number.
paras.zh: 表演结束后，现场粉丝拍摄的视频很快开始在网上流传，捕捉到了两位澳大利亚表演者在闭幕式上同台表演的画面。

paras.en: The Melbourne show forms part of 5 Seconds of Summer’s Everyone’s a Star! World Tour, supporting the band’s sixth studio album, Everyone’s a Star!, released in 2025 via Republic Records. The album debuted at No. 6 on the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 墨尔本演出是 5 Seconds of Summer 节目“人人都是明星”的一部分！世界巡演，支持乐队的第六张录音室专辑《Everybody’s a Star!》，该专辑于 2025 年通过 Republic Records 发行。这张专辑首张就在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 6。

paras.en: The tour has already taken the band through Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne, with Adelaide and Perth dates still to come on the Australian leg.
paras.zh: 乐队的巡演已途经布里斯班、悉尼和墨尔本，澳大利亚站的阿德莱德和珀斯演出尚未结束。

paras.en: The Wiggles are also in the middle of their own Australian run with the Sparkle! BIG SHOW tour. Upcoming stops include Newcastle, Canberra, Adelaide, Perth, Melbourne, Hobart, Launceston, Brisbane, Wollongong and Sydney through December.
paras.zh: Wiggles 也正与 Sparkle 一起在澳大利亚进行比赛！大秀巡演。 12 月份即将开通的站点包括纽卡斯尔、堪培拉、阿德莱德、珀斯、墨尔本、霍巴特、朗塞斯顿、布里斯班、卧龙岗和悉尼。

paras.en: For 5SOS, the cameo capped another home-country arena show in a year that has seen the group continue touring behind Everyone’s a Star! around the world.
paras.zh: 对于 5SOS 来说，这次客串是一年内另一场本土舞台演出的高潮，该乐队在《Everyone's a Star》之后继续巡回演出！世界各地。

articles.title: ‘Red Before Dawn’ Review: A Road Movie Revisits the Indonesian Revolution in Ways More Didactic Than Climactic
articles.author: Jordan Mintzer

paras.en: Few people outside of Indonesia are likely to be familiar with the war of independence that began there just as WWII was coming to an end, resulting in hundreds of thousands of deaths at the hands of both Dutch soldiers and warring sectarian factions. The country finally achieved full emancipation from the Netherlands in 1949, though the wounds opened by the long and often brutal conflict would remain for the decades that followed.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚以外的人可能很少熟悉在第二次世界大战即将结束时爆发的独立战争，这场战争导致数十万人死于荷兰士兵和交战派系之手。该国最终于 1949 年从荷兰的统治下完全解放，尽管长期且残酷的冲突造成的创伤在随后的几十年中仍然存在。

paras.en: Prolific Indonesian director Garin Nugroho revisits that pivotal historical period in Red Before Dawn (Merah Sebelum Fajar), a wartime road movie that condenses multiple aspects of the revolution into one rocky and dangerous trip through hostile territory. Following a cast of diverse characters who journey from Jakarta to Yogyakarta in 1946, facing countless obstacles but growing closer along the way, the film attempts to show how people from various ethnic and religious backgrounds managed to finally unite behind a single flag.
paras.zh: 多产的印度尼西亚导演加林·努格罗霍在《黎明前的红色》（Merah Sebelum Fajar）中重温了这一关键历史时期，这是一部战时公路电影，将革命的多个方面浓缩为一次穿越敌对领土的崎岖而危险的旅程。影片讲述了 1946 年一群形形色色的人物从雅加达前往日惹的旅程，他们面临着无数的障碍，但一路走来却越来越亲密，影片试图展示来自不同种族和宗教背景的人们如何最终团结在一面旗帜后面。

paras.en: Cast: Nicholas Saputra, Laura Basuki, Bront Palarae, Tissa Biani, Nagra Pakesadewo, Mariska Setiawan
paras.zh: 主演： 尼古拉斯·萨普特拉 / 劳拉·锺万学 / 布朗特·帕拉瑞 / 蒂莎·比亚尼 / 纳格拉·帕克萨德沃 / 玛莉丝卡·塞蒂亚万

paras.en: Screenwriters: Garin Nugroho, Dirmawan Hatta
paras.zh: 编剧： 加林·努格罗霍、迪尔马万·哈塔

paras.en: On paper the idea is intriguing, and Red Before Dawn benefits from both an ambitious set-up and a highly cinematic setting, traveling through lush jungles and fields, rivers, villages and ancient ruins as the gang makes their way across the countryside in the year following Indonesia’s declaration of independence. Where the film falters is in its rather didactic brand of storytelling, with actors reciting reams of expository dialogue and situations that tend to feel more demonstrative than dramatic.
paras.zh: 从纸面上看，这个想法很有趣，《黎明前的红色》受益于雄心勃勃的设定和高度电影化的背景，在印度尼西亚宣布独立后的一年里，黑帮穿越了茂密的丛林和田野、河流、村庄和古代遗址。这部电影的失败之处在于其相当说教的叙事方式，演员们背诵了大量的说明性对话和场景，这些对话和场景往往让人感觉更具示范性，而不是戏剧性。

paras.en: The pedagogical nature of the filmmaking is evident from the opening scene, which uses a theater piece to depict how the Dutch army showed zero mercy toward Indonesian freedom fighters during the war, labeling them as terrorists and executing them at will. (Estimates of casualties on the Indonesian side range from 100,000 to 250,000, with several million more displaced, versus roughly 15,000 dead on the Dutch side.) Animated sequences are also used to depict the inner thoughts of the film’s hero and narrator, Frans (Nicholas Saputra), a “half-blood” whose mixed Dutch and Indonesian heritage makes him a living, breathing example of the colonial battle that tore his country apart.
paras.zh: 电影制作的教育性质从开场就显而易见，它用戏剧作品描述了荷兰军队如何在战争期间对印度尼西亚自由战士表现出零怜悯，将他们标记为恐怖分子并随意处决他们。 （预计印尼方面的伤亡人数在 10 万到 25 万人之间，还有数百万人流离失所，而荷兰方面大约有 15,000 人死亡。）动画片段也用来描绘影片的英雄和叙述者弗兰斯（尼古拉斯·萨普特拉饰）的内心想法，弗兰斯是一个“混血儿”，拥有荷兰和印度尼西亚的混血血统，这使他成为了撕裂他的殖民战争的活生生的例子。国家分开。

paras.en: A respected engineer carrying a briefcase full of valuable geological surveys, Frans sets out on a mission to deliver his plans to the newly formed independent government that has set up shop in Yogyakarta, while other parts of Indonesia still remain under Dutch control. He enlists an Indian driver, Qasim (Bront Palarae), to steer their truck across deadly lands, bringing along a blind radio operator, Arya (Nagra Pakusadewo), who hopes to spread the revolutionary gospel over the airwaves. Along the way they also pick up a Chinese nurse, Fifi (Laura Basuki), and the lounge singer, Bandriah (Tissa Biani), making for an eclectic ensemble hailing from all walks of Indonesian life.
paras.zh: 弗兰斯是一位受人尊敬的工程师，提着一个装满珍贵地质调查的公文包，他的任务是向新成立的独立政府交付他的计划，该政府已在日惹设立了办事处，而印度尼西亚的其他地区仍处于荷兰的控制之下。他招募了一名印度司机卡西姆（布朗特·帕拉瑞饰）驾驶卡车穿越致命的土地，并带来了盲人无线电操作员艾莉亚（纳格拉·帕库萨德沃饰），她希望通过无线电波传播革命福音。一路上，他们还结识了中国护士菲菲（劳拉·锺万学饰）和休闲歌手班德里亚（蒂莎·比亚尼饰），组成了一支来自印尼各行各业的不拘一格的乐团。

paras.en: The 600-mile journey brings them face-to-face with hordes of their violent countrymen, whether it’s devout Muslims standing their ground, Chinese landowners facing persecution or a host of gun-toting rebels who see Frans and his crew as enemies rather than as fellow combatants. People get shot, stabbed, taken prisoner and kicked around, yet the tension is never high enough in a film that should be more thrilling. Music sequences, including a few songs performed by Biani, add some lightness to the proceedings, as does a romantic subplot between Frans and Fifi that winds up feeling superfluous.
paras.zh: 600 英里的旅程让他们与成群的暴力同胞面对面，无论是坚守阵地的虔诚穆斯林、面临迫害的中国地主，还是一群将弗兰斯和他的船员视为敌人而不是战友的持枪叛乱分子。人们被枪杀、被刺伤、被俘虏、被踢来踢去，但在一部本应该更惊心动魄的电影中，紧张气氛却从未如此强烈。音乐序列，包括比亚尼表演的几首歌曲，为整个过程增添了一些轻松感，弗兰斯和菲菲之间的浪漫次要情节最终感觉多余。

paras.en: Nugroho, a writer-director-producer who has nearly 40 movies under his belt in a career spanning over four decades, displays a solid level of craft throughout the adventure, especially in village settings that mix rural life with scenes of wartime devastation. But his narrative is ultimately more illustrative than organic, as if he needed to cover as many facets of the conflict as possible within a two-hour feature, not to mention explain the stakes to us over and over again, thus deflating much of the suspense.
paras.zh: 努格罗霍是一位编剧兼导演兼制片人，在四十多年的职业生涯中拍摄了近 40 部电影，在整个冒险过程中展现了扎实的技艺水平，尤其是在将乡村生活与战时破坏场景融为一体的乡村背景中。但他的叙述最终更多地是说明性的，而不是有机的，就好像他需要在两个小时的故事中尽可能多地涵盖冲突的各个方面，更不用说一遍又一遍地向我们解释利害关系，从而消除大部分悬念。

paras.en: Still, the traumas that Frans and the others face manage to leave their mark by the end of the journey, accumulating into a vision of the Indonesian revolution that underscores how violent the era truly was, yet how it was also filled with passion and hope among the people. True to its title, the film depicts the years before the dawn of a new nation as red ones indeed, marked by plenty of bloodshed but also a burning desire for freedom.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，弗兰斯和其他人所面临的创伤在旅程结束时仍然留下了印记，累积成印度尼西亚革命的愿景，突显了这个时代的真实暴力程度，但同时也让人民充满了激情和希望。正如其标题一样，这部电影将一个新国家黎明前的岁月描述为真正的红色岁月，其特点是大量的流血，但也有对自由的强烈渴望。

paras.en: Cast: Nicholas Saputra, Laura Basuki, Bront Palarae, Tissa Biani, Nagra Pakesadewo, Mariska Setiawan
paras.zh: 主演： 尼古拉斯·萨普特拉 / 劳拉·锺万学 / 布朗特·帕拉瑞 / 蒂莎·比亚尼 / 纳格拉·帕克萨德沃 / 玛莉丝卡·塞蒂亚万

articles.title: Inde Navarrette, Michael B. Jordan and Yerin Ha Front David Yurman’s New York-Set Holiday Campaign
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: David Yurman is no stranger to a star-studded holiday campaign, so just as the calendar struck November, the luxury label unveiled its latest iteration for the 2026 gifting season. Obsession‘s Inde Navarrette and Bridgerton‘s Yerin Ha join Academy Award-winning actor and David Yurman Global Brand Ambassador Michael B. Jordan in the cinematic seasonal campaign, aptly titled Share the Warmth, which plays out in a series of quintessential New York vignettes shot throughout the snow-dusted city.
