articles.title: World News in Brief: 300,000 displaced in Lebanon, Türk ‘deeply concerned’ over Novaya Gazeta closure, $50 million refugee appeal, World Cities Day

paras.en: World News in Brief: 300,000 displaced in Lebanon, Türk ‘deeply concerned’ over Novaya Gazeta closure, $50 million refugee appeal, World Cities Day
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：黎巴嫩 30 万流离失所者、土耳其“深切关注”《新报》关闭、5000 万美元难民呼吁、世界城市日

paras.en: Despite civilians’ willingness to return home, continued Israeli military activity and presence in the south are making it very difficult, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told journalists on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克周五对记者表示，尽管平民愿意返回家园，但以色列持续的军事活动和在南部的存在使返回家园变得非常困难。

paras.en: This week alone, further demolitions, fires and strikes by Israeli forces were reported across Southern Lebanon, both within the so-called combat zone declared by Israel – from which residents were ordered to evacuate – and beyond it.
paras.zh: 仅本周，据报道，以色列军队在黎巴嫩南部各地进行了进一步的拆除、纵火和袭击，这些事件都发生在以色列宣布的所谓战区（居民被命令撤离）及其以外。

paras.en: Although close to 970,000 people have returned to their communities in the south, their situation is often dire: homes have been damaged, while essential services are disrupted and making a living has become ever more challenging.
paras.zh: 尽管近 97 万人已返回南部社区，但他们的处境往往很严峻：家园遭到破坏，基本服务中断，谋生变得更加困难。

paras.en: In Nabatieh Governorate, for example, insecurity and restrictions on access to agricultural land are disrupting the olive harvest there.
paras.zh: 例如，在纳巴提耶省，不安全局势和对农业用地的限制正在扰乱那里的橄榄收成。

paras.en: In some villages, farmers have been able to harvest for only two days before being forced by the Israeli army to stop doing so.
paras.zh: 在一些村庄，农民只能收获两天，就被以色列军队强迫停止这样做。

paras.en: As part of the humanitarian response, OCHA’s Lebanon Humanitarian Fund has allocated $91 million to support displaced people, returnees, refugees and other communities affected by this year's escalation.
paras.zh: 作为人道主义应对措施的一部分，人道协调厅的黎巴嫩人道主义基金已拨款 9100 万美元，以支持流离失所者、回返者、难民和其他受今年冲突升级影响的社区。

paras.en: Russia: Türk ‘deeply concerned’ by forced closure of Novaya Gazeta
paras.zh: 俄罗斯：土耳其对《新报》被迫关闭表示“深切关注”

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk said on Friday he was deeply concerned and saddened by the announcement that Novaya Gazeta, a “highly respected” independent Russian newspaper, is being forced to close.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周五表示，他对“备受尊敬的”俄罗斯独立报纸《新报》被迫关闭的消息深感担忧和悲伤。

paras.en: He called it “yet another devastating blow for remaining independent media in the Russian Federation”.
paras.zh: 他称其为“对俄罗斯联邦剩余独立媒体的又一次毁灭性打击”。

paras.en: Independent journalism in Russia has faced mounting restrictions for many years, Mr. Türk said, but the pressure has intensified significantly since the country’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 图尔克表示，俄罗斯的独立新闻业多年来一直面临着越来越多的限制，但自该国全面入侵乌克兰以来，压力已大大加剧。

paras.en: That has come through increasingly restrictive legislation, tighter State controls and the harassment and persecution of journalists.
paras.zh: 这是通过日益严格的立法、更严格的国家控制以及对记者的骚扰和迫害实现的。

paras.en: Novaya Gazeta’s journalists have made an exceptional contribution to independent reporting and the defence of human rights, often at great personal risk, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，《新报》的记者常常冒着巨大的个人风险，为独立报道和捍卫人权做出了杰出贡献。

paras.en: They have faced harassment, lawsuits, threats and direct violence.
paras.zh: 他们面临骚扰、诉讼、威胁和直接暴力。

paras.en: “Among them was Anna Politkovskaya, who was murdered in 2006 following her reporting on human rights violations during Russia’s military operations in Chechnya,” said the High Commissioner.
paras.zh: “其中包括安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅 (Anna Politkovskaya)，她在报道俄罗斯在车臣军事行动期间侵犯人权行为后于 2006 年被谋杀，”高级专员表示。

paras.en: He called on Russian authorities to stop measures that stifle reporting on issues of legitimate public concern, and to allow full and free debate with a diversity of voices.
paras.zh: 他呼吁俄罗斯当局停止压制对公众合法关心的问题进行报道的措施，并允许不同声音进行充分和自由的辩论。

paras.en: $50 million appeal to help 9 million survive winter
paras.zh: 呼吁筹集 5000 万美元帮助 900 万人渡过冬季

paras.en: The UN's refugee agency, UNHCR, launched a $50 million appeal on Friday to help nine million people survive winter across Afghanistan, Ukraine, Syria and Lebanon.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署联合国难民署周五发起了一项 5000 万美元的呼吁，以帮助阿富汗、乌克兰、叙利亚和黎巴嫩的 900 万人度过冬天。

paras.en: The funding will help people like Svetlana in Dnipro, Ukraine, whose apartment was targeted and heavily damaged in a drone strike last winter.
paras.zh: 这笔资金将帮助像乌克兰第聂伯罗的斯韦特兰娜这样的人，她的公寓在去年冬天的一次无人机袭击中成为目标并严重受损。

paras.en: Moments before the attack, Svetlana grabbed her son and ran to the basement. When they emerged, they no longer had anywhere to live.
paras.zh: 袭击发生前不久，斯维特兰娜抓住她的儿子跑到地下室。当他们出来时，他们已经无处可住。

paras.en: “A donation means something very tangible. A heater, blankets, warm clothes, cash to pay for fuel, or tarpaulin and tape to repair a blown out window. For some, it may avoid taking on more debt or keep their children off the streets and safe in school,” said UNHCR’s Dominique Hyde.
paras.zh: “捐款意味着一些非常有形的东西。取暖器、毯子、保暖的衣服、支付燃料的现金，或者修复被炸毁的窗户的防水布和胶带。对于一些人来说，这可能会避免承担更多债务，或者让他们的孩子远离街头并在学校安全，”联合国难民署的多米尼克·海德说。

paras.en: The agency highlighted equally dramatic needs in Afghanistan, which has seen an estimated 6.5 million people returning in recent years, most of them involuntarily.
paras.zh: 该机构强调了阿富汗同样巨大的需求，近年来估计有 650 万人返回阿富汗，其中大多数是非自愿的。

paras.en: Many of the new arrivals have very little and need to build their lives from scratch, Ms. Hyde said.
paras.zh: 海德女士说，许多新来者几乎一无所有，需要从头开始建立自己的生活。

paras.en: She noted that in Syria, around 3.6 million refugees and internally displaced people have returned to what remains of their homes since December 2024, while 15.6 million inside the country need humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 她指出，自 2024 年 12 月以来，叙利亚约有 360 万难民和境内流离失所者已返回家园，而该国境内有 1560 万人需要人道主义援助。

paras.en: Urban regeneration key to tackling global housing crisis
paras.zh: 城市复兴是应对全球住房危机的关键

paras.en: Government leaders and urban stakeholders gathered in China’s Fuzhou on Friday to discuss the “immense” global housing crisis, in the words of the UN’s urban development agency UN-Habitat – spotlighting regeneration as a key solution.
paras.zh: 用联合国城市发展机构联合国人居署的话说，政府领导人和城市利益相关者周五齐聚中国福州，讨论“严重”的全球住房危机，强调重建是一个关键的解决方案。

paras.en: As the world marks World Cities Day, up to 3.4 billion people face inadequate housing conditions, including more than a billion living in informal settlements and slums.
paras.zh: 值此世界城市日之际，多达 34 亿人面临住房条件不足的问题，其中超过 10 亿人生活在非正规住区和贫民窟。

paras.en: At the same time, ageing infrastructure, soaring housing costs and worsening climate change are placing further strain on cities and their residents.
paras.zh: 与此同时，老化的基础设施、飙升的住房成本和日益恶化的气候变化给城市及其居民带来了进一步的压力。

paras.en: Urban regeneration aims to revitalise declining or neglected urban areas through economic, social and environmental improvements
paras.zh: 城市复兴旨在通过经济、社会和环境的改善来振兴衰落或被忽视的城市地区

paras.en: “[It] offers a path forward. By revitalizing existing urban areas, we can create more housing, upgrade infrastructure and improve public spaces, making cities more resilient, inclusive and connected,” said the UN Secretary General in his message for the day.
paras.zh: “[它]提供了一条前进的道路。通过振兴现有城市地区，我们可以建造更多住房、升级基础设施和改善公共空间，使城市更具弹性、包容性和联系性，”联合国秘书长在当天的致辞中表示。

articles.title: Somalia looks to the future as the UN's political mission closes

paras.en: Somalia looks to the future as the UN's political mission closes
paras.zh: 随着联合国政治使命的结束，索马里展望未来

paras.en: “The story of the UN's political engagement in Somalia has been one of persistence, partnership and adaptation,” Raisedon Zenenga, the UN Secretary-General's Deputy Special Representative for Somalia has said, as three decades of UN political missions in the Horn of Africa country comes to an end on 31 October.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长索马里问题副特别代表雷塞登·泽南加 (Raisedon Zenenga) 表示：“联合国在索马里的政治参与是一个关于坚持、伙伴关系和适应的故事。”联合国在这个非洲之角国家长达三十年的政治使命将于 10 月 31 日结束。

paras.en: The UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia, known as UNTMIS, wraps up its work on Saturday and according to Mr. Zenenga “while significant challenges remain, the closure of UNTMIS comes after considerable progress by Somalia since the early years of international efforts to support the country's recovery.”
paras.zh: 联合国索马里过渡时期援助团（简称联马过渡团）于周六结束其工作，泽南加先生表示，“虽然仍然存在重大挑战，但联马过渡团的结束是在索马里自早年支持该国复苏的国际努力以来取得了重大进展之后完成的。”

paras.en: Somalia has undergone a profound transformation since the early 1990s, when the collapse of central State institutions and the outbreak of civil war ushered in years of conflict, instability and humanitarian crises.
paras.zh: 自20世纪90年代初以来，索马里经历了深刻的变革，中央国家机构的崩溃和内战的爆发引发了多年的冲突、不稳定和人道主义危机。

paras.en: The conflict sparked a major outflow of refugees and internal displacements, while ongoing insecurity, contested electoral processes and constitutional reform, as well as recurrent climatic shocks – including droughts and floods – compounded humanitarian needs and presented formidable challenges to the country's recovery.
paras.zh: 冲突引发了难民大量外流和国内流离失所，而持续的不安全局势、有争议的选举进程和宪法改革以及反复出现的气候冲击（包括干旱和洪水）加剧了人道主义需求，给该国的复苏带来了巨大挑战。

paras.en: Successive political missions accompanied Somalia through critical stages of its peacebuilding and State-building journey, supporting Somali-led efforts to restore governance, rebuild institutions and foster national reconciliation.
paras.zh: 历届政治任务伴随索马里度过了建设和平和国家建设进程的关键阶段，支持索马里主导的恢复治理、重建机构和促进民族和解的努力。

paras.en: With the end of the UNTMIS, it is now Somali institutions which will take on the full responsibility for the country’s recovery with support from UN agencies already working in the country.
paras.zh: 随着联马过渡团的结束，索马里各机构将在已经在该国开展工作的联合国机构的支持下，全面承担该国的复苏责任。

paras.en: “Somalia today possesses national and federal institutions that did not exist when the UN’s political engagement began. Progress has been made in State formation, political inclusion, constitutional processes, human rights frameworks and the development of governance structures that enable Somali-led decision-making,” said Mr. Zenenga.
paras.zh: “索马里如今拥有联合国开始政治参与时并不存在的国家和联邦机构。在国家组建、政治包容、宪法进程、人权框架和发展治理结构方面取得了进展，使索马里能够主导决策，”泽南加先生说。

paras.en: “However, continued engagement by the international community will remain important to sustaining progress and addressing outstanding priorities,” he added.
paras.zh: “然而，国际社会的持续参与对于维持进展和解决悬而未决的优先事项仍然很重要，”他补充道。

paras.en: That engagement includes some 25 UN entities that are still working across Somalia on humanitarian and development support.
paras.zh: 这一参与包括仍在索马里各地提供人道主义和发展支持的约 25 个联合国实体。

paras.en: In September, in the town of Balcad, a run-down vegetable market got a makeover from the UN's migration agency, IOM.
paras.zh: 九月，在巴尔卡德镇，联合国移民机构国际移民组织对一个破旧的菜市场进行了改造。

paras.en: There are now 56 sturdy stalls, running water and solar lighting. About 70 per cent of the stalls went to women-headed households, women-led businesses and small enterprises.
paras.zh: 现在有 56 个坚固的摊位、自来水和太阳能照明。大约 70% 的摊位流向了女性户主家庭、女性主导的企业和小企业。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Somalia's health ministry, working with UNICEF, launched national guidelines on caring for newborns, including babies who are small or sick.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，索马里卫生部与联合国儿童基金会合作，推出了照顾新生儿（包括体型较小或患病的婴儿）的国家指南。

paras.en: In Puntland, where nearly a million children are out of school, the UN's food agency FAO is backing a school meals programme that links 1,330 local farmers and fisherfolk to schools serving 18,700 children, so kids eat and families earn.
paras.zh: 在邦特兰，有近 100 万儿童失学，联合国粮食机构粮农组织正在支持一项学校供餐计划，该计划将 1,330 名当地农民和渔民与为 18,700 名儿童提供服务的学校联系起来，让孩子们吃饭，家庭赚钱。

paras.en: And in Baidoa, mine action experts from UNMAS helped Somali authorities teach hundreds of students and teachers how to spot explosive dangers.
paras.zh: 在拜多阿，联合国排雷行动处的排雷行动专家帮助索马里当局向数百名学生和教师教授如何发现爆炸危险。

paras.en: The UN's humanitarian affairs office, OCHA, calls the situation in Somalia one of the world's most complex crises.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务办公室人道协调厅称索马里局势是世界上最复杂的危机之一。

paras.en: Conflict and climate shocks keep feeding each other, and families who fled drought or fighting have often been uprooted a second or third time by floods or fresh violence.
paras.zh: 冲突和气候冲击不断相互影响，逃离干旱或战斗的家庭常常因洪水或新的暴力事件而第二次或第三次背井离乡。

paras.en: This year, 4.8 million Somalis, out of a population of just under 20 million, need humanitarian help.
paras.zh: 今年，索马里人口不到 2000 万，其中有 480 万需要人道主义援助。

paras.en: Aid agencies are asking for $852 million to reach 2.4 million people, just half of those in need, and by mid-October only about 35 per cent of that had arrived.
paras.zh: 援助机构正在寻求 8.52 亿美元的援助，以帮助 240 万人，这只是有需要的人的一半，而到 10 月中旬，只有大约 35% 的人到达了。

paras.en: The UN Secretary-General also wants continued support to tackle the threat from the terror group Al-Shabaab and to help Somalia move to a gradual, sustainable security transition.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长还希望继续提供支持，应对恐怖组织青年党的威胁，并帮助索马里实现渐进、可持续的安全过渡。

paras.en: Looking ahead, one huge challenge for Somalia's leaders after October is poverty.
paras.zh: 展望未来，十月之后索马里领导人面临的一项巨大挑战是贫困。

paras.en: They'll need to tackle it while steadying an economy that's still fragile. It leans heavily on subsistence farming, livestock, money sent home by relatives abroad and pastoralism.
paras.zh: 他们需要解决这个问题，同时稳定仍然脆弱的经济。它严重依赖自给农业、牲畜、国外亲戚寄回家的钱和畜牧业。

paras.en: The country imports more than 90 per cent of its essential goods, according to OCHA.
paras.zh: 据 OCHA 称，该国 90% 以上的必需品依靠进口。

paras.en: While UNTMIS is closing down, the United Nations is not leaving. UN humanitarian and development agencies continue to support Somalia and its people.
paras.zh: 虽然联马过渡团正在关闭，但联合国并没有离开。联合国人道主义和发展机构继续支持索马里及其人民。

paras.en: “Today is not an end to the partnership between the United Nations and Somalia,” Deputy Special Representative Zenenga said. "It marks the conclusion of one chapter and the beginning of another.”
paras.zh: “今天联合国与索马里之间的伙伴关系并未结束，”副特别代表泽南加说。 “它标志着一章的结束和另一章的开始。”

articles.title: World News in Brief: healthcare crisis in Yemen’s Taiz and Afghanistan, Western Sahara mission's phased closure

paras.en: World News in Brief: healthcare crisis in Yemen’s Taiz and Afghanistan, Western Sahara mission's phased closure
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：也门塔伊兹和阿富汗的医疗危机、西撒哈拉特派团分阶段关闭

paras.en: All roads to the city are now closed due to the fighting, and no commercial supplies are getting through.
paras.zh: 由于战斗，通往该市的所有道路现已关闭，商业物资无法通过。

paras.en: Nearly a quarter of a million people have lost access to essential healthcare due to lack of supplies, including more than 186,000 children under the age of five and 23,000 pregnant women, according to the UN’s aid coordination office (OCHA).
paras.zh: 根据联合国援助协调办公室 (OCHA) 的数据，近 25 万人由于缺乏物资而无法获得基本医疗保健，其中包括超过 186,000 名五岁以下儿童和 23,000 名孕妇。

paras.en: Twelve hospitals are at risk of closing, while the demand for healthcare is only rising due to the worsening living conditions.
paras.zh: 十二家医院面临关闭的风险，而由于生活条件不断恶化，对医疗保健的需求只会不断增加。

paras.en: In just a week, more than 1,400 cases of acute diarrhoea and suspected cholera – which mostly spreads through contaminated water – have been reported.
paras.zh: 短短一周内，就报告了 1,400 多例急性腹泻和疑似霍乱病例（主要通过受污染的水传播）。

paras.en: Across the country, the displacement crisis is also deepening.
paras.zh: 在全国范围内，流离失所危机也在加深。

paras.en: Nearly 300,000 people have been forced from their homes since the beginning of August, while 5.2 million – out of a total of around 42 million people – were already displaced in the country before the latest escalation this summer, according to OCHA.
paras.zh: 据人道协调厅称，自 8 月初以来，已有近 30 万人被迫离开家园，而在今年夏天最近一次升级之前，该国总共约 4200 万人中已有 520 万人流离失所。

paras.en: The office has provided around 254,000 displaced people with food, hygiene supplies and emergency cash assistance.
paras.zh: 该办公室已向约 254,000 名流离失所者提供了食品、卫生用品和紧急现金援助。

paras.en: Afghanistan: funding shortages close vital healthcare services
paras.zh: 阿富汗：资金短缺导致重要的医疗服务关闭

paras.en: In Afghanistan, UN aid teams are warning that vital health centres are being forced to scale back or close, because of funding cuts to humanitarian services.
paras.zh: 在阿富汗，联合国援助小组警告说，由于人道主义服务资金削减，重要的卫生中心被迫缩减规模或关闭。

paras.en: In an alert, OCHA said that remote communities like those in Badakhshan province in the country’s far northeast face long and dangerous journeys to reach care.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅在一份警报中表示，该国东北部巴达赫尚省等偏远社区面临着漫长而危险的医疗旅程。

paras.en: “There are needs, particularly severe and extreme needs that are on the increase in many parts of the country,” said OCHA spokesperson Olga Cherevko, describing a “worrying” increase in malnutrition in the province’s Kishim District Hospital.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅发言人奥尔加·切列夫科 (Olga Cherevko) 表示：“该国许多地区的需求，特别是严重和极端的需求正在增加。”她描述了该省基希姆地区医院营养不良人数的“令人担忧”的增加。

paras.en: She noted that the hospital lacked the resources needed to provide adequate support to patients who depend on them.
paras.zh: 她指出，医院缺乏所需的资源，无法为依赖医院的患者提供足够的支持。

paras.en: “Often there is simply nowhere else left to turn,” she stressed.
paras.zh: “通常情况下，根本没有其他地方可以求助，”她强调说。

paras.en: Afghanistan remains one of the world’s largest humanitarian crises, with nearly 22 million people needing assistance. Food is available but it is too expensive for millions of Afghans, the UN agency said in a recent update.
paras.zh: 阿富汗仍然是世界上最大的人道主义危机之一，有近 2200 万人需要援助。该联合国机构在最近的更新中表示，食物是可用的，但对数百万阿富汗人来说太贵了。

paras.en: Western Sahara: UN sets out phased closure of MINURSO mission
paras.zh: 西撒哈拉：联合国规定分阶段结束西撒特派团任务

paras.en: The UN will repatriate some 160 military observers and close 13 facilities and team sites in Western Sahara as it winds down its peacekeeping mission there, MINURSO, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克周一表示，随着西撒特派团结束其在西撒哈拉的维和任务，联合国将遣返约 160 名军事观察员，并关闭西撒哈拉的 13 个设施和队部。

paras.en: The mission ceased operations after Security Council members did not renew its mandate, and its liquidation period began on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在安理会成员没有延长其任务期限后，该特派团停止了行动，其清理结束期于周日开始。

paras.en: A smaller team reporting to the UN Department of Operational Support will oversee the “orderly and environmentally responsible” closure and handover of the sites, in phases.
paras.zh: 向联合国行动支持部报告的一个较小的团队将分阶段监督“有序且对环境负责”的关闭和移交地点。

paras.en: Around 180 civilian and affiliated personnel will also leave. UN property and equipment will be disposed of or transferred, communications and logistics systems taken down, mission records archived and local contracts closed.
paras.zh: 大约 180 名文职人员和附属人员也将离开。联合国财产和设备将被处置或转移，通信和后勤系统将被拆除，任务记录将被存档并当地合同将被关闭。

paras.en: The UN will keep administrative, financial and security oversight throughout, while protecting the safety of all personnel, Mr. Dujarric told reporters in New York.
paras.zh: 杜雅里克在纽约对记者表示，联合国将全程进行行政、财务和安全监督，同时保护所有人员的安全。

paras.en: The Secretary-General is counting on the full cooperation of the parties to complete the process as soon as possible, the Spokesperson added.
paras.zh: 发言人补充说，秘书长希望各方充分合作，尽快完成这一进程。

paras.en: He repeated the UN chief’s message that MINURSO’s departure “does not abrogate” the right of the people of Western Sahara to self-determination, and his call on all concerned to exercise “maximum restraint”.
paras.zh: 他重申了联合国秘书长的信息，即西撒特派团的离开“并不废除”西撒哈拉人民的自决权，并呼吁有关各方保持“最大限度的克制”。

articles.title: Hamilton calls for 'serious talks' at Ferrari after Leclerc incident

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton demands 'serious talks' at Ferrari after Charles Leclerc incident at Mexico City Grand Prix
paras.zh: 在查尔斯·勒克莱尔在墨西哥城大奖赛发生事件后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿要求法拉利进行“严肃的谈话”

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton reiterated "something needs to change" after his latest incident with Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc cost the Scuderia victory in Mexico; watch Friday's practice sessions in Brazil from 3.30pm and 7pm, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿重申“有些事情需要改变”，因为他最近与法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔发生的事件导致了法拉利车队在墨西哥的胜利；观看周五下午 3.30 至晚上 7 点在天空体育 F1 直播的巴西练习赛

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton has called for "serious talks" at Ferrari after his opening lap incident with Charles Leclerc at the Mexico City Grand Prix, while team principal Frederic Vasseur suggested there was not enough "respect" given.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛首圈与查尔斯·勒克莱尔发生事故后，呼吁法拉利进行“认真的对话”，而车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，法拉利没有给予足够的“尊重”。

paras.en: Leclerc attacked Hamilton around the outside going into Turn 4 but outbraked himself and cut the corner to take the lead, while Hamilton lost out to Red Bull's Max Verstappen after briefly going off track.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔在进入第 4 号弯时在外侧攻击汉密尔顿，但他刹车失控并切入弯道取得领先，而汉密尔顿在短暂偏离赛道后输给了红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘。

paras.en: The stewards gave Leclerc a five-second time penalty which allowed Verstappen to overtake him during the pit stop phase, going on to win the race while Hamilton finished second and Leclerc in fourth.
paras.zh: 赛会干事对勒克莱尔进行了五秒的处罚，这使得维斯塔潘在进站阶段超越了他，赢得了比赛，而汉密尔顿获得了第二名，勒克莱尔获得了第四名。

paras.en: "Ultimately, it was that, that lost us the win. I think we have to have some serious talks behind the scenes, for sure," said Hamilton.
paras.zh: “最终，正是这一点让我们失去了胜利。我认为我们必须在幕后进行一些严肃的谈判，这是肯定的，”汉密尔顿说。

paras.en: "But the good thing is the team are working really hard. We've really improved our car. We're on the old engine at the weekend as well, so good result, good points. Shame we didn't get a win, some wins, some losses."
paras.zh: “但好的事情是车队真的很努力。我们确实改进了我们的赛车。周末我们也使用旧引擎，所以很好的结果，很好的积分。遗憾的是我们没有取得胜利，有些赢了，有些输了。”

paras.en: On the team radio during a red flag period for Valtteri Bottas' big crash in his Cadillac, Hamilton stated "we've got big problems" in reference to the Lap 1 incident.
paras.zh: 在瓦尔特利·博塔斯 (Valtteri Bottas) 驾驶凯迪拉克发生严重车祸的危险信号期间，汉密尔顿在车队广播中就第一圈事故表示“我们遇到了大问题”。

paras.en: A frustrated Vasseur says his discussion with the drivers ahead of this weekend's Sao Paulo Grand Prix will be "a matter of respect".
paras.zh: 沮丧的瓦塞尔表示，他在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛之前与车手的讨论将是“尊重的问题”。

paras.en: When asked if he could trust his drivers for not putting their individual objectives above the team's, Vasseur said: "This is typically what means respect.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否可以相信他的车手不会将个人目标置于车队目标之上时，瓦塞尔说：“这通常意味着尊重。

paras.en: "They are not working for themselves, they are working for a group. They are working for a lot of sponsors. They are working for the 2,000 people of the company.
paras.zh: “他们不是为自己工作，而是为一个团体工作。他们为很多赞助商工作。他们为公司的 2000 名员工工作。

paras.en: "The guys, when we had to push for the upgrades, they were working night and day. We have to keep this in mind."
paras.zh: “这些人，当我们不得不推动升级时，他们夜以继日地工作。我们必须牢记这一点。”

paras.en: Hamilton and Leclerc have found themselves fighting together several times since becoming Ferrari team-mates at the start of 2025.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔自 2025 年初成为法拉利队友以来，已经多次并肩作战。

paras.en: After being forced wide by Leclerc at the Italian Grand Prix in September, Hamilton accused Ferrari of having "no rules" and demanded "rules of engagement" are required, which he had at Mercedes.
paras.zh: 九月份在意大利大奖赛上被勒克莱尔逼出界外后，汉密尔顿指责法拉利“没有规则”，并要求需要“交战规则”，而他在梅赛德斯就有这样的规则。

paras.en: Following their latest incident in Mexico, he said: "I don't know what needs to happen now, how we discuss things when we go back. I'm not quite sure how I want to engage in that.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥发生的最新事件之后，他说：“我不知道现在需要发生什么，也不知道我们回去后如何讨论事情。我不太确定我想如何参与其中。

paras.en: "Of course, the frustrations are.. I'm happy because Kimi just won the championship, so I'm really torn because, on one side, I'm happy, and on the other side, I'm really p*****.
paras.zh: “当然，挫折是..我很高兴，因为Kimi刚刚赢得了冠军，所以我真的很矛盾，因为一方面，我很高兴，但另一方面，我真的很糟糕。

paras.en: "We lost valuable points, and we, as a team, worked so hard. We could have easily had a one-two. Really, we had the pace to do so.
paras.zh: “我们失去了宝贵的分数，而我们作为一个团队，非常努力。我们本来可以轻松地进行二过一的比赛。实际上，我们有足够的速度做到这一点。

paras.en: "We're going into Turn 4 first and second. If we just hold position, anything can happen in the race, but when your team-mate works against you and then you lose positions like that, it's definitely tough.
paras.zh: “我们将进入第一个和第二个弯。如果我们只是保持位置，比赛中任何事情都可能发生，但是当你的队友与你对抗，然后你像这样失去位置时，这绝对是艰难的。

paras.en: "We'll just talk about it offline, and it's not really worth saying too much more. We don't have rules of engagement, and whether or not that will change anything from Charles' side, I don't know. We've just got to figure it out, but something needs to change for sure."
paras.zh: “我们只是在线下讨论这件事，其实并不值得说太多。我们没有交战规则，我不知道这是否会改变查尔斯方面的任何事情。我们只是必须弄清楚，但肯定有些事情需要改变。”

paras.en: Brundle: Hamilton-Leclerc incident isn't pretty for Ferrari
paras.zh: 布伦德尔：汉密尔顿-勒克莱尔事件对法拉利来说并不美好

paras.en: "Charles should have given the place back, but he couldn't because cunning old Max Verstappen got himself in between the two Ferraris as he tried to do back in Madrid earlier this year.
paras.zh: “查尔斯应该把这个位置还给他，但他不能，因为狡猾的老马克斯·维斯塔潘让自己陷入了两辆法拉利之间，就像他今年早些时候在马德里试图做的那样。

paras.en: "They're hard-wired racing drivers, it's a curious business we have, where you perform as an individual in a team environment. You're measured as an individual, you're rewarded as an individual, but when the adrenaline is up and the chance of a gap is there, as the great Ayrton Senna used to say: 'If you don't go for a gap, you're no longer a racing driver'.
paras.zh: “他们是天生的赛车手，这是我们的一项奇怪的业务，你在团队环境中作为个人表现。你作为个人进行衡量，你作为个人得到奖励，但当肾上腺素上升并且差距的机会就存在时，正如伟大的埃尔顿·塞纳曾经说过的那样：“如果你不追求差距，你就不再是一名赛车手了”。

paras.en: "Charles has had some frustrations this year, and it doesn't look pretty for the team like when Lando ran into Oscar Piastri in Singapore in the sprint race, it doesn't look pretty for the team and you've let 1,500 people down in your team.
paras.zh: “查尔斯今年遇到了一些挫折，这对车队来说看起来不太好，就像兰多在新加坡短距离比赛中遇到奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里那样，对车队来说看起来不太好，你让车队中的 1,500 人失望了。

paras.en: "That's just the car side, without the power unit side. You're only the final link in the chain of the team but you're the one out there that's got to deliver in the heat of the moment. Ferrari will have to manage that somehow.
paras.zh: “这只是赛车方面，没有动力装置方面。你只是车队链条中的最后一环，但你是在最激烈的时刻必须交付的人。法拉利必须以某种方式管理这一点。

paras.en: "They will sit down and we will go to Brazil and they will say 'yes we sat down, we understood it all, we will move forward and it won't happen again' but in reality we know it will."
paras.zh: “他们会坐下来，我们会去巴西，他们会说‘是的，我们坐下来，我们理解这一切，我们将继续前进，这种情况不会再发生’，但实际上我们知道它会发生。”

articles.title: Bears make statement against champion Seahawks

paras.en: Chicago Bears deliver statement win over Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks as Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons star
paras.zh: 凯莱布·威廉姆斯和杰弗里·西蒙斯主演的芝加哥熊队宣布战胜超级碗冠军西雅图海鹰队

paras.en: Jeffery Simmons stars on his debut for the Chicago Bears against the Seattle Seahawks in his first appearance since arriving in a blockbuster trade from the Tennessee Titans; watch the 2026 NFL season live on Sky Sports, including every minute of the playoffs
paras.zh: 杰弗里·西蒙斯在芝加哥熊队对阵西雅图海鹰队的比赛中首次亮相，这是他从田纳西泰坦队进行重磅交易后首次亮相；在天空体育上观看 2026 年 NFL 赛季直播，包括季后赛的每一分钟

paras.en: Caleb Williams threw a touchdown pass on the opening drive and Jeffery Simmons delivered just what Chicago needed on defense as the Bears beat the Seattle Seahawks 34-17 on Monday night.
paras.zh: 卡莱布·威廉姆斯 (Caleb Williams) 在开场就传出达阵传球，而杰弗里·西蒙斯 (Jeffery Simmons) 正是芝加哥队在防守上所需要的，帮助熊队在周一晚上以 34-17 击败西雅图海鹰队。

paras.en: Williams was extremely efficient for the Bears (6-2) against one of the NFL's stingiest defenses, committing no turnovers, taking just one sack and throwing for 247 yards while completing 71 per cent of his passes.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在熊队面对 NFL 最吝啬的防守之一时表现得非常高效（6-2），没有失误，只被擒杀一次，传球距离为 247 码，传球成功率高达 71%。

paras.en: Williams' play helped set up three short touchdown runs by D'Andre Swift and that proved to be more than enough against Sam Darnold and the Seahawks (4-4), thanks to the impact Simmons had on the defense.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯的表现帮助德安德烈·斯威夫特（D'Andre Swift）完成了三次短距离达阵，事实证明这对于萨姆·达诺德（Sam Darnold）和海鹰队（4-4）来说绰绰有余，这要归功于西蒙斯对防守的影响。

paras.en: Acquired last week from Tennessee for a package that included two first-round picks, Simmons took little time to make a big impact on a defense that had lacked difference-makers.
paras.zh: 西蒙斯上周从田纳西州以包括两个首轮选秀权的价格获得，他很快就对缺乏改变者的防守产生了巨大影响。

paras.en: He had a sack on the opening drive, added another tackle for loss and finished with six tackles and a pass defended as Chicago held Seattle to 252 yards and one third-down conversion on 11 attempts.
paras.zh: 他在开局就被擒杀，又增加了一次铲断，最终以六次铲断和一次传球被防守，芝加哥队将西雅图队限制在 252 码，并在 11 次尝试中完成了一次三分转换。

paras.en: The defending champion Seahawks lost for the third time in four games and are now looking up at the NFC playoff standings and can ill afford many more slip-ups. The loss ended a 30-game streak for Seattle in the regular season and playoffs - the fourth longest for any team in the Super Bowl era - of not losing by more than four points.
paras.zh: 卫冕冠军海鹰队在四场比赛中第三次失利，现在在 NFC 季后赛积分榜上表现出色，无法承受更多的失误。这场失利结束了西雅图队在常规赛和季后赛中连续 30 场比赛不超过 4 分的记录——这是超级碗时代所有球队中第四长的记录。

paras.en: Sam Darnold went 17 of 34 for 188 yards and two touchdowns for Seattle, but his interception in the fourth quarter set up Swift's third TD that made it 34-17 with 4:41 to play.
paras.zh: 萨姆·达诺德 (Sam Darnold) 34 投 17 中，推进 188 码，两次达阵，但他在第四节的拦截帮助斯威夫特第三次达阵，比赛还剩 4 分 41 秒时，比分变为 34-17。

paras.en: The Seahawks struggled once again to run the ball despite their trade last week for three-time All-Pro guard Quenton Nelson and the return of Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price from injures. Seattle ran for only 81 yards.
paras.zh: 尽管海鹰队上周交易来了三届全职业后卫昆顿·尼尔森，并且扎克·查博内特和贾达里安·普莱斯伤愈复出，但他们在控球方面再次陷入困境。西雅图只跑了81码。

paras.en: The Bears started off well against Seattle's stout defense by putting together a 17-play drive on the opening possession to take the lead when Williams threw a 1-yard touchdown pass to Luther Burden.
paras.zh: 面对西雅图队的顽强防守，熊队开局良好，在开场控球时打出 17 球的进攻，威廉姆斯向路德·伯登传出 1 码达阵传球，取得领先。

paras.en: The Bears added two more field goals in the first half and built the lead to 20-9 in the third quarter with another efficient touchdown drive that ended with a 1-yard run by Swift.
paras.zh: 熊队在上半场再进两球，并在第三节凭借另一次高效的达阵得分以 Swift 的 1 码跑动结束将领先优势扩大到 20-9。

paras.en: The Seahawks were bottled up by Simmons and the Bears for almost the entire first half before Darnold connected with Jaxon Smith-Njigba on a 43-yard pass with 30 seconds left in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 海鹰队几乎整个上半场都被西蒙斯和熊队压制，直到第二节还剩 30 秒时，达诺德与贾克森·史密斯-恩吉巴 (Jaxon Smith-Njigba) 传球 43 码。

paras.en: Things looked bleak for Seattle when Jason Myers had a 33-yard field goal blocked in the opening minute of the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 当杰森·迈尔斯在第四节开场一分钟的 33 码射门被挡出时，西雅图的情况看起来很黯淡。

paras.en: But DeMarcus Lawrence forced a fumble by Colston Loveland on the next possession that set up Darnold's 7-yard touchdown pass to Cooper Kupp, and Seattle converted the 2-point conversion to make it 20-17.
paras.zh: 但德马库斯·劳伦斯在下一个回合中迫使科尔斯顿·拉夫兰掉球，达诺德将7码达阵传球给库珀·库普，西雅图队将比分改写为20-17。

paras.en: The Bears answered with another TD drive and put the game away after Darnold's interception.
paras.zh: 熊队再次达阵得分，在达诺德拦截后将比赛结束。

articles.title: Brundle: Russell must find 'overdrive' in 2027 or it's 'game over'

paras.zh: 马丁·布伦德尔 (Martin Brundle) 表示，乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 必须在 2027 年找到“超速行驶”，否则在看到基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 成为 F1 世界冠军后就“游戏结束”

paras.en: George Russell would have been "broken" to see his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli become world champion, according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle; watch Friday's practice sessions for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix from 3.30pm and 7pm, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 天空体育 F1 的马丁·布伦德尔表示，如果乔治·拉塞尔看到他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利成为世界冠军，他一定会“心碎”。观看周五下午 3.30 至晚上 7 点在天空体育 F1 上直播的圣保罗大奖赛练习赛

paras.en: Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle believes George Russell must find an "overdrive" to hit back at losing this year's Formula 1 Drivers' Championship to Kimi Antonelli.
paras.zh: 天空体育 F1 的马丁·布伦德尔 (Martin Brundle) 认为，乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 必须找到“超速行驶”的方式，以反击今年一级方程式车手冠军输给基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 的局面。

paras.en: Antonelli clinched the drivers' title with four rounds to spare on Sunday, becoming the youngest-ever F1 World Champion. Meanwhile, Russell endured another frustrating race, suffering a battery issue on the opening lap before later receiving a 10-second penalty for a collision with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar. He eventually finished sixth.
paras.zh: 安东内利在周日还剩四轮比赛的情况下夺得了车手冠军，成为有史以来最年轻的 F1 世界冠军。与此同时，拉塞尔又经历了另一场令人沮丧的比赛，他在第一圈就遭遇了电池问题，随后因与红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔 (Isack Hadjar) 相撞而被罚时 10 秒。他最终获得​​第六名。

paras.en: Russell started the season as the championship favourite after comfortably getting the better of Antonelli in 2025. However, he has managed just three wins compared with his team-mate's nine and has generally been outpaced, although he has arguably suffered more than his fair share of misfortune along the way.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在 2025 年轻松击败安东内利后，以冠军热门的身份开始了本赛季。然而，与队友的 9 场胜利相比，他只取得了 3 场胜利，而且总体上已经被超越，尽管他一路上遭受的不幸可能超过了他应得的。

paras.en: - Sao Paulo GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 圣保罗大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: "Russell will be broken, because he waited at Williams a long time as a Mercedes junior to get his chance. He got it just as they stopped winning," Brundle told Sky Sports News.
paras.zh: 布伦德尔告诉天空体育新闻：“拉塞尔将会崩溃，因为作为梅赛德斯的青年球员，他在威廉姆斯队等待了很长时间，才得到了机会。就在他们停止获胜时，他得到了机会。”

paras.en: "They suddenly turned up with these new 2026 cars, an early dominant car, it's not dominant right now, but it was certainly in the first phase of the season. And then this kid turns up and just transforms from a bit of a liability in year one to a generational talent in year two.
paras.zh: “他们突然带着这些新的 2026 赛车出现了，这是一辆早期占据主导地位的赛车，它现在还没有占据主导地位，但肯定是在赛季的第一阶段。然后这个孩子出现了，从第一年的一点负担变成了第二年的一代天才。

paras.en: "George has had to observe that, and I think it's affected his own performance. He's been so unlucky but then Antonelli had his fair share of unreliability, dropping out of races too. What will hit George hardest is that he couldn't match Antonelli for speed, for consistent speed. That's all that matters in this business, the stopwatch, it's a very antiquated system.
paras.zh: “乔治必须观察到这一点，我认为这影响了他自己的表现。他太不幸了，但安东内利也有他的不可靠性，也退出了比赛。对乔治影响最大的是他无法在速度上与安东内利匹敌，在稳定的速度上。这就是这个行业最重要的，秒表，这是一个非常过时的系统。

paras.en: "Despite spending hundreds of millions of dollars a year running through F1 cars, we live and die by the stopwatch. George has not been as fast as Kimi, especially in the second half of stints in a run on set of tyres. That's what will get to George.
paras.zh: “尽管我们每年花费数亿美元来驾驶 F1 赛车，但我们的生死都取决于秒表。乔治的速度没有基米快，尤其是在使用轮胎进行比赛的后半段。这就是乔治的下场。”

paras.en: "It might break George, but I think it'll make him, he'll find an overdrive, he has to. He has to come back next year and lift his game up. Meanwhile, he's had to suffer an awful season for himself. A brilliant season for a 19-year-old who has turned 20 through that season."
paras.zh: “这可能会击垮乔治，但我认为这会让他崩溃，他会找到超速运转的能力，他必须这样做。他必须明年回来并提高自己的比赛水平。与此同时，他自己也不得不经历一个糟糕的赛季。对于一个已经满20岁的19岁球员来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季。”

paras.en: Mercedes excused Russell from carrying out his post-Mexico City Grand Prix media duties because the British driver was "distraught" according to team principal Toto Wolff.
paras.zh: 车队负责人托托·沃尔夫表示，梅赛德斯原谅拉塞尔履行墨西哥城大奖赛后的媒体职责，因为这位英国车手“心烦意乱”。

paras.en: The FIA fined Mercedes €5,000 (£4,173) for their driver's absence from his media duties and Brundle says he "doesn't blame" Russell, who posted on social media on Monday, for his reaction.
paras.zh: 国际汽联因梅赛德斯车手缺席媒体职责而对梅赛德斯罚款 5,000 欧元（4,173 英镑），布伦德尔表示，他“不会责怪”拉塞尔的反应，拉塞尔周一在社交媒体上发帖。

paras.en: "We get more access to F1 drivers than any other sport can dream of with top players, or what have you in their sports. I think it was a step too far for George to go and have to congratulate him [Antonelli]," he said.
paras.zh: “我们接触到 F1 车手的机会比任何其他运动都能梦想到的顶级球员多，或者在他们的运动中拥有什么。我认为乔治迈出的一步太远了，必须祝贺他（安东内利），”他说。

paras.en: "He did congratulate him of course, underneath the podium, but to have to put up with questions like: 'How do you feel George? And is this the end of the road for you?' I don't blame him.
paras.zh: “当然，他确实在讲台下向他表示祝贺，但不得不忍受这样的问题：‘你感觉乔治怎么样？这对你来说是路的尽头吗？’我不怪他。

paras.en: "The team got fined and I'd be very happy to pay that. Not to have to basically face the music to the world when I'm at my lowest ebb and I think that's fair enough frankly. George has either got an overdrive or it's game over."
paras.zh: “球队被罚款了，我很乐意支付这笔钱。当我处于最低潮时，基本上不必面对世界的音乐，坦率地说，我认为这很公平。乔治要么超速了，要么比赛就结束了。”

paras.en: Brundle: Antonelli has all the hallmarks of a multiple F1 world champion
paras.zh: 布伦德尔：安东内利具备多次F1世界冠军的所有特征

paras.en: Antonelli has been part of Mercedes' driver programme since he was 12 years old and the team have carefully managed his career after a huge amount of excitement grew when he was winning championships in karting and junior single-seater categories.
paras.zh: 安东内利从 12 岁起就成为梅赛德斯车手计划的一部分，当他赢得卡丁车和青少年单座赛车类别的冠军后，车队对他的职业生涯进行了精心管理。

paras.en: Brundle admits he thought Antonelli may "fall apart" at times this season but was impressed to see him "flourish" instead with impressive victories in Monaco, Monza and Austin.
paras.zh: 布伦德尔承认，他认为安东内利本赛季有时可能会“崩溃”，但看到他“蓬勃发展”，在摩纳哥、蒙扎和奥斯汀取得令人印象深刻的胜利，给他留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: "Being a world champion is a whole new level of pressure on his shoulders, from his country, from going around the world as he will do," he said.
paras.zh: “成为世界冠军对他的肩膀来说是一个全新的压力，来自他的国家，来自他将要做的环游世界，”他说。

paras.en: "If he can manage that and have the right people around him to take some of that pressure and expectation away from him and make life a bit easier with getting around the world, he should have the staying power.
paras.zh: “如果他能做到这一点，并且身边有合适的人来减轻他的压力和期望，让环游世界的生活变得更轻松，那么他应该有持久力。

paras.en: "He's young, and he's fit. They don't get smashed up as much in F1 cars these days, unless they're super unlucky, actually. So that's a big factor these days. You don't get hit on the head like we used to. You don't get your legs smashed up like we used to.
paras.zh: “他很年轻，而且身体很健康。如今，他们在 F1 赛车中不会像以前那样被撞坏了，除非他们真的超级不走运。所以这是现在的一个重要因素。你不会像我们以前那样被击中头部。你不会像我们以前那样被撞伤双腿。

paras.en: "I do think Antonelli has all the hallmarks of a multiple F1 champion. But we'll see, it's really hard to do, as Lando Norris has found this year, to keep the mental and physical aspects of that going into two, three or even four seasons."
paras.zh: “我确实认为安东内利具备多次获得 F1 冠军的所有特征。但我们会看到，正如兰多·诺里斯今年所发现的那样，要在两个、三个甚至四个赛季中保持这种精神和身体方面的状态确实很难。”

articles.title: U.K. PM open to slave trade apology but rules out financial reparations
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: LONDON — British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said that he is open to a formal apology for his country’s role in the trans-Atlantic slave trade, but ruled out financial reparations as King Charles III continued his tour of the Caribbean.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，他愿意就英国在跨大西洋奴隶贸易中所扮演的角色正式道歉，但由于国王查理三世继续访问加勒比海，因此排除了经济赔偿的可能性。

paras.en: Burnham’s comments show a marked shift in stance for the U.K., which has consistently rejected demands for either an apology or reparations.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆的言论表明英国的立场发生了明显转变，英国一直拒绝道歉或赔偿的要求。

paras.en: They came as he is due to attend the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua and Barbuda next week. Charles, as head of the “family of nations,” will preside over the event.
paras.zh: 他们是在他下周出席安提瓜和巴布达举行的英联邦政府首脑会议时到来的。作为“国际大家庭”的首脑，查尔斯将主持这次活动。

paras.en: “We are offering a structured dialogue with those affected by the transatlantic slave trade,” Burnham wrote in an op-ed in The Guardian newspaper published Friday. “Listening to calls for a formal apology on behalf of the British state will form an important part of this process, and I am open to them.”
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在《卫报》周五发表的一篇专栏文章中写道：“我们正在与那些受跨大西洋奴隶贸易影响的人进行结构化对话。” “听取代表英国政府正式道歉的呼声将构成这一过程的重要组成部分，我对他们持开放态度。”

paras.en: But Burnham ruled out financial reparations, saying the British people of today who “played no personal part” in the slave trade could not be held liable.
paras.zh: 但伯纳姆排除了经济赔偿的可能性，称当今在奴隶贸易中“没有发挥个人作用”的英国人民不能承担责任。

paras.en: The trans-Atlantic trade in enslaved people was central to European colonialism and the growth of the British Empire, as millions of Africans were trafficked to the Americas to grow and harvest cash crops, while being subjected to violence, torture, sexual abuse and the denial of basic human rights.
paras.zh: 跨大西洋奴隶贸易是欧洲殖民主义和大英帝国发展的核心，数百万非洲人被贩运到美洲种植和收获经济作物，同时遭受暴力、酷刑、性虐待和基本人权的剥夺。

paras.en: Mia Mottley, the prime minister of Barbados, said on X that he welcomed the prime minister’s openness to a formal apology.
paras.zh: 巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利 (Mia Mottley) 于 X 日表示，他欢迎总理愿意正式道歉。

paras.en: Jamaica’s prime minister, Andrew Holness, also posted on X, writing: “Open-minded dialogue is always a good place to start addressing difficult issues.”
paras.zh: 牙买加总理安德鲁·霍尔尼斯也在 X 上发帖写道：“开明的对话始终是解决难题的好地方。”

paras.en: Jamaica recently took its case for reparations to Charles, and the case has since been referred to the United Kingdom’s highest court of appeal.
paras.zh: 牙买加最近向查尔斯提出赔偿案，此案已移交英国最高法院上诉法院。

paras.en: Caribbean nations had urged Britain to acknowledge its role in the slave trade ahead of Charles’ visit to the Bahamas and Guyana last week.
paras.zh: 在查尔斯上周访问巴哈马和圭亚那之前，加勒比国家敦促英国承认其在奴隶贸易中的作用。

paras.en: Charles last week visited Clifford Park, where in 1973 he granted the Bahamas independence after 300 years of British rule.
paras.zh: 查尔斯上周访问了克利福德公园，1973 年，他在那里授予巴哈马独立，结束了英国的 300 年统治。

paras.en: Members of the Bahamas’ Rastafarian community and others lined a nearby road to protest.
paras.zh: 巴哈马拉斯塔法里教社区的成员和其他人在附近的道路上排队抗议。

paras.en: “Pay us what you owe us!” one woman cried out. “I stand in memory of the horrors and the atrocities committed against Black people.”
paras.zh: “把你欠我们的钱还给我们！”一名妇女大声喊道。 “我纪念针对黑人所犯下的恐怖和暴行。”

paras.en: In his first public remarks on the island nation, Charles said: “It is only right that we should acknowledge the great suffering and injustices of the past in these islands and beyond, even as we rejoice in the successes of the present.”
paras.zh: 查尔斯在他对这个岛国的首次公开讲话中表示：“我们应该承认这些岛屿及其他地区过去所遭受的巨大痛苦和不公正，尽管我们为当前的成功感到高兴，这是正确的。”

articles.title: Massive protests sweep Europe over cost of living and strained public services
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Massive protests were sweeping Europe on Saturday as part of demonstrations driven by the cost of living and deficient public services, with police bracing for potential violence after recent looting and riots.
paras.zh: 周六，大规模抗议活动席卷欧洲，这是由生活成本和公共服务不足引发的示威活动的一部分，警方在最近的抢劫和骚乱后准备应对潜在的暴力事件。

paras.en: Germany, France, Spain and Italy are among the nations where demonstrations were being held on Halloween following a recent wave of Gen Z-led marches across the continent.
paras.zh: 继最近一波 Z 世代领导的横跨非洲大陆的游行之后，德国、法国、西班牙和意大利等国在万圣节举行了示威活动。

paras.en: French officials said they would deploy 70,000 police on Saturday following some of the worst rioting in decades, which erupted in cities across the country after student protests about the state of education evolved into wider demonstrations about the cost of living and social security.
paras.zh: 法国官员表示，在学生针对教育状况的抗议演变成针对生活成本和社会保障的更广泛示威活动后，法国各城市爆发了数十年来最严重的骚乱，法国官员表示，他们将在周六部署 7 万名警察。

paras.en: As the demonstrations began Saturday afternoon in Paris, protesters were pictured holding a banner that read: “We do not need tear gas for our future to be blurry.”
paras.zh: 周六下午，示威活动在巴黎开始，抗议者举着横幅，上面写着：“我们不需要催泪瓦斯，让我们的未来变得模糊。”

paras.en: Videos vetted by NBC News show large crowds and fires burning in Marseille.
paras.zh: NBC新闻审查的视频显示马赛有大量人群和大火。

paras.en: Some 320,000 people demonstrated across France on Saturday, including 70,000 in Paris, according to the French Interior Ministry. Authorities reported more than 560 arrests nationwide by Saturday night.
paras.zh: 据法国内政部称，周六法国各地约有 32 万人示威，其中巴黎有 7 万人。当局报告称，截至周六晚间，全国已有 560 多人被捕。

paras.en: While the protests have been largely peaceful, police arrested 1,300 people last week after an estimated 410,000 took to the streets in cities across the country. Stores, public buildings and businesses have also been damaged since the protests erupted last month.
paras.zh: 虽然抗议活动基本上是和平的，但上周全国各地城市约有 41 万人走上街头，警方逮捕了 1,300 人。自上个月爆发抗议活动以来，商店、公共建筑和企业也遭到破坏。

paras.en: “Everyone is on deck to ensure an extremely firm response to any trouble,” Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said at a news conference earlier this week as he set out security arrangements, adding there was “a very high risk” of unrest.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯在本周早些时候的新闻发布会上制定安全安排时表示，“每个人都准备好确保对任何麻烦做出极其坚定的反应”，并补充说发生骚乱的“风险非常高”。

paras.en: Measures introduced last week to protect shops would be reinforced, he said, and demonstrations would not be permitted “in city centers, where there is a risk of public disorder.”
paras.zh: 他说，上周推出的保护商店的措施将得到加强，并且不允许“在存在公共骚乱风险的市中心”举行示威活动。

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy in France advised travelers to avoid areas where demonstrations or large gatherings are planned.
paras.zh: 美国驻法国大使馆建议旅客避开计划举行示威或大型集会的地区。

paras.en: The protests in France began after Prime Minister Emmanuel Macron launched budget talks for 2027. Students in the country, angry over a declining education system and the high cost of living, then took to the streets.
paras.zh: 法国的抗议活动是在总理埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)启动2027年预算谈判后开始的。该国学生对教育体系下降和生活成本高昂感到愤怒，随后走上街头。

paras.en: They were later joined by unions and the Yellow Vests, a grassroots movement that emerged in 2018 as a revolt against fuel taxes.
paras.zh: 后来工会和黄背心运动也加入了他们的行列，黄背心运动是一场于 2018 年兴起的反对燃油税的草根运动。

paras.en: Those demonstrations appear to have inspired similar protests across the continent, with protests erupting in Belgium, Spain, Italy and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 这些示威活动似乎引发了整个非洲大陆的类似抗议活动，比利时、西班牙、意大利和其他地方爆发了抗议活动。

paras.en: In Germany there were demonstrations organized by the campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen Z takes charge) in more than 30 cities Saturday, including the capital Berlin and the financial hub Frankfurt.
paras.zh: 在德国，运动团体 Gen Z regelt（Z 世代负责）周六在 30 多个城市组织了示威活动，其中包括首都柏林和金融中心法兰克福。

paras.en: The groups demand spending on schools, climate protection and housing, and are against plans to return to mandatory military service.
paras.zh: 这些团体要求在学校、气候保护和住房方面进行支出，并反对恢复义务兵役的计划。

paras.en: “We all have those images from France in our minds — looting, burning houses, burning police vehicles, and attacks on police officers,” said Roman Poseck, interior minister for the state of Hesse, whose capital is Wiesbaden.
paras.zh: “我们脑海中都有那些来自法国的画面——抢劫、焚烧房屋、焚烧警车以及袭击警察，”首府威斯巴登的黑森州内政部长罗曼·波塞克(Roman Poseck)说。

paras.en: Protesters gathered in front of Berlin’s Brandenburg Gate, as police said an additional 1,500 officers would be deployed throughout the city.
paras.zh: 抗议者聚集在柏林勃兰登堡门前，警方表示将在全市增派 1,500 名警察。

paras.en: While most people rallied peacefully, some protests turned violent on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 虽然大多数人和平集会，但周六晚上一些抗议活动演变成暴力活动。

paras.en: In downtown Frankfurt, some rioters smashed several storefronts and stole goods from inside. They also stole weapons from a gun store, which police were able to retrieve later. Some rioters also threw Molotov cocktails at police after pummeling them with stones and bottles earlier in the day, Frankfurt police said on X.
paras.zh: 在法兰克福市中心，一些暴徒砸毁了几家店面并从里面偷走了货物。他们还从一家枪店偷了武器，警方后来将其取回。法兰克福警方 X 表示，当天早些时候，一些骚乱者用石块和瓶子殴打警察后，还向警察投掷燃烧弹。

paras.en: Elsewhere in Europe, a huge encampment of tents has occupied a square in Madrid since late last month, and thousands of people in Portugal have taken to the streets in the city of Lisbon. Tear gas and water cannons were also used on black-clad protesters in Brussels.
paras.zh: 在欧洲其他地方，自上个月末以来，一个巨大的帐篷营地占据了马德里的一个广场，而葡萄牙的数千人则走上里斯本市的街道。布鲁塞尔的黑衣抗议者也使用了催泪瓦斯和高压水枪。

paras.en: In the United Kingdom, hundreds of demonstrators are expected to gather outside the U.S. Embassy in London on Saturday and risk arrest in support of Palestine Action, a protest group banned by the British government.
paras.zh: 在英国，预计数百名示威者将于周六聚集在美国驻伦敦大使馆外，冒着被捕的危险，支持被英国政府禁止的抗议组织“巴勒斯坦行动”。

paras.en: In Serbia, student-led activism also helped unseat the country’s long-time leader at the ballot box.
paras.zh: 在塞尔维亚，学生主导的激进主义也帮助该国的长期领导人在投票箱中下台。

paras.en: In Italy, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s far-right government also said it would deploy 500 army troops alongside the police in Milan until the end of the year after groups of masked protesters looted stores in the fashion capital and elsewhere and threw projectiles at police earlier this month.
paras.zh: 在意大利，总理乔治亚·梅洛尼(Giorgia Meloni)的极右翼政府也表示，在本月早些时候，一群蒙面抗议者抢劫了时尚之都和其他地方的商店并向警察投掷弹丸后，将在米兰部署500名军队与警察一起部署到年底。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people again took to the streets of Rome on Friday and other cities and towns across the country.
paras.zh: 周五，数万人再次走上罗马和全国其他城镇的街头。

paras.en: The demonstrations were largely peaceful, but an NBC News crew saw police use a water cannon on protesters and groups of police charging to disperse protesters.
paras.zh: 示威活动基本上是和平的，但 NBC 新闻工作人员看到警察对抗议者使用高压水枪，以及成群结队的警察冲锋驱散抗议者。

paras.en: Italian police were out in force with riot brigades, drones and helicopters visible in the skies above the capital.
paras.zh: 意大利警察出动，防暴队、无人机和直升机在首都上空清晰可见。

paras.en: “We have been completely screwed by the fact that the wages do not keep up on inflation and the wages in general do not keep up with the cost of living,” said Luca, a 20-year-old medical student who asked to have his last name withheld out of fear of repercussions from law enforcement.
paras.zh: 20 岁的医科学生卢卡 (Luca) 说：“工资跟不上通货膨胀，而且总体工资跟不上生活成本，我们彻底被搞砸了。”由于担心执法部门的影响，他要求隐去自己的姓氏。

paras.en: CORRECTION (Nov. 2, 2026, 8:30 a.m. ET): A previous version of this article misstated the capital of the German state of Hesse. It is Wiesbaden, not Frankfurt.
paras.zh: 更正（美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 2 日上午 8:30）：本文的先前版本错误地描述了德国黑森州的首府。这是威斯巴登，不是法兰克福。

articles.title: U.S. military carries out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island
articles.author: Gordon Lubold

paras.en: The U.S. military carried out limited strikes Monday on Iran’s Qeshm Island, according to two U.S. officials.
paras.zh: 据两名美国官员称，美国军方周一对伊朗格什姆岛进行了有限的袭击。

paras.en: The officials said the U.S. attacks, which came on the eve of crucial U.S. midterm elections and as the Middle East is anxious about the possibility of a return to all-out war, were not a resumption of major combat operations in Iran. They described the attacks as self-defense in response to Iran’s ongoing efforts to target maritime shipping and U.S. assets.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，美国的袭击发生在关键的美国中期选举前夕，而且中东地区担心全面战争的可能性，但这并不是伊朗恢复重大战斗行动。他们将这些袭击描述为自卫，以回应伊朗持续针对海上运输和美国资产的努力。

paras.en: The U.S. continues to intercept drones and missiles that are targeting shipping every day, one of the U.S. officials said.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员表示，美国每天都在继续拦截针对航运的无人机和导弹。

paras.en: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has routinely targeted and shot at U.S. manned and unmanned aircraft over the Strait of Hormuz and in the area over the past few weeks, one of the U.S. officials said.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员表示，过去几周，伊斯兰革命卫队经常对霍尔木兹海峡和该地区的美国有人驾驶和无人机进行瞄准和射击。

paras.en: The U.S. is occasionally striking Iranian missile launchers in self-defense when the Revolutionary Guard shoots at U.S. aircraft, the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，当革命卫队向美国飞机射击时，美国偶尔会出于自卫而攻击伊朗导弹发射器。

paras.en: Iran tried to target a U.S. aircraft again, leading to the U.S. strike on Qeshm to take out the launcher, the official said, calling it part of ongoing operations.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，伊朗再次试图瞄准一架美国飞机，导致美国对格什姆岛发动空袭以取出发射器，并称这是正在进行的行动的一部分。

paras.en: A third U.S. official said, “This was a defensive measure for Iranians using surface-to-air missiles against U.S. assets.”
paras.zh: 第三位美国官员表示，“这是伊朗使用地对空导弹攻击美国资产的防御措施。”

paras.en: Iranian state media reported that five explosions were heard Monday on Qeshm Island.
paras.zh: 伊朗官方媒体报道称，周一格什姆岛发生了五次爆炸。

paras.en: President Donald Trump had said the U.S. would not launch strikes on Iran before Tuesday’s midterm elections.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统曾表示，美国不会在周二中期选举之前对伊朗发动袭击。

paras.en: The unpopular Iran war and the resulting impact on U.S. gasoline prices and other parts of the economy have been a vulnerability for Republicans as they try to keep control of Congress.
paras.zh: 不受欢迎的伊朗战争及其对美国汽油价格和其他经济领域的影响一直是共和党试图保持对国会控制权的一个弱点。

paras.en: The administration was last known to have carried out some attacks in early September, but thousands of U.S. troops remain in the waters off Iran to maintain a naval blockade aimed at preventing tankers carrying Iranian oil from getting to the global market. A third aircraft carrier and thousands of additional troops are also on their way to the Middle East.
paras.zh: 据了解，美国政府最后一次发动袭击是在 9 月初，但数千名美军仍留在伊朗附近海域，维持海上封锁，旨在阻止运载伊朗石油的油轮进入全球市场。第三艘航空母舰和数千名额外部队也正在前往中东的途中。

paras.en: Earlier Monday, Vice President JD Vance offered measured optimism that a deal can still be struck to prevent Trump from following through on his threat to potentially order new strikes on Iran after the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，副总统万斯表示乐观，认为仍然可以达成协议，以防止特朗普兑现其在中期选举后可能下令对伊朗进行新打击的威胁。

paras.en: Vance sent a letter to Iran’s security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, last week, few details of which have been offered by the White House. Trump told reporters the letter was focused on assisting Iran with “medical supplies and various things.”
paras.zh: 万斯上周致函伊朗安全负责人穆赫森·礼扎伊，但白宫并未透露其中的细节。特朗普告诉记者，这封信的重点是向伊朗提供“医疗用品和各种物品”。

paras.en: Vance suggested Monday that there was reason to believe the U.S. and Iran could still come to an agreement.
paras.zh: 万斯周一表示，有理由相信美国和伊朗仍然可以达成协议。

paras.en: “We’ve had a number of good conversations with the Iranians,” he told reporters when he was asked about the letter, adding that he and Trump “both feel pretty good about the prospects for potentially coming to a negotiated settlement. We’re going to keep on working at it.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这封信时，他告诉记者：“我们与伊朗人进行了多次良好的对话。”他补充说，他和特朗普“都对通过谈判达成解决方案的前景感到非常满意。我们将继续为此努力。”

paras.en: The region remains on edge about the prospect of the U.S.’ resuming full-scale operations against Iran. The back-channel efforts are playing out as Israel and some Middle East allies lobby Trump on the way forward in the eight-month-old war, which has rattled global markets and wreaked havoc on Iran.
paras.zh: 该地区仍对美国恢复对伊朗全面行动的前景感到紧张。随着以色列和一些中东盟友游说特朗普在这场持续八个月的战争中取得进展，这些秘密渠道的努力正在上演，这场战争已经扰乱了全球市场，并对伊朗造成了严重破坏。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had pushed for renewed strikes even before the Israeli election last week as he sought to highlight his security credentials to a public deeply scarred by Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023, attack.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡甚至在上周以色列大选之前就已推动重新发动袭击，因为他试图向因哈马斯 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击而深受创伤的公众强调他的安全资历。

paras.en: But the war has also loomed large for American voters ahead of Tuesday’s midterm elections.
paras.zh: 但在周二的中期选举之前，这场战争对美国选民来说也显得尤为重要。

paras.en: Oil prices dropped sharply Monday as renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war appeared to show signs of progress.
paras.zh: 由于结束战争的新外交努力似乎显示出进展迹象，周一油价大幅下跌。

paras.en: Trump noted the drop Monday in a speech in Washington, which was billed as his closing argument to Americans, and sought to minimize the scale of the conflict, which has cost U.S. taxpayers at least $47 billion.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在华盛顿的一次演讲中指出了局势的下降，这场演讲被宣传为他对美国人的结案陈词，并试图将冲突的规模降至最低，这场冲突已使美国纳税人损失了至少 470 亿美元。

paras.en: “I don’t know if you even call it a war, because we haven’t been doing any fighting for months,” Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我不知道你是否称其为战争，因为我们已经好几个月没有进行任何战斗了。”

paras.en: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has repeatedly said Iran is open to diplomatic talks.
paras.zh: 伊朗外长阿拉格奇多次表示，伊朗对外交谈判持开放态度。

paras.en: “While our Brave Armed Forces are fully prepared to defend the Homeland, Iran continues to give diplomacy a chance to succeed,” he wrote on X last week.
paras.zh: “虽然我们勇敢的武装部队已做好保卫祖国的充分准备，但伊朗继续为外交提供成功的机会，”他上周在 X 上写道。

articles.title: Lamarre-Condon told police he was not a bad person, trial hears
articles.author: Jamie McKinnell

paras.en: A detective leading the double murder investigation told a jury of Beau Lamarre-Condon's demeanour in the days after the deaths.
paras.zh: 一名领导这起双重谋杀案调查的侦探向陪审团讲述了博·拉马尔-康登在死后几天的行为举止。

paras.en: Detective Sasha Pinazza said Mr Lamarre-Condon appeared emotional and told police "I'm not a bad person".
paras.zh: 警探萨沙·皮纳扎 (Sasha Pinazza) 表示，拉马尔·康登 (Lamarre-Condon) 先生显得情绪激动，并告诉警方“我不是坏人”。

paras.en: The court also heard Mr Lamarre-Condon expressed hope of one day talking to the families of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.
paras.zh: 法庭还获悉，拉马尔-康登先生表示希望有一天能与杰西·贝尔德和卢克·戴维斯的家人交谈。

paras.en: Accused double murderer Beau Lamarre-Condon became emotional and told police that he was "not a bad person" after revealing the location where he left the bodies of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies, a jury has heard.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，被指控的双重杀人犯博·拉马尔-康登在透露了他留下杰西·贝尔德和卢克·戴维斯尸体的地点后，情绪激动，告诉警方他“不是一个坏人”。

paras.en: The 31-year-old former officer is facing trial on two counts of murder, accused of shooting the couple with his police pistol inside Mr Baird's Paddington share house in February 2024.
paras.zh: 这位 31 岁的前警官因两项谋杀罪而面临审判，他被指控于 2024 年 2 月在贝尔德先生位于帕丁顿的合租房屋内用警用手枪射击这对夫妇。

paras.en: Their bodies were discovered in surfboard bags near a monastery in Bungonia, south of Sydney, more than a week after the deaths. Mr Lamarre-Condon has pleaded not guilty and is arguing self-defence.
paras.zh: 在死亡一周多后，他们的尸体在悉尼南部Bungonia修道院附近的冲浪板袋中被发现。Lamarre-Condon先生已表示不认罪，并正在进行自卫。

paras.en: Jurors in the Supreme Court trial have previously seen body-cam footage of the moment Mr Lamarre-Condon handed himself in at Bondi Police Station four days after the men died.
paras.zh: 最高法院审判的陪审员此前曾看过拉马尔-康登先生在两名男子死亡四天后在邦迪警察局自首的随身摄像机的镜头。

paras.en: Detective Sasha Pinazza, the officer in charge of the investigation, was with the accused as he was taken to another station, the court heard on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 法庭周二获悉，负责调查的警官萨沙·皮纳扎 (Sasha Pinazza) 与被告一起被带到另一个警察局。

paras.en: She advised him that it may be in his best interests to speak to his lawyer regarding the 'no body, no parole' legislation.
paras.zh: 她建议他，与律师讨论“不带尸体，不准假释”的立法可能符合他的最大利益。

paras.en: "I explained that legislation excluded a person convicted of murder from release on parole in circumstances where the victims had not been located, and the accused had failed to assist," Detective Pinazza said in her statement, which was read to the court.
paras.zh: 皮纳扎警探在向法庭宣读的声明中说：“我解释说，在受害者下落不明且被告未能提供协助的情况下，立法禁止被判谋杀罪的人假释。”

paras.en: When he was told that police had information about the men's bodies being in a dam or on a farm near Goulburn, he did not comment and cited legal advice.
paras.zh: 当他被告知警方掌握了有关这些人的尸体位于古尔本附近的水坝或农场的信息时，他没有发表评论，并引用了法律建议。

paras.en: The court heard he spoke about having an "outer body experience".
paras.zh: 法庭获悉他谈到了“外部身体体验”。

paras.en: 'I don't want you to judge me, I'm not a bad person'
paras.zh: “我不想让你评判我，我不是坏人”

paras.en: In an interview room, he was crying and became emotional as he talked about mental health and claimed to have PTSD, Detective Pinazza's statement said.
paras.zh: 皮纳扎警探的声明称，在采访室里，他在谈论心理健康并声称患有创伤后应激障碍时哭泣并变得情绪化。

paras.en: The detective said he claimed previous work-related matters had "messed me up" and said he was sent to Youth Command as punishment.
paras.zh: 这名侦探说，他声称之前与工作相关的事情“把我搞砸了”，并表示他被送到青年指挥部作为惩罚。

paras.en: She recalled the accused stating: "I don't want you to judge me, I'm not a bad person."
paras.zh: 她回忆起被告说：“我不想让你评判我，我不是一个坏人。”

paras.en: He also asked whether police were close to finding the men's bodies.
paras.zh: 他还询问警方是否即将找到这些男子的尸体。

paras.en: The court heard that four days later, Detective Pinazza and colleagues attended Silverwater prison and advised the accused that they only wanted to speak to him about the location of the bodies.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，四天后，皮纳扎警探和同事来到了银水监狱，并告诉被告，他们只想与他谈论尸体的位置。

paras.en: After speaking to his lawyer, he said the location was in the same area as a Bungonia farm police had been searching.
paras.zh: 在与他的律师交谈后，他说该地点与邦尼亚农场警察一直在搜寻的地区位于同一地区。

paras.en: Jurors heard that police showed Mr Lamarre-Condon maps on a laptop and he indicated the roads he had travelled to a monastery, before describing its gates.
paras.zh: 陪审员听说，警方向拉马尔-康登先生展示了笔记本电脑上的地图，他在描述修道院大门之前指出了他前往修道院的道路。

paras.en: He was then shown images of a property police believed he had gone to.
paras.zh: 然后他看到了警方认为他去过的一处房产的照片。

paras.en: "The accused believed to the best of his recollection this to be location where he left the bodies of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies," Detective Pinazza said in her statement.
paras.zh: 皮纳扎警探在声明中说：“据被告所知，他认为这是他留下杰西·贝尔德和卢克·戴维斯尸体的地方。”

paras.en: "The accused was emotional and implored that he was not a bad person."
paras.zh: “被告情绪激动，恳求自己不是坏人。”

paras.en: He also asked to wait while investigators attended the location.
paras.zh: 他还要求在调查人员到达该地点时等待。

paras.en: "The accused expressed a hope that he would one day be able to talk to Jesse and Luke's families," her statement recorded.
paras.zh: “被告表示希望有一天能够与杰西和卢克的家人交谈，”她的声明记录道。

paras.en: "He was emotional and stated, 'I'm not that person'."
paras.zh: “他很情绪化，并表示，‘我不是那个人’。”

paras.en: That day, police located the bodies near the entrance of a monastery in surfboard bags, partially covered by sticks and rocks.
paras.zh: 那天，警方在一座修道院入口附近发现了装在冲浪板袋中的尸体，部分尸体被棍棒​​和石块覆盖。

paras.en: The court has previously heard he allegedly attempted to sink the bags in a dam at a Bungonia farm, using quick-set cement and weights, after transporting them in a white hire van.
paras.zh: 法庭此前获悉，他据称在用一辆白色出租货车运输袋子后，试图使用速凝水泥和重物将袋子沉入 Bungonia 农场的水坝中。

paras.en: The jury has heard evidence about his movements in the week of the alleged murders, which the Crown alleges involved deliberate steps to cover up his involvement in the deaths.
paras.zh: 陪审团听取了有关他在涉嫌谋杀案发生的一周内的行动的证据，检方称这涉及故意采取措施掩盖他参与死亡事件的事实。

paras.en: Mr Lamarre-Condon's lawyers have indicated that his case will be that he "panicked" after two separate struggles involving the gun, which resulted in the two deaths.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登的律师表示，他的案件是，他在两次涉及枪支的独立斗争中“惊慌失措”，导致两人死亡。

paras.en: The Crown is expected to close its case shortly in the trial, which is now in its seventh week.
paras.zh: 预计检方将在审判中很快结案，目前审判已进入第七周。

paras.en: It has an estimatedThe trial is expected to run for three months.
paras.zh: 预计试验将持续三个月。

articles.title: Polls show Trump's party could lose control of Congress but they may be wrong
articles.author: Emilie Gramenz

paras.en: If the midterm elections polls can be believed, the Democratic Party could be about to seize control of the US Congress.
paras.zh: 如果中期选举民意调查可信，民主党可能即将夺取美国国会的控制权。

paras.en: Polling predicts a crushing victory for Democrats in the House of Representatives, where they need to gain four seats.
paras.zh: 民意调查预测民主党将在众议院取得压倒性胜利，他们需要获得四个席位。

paras.en: There is even the possibility of Republicans losing their majority in the Senate, where the Democrats need to defend four seats in tight races and win four more to wrest back control.
paras.zh: 共和党甚至有可能失去参议院多数席位，民主党需要在激烈的竞选中捍卫四个席位，并再赢得四个席位才能夺回控制权。

paras.en: Historically at midterm elections, control of the House can flip. But a path to the Senate for Democrats is quite a turnaround for the party that started out having to "pitch a perfect game", as Jessica Taylor from the Cook Political Report puts it.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，在中期选举中，众议院的控制权可能会发生翻转。但正如《库克政治报告》的杰西卡·泰勒所说，民主党进入参议院的道路对于该党来说是一个很大的转变，该党一开始必须“推出一场完美的游戏”。

paras.en: Mr Trump's decision to launch a war on Iran has been pivotal in his sliding popularity.
paras.zh: 特朗普决定对伊朗发动战争是他支持率下滑的关键。

paras.en: "Typically the president's party loses seats and certainly President Trump's approval ratings were not great before March, but pursuing an unpopular war that drove prices, especially on gasoline and diesel, further up has only put his party in more peril," Ms Taylor said.
paras.zh: 泰勒女士表示：“通常情况下，总统所在的政党都会失去席位，当然，特朗普总统在三月份之前的支持率并不高，但推行一场不受欢迎的战争，导致价格进一步上涨，尤其是汽油和柴油价格的上涨，只会让他的政党陷入更大的危险。”

paras.en: Democrats now look competitive in Senate races in red states such as Texas, Kansas, Alaska, Iowa and Ohio.
paras.zh: 民主党现在在德克萨斯州、堪萨斯州、阿拉斯加州、爱荷华州和俄亥俄州等红色州的参议员竞选中看起来很有竞争力。

paras.en: They are widely considered likely to win a North Carolina Senate seat off the Republicans, and polling is very tight in the swing state of Michigan, which backed Mr Trump in the presidential race two years ago.
paras.zh: 人们普遍认为他们有可能击败共和党赢得北卡罗来纳州参议院席位，而摇摆州密歇根州的民调非常紧张，该州在两年前的总统竞选中支持特朗普。

paras.en: But Ms Taylor cautions that polls are only a snapshot of voter sentiment at a moment in time.
paras.zh: 但泰勒女士警告说，民意调查只是选民情绪的一个缩影。

paras.en: "I think this is why we look at polls holistically, rather than one poll, because you can have an outlier ... but we see most of the polls trending in the same direction. I mean, a lot of these polls are just very, very close."
paras.zh: “我认为这就是为什么我们从整体上看待民意调查，而不是单一民意调查，因为你可能会出现异常值……但我们看到大多数民意调查都朝着同一方向发展。我的意思是，很多民意调查都非常非常接近。”

paras.en: Ms Taylor says Democrats should not interpret the positive numbers as an endorsement.
paras.zh: 泰勒女士表示，民主党人不应将正数解读为支持。

paras.en: Many analysts, including the founder of the Cook Political Report, are characterising the numbers as more of a "red undertow" than a "blue wave".
paras.zh: 许多分析师，包括库克政治报告的创始人，将这些数字描述为“红色浪潮”而不是“蓝色浪潮”。

paras.en: "It's Republicans that are in power and voters have a strong anti-incumbent sentiment right now. It's more like a pox on both their houses," Ms Taylor said.
paras.zh: “掌权的是共和党人，选民现在有强烈的反现任情绪。这更像是两院都长了痘，”泰勒女士说。

paras.en: Polls look 'genuinely bad' for Republicans
paras.zh: 民意调查对共和党人来说“确实很糟糕”

paras.en: Many polls are extremely close and within the margin of error (a measure that accounts for how likely it is to be wrong).
paras.zh: 许多民意调查都非常接近，并且在误差范围内（衡量错误可能性的衡量标准）。

paras.en: This is similar to the 2024 presidential polls, which were mostly too close to call. Mr Trump ended up sweeping all the swing states, but that was not particularly outside what polls had predicted.
paras.zh: 这与 2024 年的总统民意调查类似，当时的民调大多都势均力敌。特朗普最终横扫了所有摇摆州，但这并不特别超出民意调查的预测。

paras.en: "National polls always under count support for Republicans, and with President Trump barnstorming the country and driving our voters to the polls, Republicans are ready to fight, defy history, and protect our majorities," Republican National Committee press secretary Natalie Baldassarre said.
paras.zh: 共和党全国委员会新闻秘书娜塔莉·巴尔达萨尔表示：“全国民意调查始终显示对共和党的支持率，随着特朗普总统对全国进行巡回演讲并推动我们的选民去投票站，共和党人已准备好战斗，蔑视历史并保护我们的多数派。”

paras.en: Charles Franklin, the director of the respected Marquette Law School Poll, recently told Politico that one of the largest fears for pollsters was that not enough Republicans were responding.
paras.zh: 受人尊敬的马凯特法学院民意调查中心主任查尔斯·富兰克林最近告诉《政治》杂志，民意调查机构最担心的问题之一是没有足够多的共和党人做出回应。

paras.en: "We've done a lot over this past decade to try to improve the control we have over those kinds of errors, but ultimately we can't force people to do polls, and so this remains always a background fear factor," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在过去的十年里，我们做了很多工作来试图改善对此类错误的控制，但最终我们不能强迫人们进行民意调查，因此这始终是一个背景恐惧因素。”

paras.en: This graph shows how polls have changed this year.
paras.zh: 该图显示了今年民意调查的变化。

paras.en: But Republican pollster and strategist Patrick Ruffini said the environment was "genuinely bad" for Republicans.
paras.zh: 但共和党民意调查专家和策略师帕特里克·鲁菲尼表示，环境对共和党来说“确实很糟糕”。

paras.en: "They look weaker this late in a cycle than I can remember," he told the ABC.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国广播公司：“在一个周期的后期，它们看起来比我记忆中的更弱。”

paras.en: He said there also were complications with where the Democrats were leading.
paras.zh: 他表示，民主党的领先地位也存在复杂性。

paras.en: "The Senate battleground runs through red states like Iowa, Ohio and Texas and these are states that Republicans consistently carry by solid margins, or that the polls have a hard time getting right."
paras.zh: “参议院的战场贯穿爱荷华州、俄亥俄州和得克萨斯州等红色州，这些州是共和党一直以稳固优势领先的州，或者说民意调查很难取得正确的结果。”

paras.en: Mr Ruffini recently examined more than 3,000 Senate polls from the past eight years to assess their track record.
paras.zh: 鲁菲尼先生最近审查了过去八年的 3,000 多项参议院民意调查，以评估他们的记录。

paras.en: He found 73 per cent of them had overstated the Democrat candidate. In Iowa, Ohio and Michigan, the Democrats were overstated 93 per cent of the time.
paras.zh: 他发现其中 73% 的人夸大了民主党候选人。在爱荷华州、俄亥俄州和密歇根州，民主党93%的时间都被夸大了。

paras.en: "That doesn't mean it will happen again. Democrats are still gaining in the polls this year," he said.
paras.zh: “这并不意味着这种情况会再次发生。民主党今年在民调中仍然取得优势，”他说。

paras.en: "The bigger risk is uneven error from state to state, where the national picture is right but some states miss.
paras.zh: “更大的风险是各州之间的错误参差不齐，全国情况是正确的，但有些州却错了。

paras.en: "Polls have been more accurate in the Sun Belt than in the Rust Belt, so I'd believe a blue Texas before a blue Iowa."
paras.zh: “阳光地带的民意调查比铁锈地带更准确，所以我更愿意相信蓝色的德克萨斯州，而不是蓝色的爱荷华州。”

paras.en: It is not always the Republicans who defy polls. In what the US calls off-cycle elections, the Democrats running in high-profile governor races in New Jersey and Virginia have outperformed their polling and won easily.
paras.zh: 反抗民意调查的并不总是共和党人。在美国所谓的非周期选举中，民主党在新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州备受瞩目的州长竞选中表现出色，轻松获胜。

paras.en: Even with the extraordinary unpopularity of Mr Trump, Democrats are reluctant to consider the midterms sewn up.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普极不受欢迎，但民主党人仍不愿认为中期选举已经尘埃落定。

paras.en: Former Obama White House chief of staff Rahm Emanuel recently stressed to The New Yorker that he felt only "cautiously optimistic" about the Senate, although he was more confident about the House.
paras.zh: 前奥巴马白宫办公厅主任拉姆·伊曼纽尔最近向《纽约客》强调，他对参议院只感到“谨慎乐观”，尽管他对众议院更有信心。

paras.en: It is possible to read some tea leaves about where money is pouring in.
paras.zh: 可以读到一些关于资金涌入何处的茶叶。

paras.en: The analytics firm AdImpact calculated that Republicans were out-spending Democrats in 10 battleground Senate races a week out from the election.
paras.zh: 分析公司 AdImpact 计算得出，选举结束后一周，共和党在 10 场参议员战场竞选中的支出超过了民主党。

paras.en: The Republican war chest was significantly boosted by MAGA Inc, a political action committee, or PAC, associated with the president.
paras.zh: MAGA Inc（与总统有联系的政治行动委员会，简称 PAC）大大增加了共和党的战争资金。

paras.en: PACs are organisations formed explicitly to raise and spend money on election races.
paras.zh: 政治行动委员会是专门为选举竞选筹集和支出资金而成立的组织。

paras.en: In the final sprint of campaigning, Mr Trump promised that he would unleash a further $US100 million ($142 million) to back Republican candidates, adding to more than $US300 million MAGA Inc had already spent.
paras.zh: 在竞选的最后冲刺中，特朗普承诺将再投入 1 亿美元（1.42 亿美元）来支持共和党候选人，这使得 MAGA Inc 已经花费了超过 3 亿美元。

paras.en: Other mega-donors like Elon Musk are also using PACs to put money behind favored candidates.
paras.zh: 像埃隆·马斯克（ Elon Musk ）这样的其他大型捐赠者也在使用PAC来为受青睐的候选人提供资金。

paras.en: The closely fought Texas Senate race has been flooded with cash, with spending surpassing $US500 million.
paras.zh: 竞争激烈的德克萨斯州参议员竞选资金充沛，支出超过 5 亿美元。

paras.en: In North Carolina, where the former Democratic governor Roy Cooper looks set to easily convert a Republican Senate seat, the top campaign spending organisation for Senate Republicans pulled its funding at the start of October.
paras.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州，前民主党州长罗伊·库珀看起来将轻松转换共和党参议院席位，参议院共和党的最高竞选支出组织于 10 月初撤回了资金。

paras.en: That suggests the party considered the seat lost even then. In Kansas, which has not elected a Democrat senator since 1932, ad spending increased tenfold in the weeks leading up to the election.
paras.zh: 这表明该党即使在当时也认为失去了席位。堪萨斯州自 1932 年以来就没有选举过民主党参议员，在选举前几周，广告支出增加了十倍。

paras.en: Observers are also reading in to Mr Trump's travel schedule. He has mainly held rallies in deeply red areas.
paras.zh: 观察人士也在关注特朗普的旅行日程。他主要在深红色地区举行集会。

paras.en: And the president, of course, does not believe the polling.
paras.zh: 总统当然不相信民意调查。

paras.en: "Look, the polls are fake," he said last week. "I don't rely on the polls, but polls mean something. But a lot of the polls are rigged, just like the journalists are rigged."
paras.zh: “看，民意调查是假的，”他上周说道。 “我不依赖民意调查，但民意调查是有意义的。但很多民意调查都被操纵了，就像记者被操纵一样。”

articles.title: Quick hits: A-listers, mistakes and the King's Melbourne Cup connection
articles.author: Simon Smale

paras.en: The 2026 Melbourne Cup race day has provided on-course action and off-track celebrities.
paras.zh: 2026 年墨尔本杯比赛日汇聚了赛场内和赛场外的名人。

paras.en: With a generous A-lister shouting fans dinner, a heartfelt message from MND sufferer Nathan Charles and the royal connection to race winner Point of Law, there was a little bit of everything at Flemington.
paras.zh: 一场慷慨的一线明星大喊大叫的粉丝晚宴、MND 患者内森·查尔斯 (Nathan Charles) 的衷心祝愿以及与比赛冠军 Point of Law 的皇室联系，在弗莱明顿 (Flemington) 可谓应有尽有。

paras.en: Here's the quick hits from the race that stops a nation.
paras.zh: 以下是这场让一个国家停下来的比赛的快速报道。

paras.en: 1. Waller fined $50,000 for 'honest mistake'
paras.zh: 1. 沃勒因“无心错误”被罚款 50,000 美元

paras.en: Some mistakes are more costly than others on Melbourne Cup Day, and it's fair to say that Chris Waller paid dearly for an error made by a member of his team on race day morning.
paras.zh: 在墨尔本杯日，有些错误的代价比其他错误要高，公平地说，克里斯·沃勒为他的团队成员在比赛当天早上犯下的错误付出了高昂的代价。

paras.en: The New Zealand horse Asterix was found to have had Penetrene administered to both forelegs in its stable just hours before the race.
paras.zh: 就在比赛前几个小时，新西兰马阿斯特里克斯(Asterix)被发现在马厩中对双前腿注射了Penetrene。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, there was a topical treatment applied to the horse this morning which is allowed during the week but not on race day," Racing Victoria chief steward Rob Montgomery told Nine.
paras.zh: 维多利亚赛马队首席干事罗布·蒙哥马利告诉九号台：“不幸的是，今天早上对这匹马进行了局部治疗，这在一周内是允许的，但在比赛当天是不允许的。”

paras.en: "It just is an honest mistake but unfortunately has big consequences."
paras.zh: “这只是一个无心的错误，但不幸的是会产生严重的后果。”

paras.en: Penetrene is used to relieve muscle soreness and inflammation and is permitted for use, but not on race days.
paras.zh: Penetrene 用于缓解肌肉酸痛和炎症，允许使用，但不得在比赛日使用。

paras.en: Waller was fined $50,000 for the error, but said there was no blame for the incident.
paras.zh: 沃勒因这一错误被罚款 5 万美元，但表示这起事件没有责任。

paras.en: "It's a very basic liniment most stables use and I guess the pressure of race day, the person that looks after the horse, put it on his legs right in front of the security guard," Waller said.
paras.zh: 沃勒说：“这是大多数马厩使用的一种非常基本的搽剂，我猜是比赛当天的压力，照顾马的人在保安面前把它涂在马的腿上。”

paras.en: "Nothing was hidden … as soon as it happened we knew there was a problem.
paras.zh: “没有什么隐藏的……事情一发生我们就知道有问题了。

paras.en: "It's not [the stablehand's] fault, I've got to wear the responsibility, it's my team."
paras.zh: “这不是（马夫）的错，我必须承担责任，这是我的团队的错。”

paras.en: The Melbourne Cup is known for attracting everyone and anyone who wants to be seen in high society and this year is no exception.
paras.zh: 墨尔本杯以吸引每个人以及任何想出现在上流社会的人而闻名，今年也不例外。

paras.en: Hollywood A-lister Jamie Foxx has been in Melbourne shooting his latest film, Deadlocked.
paras.zh: 好莱坞一线明星杰米·福克斯正在墨尔本拍摄他的最新电影《死锁》。

paras.en: Between takes though, he has been mixing it with the Melbourne public, including at the evocatively named Maison Bâtard where, according to The Age, he paid for several people's dinner by surprise.
paras.zh: 不过，在拍摄间隙，他一直与墨尔本公众混在一起，包括在名字叫 Maison Batard 的 Maison Batard 餐厅，据《时代报》报道，他出人意料地为几个人支付了晚餐费用。

paras.en: He was at Flemington and told the Daily Mail Australia that he was taking his girlfriend, Alyce Huckstepp, and her family to the races as a surprise.
paras.zh: 他在弗莱明顿告诉《澳大利亚每日邮报》，他将带着女友艾丽丝·哈克斯特普和她的家人去参加比赛，以给他一个惊喜。

paras.en: On a more serious note, former Wallaby Nathan Charles was also at Flemington today.
paras.zh: 更严重的是，前小袋鼠内森·查尔斯今天也在弗莱明顿。

paras.en: The 37-year-old has recently been diagnosed with motor neurone disease and, despite the shock of such a devastating diagnosis, is intent on raising the profile of the disease and living his life to the full at the same time.
paras.zh: 这位 37 岁的老人最近被诊断出患有运动神经元疾病，尽管如此毁灭性的诊断令人震惊，但他仍致力于提高人们对这种疾病的认识，同时过上充实的生活。

paras.en: "In life, everyone has adversity. I've always been a believer in you should be judged not by how you fall over, but instead how you stand back up. And it's a really unfortunate circumstance," he told Nine.
paras.zh: “在生活中，每个人都会遇到逆境。我一直相信，评判你的标准不应该看你如何跌倒，而应看你如何站起来。这真是不幸的情况，”他告诉九号台。

paras.en: "But it is my journey and I've just got to keep on moving forward.
paras.zh: “但这是我的旅程，我必须继续前进。

paras.en: "I sort of took the week to get my emotions together.
paras.zh: “我花了一周的时间来整理自己的情绪。

paras.en: "And then I just thought, you know what, I gotta flip the script.
paras.zh: “然后我就想，你知道吗，我必须翻转剧本。

paras.en: "Instead of doing things for the last time I want to start doing things for the first time.
paras.zh: “我不想做最后一次事情，而是想开始第一次做事情。

paras.en: "And I want to provide inspiration and hope to young Australians that they can achieve in the face of adversity."
paras.zh: “我想为澳大利亚年轻人提供灵感和希望，让他们在逆境中能够取得成就。”

paras.en: Racegoers were given a real musical treat ahead of the race, with 52-year-old British legend Robbie Williams performing both pre and post-race at Flemington.
paras.zh: 赛前和赛后，52 岁的英国传奇人物罗比·威廉姆斯 (Robbie Williams) 在弗莱明顿为赛马观众带来了一场真正的音乐盛宴。

paras.en: Ahead of his latest Australian tour, which starts at Adelaide Oval on Saturday, Williams performed singalong favourites Feel, Rock DJ, Angels and then Let Me Entertain You.
paras.zh: 在周六于阿德莱德椭圆形体育场开始的最新澳大利亚巡演之前，威廉姆斯演唱了最受欢迎的歌曲《Feel》、《Rock DJ》、《Angels》和《Let Me Entertain You》。

paras.en: The crowd at Flemington were up on their feet.
paras.zh: 弗莱明顿的人群都站了起来。

paras.en: And they'll have another opportunity to enjoy the British legend later on too, when he performs another set at the course.
paras.zh: 稍后，当他在球场上表演另一场比赛时，他们还将有另一个机会欣赏这位英国传奇人物。

paras.en: Cup winner Point of Law has had quite the colourful past.
paras.zh: 杯赛冠军Point of Law有着丰富多彩的过去。

paras.en: The four-year-old, who was sired by unbeaten British legend Frankel, formerly belonged to King Charles III, who sold the colt earlier this year.
paras.zh: 这匹四岁的小马是不败的英国传奇人物弗兰克尔的父亲，以前属于国王查理三世，他在今年早些时候卖掉了这匹小马。

paras.en: King Charles's mother, the late Queen Elizabeth II, was a noted horse racing fan, with her gleeful celebration of Estimate's victory in the 2013 Ascot Gold Cup a particular highlight.
paras.zh: 查尔斯国王的母亲、已故的伊丽莎白二世女王是一位著名的赛马迷，她在 2013 年阿斯科特金杯赛中兴高采烈地庆祝埃斯蒂姆获胜是一个特别的亮点。

paras.en: She even finished sixth in the 1997 Melbourne Cup with Frankie Dettori on Arabian Story.
paras.zh: 她甚至在 1997 年墨尔本杯比赛中与 Frankie Dettori 一起凭借《阿拉伯故事》获得第六名。

paras.en: One can only guess how she'd have felt about her son selling a horse that would go on to win the race later that same year…
paras.zh: 人们只能猜测，如果她的儿子卖掉一匹马，这匹马将在同年晚些时候赢得比赛，她会有什么感受……

paras.en: A consortium of Australians bought Point of Law, among them legendary West Coast and Carlton superstar, Chris Judd.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚财团收购了 Point of Law，其中包括传奇的西海岸和卡尔顿巨星克里斯·贾德 (Chris Judd)。

paras.en: The Melbourne Cup offers something for everyone each year.
paras.zh: 墨尔本杯每年都会为每个人提供一些东西。

paras.en: Sure, there are plenty of punters who study the form guide intently, listen to all the shows, read all the previous and make an educated selection based on all those factors and more.
paras.zh: 当然，有很多投注者会专心研究表格指南，收听所有节目，阅读所有之前的内容，并根据所有这些因素等做出明智的选择。

paras.en: And then there's the rest of us, who pick the horse with the name they like best or whose colours remind you of your favourite flag.
paras.zh: 然后是我们其他人，他们用他们最喜欢的名字或者颜色让你想起你最喜欢的旗帜来挑选马。

paras.en: For tangential sports fans, there may have been one name that stuck out: James J Braddock.
paras.zh: 对于那些不切实际的体育迷来说，可能有一个名字很突出：詹姆斯·J·布拉多克(James J Braddock)。

paras.en: Film buffs may well recognise this name better than sporties, because James J Braddock was the subject of the 2005 biographical film, Cinderella Man, starring Russell Crowe.
paras.zh: 电影爱好者可能比运动爱好者更熟悉这个名字，因为詹姆斯·J·布拉多克 (James J Braddock) 是 2005 年由罗素·克劳 (Russell Crowe) 主演的传记电影《灰姑娘男人》(Cinderella Man) 的主角。

paras.en: Braddock was an American boxer in the 1930s who, due to persistent hand injuries, jacked in his ring career to work in the docks during the Great Depression.
paras.zh: 布拉多克是 20 世纪 30 年代的美国拳击手，由于手部持续受伤，他在大萧条期间在码头工作，结束了自己的拳击生涯。

paras.en: He came back to the ring though and, after a couple of impressive victories, managed to land a fight against the heavyweight champion of the world, Max Baer, at Madison Square Garden in 1935.
paras.zh: 不过，在取得几场令人印象深刻的胜利后，他又回到了拳击场，并于 1935 年在麦迪逊广场花园与世界重量级冠军马克斯·贝尔 (Max Baer) 进行了比赛。

paras.en: So monumental was the upset and the way he had come back from near retirement, that the press christened him the Cinderella Man.
paras.zh: 他的沮丧和他从接近退休后回来的方式是如此具有纪念意义，以至于媒体称他为“灰姑娘男人”。

paras.en: Braddock's next fight was against Joe Louis, who knocked him out in the eighth round of their bout in Chigaco in 1937.
paras.zh: 布拉多克的下一场比赛是对阵乔·路易斯，后者在 1937 年于奇加科举行的第八回合比赛中将他击倒。

paras.en: As for his equine namesake, he finished a credible seventh in the Cup.
paras.zh: 至于他的同名马匹，他在杯赛中获得了可靠的第七名。

articles.title: Canadian dentist detained by ICE in Minnesota released after federal court ruling

paras.en: Canadian dentist detained by ICE in Minnesota released after federal court ruling
paras.zh: 联邦法院裁决后，被明尼苏达州 ICE 拘留的加拿大牙医获释
