paras.en: Dr. William Lizardo, originally of Mississauga, was arrested on Oct. 23 at a green card interview
paras.zh: William Lizardo 博士原籍密西沙加，于 10 月 23 日在一次绿卡面试中被捕

paras.en: A Canadian dentist detained by U.S. federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents in Minnesota during a green card interview is back home after being ordered released by a federal judge.
paras.zh: 一名在明尼苏达州绿卡面试期间被美国联邦移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 人员拘留的加拿大牙医在联邦法官下令释放后已返回家中。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Michael J. Davis wrote in his ruling that the arrest and detention of Dr. William Lizardo, 32, originally of Mississauga, Ont., violated his constitutional rights.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官迈克尔·J·戴维斯 (Michael J. Davis) 在裁决中写道，逮捕和拘留来自安大略省米西索加的 32 岁威廉·利扎多 (William Lizardo) 博士侵犯了他的宪法权利。

paras.en: Lizardo moved to the U.S. on a student visa in 2019 to study at the University of Minnesota School of Dentistry, according to court documents. He graduated in 2023 and married an American that same year. They had a daughter two years later.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，利扎多于 2019 年持学生签证移居美国，在明尼苏达大学牙科学院学习。他于 2023 年毕业，同年与一位美国人结婚。两年后他们有了一个女儿。

paras.en: Lizardo's wife filed a petition for an alien relative in September 2023, while Lizardo applied to adjust his status to permanent residency. The relative petition was approved in January 2025, according to the court.
paras.zh: 利扎多的妻子于2023年9月提出了外籍亲属申请，而利扎多则申请将其身份调整为永久居留权。据法院称，相关申请于 2025 年 1 月获得批准。

paras.en: Lizardo practised dentistry in federally-designated shortage areas until his work authorization was revoked, at which time he started volunteering at a low-cost clinic in Burnsville, Minn., according to the court documents.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，利扎多在联邦指定的短缺地区从事牙科工作，直到他的工作授权被撤销，此时他开始在明尼苏达州伯恩斯维尔的一家低成本诊所做志愿者。

paras.en: In January, his request for permanent residency was denied because he had failed to provide a certified document from Ontario.
paras.zh: 一月份，他的永久居留申请被拒绝，因为他未能提供安大略省的认证文件。

paras.en: Orders to appear at subsequent hearings were sent to the wrong address. Lizardo missed the hearings and was subsequently arrested by ICE on Oct. 23, detained at Sherburne County Jail and ordered removed from the U.S.
paras.zh: 出席随后听证会的命令被发送到了错误的地址。 Lizardo 缺席了听证会，随后于 10 月 23 日被 ICE 逮捕，拘留在谢伯恩县监狱，并被勒令驱逐出美国。

paras.en: The judge called the facts of the case "appalling" — noting that while the couple moved several times, each time Lizardo "filed changes of address" with the post office and with U.S. Citizen and Immigration Services (USCIS). "In turn, USCIS communicated with Petitioner at each new address."
paras.zh: 法官称此案的事实“令人震惊”，并指出，虽然这对夫妇多次搬家，但利扎多每次都向邮局和美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）“提交地址变更申请”。 “反过来，移民局会在每个新地址与申请人进行沟通。”

paras.en: The judge also noted that Lizardo had never been arrested during his time in the U.S.
paras.zh: 法官还指出，利扎多在美国期间从未被捕。

paras.en: - Canadians caught up in Trump voter fraud crackdown as U.S. accuses Canada of election interference
paras.zh: - 美国指责加拿大干预选举，加拿大人陷入特朗普选民欺诈打击行动

paras.en: - Edmonton-born man held for months in ICE detention centres returns to Canada
paras.zh: - 出生于埃德蒙顿的男子在 ICE 拘留中心被关押数月后返回加拿大

paras.en: Lizardo filed to have the order of removal rescinded as he had never received the notices for the hearings. That request was granted by an immigration court on Oct. 28 after it found he had provided sufficient evidence of lack of notice.
paras.zh: 利扎多申请撤销驱逐令，因为他从未收到听证会通知。 10 月 28 日，移民法庭发现他提供了充分的证据证明他没有通知，并批准了这一请求。

paras.en: ICE argued Lizardo should be kept in custody while the green card case was being decided.
paras.zh: ICE 认为，在绿卡案件裁决期间，应该拘留利扎多。

paras.en: The judge ruled ICE agents had no reason to believe Lizardo was a flight risk and ordered him immediately released.
paras.zh: 法官裁定 ICE 特工没有理由相信 Lizardo 有潜逃风险，并下令立即释放他。

paras.en: "Because the facts presented here are so appalling and so well supported, the Court could issue a long order, complete with colorful details about, and commentary on, the abuses suffered by Petitioner," the judge wrote.
paras.zh: 法官写道：“由于这里提出的事实如此令人震惊且得到充分支持，法院可以发布一项长命令，其中包含有关请愿人遭受的虐待的丰富多彩的细节和评论。”

paras.en: Instead, he said he simply wanted to make sure Lizardo didn't spend another night in jail.
paras.zh: 相反，他说他只是想确保利扎多不会再在监狱里度过一个晚上。

paras.en: Lizardo's lawyer, Hassan Ahmad, confirmed to CBC News that his client was finally released Sunday evening, hours after the judge's order.
paras.zh: 利扎多的律师哈桑·艾哈迈德 (Hassan Ahmad) 向加拿大广播公司新闻证实，他的当事人终于在周日晚上、即法官下达命令数小时后获释。

paras.en: Lizardo is now waiting for a USCIS decision on his green card application, and Ahmad says he hopes that given what his client has been through, that decision will come soon.
paras.zh: 利扎多现在正在等待美国移民局对其绿卡申请的决定，艾哈迈德说，他希望考虑到他的客户所经历的一切，这一决定很快就会到来。

paras.en: "This was a paperwork error," Ahmad said. "That's all it was. And they literally made a federal case out of it."
paras.zh: “这是一个文书工作错误，”艾哈迈德说。 “就是这样。他们确实以此为联邦案件。”

paras.en: Ahmad says Lizardo cannot be detained again by ICE while he is waiting for the decision on his green card. "I made sure to put that in the order when I filed and, and the judge signed on," he said.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德表示，利扎多在等待绿卡决定期间不能再次被 ICE 拘留。 “我在提交申请时确保将其纳入命令中，并且法官也签字了，”他说。

paras.en: "This whole removal proceedings was tainted from the very beginning," Ahmad said, adding that he hopes ICE will just let it go.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德说：“整个驱逐程序从一开始就受到了污染。”他补充说，他希望 ICE 能够放过这件事。

articles.title: Experts suggest Canada lock in gains with EU amid 'associate member' confusion
articles.author: Dylan Robertson

paras.en: Experts suggest Canada lock in gains with EU amid 'associate member' confusion
paras.zh: 专家建议加拿大在“准成员”混乱中锁定欧盟收益

paras.en: Academics testified at committee on heels of Canada-EU summit
paras.zh: 学者们在加拿大-欧盟峰会后的委员会上作证

paras.en: Experts in European Union policy say Canada should try solidifying gains with the EU in legal frameworks, particularly as talk of becoming an EU "associate member" continues to cause confusion.
paras.zh: 欧盟政策专家表示，加拿大应该尝试在法律框架上巩固与欧盟的成果，特别是在有关成为欧盟“准成员”的言论继续引起混乱的情况下。

paras.en: Academics studying EU relations testified on Monday to the House foreign affairs committee, after a summit in Montreal last week brought together top Canadian and EU officials.
paras.zh: 加拿大和欧盟高级官员上周在蒙特利尔举行峰会后，研究欧盟关系的学者周一向众议院外交事务委员会作证。

paras.en: The officials praised the plan as a historic partnership. The experts were less enthusiastic.
paras.zh: 官员们称赞该计划是一次历史性的伙伴关系。专家们的热情不高。

paras.en: "A lot of these agreements are essentially expressions of intent," University of Toronto professor Mark Manger testified. "I'm still waiting for a concrete announcement."
paras.zh: “许多这些协议本质上都是意图的表达，”多伦多大学教授马克·曼格作证说。 “我仍在等待具体的公告。”

paras.en: Manger argued Mexico already has many of the arrangements with the EU that Canada is now gaining or seeking.
paras.zh: 马格认为，墨西哥已经与欧盟达成了加拿大现在正在获得或寻求的许多安排。

paras.en: - Canada seeking to become the EU's 1st associate member, Carney says
paras.zh: - 卡尼表示，加拿大寻求成为欧盟第一个准成员

paras.en: - Carney welcomes top EU officials to Montreal summit
paras.zh: - 卡尼欢迎欧盟高级官员参加蒙特利尔峰会

paras.en: The testimony comes after weeks of confusion over nomenclature, with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen pitching Canada become an associate member.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 力劝加拿大成为准成员，数周以来，命名法出现了混乱。

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney had largely avoided that phrasing since von der Leyen introduced the concept in September, instead speaking of an "alliance for the future." But on Thursday Carney said the goal was associate EU membership — a term that has no official definition.
paras.zh: 自冯德莱恩九月提出这一概念以来，英国首相马克·卡尼基本上避免使用这种措辞，而是谈到“未来联盟”。但卡尼周四表示，目标是成为欧盟准成员国——这一术语没有官方定义。

paras.en: Achim Hurrelmann, co-director of the Centre for European Studies at Carleton University, said the phrasing was "a bit of a distraction from the policy work leading up to the summit — mainly because the EU, frankly, hadn't really done its homework in defining what this status would mean, and how it could be integrated into EU law."
paras.zh: 卡尔顿大学欧洲研究中心联席主任阿奇姆·胡雷尔曼表示，这种措辞“有点分散了峰会前政策工作的注意力——坦率地说，主要是因为欧盟在定义这一地位意味着什么以及如何将其纳入欧盟法律方面并没有真正做足功课。”

paras.en: Still, Hurrelmann said Carney and von der Leyen are "keen to maintain" the buzz around such phrasing.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，胡雷尔曼表示，卡尼和冯德莱恩“热衷于维持”围绕此类措辞的讨论。

paras.en: "I don't think they are really fully attached to the concept of associate membership, but stick to it now because it brings this symbolic attention. Everyone's talking about this," he testified.
paras.zh: “我认为他们并不真正完全认同准会员的概念，但现在就坚持下去，因为它带来了象征性的关注。每个人都在谈论这一点，”他作证说。

paras.en: Hurrelmann said both sides will need to settle on an arrangement that is somewhere between a mere political declaration and some formal status — which would require complicated amendments to EU treaties and votes in the Canadian Parliament.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼表示，双方需要达成一项介于纯粹政治宣言和某种正式地位之间的安排，这将需要对欧盟条约进行复杂的修改并在加拿大议会进行投票。

paras.en: "The proposals that we have heard do not require associate membership at all to be realized," he said.
paras.zh: “我们听到的建议根本不需要准成员身份就能实现，”他说。

paras.en: Hurrelmann suggested thinking of associate membership as the "symbolic affirmation" of moving from a common-law relationship to marriage.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼建议将准会员身份视为从同居关系转向婚姻的“象征性肯定”。

paras.en: Anand Sundar, a transatlantic defence adviser at the European Council on Foreign Relations, testified that "associate membership" seems to be something Brussels is pushing despite strong objection from countries such as Germany.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会跨大西洋防务顾问阿南德·桑达尔作证说，尽管德国等国强烈反对，但布鲁塞尔似乎正在推动“准成员资格”。

paras.en: "It's a very political sort of game that we're seeing," he said. "This might be something in interest of the [European] Commission, but not of certain member states."
paras.zh: “我们看到的是一种非常政治化的游戏，”他说。 “这可能符合[欧洲]委员会的利益，但不符合某些成员国的利益。”

paras.en: Hurrelmann said officials might need to move fast, as MPs raised concerns about rising far-right movements across Europe that are skeptical of partnering with other countries.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼表示，官员们可能需要迅速采取行动，因为议员们对欧洲各地极右运动的兴起表示担忧，这些运动对与其他国家的合作持怀疑态度。

paras.en: "It's going to be important to ask how quickly can this agreement be put fully in legal force on the European side," Hurrelmann said.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼说：“重要的是要问该协议多久才能在欧洲方面完全生效。”

paras.en: He also suggested Ottawa consider restructuring Canada's EU trade deal to increase economic gains, particularly by changing its status from the current "mixed agreement" that requires individual ratification by each member state.
paras.zh: 他还建议渥太华考虑重组加拿大的欧盟贸易协议以增加经济收益，特别是改变其目前需要每个成员国单独批准的“混合协议”的地位。

paras.en: Of the bloc's 27 members, nine still haven't put the decade-old Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) into full force.
paras.zh: 在欧盟 27 个成员国中，有 9 个尚未全面实施已有十年之久的加拿大-欧盟全面经济贸易协定 (CETA)。

paras.en: Canadians chafe at food regulations that bar many Canadian imports. Europeans complain about Canada's dairy quota and protected-origin phrasing, Hurrelmann noted, such as whether cheeses called feta can originate from anywhere outside a specific region of Greece.
paras.zh: 加拿大人对禁止许多加拿大进口的食品法规感到愤怒。胡雷尔曼指出，欧洲人抱怨加拿大的乳制品配额和原产地保护措辞，例如称为羊乳酪的奶酪是否可以来自希腊特定地区以外的任何地方。

paras.en: Hurrelmann noted the deal was praised at the time it was signed for innovative clauses on aligning regulations, assessing conformity with rules and recognizing professional qualifications — and that all these have had limited success, resulting in less trade than what was envisioned.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼指出，该协议在签署时因在协调监管、评估规则合规性和认可专业资格方面的创新条款而受到称赞，但所有这些都取得了有限的成功，导致贸易量低于预期。

paras.en: "The joint statement from the summit has some very vague language on that. But I would really encourage both sides to look at the CETA governance structure," he said.
paras.zh: “峰会联合声明对此有一些非常模糊的措辞。但我真的鼓励双方审视 CETA 的治理结构，”他说。

paras.en: Manger suggested Canada and the EU enhance the existing trade deal with "economic and legal parameters" that make it more appealing to boost exports and investments.
paras.zh: 马格建议加拿大和欧盟通过“经济和法律参数”加强现有贸易协议，使其更具吸引力以促进出口和投资。

paras.en: "In international agreements, it's desirable to have something that is locking in a certain trade relationship, that makes it clear for Canadian firms … that this is a long-term relationship," he said.
paras.zh: “在国际协议中，希望有某种东西能够锁定某种贸易关系，让加拿大公司清楚地知道……这是一种长期关系，”他说。

paras.en: He suggested Ottawa could allow European mobile networks to set up shop in Canada in exchange for European countries dropping restrictions on importing Canadian food.
paras.zh: 他建议渥太华可以允许欧洲移动网络在加拿大开设商店，以换取欧洲国家取消对进口加拿大食品的限制。

paras.en: Hurrelmann suggested Ottawa focus on projects in areas where the EU has clear jurisdiction such as in research and academic exchanges, while working directly with countries on key issues where they have power, such as defence and energy.
paras.zh: 胡雷尔曼建议渥太华重点关注欧盟有明确管辖权的领域的项目，例如研究和学术交流，同时在国防和能源等拥有权力的关键问题上与国家直接合作。

paras.en: He also said closer ties to Europe will only work if there is cross-party collaboration.
paras.zh: 他还表示，只有跨党派合作，与欧洲建立更紧密的联系才会发挥作用。

paras.en: That comes as Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre argues the government has not been clear on its deals with Europe, that the Montreal summit was a waste of time meant to distract from domestic issues and that Canada risks losing sovereignty to Europe and control of its borders.
paras.zh: 与此同时，保守党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫 (Pierre Poilievre) 辩称，政府在与欧洲的协议上并不清楚，蒙特利尔峰会是浪费时间，旨在分散人们对国内问题的注意力，而且加拿大有可能失去对欧洲的主权和对其边境的控制。

articles.title: Finland says its national teams won't play against Russia in hockey tournaments
articles.author: Stephen Whyno, James Ellingworth

paras.en: Finland says its national teams won't play against Russia in hockey tournaments
paras.zh: 芬兰表示其国家队不会在曲棍球锦标赛中对阵俄罗斯

paras.en: Finnish association spokesperson says they believe other countries are interested in boycott
paras.zh: 芬兰协会发言人表示，他们相信其他国家有兴趣抵制

paras.en: The Finnish Ice Hockey Association said Monday its national teams won't play against Russia in international tournaments as long as the war in Ukraine is ongoing.
paras.zh: 芬兰冰球协会周一表示，只要乌克兰战争仍在继续，芬兰冰球协会就不会在国际比赛中与俄罗斯队比赛。

paras.en: That stance by Finland, and reportedly also Latvia, comes after the Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled last week that the International Ice Hockey Federation must reinstate Russian teams beginning with the world juniors that begins in late December in western Canada.
paras.zh: 芬兰以及据报道拉脱维亚也采取了这一立场，此前体育仲裁法院上周裁定国际冰球联合会必须恢复俄罗斯队的参赛资格，从12月底在加拿大西部开始的世界青少年赛开始。

paras.en: Finnish Ice Hockey Association spokesperson Henna Malmberg said the organization does not believe it is alone among countries interested in boycotting games against Russia. Media reports in Latvia said that nation's teams would not play Russia, citing legal reasons.
paras.zh: 芬兰冰球协会发言人汉娜·马尔姆伯格表示，该组织并不认为它是唯一有兴趣抵制俄罗斯比赛的国家。拉脱维亚媒体报道称，该国球队不会以法律理由与俄罗斯队比赛。

paras.en: A message sent to the IIHF seeking comment and clarification on what Finland boycotting games against Russia would mean was not immediately returned. The rulebook says in the event of a forfeit “supplementary discipline will be applied by the proper authorities at their discretion."
paras.zh: 一封发送给国际冰联的信息寻求评论并澄清芬兰抵制俄罗斯比赛的意义，但该信息并未立即得到回复。规则手册称，如果出现弃权，“有关当局将酌情采取补充纪律。”

paras.en: Germany’s national hockey federation is weighing whether it can continue as host of the men’s world championship next year.
paras.zh: 德国国家曲棍球联合会正在考虑是否可以继续主办明年的男子世界锦标赛。

paras.en: Swedish furniture company AJ Products has been a men's world championship sponsor since 1989, with its logo on the referees' uniforms and boards. Chief executive Enock Johansson told broadcaster TV4 on Monday that the company plans to request its logo not be displayed at the championship because of Russia's reinstatement.
paras.zh: 瑞典家具公司 AJ Products 自 1989 年以来一直是男子世界锦标赛的赞助商，其标志出现在裁判服和裁判板上。首席执行官埃诺克·约翰逊 (Enock Johansson) 周一告诉 TV4 广播公司，由于俄罗斯恢复参赛，该公司计划要求锦标赛上不要显示其徽标。

paras.en: “It’s a decision we very much regret having to make, but we all agree it’s the right one," Johansson told TV4.
paras.zh: 约翰逊对 TV4 表示：“我们非常后悔不得不做出这个决定，但我们都认为这是正确的决定。”

paras.en: - Russia is back in the hockey world championships after sports court ruling
paras.zh: - 体育法庭裁决后，俄罗斯重返冰球世锦赛

paras.en: - Decision clearing path for Russia to join world juniors in Alberta is 'very unwelcome,' minister says
paras.zh: - 部长表示，为俄罗斯加入阿尔伯塔省世界青少年赛扫清道路的决定“非常不受欢迎”

paras.en: The German hockey federation has said it can't guarantee going ahead with hosting the world championship next year because of extra costs related to Russian participation. It has also raised concerns over security.
paras.zh: 德国曲棍球联合会表示，由于俄罗斯参赛会产生额外费用，因此无法保证明年继续举办世界锦标赛。它还引发了人们对安全的担忧。

paras.en: German federation chief executive Frank H. Lutz is heading to Berlin this week for talks with political figures on the issue.
paras.zh: 德国足协首席执行官弗兰克·H·卢茨本周将前往柏林与政治人物就这一问题进行会谈。

paras.en: The Czech Republic hosts the women’s under-18 world championship in January. A spokesperson for the president of the Czech Republic, Petr Pavel, said last week he favours banning “the participation of athletes under the Russian and Belarusian flags."
paras.zh: 捷克共和国将于 1 月主办 18 岁以下女子世界锦标赛。捷克共和国总统彼得·帕维尔的发言人上周表示，他赞成禁止“悬挂俄罗斯和白俄罗斯国旗的运动员参赛”。

articles.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria

paras.en: "We are choosing between war and peace," Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev told voters ahead of Sunday's presidential election runoff between incumbent President Iliana Yotova, who opposes military aid to Ukraine and favors dialogue with Russia, and former caretaker Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov, who is regarded as staunchly pro-European and pro-Ukrainian.
paras.zh: “我们正在战争与和平之间做出选择，”周日总统选举决选前，保加利亚总理鲁门·拉德夫对选民说，现任总统伊利亚娜·约托娃反对向乌克兰提供军事援助，支持与俄罗斯对话，而前看守总理安德烈·久罗夫则被视为坚定的亲欧洲和亲乌克兰人。

paras.en: With these words, it was clear that Sunday's runoff had turned into a kind of referendum on the country's foreign policy and stance on the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这些话显然表明，周日的决选已转变为对该国外交政策和乌克兰战争立场的全民公投。

paras.en: Now that the official results are in and it is clear that Iliana Yotova won the election decisively by 57.6% to Gyurov's 39.5%, Radev claims that Bulgarians have chosen peace.
paras.zh: 现在官方结果已经公布，伊利亚娜·约托娃 (Iliana Yotova) 以 57.6% 的得票率对久罗夫 (Gyurov) 的 39.5% 的得票率决定性地赢得了选举，拉德夫声称保加利亚人选择了和平。

paras.en: When the presidential election campaign began in Bulgaria on September 25, there did not seem to be any doubt about the outcome: Iliana Yotova was well ahead in the polls on 44.5%. Gyurov, her main rival, trailed far behind on 26.1%.
paras.zh: 当9月25日保加利亚总统竞选活动开始时，结果似乎没有任何疑问：伊利亚娜·约托娃(Iliana Yotova)在民意调查中以44.5%的支持率遥遥领先。她的主要竞争对手久罗夫以 26.1% 的支持率远远落后。

paras.en: Yotova was backed by both the prime minister and his ruling Progressive Bulgaria party, which won an absolute majority in the parliamentary election on April 19.
paras.zh: 约托娃得到了总理及其执政的保加利亚进步党的支持，该党在 4 月 19 日的议会选举中赢得了绝对多数。

paras.en: But the first round turned out to be much tighter than anticipated.
paras.zh: 但第一轮的比赛比预想的要紧张得多。

paras.en: While Yotova got 34.8% of the vote in the first round, Gyurov was close behind on 31.95%, which meant that a runoff between the two was necessary.
paras.zh: 虽然约托娃在第一轮中获得了 34.8% 的选票，但久罗夫以 31.95% 的得票率紧随其后，这意味着两人之间有必要进行决选。

paras.en: While Yotova won the runoff convincingly, both the campaign and the outcome showed that the Bulgarian electorate is divided.
paras.zh: 虽然约托娃令人信服地赢得了决选，但竞选活动和结果都表明保加利亚选民存在分歧。

paras.en: This division is both generational and geographical, explains Dimitar Ganev, sociologist and political scientist at the Trend market and electoral research agency.
paras.zh: 趋势市场和选举研究机构的社会学家和政治学家迪米塔尔·加内夫（Dimitar Ganev）解释说，这种划分既是代际的，也是地理的。

paras.en: "Younger voters — those aged between 18 and 40 — favor Gyurov. Those over 40 tend to prefer Yotova," Ganev told DW. "It also appears that Gyurov dominates in the capital, Sofia. In smaller regional cities, other towns and villages, Yotova dominates decisively," he said.
paras.zh: 加内夫告诉德国之声：“年轻选民——18岁至40岁之间的选民——支持久罗夫。40岁以上的选民则倾向于支持尤托娃。” “看起来久洛夫在首都索非亚占据主导地位。在较小的地区城市、其他城镇和村庄，约托娃占据决定性主导地位，”他说。

paras.en: This divide was also evident during the campaign.
paras.zh: 这种分歧在竞选期间也很明显。

paras.en: While Andrey Gyurov relied mainly on social media for his campaign, Yotova chose to speak mostly to supporters of Progressive Bulgaria in closed venues.
paras.zh: 安德烈·久罗夫主要依靠社交媒体进行竞选活动，而约托娃则选择主要在封闭的场所向保加利亚进步党的支持者发表讲话。

paras.en: At such events, the war in Ukraine was always high on the agenda.
paras.zh: 在此类事件中，乌克兰战争始终是重要议题。

paras.en: "As long as I am president, and if you place your trust in me, not a single Bulgarian soldier will go to Ukraine," Yotova declared at an election rally on October 6 — even though according to the Bulgarian Constitution, only parliament (not the president) has the authority to send troops abroad or declare war.
paras.zh: 约托娃在 10 月 6 日的选举集会上宣称：“只要我还是总统，如果你们信任我，就没有一个保加利亚士兵会前往乌克兰。”尽管根据保加利亚宪法，只有议会（而非总统）有权向国外派遣军队或宣战。

paras.en: Throughout the campaign, she referred to her opponents as "warmongers" and described herself as the "president of peace."
paras.zh: 在整个竞选过程中，她将对手称为“战争贩子”，并将自己描述为“和平总统”。

paras.en: "We won because we talked to people about income and about peace," Yotova said after the election.
paras.zh: “我们获胜是因为我们与人们谈论收入和和平，”约托娃在选举后说道。

paras.en: Russia's war in Ukraine a major campaign issue
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争是一个重大竞选问题

paras.en: In this, she is similar to Prime Minister Rumen Radev.
paras.zh: 在这一点上，她与总理鲁门·拉德夫很相似。

paras.en: When it comes to Ukraine, Radev regularly speaks of the need for peace and avoids calling Russia an "aggressor." Both Radev and Yotova oppose military aid to Ukraine and criticize European leaders for not making sufficient efforts to engage with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 当谈到乌克兰时，拉德夫经常谈到和平的必要性，并避免称俄罗斯为“侵略者”。拉德夫和约托娃都反对向乌克兰提供军事援助，并批评欧洲领导人没有做出足够的努力与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京接触。

paras.en: Gyurov, on the other hand, has sharply criticized Russian aggression in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 另一方面，久罗夫严厉批评俄罗斯对乌克兰的侵略。

paras.en: Appointed caretaker prime minister by Yotova in February, Gyurov in March signed a security cooperation agreement with Ukraine, provoking the disapproval of both Yotova and Radev.
paras.zh: 久罗夫于2月被约托娃任命为看守总理，3月与乌克兰签署安全合作协议，引起约托娃和拉德夫的反对。

paras.en: The impact of drone attacks in the Black Sea
paras.zh: 黑海无人机袭击的影响

paras.en: In the weeks leading up to the election, several ships in the Black Sea were hit by drones off the Bulgarian coast.
paras.zh: 在选举前几周，黑海的几艘船只在保加利亚海岸遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: The European Council criticized Russia for the escalation, and the European Parliament called on the EU and its member states "to consider deploying an EU naval operation" there.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会批评俄罗斯的升级行动，欧洲议会呼吁欧盟及其成员国“考虑在那里部署欧盟海军行动”。

paras.en: Prime Minister Radev, however, was not as equivocal, going no further than summoning the Russian ambassador and stating that "logic suggests that the outcome" of the attacks in the Black Sea "is to the advantage of the Russian Federation."
paras.zh: 然而，拉德夫总理并没有那么模棱两可，他只是召见了俄罗斯大使，并表示“逻辑表明，黑海袭击的结果”“对俄罗斯联邦有利”。

paras.en: Just days before the runoff, he noted that "two ships were struck and sunk in Romanian territorial waters" after Romania had held Russia responsible for the attacks in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 就在决选前几天，他指出，在罗马尼亚指责俄罗斯对黑海袭击负责后，“两艘船在罗马尼亚领海被击沉”。

paras.en: "Many people think that once the aggressor is identified, the attacks will stop," he said, downplaying the Kremlin's responsibility. His remarks drew criticism from politicians and the media in Romania.
paras.zh: “许多人认为，一旦确定了侵略者，袭击就会停止，”他说，但淡化了克里姆林宫的责任。他的言论遭到罗马尼亚政界人士和媒体的批评。

paras.en: Yotova also did not name Russia as the perpetrator, instead saying during her campaign that she did not want to see "foreign flags in Bulgaria" — a clear reference to the Ukrainian flag, which has been displayed outside several institutions in Bulgaria as a sign of solidarity with the war-torn country.
paras.zh: 约托娃也没有将俄罗斯列为肇事者，而是在竞选期间表示，她不想在保加利亚看到“外国国旗”——这明显指的是乌克兰国旗，乌克兰国旗已悬挂在保加利亚的几个机构外，作为与这个饱受战争蹂躏的国家团结一致的标志。

paras.en: Most opposition parties, including the right-wing conservative GERB led by former long-serving Prime Minister Boyko Borisov, refused to field a candidate for the presidency, which is one reason why turnout on Sunday was less than 30%.
paras.zh: 大多数反对党，包括长期任职的前总理博伊科·鲍里索夫领导的右翼保守派德国国民党，都拒绝派出总统候选人，这也是周日投票率低于 30% 的原因之一。

paras.en: In the first round, the pro-Russian candidate Kostadin Kostadinov from the nationalist Vazrazhdane (Revival) party came third with 12.5% of the vote. According to Dimitar Ganev, around 70% of Vazrazhdane voters backed Yotova in the runoff.
paras.zh: 在第一轮投票中，民族主义复兴党的亲俄候选人科斯塔丁·科斯塔迪诺夫以12.5%的得票率排名第三。据 Dimitar Ganev 称，大约 70% 的 Vazrazhdane 选民在决选中支持 Yotova。

paras.en: To secure their support, Yotova targeted pro-Russian voters.
paras.zh: 为了获得他们的支持，约托娃瞄准了亲俄罗斯选民。

paras.en: "Russia is by no means an enemy of Bulgaria," she said in a podcast interview just two days before the runoff, adding "Russia is part of our history, and I very much hope that it will be a key factor in the future security architecture across Europe, including for us."
paras.zh: “俄罗斯绝不是保加利亚的敌人，”她在决选前两天接受播客采访时表示，并补充道，“俄罗斯是我们历史的一部分，我非常希望它将成为整个欧洲未来安全架构的关键因素，包括我们。”

paras.en: In the days leading up to the vote, some of her supporters began claiming that the opposition was preparing a "Maidan," a reference to the Ukrainian revolution of 2014 that culminated in the ousting of President Viktor Yanukkovych, who had close ties to Moscow.
paras.zh: 在投票前几天，她的一些支持者开始声称反对派正在准备一场“独立广场”，指的是2014年乌克兰革命，这场革命最终导致与莫斯科关系密切的总统维克托·亚努科维奇下台。

paras.en: "All of Gyurov's lackeys are speaking openly about inevitable protests. They're using prime time to stir up a Maidan. Every single one of them," Sonya Momchilova, who was appointed to the media regulator by Radev, wrote on Facebook on Sunday.
paras.zh: “久罗夫的所有走狗都在公开谈论不可避免的抗议活动。他们利用黄金时间煽动独立广场。他们每一个人，”被拉德夫任命为媒体监管者的索尼娅·莫奇洛娃周日在 Facebook 上写道。

paras.en: Similar claims were made by both former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban and former Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic ahead of this year's elections in their countries.
paras.zh: 匈牙利前总理欧尔班·维克多和塞尔维亚前总统亚历山大·武契奇在各自国家今年的选举前都发表了类似的言论。

paras.en: "This claim that Ms. Yotova will be a president of peace is directly linked to the incitement of a fear of war," said former Defense Minister Todor Tagarev, who was part of the committee that nominated Andrey Gyurov for president. "Bulgaria will be in a much worse position within Europe and NATO under her leadership," he said during a TV interview.
paras.zh: “约托娃女士将成为和平总统的说法与煽动对战争的恐惧直接相关，”提名安德烈·久罗夫为总统的委员会成员、前国防部长托多尔·塔加列夫说。他在接受电视采访时表示：“在她的领导下，保加利亚在欧洲和北约内的处境将更加糟糕。”

paras.en: Dimitar Ganev, on the other hand, sees no threat to Bulgaria's commitment to the EU and NATO. "Over two-thirds of Bulgarians do not question the country's geopolitical orientation, and around two-thirds have a positive attitude towards the EU," he told DW.
paras.zh: 另一方面，迪米塔·加内夫认为保加利亚对欧盟和北约的承诺不会受到威胁。他告诉德国之声：“超过三分之二的保加利亚人不质疑国家的地缘政治取向，大约三分之二的人对欧盟持积极态度。”

paras.en: But the positions of Radev and Yotova, which many view as ambivalent, mobilized both the pro-European camp and Eurosceptic voters, who, according to Ganev, make up around a third of the country's population.
paras.zh: 但拉德夫和约托娃的立场（许多人认为是矛盾的）动员了亲欧阵营和疑欧派选民，据加内夫称，这些选民约占该国人口的三分之一。

paras.en: According to Prime Minister Rumen Radev and President Iliana Yotova, the Bulgarian people chose peace in the presidential election. Nevertheless, the war continues.
paras.zh: 总理鲁门·拉德夫和总统伊利亚娜·约托娃表示，保加利亚人民在总统选举中选择了和平。尽管如此，战争仍在继续。

articles.title: Global pedestrian Karl Bushby returns home to UK after 28-year trek

paras.en: British adventurer Karl Bushby, 57, arrived back his hometown in England on Monday after crossing four continents on foot.
paras.zh: 57 岁的英国冒险家卡尔·布什比 (Karl Bushby) 在徒步穿越四大洲后于周一回到了家乡英国。

paras.en: He was met by a cheering crowd of about 500 people in the northeastern city of Hull at the end of his 50,000-kilometer (31,000-mile) journey, which began in the far south of South America in 1998.
paras.zh: 1998 年，他从南美洲最南端开始，开始了 50,000 公里（31,000 英里）的旅程，在东北部城市赫尔，约 500 人欢呼雀跃迎接他。

paras.en: "I didn't do this alone. There was a big team, the biggest team, Earth. That's what it took to get me back," Bushby told the crowd.
paras.zh: “我不是一个人做到的。有一个大团队，最大的团队，地球。这就是让我回来的原因，”布什比告诉人群。

paras.en: On his trip, he obeyed two rules: to avoid all forms of motorized transport to advance; and not to return until he had finished what he had set out to do.
paras.zh: 旅途中，他遵守两条规则：避免使用一切形式的机动交通工具前进；并且在完成他打算做的事情之前不要回来。

paras.en: A very final leg of his journey was to take him to north Hull, where he was to reunite with his mother, Angela, his 36-year-old son, Adam, and a 12-year-old granddaughter he had never met.
paras.zh: 他旅程的最后一站是前往赫尔北部，在那里与他的母亲安吉拉、他 36 岁的儿子亚当以及他从未见过的 12 岁孙女团聚。

paras.en: What did Bushby experience on his epic journey?
paras.zh: 布什比在他的史诗旅程中经历了什么？

paras.en: Bushby, a former paratrooper, began his adventure in Chile aged 29 after a marriage breakup that saw his wife return to Northern Ireland with their son.
paras.zh: 布什比曾是一名伞兵，在婚姻破裂后，他的妻子带着儿子回到了北爱尔兰，29 岁时，他开始了在智利的冒险之旅。

paras.en: During the trip, he crossed an iced-over Bering Strait from Alaska to Russia with French explorer Dimitri Kieffer in 2006 — nearly losing his life in the process — and, returning to Britain early last month, he swam the English Channel from northern France to Dover over four days.
paras.zh: 2006 年，他与法国探险家迪米特里·基弗 (Dimitri Kieffer) 一起穿越冰封的白令海峡，从阿拉斯加到达俄罗斯，差点丧命。上月初返回英国后，他用四天时间从法国北部游过英吉利海峡到达多佛。

paras.en: He interrupted, or was forced to pause, his journey several times, including when he was refused a visa by Russia, which caused a journey originally planned to take 12 years to last more than double that time.
paras.zh: 他多次中断或被迫暂停他的旅程，包括被俄罗斯拒绝签证，这导致原计划需要 12 年的旅程延长了一倍多。

paras.en: He also spent some jail time in Panama for entering the country without a visa.
paras.zh: 他还因无签证进入巴拿马而入狱。

paras.en: The COVID-19 pandemic also caused delays, and he spent some time living at a base in Mexico.
paras.zh: COVID-19 大流行也造成了延误，他在墨西哥的一个基地住了一段时间。

paras.en: But he always resumed the trek at the exact spot where he had left off.
paras.zh: 但他总是在他中断的地方重新开始跋涉。

paras.en: The famous German filmmaker Werner Herzog is making a feature-length documentary about the journey entitled "Walk of Life."
paras.zh: 德国著名电影制片人沃纳·赫尔佐格正在制作一部关于这段旅程的长篇纪录片，名为《生命之路》。

paras.en: In an interview with the AFP news agency from northern France in September, Bushby expressed apprehension about returning to a more normal life back in Britain.
paras.zh: 9月，布什比在法国北部接受法新社采访时，表达了对回到英国恢复正常生活的担忧。

paras.en: "I've got to try and get established in the grown-up world again," he said.
paras.zh: “我必须尝试再次在成年人的世界中站稳脚跟，”他说。

articles.title: US to drop South Africa, Rwanda from duty-free trade initiative

paras.en: South Africa and Rwanda are set to be removed from a US trade initiative that has provided duty-free access to the US market for thousands of products from sub-Saharan African countries for 26 years.
paras.zh: 南非和卢旺达将被从美国一项贸易计划中除名，该计划26年来一直为来自撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数千种产品提供免税进入美国市场的机会。

paras.en: On Monday, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said US President Donald Trump intends to "terminate" the two countries from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade preference program starting in January 2027.
paras.zh: 周一，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普打算从 2027 年 1 月开始“终止”这两个国家的《非洲增长与机会法案》(AGOA) 贸易优惠计划。

paras.en: The program, which comes under regular review, was extended in February by Trump.
paras.zh: 该计划受到定期审查，并于二月份被特朗普延长。

paras.en: In a statement, Greer said that "the governments of Rwanda and South Africa are engaging in practices that are inconsistent with AGOA's eligibility criteria."
paras.zh: 格里尔在一份声明中表示，“卢旺达和南非政府的做法不符合 AGOA 的资格标准。”

paras.en: Greer said these practices include "barriers that undermine American trade and investment and practices that pose a threat to US national security and foreign policy interests in the region."
paras.zh: 格里尔表示，这些做法包括“破坏美国贸易和投资的壁垒，以及对美国国家安全和该地区外交政策利益构成威胁的做法”。

paras.en: The statement did not provide any specific examples of the trade barriers or security and foreign policy issues in question.
paras.zh: 该声明没有提供有关贸易壁垒或安全和外交政策问题的任何具体例子。

paras.en: AGOA was introduced in 2000 by former US President Bill Clinton, and it has become a centerpiece of US economic engagement with sub-Saharan Africa.
paras.zh: AGOA 由美国前总统比尔·克林顿于 2000 年提出，现已成为美国与撒哈拉以南非洲经济接触的核心内容。

paras.en: Duty free access to the US market is seen as a critical economic boost for the more than 30 AGOA countries. Over 1,800 specific products are covered under AGOA.
paras.zh: 免税进入美国市场被视为对 30 多个 AGOA 国家经济的重要推动力。 AGOA 涵盖 1,800 多种特定产品。

paras.en: Requirements for membership include eliminating barriers to US trade and investment, while maintaining an open market economy along with democratic principles like the rule of law, human rights and labor protections.
paras.zh: 入会要求包括消除美国贸易和投资壁垒，同时维持开放的市场经济以及法治、人权和劳工保护等民主原则。

paras.en: South Africa has been AGOA's largest beneficiary, with $1.7 billion (€1.5 billion) worth of goods like car parts, citrus fruit and wine, exported to the US under the program in 2025.
paras.zh: 南非是 AGOA 的最大受益者，根据该计划，到 2025 年，南非将向美国出口价值 17 亿美元（15 亿欧元）的汽车零部件、柑橘类水果和葡萄酒等商品。

paras.en: South Africa's Trade Ministry said last week that it was prepared for the decision, adding that AGOA exports comprise only about 10% of its total exports to the US and 1% of its total global exports.
paras.zh: 南非贸易部上周表示，已为这一决定做好准备，并补充说，AGOA 出口仅占其对美国出口总额的 10% 左右，占其全球出口总额的 1%。

paras.en: "AGOA remains important to South Africa, but it does not constitute the totality of the economic relationship between South Africa and the United States," it said in a statement.
paras.zh: “《非洲增长和机会法案》对南非仍然很重要，但它并不构成南非与美国之间经济关系的全部，”它在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: In recent weeks, President Cyril Ramaphosa has also said South Africa must prepare for being excluded from AGOA by seeking new markets and trade deals with partners like China.
paras.zh: 最近几周，总统西里尔·拉马福萨还表示，南非必须为被排除在《非洲增长机会法案》之外做好准备，寻求新市场并与中国等合作伙伴达成贸易协议。

paras.en: On Monday, the South Africa government said the US remains an important trade partner and it would provide support for affected sectors.
paras.zh: 周一，南非政府表示，美国仍然是重要的贸易伙伴，并将为受影响的行业提供支持。

paras.en: South Africa's export-dependent citrus industry warned that its entire value chain "on both sides of the Atlantic, is now under threat," and warned that jobs and the economic security of entire communities is now at stake.
paras.zh: 南非依赖出口的柑橘产业警告称，“大西洋两岸”的整个价值链现在都受到威胁，并警告说，整个社区的就业和经济安全现在都受到威胁。

paras.en: The US has been putting economic pressure on Rwanda over its alleged support of the M23 rebel group in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
paras.zh: 由于卢旺达涉嫌支持刚果民主共和国的“M23”叛乱组织，美国一直对卢旺达施加经济压力。

paras.en: Washington sanctioned Rwanda's Defense Ministry last week, which denies any ties to M23, along with several individuals, institutions and a gold refinery.
paras.zh: 华盛顿上周制裁了卢旺达国防部，该部否认与“M23”运动以及数名个人、机构和一家黄金精炼厂有任何联系。

paras.en: Major Rwandan exports to the US include coffee and minerals.
paras.zh: 卢旺达对美国的主要出口包括咖啡和矿产。

articles.title: How a Harvard dream ended in tragedy for a Pakistani family

paras.en: Islamabad, Pakistan – The sign above the Rana Malik Center, a dairy shop in Islamabad’s G-10 neighbourhood, advertises milk, fresh yoghurt, lassi and desi ghee. Rana Muhammad Ijaz has lived with his family in the apartment above for more than three decades.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡——伊斯兰堡 G-10 街区的一家乳品店拉纳马利克中心 (Rana Malik Center) 上方的招牌上写着牛奶、新鲜酸奶、lassi 和 desi ghee 的广告。拉纳·穆罕默德·伊贾兹 (Rana Muhammad Ijaz) 与家人在上面的公寓里住了三十多年。

paras.en: Sitting outside his shop in late October, Ijaz recalled how his youngest daughter, Laiba, would make tea for him every morning and then again at night before bedtime.
paras.zh: 10 月底，伊贾兹坐在他的店外，回忆起他的小女儿莱巴 (Laiba) 每天早上都会为他泡茶，晚上睡觉前又会为他泡茶。

paras.en: “She used to massage my shoulders before I went to bed too.” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我睡觉前她也会按摩我的肩膀。”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Ijaz sat outside his shop, remembering her. “Now that she is gone, I miss it all.”
paras.zh: 伊贾兹坐在他的店外，想起了她。 “现在她走了，我很怀念这一切。”

paras.en: Laiba Ijaz, 24, a physics gold medallist from the publicly funded International Islamic University Islamabad (IIUI), was found dead near her home on October 9.
paras.zh: 24 岁的莱巴·伊贾兹 (Laiba Ijaz) 是公立伊斯兰堡国际伊斯兰大学 (IIUI) 的物理学金牌得主，10 月 9 日被发现死于家附近。

paras.en: According to the initial findings of a police case, she likely died by suicide after she and her family were defrauded of millions of rupees – tens of thousands of dollars – by a man who promised her admission to Harvard University in the United States.
paras.zh: 根据警方案件的初步调查结果，她和她的家人被一名承诺让她进入美国哈佛大学的男子诈骗了数百万卢比（数万美元）后，她很可能自杀身亡。

paras.en: Muhammad Noman, accused of the fraud, was arrested two days later. He died on October 20 after being shot while in police custody. Police said his accomplices had opened fire to free him.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德·诺曼被指控犯有欺诈罪，两天后被捕。他于 10 月 20 日在警方拘留期间中枪身亡。警方称，他的同伙开枪解救了他。

paras.en: On October 21, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi visited the family and handed over more than 5 million rupees ($18,000) that officials said had been recovered from Noman.
paras.zh: 10 月 21 日，内政部长穆赫辛·纳克维 (Mohsin Naqvi) 拜访了这家人，并移交了超过 500 万卢比（18,000 美元），官员称这些钱是从诺曼那里追回的。

paras.en: But that money means little to Ijaz and his family. What mattered most – his daughter – is gone.
paras.zh: 但这笔钱对伊贾兹和他的家人来说意义不大。最重要的东西——他的女儿——已经消失了。

paras.en: Ijaz studied until the eighth grade and his wife until grade 10, but all four of their daughters went to university.
paras.zh: 伊贾兹一直学习到八年级，他的妻子一直学习到十年级，但他们的四个女儿都上了大学。

paras.en: Two of the sisters studied mathematics while one of Laiba’s elder sisters spent a year in China on a scholarship, learning Mandarin. Laiba, too, studied on scholarships, her father said, and won the gold medal at her university.
paras.zh: 其中两个姐妹学习数学，而来芭的一个姐姐获得奖学金在中国学习了一年普通话。她父亲说，莱芭也靠奖学金学习，并在她的大学获得了金牌。

paras.en: “The day she got it, Laiba danced and jumped in front of her sisters,” Ijaz said.
paras.zh: “当她拿到它的那天，莱巴在她的姐妹们面前跳舞、跳跃，”伊贾兹说。

paras.en: Laiba later taught science at an Islamabad school and gave out-of-school tuition classes to children between grades 2 and 6. IIUI offered her a scholarship to study in Saudi Arabia, but she wanted to pursue higher studies in the US, her father said.
paras.zh: 莱巴后来在伊斯兰堡的一所学校教科学，并为 2 至 6 年级的孩子提供校外补习班。IIUI 为她提供了去沙特阿拉伯学习的奖学金，但她的父亲说，她想在美国继续深造。

paras.en: She asked him to pay for her studies abroad.
paras.zh: 她要求他支付她出国留学的费用。

paras.en: “’I did all the work myself, and I teach tuitions too, so can’t you do this for me?'” she asked her father, he recalled.
paras.zh: “‘所有的工作都是我自己做的，而且我也教补习班，所以你不能帮我做这个吗？’”她问父亲，他回忆道。

paras.en: He told her: “My dear daughter, I will.”
paras.zh: 他告诉她：“我亲爱的女儿，我会的。”

paras.en: “From there, we started preparing,” Ijaz said.
paras.zh: “从那时起，我们就开始准备，”伊贾兹说。

paras.en: Then they met Noman, and the dream grew. Unknown to the family at the time, it was built on hollow promises and outright lies.
paras.zh: 然后他们遇到了诺曼，梦想开始成长。当时家人并不知道，这是建立在空洞的承诺和彻头彻尾的谎言之上的。

paras.en: Laiba met Noman this year at a call centre where she worked in Islamabad’s Blue Area, the capital’s main business district. Her hours were late, and most of her colleagues were male. Ijaz was uncomfortable with Laiba’s work environment and encouraged her to leave. She quit the job.
paras.zh: 莱巴今年在伊斯兰堡蓝色区域（首都主要商业区）的一个呼叫中心遇到了诺曼。她的工作时间很晚，而且大多数同事都是男性。伊贾兹对莱巴的工作环境感到不舒服，并鼓励她离开。她辞去了工作。

paras.en: But Noman then began coming to the shop to buy milk and yoghurt. During his visits, Ijaz said, he asked about Laiba’s plans to study in Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 但诺曼随后开始到商店购买牛奶和酸奶。伊贾兹说，在访问期间，他询问了莱巴前往沙特阿拉伯学习的计划。

paras.en: “No, we will not go to Saudi Arabia. We will go to America,” Ijaz said he told Noman.
paras.zh: “不，我们不会去沙特阿拉伯。我们会去美国，”伊贾兹告诉诺曼。

paras.en: Noman claimed to work at the Supreme Court, showed Ijaz a service card and said he needed no licence because he was a government employee.
paras.zh: 诺曼声称自己在最高法院工作，向伊贾兹出示了一张服务卡，并表示他不需要执照，因为他是政府雇员。

paras.en: “The card looked right to me too. I showed it to the people next to me,” Ijaz said.
paras.zh: “这张卡片对我来说也很合适。我把它展示给我旁边的人，”伊贾兹说。

paras.en: Noman offered to help Laiba with her application. Ijaz and Laiba decided to accept his offer. “That was our biggest mistake,” the father said.
paras.zh: 诺曼主动提出帮助莱巴完成申请。伊贾兹和莱巴决定接受他的提议。 “这是我们最大的错误，”父亲说。

paras.en: The family paid in stages, starting with 2.2 million rupees ($7,900) for university fees, Ijaz said. Noman later claimed Harvard needed a statement proving 7.2 million rupees ($25,900) in funds, which he insisted had to pass through his account to be converted into dollars.
paras.zh: 伊贾兹说，这个家庭分阶段支付了大学学费，首先是 220 万卢比（7,900 美元）。诺曼后来声称哈佛需要一份证明720万卢比（25,900美元）资金的声明，他坚称这些资金必须通过他的账户才能兑换成美元。

paras.en: “To help my daughter, I sold a plot which I owned. I also sold the [family] jewellery, so I could complete the demanded 7.2 million rupees,” he said.
paras.zh: “为了帮助我的女儿，我卖掉了自己拥有的一块土地。我还卖掉了[家庭]珠宝，这样我就可以完成所要求的 720 万卢比，”他说。

paras.en: Documents shared with Al Jazeera appear to trace a real application: Harvard offer and scholarship letters, a US immigration form with an official-looking stamp, a sponsor’s affidavit from a New York relative, an embassy record bearing Laiba’s photograph and a business-class ticket to Boston.
paras.zh: 与半岛电视台分享的文件似乎追踪了真实的申请：哈佛大学的录取通知书和奖学金信函、带有官方印章的美国移民表格、来自纽约亲戚的担保人宣誓书、带有莱巴照片的大使馆记录和一张飞往波士顿的商务舱机票。

paras.en: The final file, handed over in late September, also contained a bank statement in Laiba’s name and an October 12 visa interview date, Ijaz said.
paras.zh: Ijaz 表示，最终文件于 9 月底提交，其中还包含一份以 Laiba 名义的银行对账单以及 10 月 12 日的签证面谈日期。

paras.en: In early October, Ijaz said he called Noman to help prepare his daughter for the interview. Noman told him he was in Quetta and would return the next day.
paras.zh: 十月初，伊贾兹说他打电话给诺曼，帮助他女儿准备面试。诺曼告诉他，他在奎达，并将于第二天返回。

paras.en: Suspicious of his evasiveness, the family showed the documents to a travel agent and discovered the Boston ticket was fake.
paras.zh: 家人对他的闪烁其词表示怀疑，于是向一家旅行社出示了这些文件，发现波士顿机票是假的。

paras.en: A lawyer neighbour checked the file and told them none of the documents was genuine. They learned the truth about October 6, Ijaz said.
paras.zh: 一位律师邻居检查了文​​件，并告诉他们这些文件都不是真实的。伊贾兹说，他们了解到了 10 月 6 日的真相。

paras.en: The family was shattered. “I used to tell her, ‘What had to happen has happened,'” Ijaz said.
paras.zh: 家庭支离破碎。 “我常常告诉她，‘该发生的事情已经发生了，’”伊贾兹说。

paras.en: But Laiba “continued to have hope” that US authorities and Harvard might still process a real application on her behalf, Ijaz said.
paras.zh: 但伊贾兹说，莱巴“仍然希望”美国当局和哈佛大学仍可能代表她处理真正的申请。

paras.en: On October 9 as Ijaz prepared to close his shop for Friday prayers, Laiba told him Noman had sent her a message. He would pray at their area mosque and then come to see the family.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日，当伊贾兹 (Ijaz) 准备关闭商店进行周五祈祷时，莱巴 (Laiba) 告诉他，诺曼 (Noman) 给她发了一条消息。他会在当地的清真寺祈祷，然后来看望家人。

paras.en: “Laiba, my dear, he will not come. There is no need to listen to his message,” Ijaz recalled telling her. It was one of the last things he said to his daughter.
paras.zh: “莱巴，亲爱的，他不会来。没有必要听他的消息，”伊贾兹回忆告诉她。这是他对女儿说的最后一句话之一。

paras.en: He told Laiba to stay inside and asked his wife to ensure she did. When he returned, his wife said Laiba had received a message from Noman and left despite her mother’s protestations.
paras.zh: 他告诉莱巴待在室内，并要求他的妻子确保她这样做。当他回来时，他的妻子说莱巴收到了诺曼的消息，尽管母亲极力反对，但还是离开了。

paras.en: “Upon hearing this, the ground slipped from under my feet,” Ijaz said.
paras.zh: “听到这个消息，我脚下的地面就塌陷了，”伊贾兹说。

paras.en: Ijaz sent Laiba’s brother-in-law, Zaid bin Afzal, and one of Laiba’s younger brothers to search for her. One of Laiba’s sisters, meanwhile, guided them by using an app that helped them trace the missing woman’s phone to an area near the house.
paras.zh: 伊贾兹派莱巴的妹夫扎伊德·本·阿夫扎尔和莱巴的一个弟弟去寻找她。与此同时，莱巴的一位姐妹指导他们使用一款应用程序，帮助他们追踪失踪妇女的手机，找到房子附近的一个区域。

paras.en: They found her body about 3:30pm, less than two hours after Laiba had left home. Zaid called the police emergency number and then rang his father-in-law, asking him to come to the spot urgently. He didn’t want to tell Ijaz about Laiba’s death on the phone, so he told his father-in-law that Laiba was “being stubborn and refusing to come home”.
paras.zh: 下午 3 点 30 分左右，他们发现了她的尸体，此时距离莱巴离家还不到两小时。扎伊德拨打了警方的紧急电话，然后又给岳父打电话，要求他紧急赶到现场。他不想在电话里告诉伊贾兹莱巴的死讯，所以他告诉岳父莱巴“很顽固，不肯回家”。

paras.en: But Ijaz instantly sensed something was wrong. When he reached the spot, he found his daughter dead.
paras.zh: 但伊贾兹立刻就察觉到了不对劲。当他到达现场时，发现女儿已经死亡。

paras.en: Laiba was among a growing number of Pakistanis hoping to study in the US.
paras.zh: 莱巴是越来越多希望去美国学习的巴基斯坦人之一。

paras.en: During the 2024-2025 school year, more than 13,000 Pakistani students were enrolled at US institutions, a 75 percent increase from 2017-2018, according to the Institute of International Education’s Open Doors report.
paras.zh: 根据国际教育研究所的门户开放报告，2024-2025 学年，有超过 13,000 名巴基斯坦学生在美国院校就读，比 2017-2018 年增加了 75%。

paras.en: The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) said Noman was not a registered visa agent. The government also has left a gaping hole in the market for foreign studies: It does not regulate education consultancies, according to the industry body All Pakistan Association of Foreign Education and Immigration Consultants.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局（FIA）表示，诺曼不是注册签证代理人。行业机构全巴基斯坦外国教育和移民顾问协会表示，政府还在出国留学市场上留下了一个巨大的漏洞：它没有对教育咨询机构进行监管。

paras.en: “I do not know of a regulatory body that checks or registers education consultants,” Nushmiya Sukhera, cofounder of CollegeWorks, a college consultancy in Lahore, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我不知道有哪个监管机构会对教育顾问进行检查或注册，”拉合尔大学咨询公司 CollegeWorks 的联合创始人努什米亚·苏赫拉 (Nushmiya Sukhera) 告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “No education consultancy can guarantee admission,” she said.
paras.zh: “没有任何教育咨询机构可以保证录取，”她说。

paras.en: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered Noman’s arrest a day after Laiba died. Police and the FIA registered separate cases.
paras.zh: 莱巴死后第二天，总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫下令逮捕诺曼。警方和国际汽联分别登记了案件。

paras.en: Police said on October 20 that four men on two motorcycles opened fire as Noman was being taken to recover evidence. The men, according to the police, were trying to help Noman escape, but ended up shooting him. Noman, they said, died while being treated for his bullet wounds.
paras.zh: 警方10月20日表示，当诺曼被带去取证时，四名骑着两辆摩托车的男子开枪。据警方称，这些人试图帮助诺曼逃跑，但最终开枪射杀了他。他们说，诺曼在接受枪伤治疗时死亡。

paras.en: To Ijaz, Noman’s death, however controversial the circumstances, represents a modicum of justice. “In my view, whatever happened was right,” the father said, of the agent’s killing. Authorities are investigating the attack on Noman, but no one has been arrested yet.
paras.zh: 对伊贾兹来说，诺曼的死，无论情况如何有争议，都代表了一点正义。 “在我看来，无论发生什么都是正确的，”父亲在谈到特工被杀时说道。当局正在调查诺曼遇袭事件，但尚未逮捕任何人。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a senior police official, speaking to Al Jazeera on condition of anonymity, said investigations into Laiba’s death were ongoing.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一名不愿透露姓名的高级警官对半岛电视台表示，对莱巴死亡事件的调查正在进行中。

paras.en: Initial postmortem findings pointed to suicide, the official said, adding that footage showed Laiba leaving home on her own with a phone in her hand.
paras.zh: 该官员表示，初步尸检结果表明莱巴是自杀，并补充说，视频显示莱巴独自离家，手里拿着手机。

paras.en: The remaining forensic report usually takes 15 to 20 days, the official said.
paras.zh: 该官员表示，剩下的法医报告通常需要 15 至 20 天。

paras.en: But Ijaz and his family refuse to accept that Laiba died by suicide.
paras.zh: 但伊贾兹和他的家人拒绝接受莱巴自杀身亡的说法。

paras.en: Zaid said after discovering Laiba that “she could not have done this herself”.
paras.zh: 扎伊德在发现莱巴后表示，“她自己不可能做到这一点”。

paras.en: “She did not die herself,” he said. “He [Noman] killed her.”
paras.zh: “她自己没有死，”他说。 “他[诺曼]杀了她。”

articles.title: Palestine weekly: Election deadlock meets West Bank sieges, Gaza killings

paras.en: The election night highs for Palestinian citizens of Israel – Arab-led parties won a record 19 seats – turned into a week of delegitimising rhetoric from Israeli politicians.
paras.zh: 以色列巴勒斯坦公民的选举之夜创下新高——阿拉伯领导的政党赢得了创纪录的 19 个席位——却变成了以色列政界人士为期一周的非法言论。

paras.en: Nearly 840,000 people voted for Ra’am and the Joint List, a 64 percent increase on 2022, and adding them to opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot’s bloc would give an anti-Netanyahu coalition 67 seats; without them, only a unity deal between the main Zionist blocs or another election is possible.
paras.zh: 近 84 万人投票给拉姆和联合名单，比 2022 年增加了 64%，将他们加入反对派领袖加迪·艾森科特的阵营，将使反内塔尼亚胡联盟获得 67 个席位； without them, only a unity deal between the main Zionist blocs or another election is possible.

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud alleged the election had been “stolen” by Palestinian parties with unproven claims of Qatari financing. Qatar denied such accusations, as police sources told The Times of Israel that there was no evidence of widespread fraud. By Sunday, election committee chairman Noam Sohlberg declared the election “conducted properly”.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团声称，选举被巴勒斯坦政党“窃取”，未经证实的卡塔尔资助主张。卡塔尔否认了此类指控，警方消息人士告诉《以色列时报》，没有证据表明存在广泛的欺诈行为。周日，选举委员会主席诺姆·索尔伯格宣布选举“进行得当”。

paras.en: However, the rhetoric delegitimising the Palestinian vote is now being reflected in the coalition negotiations under way. Avigdor Lieberman, leader of the right-wing Yisrael Beytenu party, has ruled out Palestinian partners, and Eisenkot has presented four conditions for anyone joining his coalition that would be anathema to the Palestinian parties, including recognising Israel as “a Jewish, democratic, liberal, and egalitarian state”, and mandatory national service for all citizens, including Palestinians.
paras.zh: 然而，使巴勒斯坦投票合法化的言论现在正反映在正在进行的联盟谈判中。右翼以色列贝特努党领导人阿维格多·利伯曼排除了巴勒斯坦伙伴，而艾森科特则向任何加入其联盟的人提出了四项令巴勒斯坦各方憎恶的条件，其中包括承认以色列是“一个犹太、民主、自由和平等的国家”，以及对包括巴勒斯坦人在内的所有公民实行强制性国民服役。

paras.en: However, Palestinian politicians continue to express a willingness to back an Eisenkot government from outside – if only to enable the departure of Netanyahu and the far right. Meanwhile, thousands rallied in Tel Aviv for a coalition that includes the parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel.
paras.zh: 然而，巴勒斯坦政界人士继续表示愿意从外部支持艾森科特政府 — — 哪怕只是为了让内塔尼亚胡和极右翼离开。与此同时，数千人在特拉维夫集会，组建一个联盟，其中包括代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的政党。

paras.en: While the Israeli electorate was consumed by the election’s unclear results, Palestinians in the occupied West Bank continued enduring a variety of sieges, most prominently in Hebron. By October 29, Al Jazeera’s data unit counted 10 entrances sealed and about 5,000 people displaced. The city saw at least 120 arrests and 13 businesses demolished by Friday, when the army also blew up the homes of two men it blamed for an attack. Palestinian officials accused the government of using the operation to win settler votes; no Israeli official has said so outright.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列选民对选举结果不明确感到困惑，但被占领的约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦人却继续遭受各种围困，尤其是在希伯伦。截至 10 月 29 日，半岛电视台数据部门统计，有 10 个入口被封锁，约 5000 人流离失所。截至周五，该市至少有 120 人被捕，13 家企业被拆毁，军队还炸毁了两名被其归咎为袭击事件的男子的房屋。巴勒斯坦官员指责政府利用这次行动来赢得定居者选票；没有以色列官员直言不讳地说过这一点。

paras.en: On November 2, Governor Khaled Dudin announced the army had withdrawn from Hebron, and that displaced families could return. The Jerusalem Post reported that the army’s chief of staff recommended leaving Hebron before the election, but that Netanyahu refused.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，州长哈立德·杜丁宣布军队已从希伯伦撤军，流离失所的家庭可以返回。 《耶路撒冷邮报》报道称，陆军参谋长建议在选举前离开希伯伦，但内塔尼亚胡拒绝了。

paras.en: But even with the operation over, the damage remains following more than 120 arrests and daily economic losses the governor put at 10 million to 12 million shekels ($3.2m to $3.8m) in a city responsible for about 40 percent of Palestinian industrial output.
paras.zh: 但即使行动结束，该市仍有 120 多人被捕，州长预计每日经济损失达 1000 万至 1200 万谢克尔（320 万至 380 万美元），这座城市的工业产值约占巴勒斯坦工业总产值的 40%，损失依然存在。

paras.en: But Hebron was only the largest of many closures that continue to plague the West Bank. In Masafer Yatta, at least 12 villages were cut off, and the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported that forces detained 10 teachers from the Jinba school on Sunday.
paras.zh: 但希伯伦只是继续困扰西岸的众多封锁中规模最大的一个。在Masafer Yatta，至少有12个村庄被切断，巴勒斯坦通讯社Wafa报道称，部队周日拘留了Jinba学校的10名教师。

paras.en: Yousef Shanaran – who has been besieged in his home with his family in Wadi Rakhim for four weeks now – told Al Jazeera on Monday that settlers have now poisoned the well outside his family home, which the family already was unable to access for days at a time due to the siege. “No water, no food, nothing at all I’ve got,” he said. “Nobody is allowed to bring anything to us.”
paras.zh: 优素福·沙纳兰（Yousef Shanaran）与家人在拉希姆干河（Wadi Rakhim）的家中被围困了四个星期。他周一告诉半岛电视台，定居者现在在他家外面的水井里下了毒，由于被围困，他们一家人已经好几天无法进入这口井了。 “没有水，没有食物，我什么都没有，”他说。 “任何人都不可以给我们带来任何东西。”

paras.en: These sieges continue as settlers, and increasingly Israeli forces, disrupt the olive harvest across the West Bank. United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) documented 397 settler attacks causing casualties or damage in the first 26 days of October – a monthly high since OCHA began tracking such incidents in 2006.
paras.zh: 随着定居者和越来越多的以色列军队扰乱西岸的橄榄收成，这些围困仍在继续。联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 记录了 10 月前 26 天内发生的 397 起定居者袭击事件，造成人员伤亡或财产损失，这是自 OCHA 自 2006 年开始追踪此类事件以来的单月最高水平。

paras.en: Across villages, a familiar pattern has emerged: settlers attack pickers, the army declares a closed military zone and orders the farmers out, and the harvest is lost.
paras.zh: 各个村庄都出现了一种熟悉的模式：定居者袭击采摘者，军队宣布军事禁区并命令农民离开，收成遭到损失。

paras.en: Amid reports of detentions and deportations of solidarity activists who came to the West Bank to assist in the olive harvest in recent days, activists accused settlers of assaulting three activist journalists at Umm al-Khair, and Israel revoked Brad Lander’s travel authorisation after he was detained while harvesting olives two weeks ago.
paras.zh: 据报道，最近几天前往西岸协助收获橄榄的团结活动人士被拘留和驱逐出境，活动人士指责定居者在乌姆凯尔袭击三名活动记者，两周前布拉德·兰德在收获橄榄时被拘留后​​，以色列取消了他的旅行许可。

paras.en: In Gaza, attacks continued on a daily basis as the UN human rights office warned on October 30 that Palestinians are being pushed into an ever smaller area, calling the “Yellow Line” a “kill zone” that is moving westward.
paras.zh: 在加沙，袭击事件每天都在继续，联合国人权办公室10月30日警告称，巴勒斯坦人正被推向更小的地区，称“黄线”是向西移动的“杀戮区”。

paras.en: By November 2, the Ministry of Health put the death toll since last year’s ceasefire at 1,593. Sunday was the deadliest day of the week, with at least eight killed. Among those reported killed over the past week:
paras.zh: 截至 11 月 2 日，卫生部统计自去年停火以来的死亡人数为 1,593 人。周日是一周中死亡人数最多的一天，至少有八人死亡。据报道，过去一周遇害的人包括：

paras.en: - Government and police personnel were among those killed. On October 28, a drone strike on a Ministry of Economy facility in al-Mawasi, Rafah, where staff and security personnel had gathered, killed five people, including Ministry of Agriculture official Wajdi Abu Bakr, who died on Sunday from injuries sustained in the attack.
paras.zh: - 遇难者中有政府人员和警察人员。 10 月 28 日，拉法省马瓦西经济部一处设施遭到无人机袭击，工作人员和安保人员聚集于此，造成 5 人死亡，其中包括农业部官员瓦吉迪·阿布·巴克尔 (Wajdi Abu Bakr)，他于周日在袭击中受伤身亡。

paras.en: - On November 1, a drone strike in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, killed five men whom Gaza’s Interior Ministry said were police officers.
paras.zh: - 11 月 1 日，汗尤尼斯 (Khan Younis) 的马瓦西 (al-Mawasi) 遭遇无人机袭击，造成 5 名男子死亡，加沙内政部称这些人是警察。

paras.en: - Israeli attacks also killed children. Six-year-old Tahani Shalalfeh died of a gunshot wound in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, on October 27, and Yamen Saqr, eight, died on October 30 of wounds from Israeli fire in Khan Younis, according to Wafa and local activists. The young child Zain Owais was reported killed on November 1 with his father, Mohammed Ali Owais, and a third man in a strike near Taj Mall in Gaza City.
paras.zh: - 以色列的袭击还杀死了儿童。据瓦法和当地活动人士称，10 月 27 日，六岁的塔哈尼·沙拉菲 (Tahani Shalalfeh) 在汗尤尼斯的马瓦西 (al-Mawasi) 中枪身亡，八岁的亚门·萨克尔 (Yamen Saqr) 于 10 月 30 日在汗尤尼斯的以色列炮火中受伤身亡。据报道，11 月 1 日，年幼的孩子扎因·奥韦斯 (Zain Owais) 与他的父亲穆罕默德·阿里·奥韦斯 (Mohammed Ali Owais) 以及第三名男子在加沙城泰姬陵购物中心附近的一次罢工中丧生。

paras.en: - On October 27, a young man was killed in an air strike in west Rafah, and a member of the Bseiso family died of earlier wounds in Gaza City, Gaza Now reported. Mohammad al-Bayouk was killed in Khan Younis on October 28, and Mohammed al-Najjar was killed near Jabalia on Thursday.
paras.zh: - 据《Gaza Now》报道，10 月 27 日，一名年轻人在西拉法的一次空袭中丧生，Bseiso 家族的一名成员在加沙城因早前受伤身亡。穆罕默德·巴尤克于 10 月 28 日在汗尤尼斯被杀，穆罕默德·纳贾尔于周四在贾巴利亚附近被杀。

paras.en: - On Friday, the body of a 47-year-old man killed in an air strike at al-Waha, north of Gaza City, was recovered, Wafa reported.
paras.zh: - 据瓦法报道，周五，在加沙城北部瓦哈空袭中丧生的一名 47 岁男子的尸体已被找到。

paras.en: - Ibrahim Saeed died on Sunday of wounds from tank fire in al-Musaddar, and Yusuf Abu Younis died Monday of wounds from a drone strike in Khan Younis the day before, according to local activist Hamza al-Masri.
paras.zh: - 据当地活动家哈姆扎·马斯里称，易卜拉欣·赛义德于周日在穆萨达尔因坦克炮火受伤身亡，优素福·阿布·尤尼斯于周一因前一天在汗尤尼斯的无人机袭击中受伤身亡。

paras.en: - On Monday, Mahmoud Qaffa and Asaad Qeshta were killed in separate air strikes in Khan Younis and Ibrahim al-Saayida, 40, in al-Musaddar, according to Wafa and Haaretz.
paras.zh: - 据《瓦法报》和《国土报》报道，周一，马哈茂德·卡法和阿萨德·盖什塔分别在汗尤尼斯和穆萨达尔的 40 岁易卜拉欣·萨伊达的空袭中丧生。

paras.en: Israeli authorities claimed many of those killed this week were Hamas fighters, though no evidence was provided. Among those were Diaa Abu al-Rous, killed north of Nuseirat on Saturday, and Mohammed Qudeih, killed in a strike on a tent in Khan Younis the same day, who the military claimed were members of Hamas’s Nukhba Forces; Palestinian reports describe Abu al-Rous as a teacher.
paras.zh: 以色列当局声称本周被杀的许多人是哈马斯战士，但没有提供证据。其中包括周六在努塞拉特以北被杀的迪亚·阿布·鲁斯（Diaa Abu al-Rous）和当天在汗尤尼斯（Khan Younis）的一个帐篷遭到袭击时被杀的穆罕默德·库代赫（Mohammed Qudeih），军方声称他们是哈马斯努赫巴部队的成员；巴勒斯坦报道称阿布·鲁斯是一名教师。

paras.en: Such killings take place with winter closing in and humanitarian conditions struggling to improve: two infant girls died of burns in a tent fire in al-Mawasi on Friday, and the shelter picture is dire, with Gaza’s Social Development Ministry saying about 200,000 tents are needed, yet only dozens have arrived due to Israeli entry restrictions.
paras.zh: 此类杀戮发生在冬季临近、人道主义状况难以改善的情况下：周五，两名女婴在马瓦西的帐篷火灾中被烧伤身亡，避难所的情况很糟糕，加沙社会发展部表示需要约 20 万顶帐篷，但由于以色列入境限制，只有几十顶帐篷抵达。

paras.en: With no hospitals in Gaza fully functioning, the Red Crescent warned on Monday that the health system is at risk of collapse after 26 hospitals went out of service – with fuel shortages threatening the remaining facilities.
paras.zh: 由于加沙没有一家医院完全运转，红新月会周一警告说，26 家医院停止服务后，卫生系统面临崩溃的风险，燃料短缺威胁着剩余的设施。

articles.title: AFC reschedules Asian Cup 2027 in Saudi Arabia amid regional conflict

paras.en: Football’s upcoming Asian Cup 2027 tournament in Saudi Arabia has been rescheduled from a January start to December due to the ongoing conflict in the region, the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has confirmed.
paras.zh: 亚洲足球联合会 (AFC) 证实，由于该地区持续不断的冲突，即将在沙特阿拉伯举行的 2027 年亚洲杯足球赛已从 1 月开始重新安排到 12 月。

paras.en: The 24-team competition, which was due to get under way in Riyadh on January 7, 2027, will now begin on December 23, the AFC said in a statement on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 亚足联周二在一份声明中表示，这项由 24 支球队参加的比赛原定于 2027 年 1 月 7 日在利雅得举行，现将于 12 月 23 日开始。

paras.en: Asian football’s governing body announced the decision following “extensive discussions and close consultation with the Local Organising Committee (LOC) of the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027 and the Saudi Arabian Football Federation (SAFF)”.
paras.zh: 亚洲足球管理机构在“与2027年沙特阿拉伯亚洲杯当地组委会（LOC）和沙特阿拉伯足协（SAFF）进行广泛讨论和密切协商”后宣布了这一决定。

paras.en: The tournament will now run from December 23, 2027, to January 21, 2028.
paras.zh: 比赛将于2027年12月23日至2028年1月21日举行。

paras.en: “The organising committee for the AFC Asian Cup approved rescheduling the tournament in light of the current exceptional circumstances arising from developments in the region, including substantial logistical complexities and travel disruptions,” the AFC’s statement added.
paras.zh: 亚足联的声明补充道：“鉴于该地区事态发展目前出现的特殊情况，包括严重的后勤复杂性和旅行中断，亚足联亚洲杯组委会批准重新安排比赛时间。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has repeatedly come under attack from Yemen’s Houthis since September, with capital Riyadh among the cities repeatedly targeted by missiles.
paras.zh: 自9月以来，沙特阿拉伯一再受到也门胡塞武装的袭击，首都利雅得一再成为导弹袭击的目标。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen reported on Friday that it “intercepted and destroyed” a drone launched by the Houthis towards Saudi Arabia’s Mecca region.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的也门联盟周五报告说，它“拦截并摧毁”了胡塞武装向沙特阿拉伯麦加地区发射的一架无人机。

paras.en: It was also reported that a missile aimed at western Saudi Arabia was earlier brought down, as hostilities between the Riyadh-backed Yemen government and Iran-backed Houthis continue to escalate.
paras.zh: 另据报道，随着利雅得支持的也门政府和伊朗支持的胡塞武装之间的敌对行动继续升级，一枚针对沙特阿拉伯西部的导弹早些时候被击落。

paras.en: The tournament’s fate hung in the balance in past weeks, with several participating nations expressing concerns about the security situation.
paras.zh: 过去几周，世界杯的命运悬而未决，一些参赛国对安全局势表示担忧。

paras.en: The AFC said while “exceptional circumstances” had been created for the organisation and delivery of the competition as originally scheduled, the postponement became necessary “in the interest of all participating teams, officials, spectators and other stakeholders.”
paras.zh: 亚足联表示，虽然为按原定计划组织和举办比赛创造了“特殊情况”，但“为了所有参赛球队、官员、观众和其他利益相关者的利益”，推迟是必要的。

paras.en: The AFC will submit the new tournament dates to FIFA for approval from football’s global governing body.
paras.zh: 亚足联将向国际足联提交新的比赛日期，以获得全球足球管理机构的批准。

articles.title: France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe
paras.zh: 年轻人领导的抗议活动席卷欧洲，法国再次沸腾

paras.en: PARIS — Hundreds of thousands of mostly young protesters took to the streets across France on Saturday in a third consecutive weekend of demonstrations over living costs and education.
paras.zh: 巴黎——周六，数十万抗议者走上法国各地街头，其中大部分是年轻抗议者，这是连续第三个周末就生活费用和教育问题举行示威活动。

paras.en: About 70,000 police and gendarmes were deployed across the country, and Paris marches were rerouted to the capital's edge. Youth-led demonstrations were also reported in Germany and Italy.
paras.zh: 全国各地部署了约 70,000 名警察和宪兵，巴黎的游行队伍改道至首都边缘。据报道，德国和意大利也发生了由青年领导的示威活动。

paras.en: France's government estimated that 320,000 people protested nationwide Saturday, fewer than in previous protests but still a significant turnout. Mass protests on Oct. 17 that deteriorated into some of France's worst rioting in years drew more than 500,000 people around France, and demonstrations on Oct. 24 drew 410,000, according to government estimates. Organizers' turnout estimates are much higher.
paras.zh: 法国政府估计周六全国有 32 万人举行抗议活动，比之前的抗议活动少，但参与人数仍然很高。据政府估计，10 月 17 日的大规模抗议活动升级为法国多年来最严重的骚乱，吸引了法国各地超过 50 万人参加，10 月 24 日的示威活动吸引了 41 万人参加。组织者对投票率的估计要高得多。

paras.en: Authorities in France reported about 300 arrests nationwide so far — down from 800 at the same point in last week's protests.
paras.zh: 法国当局报告称，迄今为止，全国约有 300 人被捕，低于上周抗议活动同期的 800 人。

paras.en: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned of a "very high risk" of disorder, especially after dark on Halloween. Police had arrested thousands of people following riots and looting that marred the largely peaceful protest marches the previous two Saturdays.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯警告说，发生骚乱的“风险非常高”，尤其是万圣节天黑后。前两个周六，骚乱和抢劫破坏了基本上和平的抗议游行，警方逮捕了数千人。

paras.en: At Porte de Bagnolet, on the eastern edge of Paris, thousands gathered behind a line of students who led the march hand in hand. Security agents from the CGT, one of France's largest labor unions, were keeping watch at the front of the gathering, while police were massed on side streets.
paras.zh: 在巴黎东部边缘的巴尼奥莱门，数千人聚集在手拉手带领游行的学生队伍后面。法国最大工会之一的总工会的安全人员在集会前线巡逻，而警察则聚集在小街上。

paras.en: The Interior Ministry told reporters that of the 320,000 protesting Saturday, 70,000 people are estimated to have turned out for the main protest in Paris, which police moved outside the city center to reduce the risk of unrest around government buildings and tourist sites after a last-minute court battle.
paras.zh: 内政部告诉记者，在周六的 32 万人抗议中，估计有 7 万人参加了巴黎的主要抗议活动，在最后一刻的法庭斗争后，警方将抗议活动转移到市中心以外，以减少政府大楼和旅游景点周围发生骚乱的风险。

paras.en: Each group carried its own banner: high school students, climate activists and people angry about the cost of living.
paras.zh: 每个团体都举着自己的旗帜：高中生、气候活动人士和对生活成本感到愤怒的人们。

paras.en: Corentin Cabreux, a 21-year-old student, said that he lives in a state-run student residence where "there are damp stains all along the bottom of my walls, whole sections peeling off, cockroaches everywhere, rats."
paras.zh: 21岁的学生科朗廷·卡布勒克斯(Corentin Cabreux)说，他住在国营学生宿舍里，“墙底都是潮湿的污渍，整块都剥落了，到处都是蟑螂、老鼠。”

paras.en: The crowd streamed along the Boulevards des Maréchaux, the ring of avenues that skirts the edge of Paris, in a march that was joyful for hours. Techno music blasted from speakers, a painter at work along the route drew cheers from the crowd, and some marchers went trick-or-treating. A police helicopter hovered overhead as the sun set slowly over the city.
paras.zh: 人群沿着巴黎边缘的马雷肖大道（Boulevards des Maréchaux）涌动，游行队伍欢乐地持续了几个小时。扬声器中传出电子音乐，沿途正在工作的画家引起了人群的欢呼，一些游行者进行了“不给糖就捣蛋”的活动。当太阳慢慢地落在城市上空时，一架警用直升机在头顶盘旋。

paras.en: Later, clashes broke out near Porte de Charenton, where the march ended. Protesters hurled glass bottles and fireworks at police. Officers responded with volleys of stun grenades and tear gas. The blasts echoed through the streets, and smoke filled the air as dusk fell.
paras.zh: 随后，游行结束处的夏朗通门附近爆发了冲突。抗议者向警察投掷玻璃瓶和烟花。警察用眩晕手榴弹和催泪瓦斯进行回应。爆炸声在街道上回响，黄昏时分，烟雾弥漫在空气中。

paras.en: Many peaceful marchers turned back, coughing, their eyes streaming with tears, and left the march, some scattering into the nearby Bois de Vincennes, one of the largest parks in Paris.
paras.zh: 许多和平的游行者咳嗽着、眼里含着泪水回头，离开了游行队伍，一些人分散到了附近的文森森林，这是巴黎最大的公园之一。

paras.en: The rallies started last month as a movement of high school students protesting neglected buildings, teacher shortages and a university admissions system seen as unfair to disadvantaged students. Labor unions and others angry at President Emmanuel Macron joined in with a variety of demands.
paras.zh: 集会于上个月开始，是一场高中生运动，抗议被忽视的建筑、教师短缺以及被视为对弱势学生不公平的大学招生制度。工会和其他对总统马克龙感到愤怒的人也提出了各种要求。

paras.en: While the vast majority of protesters have been peaceful, groups of troublemakers routinely target police with fireworks and projectiles. Some protests have degenerated into rioting and looting — including unrest on Oct. 17 that appeared to take the government by surprise. Police have responded with tear gas, dispersion grenades, water cannons and other tactics that have resulted in severe injuries.
paras.zh: 虽然绝大多数抗议者都是和平的，但成群结队的闹事者经常用烟花和投弹袭击警察。一些抗议活动已经演变成骚乱和抢劫——包括 10 月 17 日发生的骚乱，这似乎让政府措手不及。警方使用催泪瓦斯、分散手榴弹、高压水枪和其他手段进行回应，导致人员严重受伤。

paras.en: Macron said that Saturday's marches would stay out of city centers to protect shops. Police also barred people from entering Place de la Republique and Les Halles from 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. Saturday and Sunday.
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，周六的游行将远离市中心，以保护商店。警方还从晚上 11 点起禁止人们进入共和广场和巴黎大堂。周六和周日至早上 6 点。

paras.en: Unaccompanied minors face a separate 9 p.m. curfew around the Champs-Elysees. A Paris court on Wednesday suspended an earlier curfew on minors as a serious and illegal infringement of freedom of movement.
paras.zh: 无人陪伴的未成年人晚上 9 点要单独面对。香榭丽舍大街周围实行宵禁。巴黎一家法院周三暂停了早些时候对未成年人的宵禁，称其严重非法侵犯了行动自由。

paras.en: Protests took place in Germany, Portugal and the Netherlands
paras.zh: 德国、葡萄牙和荷兰爆发抗议活动

paras.en: In Germany, a youth initiative called "Gen Z regelt" — roughly "Gen Z's got this" — rallied in more than 30 cities "for education, health, climate protection and an affordable life," and against any return of military conscription. Organizers said that tens of thousands participated in the protests across the country, but official figures weren't immediately available.
paras.zh: 在德国，一项名为“Gen Z regelt”的青年倡议——大致是“Z世代得到了这个”——在30多个城市集会，“争取教育、健康、气候保护和负担得起的生活”，并反对任何重新征兵的做法。组织者表示，全国各地有数万人参加了抗议活动，但官方数据尚未公布。

paras.en: In Berlin, young protesters also gathered at Brandenburg Gate on Saturday afternoon, demanding more investments in education and housing.
paras.zh: 在柏林，年轻的抗议者周六下午也聚集在勃兰登堡门，要求对教育和住房进行更多投资。

paras.en: "We call for more money to be invested in social services and education, as well as in climate protection — in short, in our future — because we are the ones who will be affected by this the longest and who will have to live with it," high school student Lara Breitenbach said.
paras.zh: “我们呼吁在社会服务和教育以及气候保护方面投入更多资金——简而言之，在我们的未来——因为我们将是受此影响最久的人，并且将不得不忍受它，”高中生劳拉·布莱滕巴赫说。

paras.en: Janelle Schulz, another high school student from Berlin, also said that the authorities had to invest more money in education.
paras.zh: 另一位来自柏林的高中生贾内尔·舒尔茨也表示，当局必须在教育方面投入更多资金。

paras.en: "At my school, the ceiling is collapsing because of water damage, nothing is being done about it, we have a shortage of teachers, the toilets are broken," she said.
paras.zh: “在我的学校，天花板因水灾而倒塌，但我们没有采取任何措施，我们缺少教师，厕所也坏了，”她说。

paras.en: Later on Saturday, police ended a protest march early in the western city of Cologne after protesters used pyrotechnics, threw stones at them and covered their faces despite a ban. Police also used water cannons to disperse demonstrators. In the northern city of Hamburg, some protesters also shot pyrotechnics toward police and burned down barricades. Police used water cannons and tear gas to disperse the crowds in Hamburg. In Frankfurt, protesters pummeled police with stones, injuring several officers, one of them severely, police said.
paras.zh: 周六晚些时候，警方在西部城市科隆提前结束了抗议游行，抗议者不顾禁令使用烟火、向他们投掷石块并遮住脸部。警方还使用高压水枪驱散示威者。在北部城市汉堡，一些抗议者还向警察发射烟火并烧毁路障。汉堡警方使用高压水枪和催泪瓦斯驱散人群。警方称，在法兰克福，抗议者用石块殴打警察，导致几名警察受伤，其中一人严重受伤。

paras.en: Elsewhere in Europe, people also protested against the housing crisis and for a better future.
paras.zh: 在欧洲其他地方，人们也抗议住房危机并争取更美好的未来。

paras.en: Thousands of protesters, including families with small children, converged in downtown Lisbon to peacefully protest Portugal's housing crisis, holding up placards reading "Houses or Fire" and "We are not Afraid." Others in the crowd held aloft small cardboard houses while a few dressed up for Halloween.
paras.zh: 数千名抗议者，包括有小孩的家庭，聚集在里斯本市中心，和平抗议葡萄牙的住房危机，他们举着写有“房屋或火灾”和“我们不害怕”的标语牌。人群中的其他人高举着小纸板屋，还有一些人打扮得像万圣节。

paras.en: In The Hague, Netherlands, there was a strong police presence in and around the downtown shopping area on Saturday afternoon after online appeals for protests and fears of rioting and looting. However, there was little sign of protests and no major disturbances by midafternoon. Police frisked some groups of black-clad youngsters and checked their identities, local media reported. Many stores in the city were boarded up as a precaution.
paras.zh: 在荷兰海牙，由于网上呼吁抗议以及担心发生骚乱和抢劫，周六下午，市中心购物区及其周边地区部署了强大的警察。然而，到下午三点左右，几乎没有抗议的迹象，也没有发生重大骚乱。据当地媒体报道，警方对一些身穿黑衣的年轻人进行了搜身，并检查了他们的身份。作为预防措施，该市许多商店都用木板封起来。

articles.title: A new political era in the Southern Philippines
articles.author: Jan Camenzind Broomby

paras.en: A new political era in the Southern Philippines
paras.zh: 菲律宾南部的新政治时代

paras.en: A new local government has taken its seat in the southern Philippines, in a step that marks a milestone in the peace process for a conflict that has lasted some 80 years.
paras.zh: 新的地方政府在菲律宾南部就职，这一举措标志着持续约 80 年冲突的和平进程中的一个里程碑。

paras.en: A new political era began on Friday in the Southern Philippines. Lawmakers took their seats in a newly elected local parliament, marking a major milestone in ending one of the country's last separatist insurgencies. It lasted eight decades and claimed hundreds of thousands of lives. Last month, reporter Jan Camenzind Broomby was at the polling stations as former fighters traded weapons for ballots. And a warning, this story has sounds of gunfire.
paras.zh: 周五，菲律宾南部开始了一个新的政治时代。立法者在新当选的地方议会中就职，标志着结束该国最后的分裂主义叛乱之一的一个重要里程碑。它持续了八十年，夺走了数十万人的生命。上个月，记者简·卡门津德·布鲁姆比 (Jan Camenzind Broomby) 在投票站，前战士用武器换取选票。警告一下，这个故事有枪声。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #1: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#1：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED CROWD #1: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人群#1：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: JAN CAMENZIND BROOMBY, BYLINE: In the Southern Philippines, a university gymnasium in Cotabato City has been transformed. Instead of sports fans, the stands teem with attendees of a grand political rally. Hundreds of supporters for the political wing of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front, or MILF, a local Islamist militant group.
paras.zh: 扬·卡门辛德·布鲁姆比连线：在菲律宾南部，哥打巴托市的一所大学体育馆已经改造。看台上挤满了盛大政治集会的参加者，而不是体育迷。当地伊斯兰激进组织摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线（摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线）政治派别的数百名支持者。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #1: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#1：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Mingling in the crowd, dozens of men who call themselves mujahideen fighters.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：数十名自称圣战者战士的男子混在人群中。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #2: Yeah. All of us. We are all combatant.
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#2：是的。我们所有人。我们都是战士。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Among them, Bhong Dalama.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比： 其中就有 Bhong Dalama。

paras.en: BHONG DALAMA: We fight them in the battlefield.
paras.zh: BHONG DALAMA：我们在战场上与他们作战。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: He's a deputy base commander for the MILF who once fought a guerrilla war against the Philippine government.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：他是摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线的副基地指挥官，曾与菲律宾政府进行过游击战。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Manila may have viewed it as a secessionist conflict, but to him, it was a form of jihad, a term whose meaning is contested globally, but many here interpret as a religious struggle to defend one's own beliefs. Now, after years of armed insurgency for the sake of the next generation, he hopes for peace.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：马尼拉可能认为这是一场分裂主义冲突，但对他来说，这是一种圣战形式，这个术语的含义在全球范围内存在争议，但许多人将其解释为捍卫自己信仰的宗教斗争。现在，为了下一代，经过多年的武装叛乱，他希望实现和平。

paras.en: DALAMA: We are more than willing to accept, based on the peaceful means.
paras.zh: 达拉马：我们非常愿意以和平方式接受。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #3: (Singing in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#3：（用非英语语言唱歌）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: The Philippines might be almost 79% Roman Catholic, but here in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, also known as the BARMM, Muslims are in the majority.
paras.zh: 卡门青德·布鲁姆比：菲律宾可能有近 79% 的人信奉罗马天主教，但在棉兰老岛穆斯林邦萨摩洛自治区（也称为 BARMM），穆斯林占多数。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #3: (Singing in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#3：（用非英语语言唱歌）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Locals have fought for autonomy for hundreds of years, including against the United States, which colonized the region in 1898, and then against the Philippines government after independence in 1946, which many people here viewed as a continuation of outside rule.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：数百年来，当地人一直在争取自治，包括反对 1898 年殖民该地区的美国，以及 1946 年独立后反对菲律宾政府，这里的许多人认为菲律宾政府是外部统治的延续。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #4: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#4：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #5: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#5：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: A key figure in the struggle, Murad Ebrahim, chairperson of the MILF. In one of the Rebel group's strongholds, he tells us the time for violence is now over.
paras.zh: 卡门青德·布鲁姆比：斗争中的关键人物穆拉德·易卜拉欣，摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线主席。在叛军的一处据点，他告诉我们暴力的时代已经结束了。

paras.en: MURAD EBRAHIM: The real meaning of Jihad is struggle. We have struggled so much. We even wage war.
paras.zh: 穆拉德·易卜拉欣：圣战的真正意义是斗争。我们经历了很多挣扎。我们甚至发动战争。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Under a peace deal signed in 2014, the MILF and Manila have agreed that BARMM will stay Filipino, but will have its own local government. Ebrahim says jihadi struggle, once expressed through violence, will now be expressed via democracy.
paras.zh: 卡门青德·布鲁姆比：根据 2014 年签署的和平协议，摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线和马尼拉同意 BARMM 将保留菲律宾国籍，但将拥有自己的地方政府。易卜拉欣说，曾经通过暴力表达的圣战斗争现在将通过民主表达。

paras.en: EBRAHIM: So now we have our own government, and we have to protect it. And this can only be protected by the balance.
paras.zh: 易卜拉欣：现在我们有了自己的政府，我们必须保护它。而这只能通过平衡来保护。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #6: (Singing in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#6：（用非英语语言唱歌）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: As the morning prayers ring out on election day, we head to a polling station.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：随着选举日晨祷的响起，我们前往投票站。

paras.en: There's a queue that stretches all the way around the corner, with probably hundreds of people lining up.
paras.zh: 拐角处已经排起了长队，大概有数百人在排队。

paras.en: Inside, we find Mohammed Bedtikan, a Cotabato local.
paras.zh: 在里面，我们找到了哥打巴托当地人穆罕默德·贝蒂坎 (Mohammed Bedtikan)。

paras.en: MOHAMMED BEDTIKAN: I feel great because this the first parliamentary election here in BARMM. We're hoping that this election will be safe.
paras.zh: MOHAMMED BEDTIKAN： 我感觉很棒，因为这是 BARMM 的第一次议会选举。我们希望这次选举能够安全。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: And the fears, they're valid because in the last few hours, there have been two explosions in this city alone and numerous people shot dead in what is thought to be election-related violence.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：这些担忧是有道理的，因为在过去的几个小时里，仅在这座城市就发生了两起爆炸，许多人在被认为与选举有关的暴力事件中被枪杀。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #7: A ba da ba da ba.
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#7：阿巴达巴达巴。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: A reminder that even though lawmakers are now taking their seats, peace is fragile.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：提醒人们，尽管立法者现在已经就座，但和平仍然脆弱。

paras.en: GEORGI ENGELBRECHT: The interim government has failed to curb violence.
paras.zh: 乔治·恩格尔布莱希特：临时政府未能遏制暴力。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: This is Georgi Engelbrecht, from the Belgium-based think tank International Crisis Group. He says combatants must now build political coalitions that deliver for locals, because after the votes are counted, no party has won a clear majority.
paras.zh: 卡门青德·布鲁姆比：我是乔治·恩格尔布雷希特，来自比利时智库国际危机组织。他说，战斗人员现在必须建立为当地人服务的政治联盟，因为计票后，没有一个政党赢得明显多数。

paras.en: ENGELBRECHT: If malgovernance will persist, it might be just a matter of time until a new group will emerge and fight for the rights of the people.
paras.zh: 恩格尔布莱希特：如果治理不善继续存在，一个新团体的出现并为人民的权利而战可能只是时间问题。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #8: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#8：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: And another challenge. While some 26,000 of the MILF's combatants have been decommissioned, 14,000 remain active, guarding militia camps.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比： 还有另一个挑战。虽然大约 26,000 名摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线战斗人员已经退役，但仍有 14,000 人仍然活跃，守卫民兵营地。

paras.en: EBRAHIM: What we are asking now is that they will deliver...
paras.zh: 易卜拉欣：我们现在要求的是他们将提供......

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: Chairperson Ebrahim says decommissioning will continue once Manila provides mujahideen fighters with the support needed to reintegrate into society...
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：主席易卜拉欣表示，一旦马尼拉为圣战者战士提供重新融入社会所需的支持，退役工作就会继续进行……

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON #9: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人#9：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED CROWD #2: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人群#2：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: CAMENZIND BROOMBY: ...With the hope that the fate of their homeland can now be decided not on the battlefield, but at the ballot box instead.
paras.zh: 卡门辛德·布鲁姆比：……希望他们祖国的命运现在可以不是在战场上决定，而是在投票箱上决定。

paras.en: For NPR News, I'm Jan Camenzind Broomby in Cotabato City, the Philippines.
paras.zh: 我是 NPR 新闻的 Jan Camenzind Broomby，来自菲律宾哥打巴托市。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF 99GINGER AND C-AFROBRASIL'S "NOTURNO")
paras.zh: （99GINGER 和 C-AFROBRASIL 的“NOTURNO”原声片段）
