paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
articles.author: Michele Kelemen

paras.en: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
paras.zh: 卢比奥国务卿很难让 G20 官员达成共识

paras.en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥将在亚特兰大主办二十国集团外长会议，重点讨论经济和安全挑战。

paras.en: Tensions flared this weekend at a meeting chaired by Secretary of State Marco Rubio of the Group of 20 leading economies. NPR's Michele Kelemen reports from Atlanta.
paras.zh: 本周末，二十国集团主要经济体国务卿马可·卢比奥主持的一次会议上，紧张局势加剧。 NPR 的米歇尔·凯莱门 (Michele Kelemen) 来自亚特兰大的报道。

paras.en: MICHELE KELEMEN, BYLINE: There was no joint communiqué or even a family photo. Several foreign ministers did not want to be in a picture with Russia's Sergey Lavrov. So Rubio canceled plans for that, but he says countries did come together around some big themes, including freedom of navigation.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·克莱门连线：没有联合公报，甚至没有一张全家福。几位外交部长不想与俄罗斯总统谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫合影。因此卢比奥取消了这一计划，但他表示，各国确实围绕一些重大主题聚集在一起，包括航行自由。

paras.en: MARCO RUBIO: Safe passage of vessels in international waters is vital to the livelihood of the world. And we now live in a world where the Iranian regime actively and openly targets commercial vessels.
paras.zh: 马可·鲁比奥：船舶在国际水域的安全通行对于世界的生计至关重要。我们现在生活在一个伊朗政权积极、公开地针对商业船只的世界。

paras.en: KELEMEN: He says the U.S. is open to diplomacy with Iran, but he wouldn't rule out a new round of attacks, even as the U.S. military tries to keep the Strait of Hormuz open.
paras.zh: 克莱门：他说美国对与伊朗进行外交持开放态度，但他不排除发动新一轮袭击的可能性，尽管美国军方试图保持霍尔木兹海峡开放。

paras.en: RUBIO: Central Command in the United States has done a phenomenal job of protecting this shipping. And today, the amount of fuel getting through there is comparable with what was coming out before the conflict. But nonetheless, we've had to defend these ships from drones and missiles almost every single night.
paras.zh: 卢比奥：美国中央司令部在保护这艘船方面做得非常出色。如今，通过那里的燃料量与冲突前的量相当。但尽管如此，我们几乎每晚都必须保护这些船只免受无人机和导弹的袭击。

paras.en: KELEMEN: Other G20 countries are worried about the potential for a new escalation in the Middle East. Europeans are also nervous about U.S. sanctions relief to Russia. Germany's foreign minister, Johann Wadephul, is trying to highlight the positive, saying, while they may not agree on tactics, everyone shares the goal of getting Russia to the negotiating table to end the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 克莱门：其他二十国集团国家担心中东局势可能出现新一轮升级。欧洲人也对美国放松对俄罗斯的制裁感到紧张。德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔试图强调积极的一面，他表示，虽然他们可能在策略上不一致，但每个人都有一个共同目标，那就是让俄罗斯坐到谈判桌前结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: JOHANN WADEPHUL: In the substance, we have the same position, not only in Europe, but together also with the United States of America. And for us, Marco Rubio was always a reliable partner.
paras.zh: 约翰·瓦德菲尔：实质上，我们不仅在欧洲，而且与美利坚合众国都有相同的立场。对于我们来说，马可·卢比奥始终是可靠的合作伙伴。

paras.en: KELEMEN: Rubio did meet briefly with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, who's been making light over the dispute over the family photo and defending Russia's war in Ukraine. Russia has long blamed the West for provoking Moscow. Poland's foreign minister, Radek Sikorski, has heard it all before.
paras.zh: 凯莱门：卢比奥确实与俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫进行了短暂会面，拉夫罗夫一直在揭露家庭照片纠纷，并为俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争辩护。俄罗斯长期以来一直指责西方挑衅莫斯科。波兰外交部长拉德克·西科尔斯基以前就听过这一切。

paras.en: RADEK SIKORSKI: Sergey Lavrov's repeated diatribes against Europe suggests to me that they've realized that Europe has cards.
paras.zh: 拉德克·西科斯基：谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫对欧洲的反复谩骂表明他们已经意识到欧洲有牌。

paras.en: KELEMEN: Europe, he says, has Russia's frozen assets, and it's buying weapons from the U.S. for Ukraine. Poland is lobbying to become a member of the G20 over Russia's objections. Sikorski says he used his time here to push for a ceasefire in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 克莱门：他说，欧洲拥有俄罗斯冻结的资产，并且正在从美国为乌克兰购买武器。波兰不顾俄罗斯的反对，正在游说加入二十国集团。西科尔斯基说，他利用在这里的时间推动黑海停火。

paras.en: SIKORSKI: So that both Ukrainian and Russian grain could make it through the Bosphorus to the people who need it in Egypt and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 西科尔斯基：这样乌克兰和俄罗斯的粮食就能通过博斯普鲁斯海峡到达埃及和其他地方需要的人们。

paras.en: KELEMEN: Secretary Rubio says he wouldn't place bets on whether such a ceasefire is possible, but he says there was a lot of interest around the table to do that. He also defended the decision to host Lavrov in Atlanta and to invite Russian president Vladimir Putin to the G20 summit in Florida, though it's not clear Putin will come.
paras.zh: 凯莱门：卢比奥国务卿表示，他不会对停火是否可能进行打赌，但他表示，会议上有很多人对此感兴趣。他还为在亚特兰大接待拉夫罗夫并邀请俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京参加佛罗里达州 G20 峰会的决定进行了辩护，尽管目前还不清楚普京是否会来。

paras.en: RUBIO: We have to be able to talk to the Russian side, and one of the ways to do that is to invite him to forums like this, where they're not just hearing from us, but potentially hearing from other countries that are there as well.
paras.zh: 卢比奥：我们必须能够与俄罗斯方面对话，而做到这一点的方法之一就是邀请他参加这样的论坛，在那里他们不仅会收到我们的消息，而且可能还会收到其他国家的消息。

paras.en: KELEMEN: Secretary Rubio also met briefly with his counterpart from Brazil, breaking the ice after right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro lost the elections and fled to the U.S. Rubio says President Trump made the decision to allow Bolsonaro into the country, but the U.S. government did not facilitate the travel.
paras.zh: 凯莱门：卢比奥国务卿还与巴西外长进行了短暂会面，打破了右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗输掉选举并逃往美国后的僵局。卢比奥表示，特朗普总统决定允许博尔索纳罗进入该国，但美国政府并未为此次旅行提供便利。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Trump calls Iran conflict a 'soft war,' insists US holds the cards ahead of midterm elections

paras.en: President Donald Trump sought to reassure voters the day before the midterm elections that Iran is not a "forever war," but a "soft war" that the United States could end at any time.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统试图在中期选举前一天向选民保证，伊朗不是一场“永远的战争”，而是一场美国可以随时结束的“软战争”。

paras.en: "We're not fighting a war … When was the last time we fired anything? This isn't a war, this is a very soft war," Trump said Monday on "Hannity."
paras.zh: “我们不是在打一场战争……我们最后一次开枪是什么时候？这不是一场战争，这是一场非常软的战争，”特朗普周一在“汉尼提”节目中说道。

paras.en: Iran could be a key deciding issue as voters go to the polls on Election Day Tuesday as Americans continue to grapple with surging gas prices and the economic fallout from the United States’ conflict, which began eight months ago.
paras.zh: 随着选民在周二选举日前往投票站，伊朗可能成为一个关键的决定性问题，因为美国人继续应对飙升的汽油价格和八个月前开始的美国冲突造成的经济影响。

paras.en: "What’s a war? A war is fighting. Take a look at World War I, World War II. When was the last time you saw us fighting with them? We go months and months, we talk," Trump told host Sean Hannity.
paras.zh: “什么是战争？战争正在打。看看第一次世界大战、第二次世界大战。你最后一次看到我们与他们战斗是什么时候？我们几个月又几个月地交谈，”特朗普告诉主持人肖恩·汉尼提。

paras.en: "This is not much of a war, Sean, because there hasn't been shooting for months."
paras.zh: “肖恩，这算不上一场战争，因为已经好几个月没有发生枪击事件了。”

paras.en: Trump’s comments come shortly after the United States struck Iran’s Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz Monday after Iran fired at a U.S. aircraft. Officials confirmed to Fox News that the "defensive" strike does not indicate a return to full-blown U.S. military strikes in Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普发表上述言论前不久，伊朗向一架美国飞机开火，美国周一袭击了霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗格什姆岛。官员们向福克斯新闻证实，“防御性”打击并不意味着美国将恢复对伊朗的全面军事打击。

paras.en: The president said Monday that he was in no hurry to resume military strikes against Iran but warned that the U.S. will give Iran "the hammer" soon if the latest round of peace talks are not fruitful.
paras.zh: 总统周一表示，他并不急于恢复对伊朗的军事打击，但警告说，如果最新一轮和谈没有成果，美国将很快向伊朗“敲击”。

paras.en: "With [Operation] Midnight Hammer, we bombed out all of their potential nuclear power. Now we have might have to go after Pickaxe [Mountain], but that's not a big deal. We can do it in literally one hour," Trump told Fox News.
paras.zh: “通过午夜之锤行动，我们炸毁了他们所有潜在的核力量。现在我们可能不得不追击镐山，但这不是什么大问题。我们实际上可以在一个小时内完成，”特朗普告诉福克斯新闻。

paras.en: "This isn't like a war that's going on, there’s no war raging," he added. "It could happen if they don't make a deal. But they want to make a deal very badly, and there is a very good chance we make a deal."
paras.zh: “这不像是一场正在发生的战争，没有激烈的战争，”他补充道。 “如果他们不达成协议，这种情况就有可能发生。但他们非常想达成协议，而我们达成协议的机会很大。”

paras.en: The financial toll of the Iran conflict has emerged as a political liability for Republicans ahead of Election Day as the Pentagon estimates the war has cost taxpayers more than $47 billion.
paras.zh: 伊朗冲突造成的经济损失已成为选举日之前共和党人的政治负担，五角大楼估计这场战争已使纳税人损失超过 470 亿美元。

paras.en: President Trump, however, dismissed criticism of the staggering price tag, describing the expense as "peanuts" and saying that the war was necessary to disarm Iran from building a nuclear weapon.
paras.zh: 然而，特朗普总统驳回了对这一惊人价格的批评，称这笔费用“微不足道”，并表示，为了解除伊朗制造核武器的武装，这场战争是必要的。

paras.en: "Their military is gone, their navy is gone, their air force is gone, their anti-aircraft is gone, and they have some missiles, but they don't have many of them – very little capacity to build more. They have drones, but they don't have very many, they have very little capacity to build more," he said.
paras.zh: “他们的军队消失了，他们的海军消失了，他们的空军消失了，他们的防空武器消失了，他们有一些导弹，但他们没有很多——几乎没有能力建造更多。他们有无人机，但他们没有太多，他们没有能力建造更多，”他说。

paras.en: "What we’ve done is amazing," the president continued.
paras.zh: “我们所做的事情令人惊叹，”总统继续说道。

paras.en: Trump said the U.S. is dealing from a position of "total strength" and that the conflict can be ended "at any time."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，美国正在以“全面实力”的立场进行应对，冲突可以“随时”结束。

articles.title: Bears prove they are NFC North's most complete team with commanding win over Seahawks

paras.en: Don’t let the standings fool you: the Chicago Bears are the darling of the loaded NFC North, and they proved why on "Monday Night Football" against the Seattle Seahawks.
paras.zh: 不要让排名欺骗了您：芝加哥熊队是国联北方队的宠儿，他们在“周一橄榄球之夜”对阵西雅图海鹰队的比赛中证明了这一点。

paras.en: Lumen Field and the "12s" never make it easy for a road team to play against the Seattle Seahawks, and it doesn’t help that this group just gave the Kansas City Chiefs its first loss of the season in Week 7.
paras.zh: 流明球场和“12人队”从来不会让客场球队对阵西雅图海鹰队变得容易，更糟糕的是，这支球队刚刚在第七周让堪萨斯城酋长队遭遇了本赛季的首场失利。

paras.en: But the Bears, led by head coach Ben Johnson and quarterback Caleb Williams, don’t seem to care where their games are held each week.
paras.zh: 但在主教练本·约翰逊和四分卫凯莱布·威廉姆斯的带领下，熊队似乎并不关心每周的比赛在哪里举行。

paras.en: Their offense, and a defense that saw All-Pro Jeffery Simmons show out in his first game with the club since he was traded, made problems for the reigning Super Bowl champions in a 34-17 victory to improve to 6-2 on the season.
paras.zh: 他们的进攻，以及全职业选手杰弗里·西蒙斯（ Jeffery Simmons ）自被交易以来在俱乐部的第一场比赛中表现出的防守，在34-17的胜利中为卫冕超级碗冠军带来了问题，在本赛季提高到6-2。

paras.en: The Minnesota Vikings are still in first place in the division at 6-1, but there are a lot of questions about their offensive struggles compared to a suffocating defense that has kept them on the right side of close games thus far.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达维京人队仍以 6 胜 1 负的战绩位居分区第一，但与迄今为止使他们在势均力敌的比赛中处于右侧的令人窒息的防守相比，他们的进攻表现存在很多疑问。

paras.en: The Detroit Lions gave the Vikings their first loss to move to 5-2, while the Green Bay Packers got the job done against the Carolina Panthers on "Thursday Night Football" to get to 5-3.
paras.zh: 底特律雄狮队以 5-2 的比分击败了维京人队，这是他们的首场失利，而绿湾包装工队则在“周四橄榄球之夜”中击败了卡罗莱纳黑豹队，将比分追至 5-3。

paras.en: It’s loaded from top to bottom, but the Bears appear to be the most complete team out of this pack.
paras.zh: 它从上到下都有，但熊队似乎是这支球队中最完整的球队。

paras.en: Just look at what Williams and company accomplished against the league’s best defense in terms of yards allowed per game (233.9). The Bears totaled 363 yards, 237 of which were through the air on big chunk plays including a 23-yarder to Luther Burden III, who caught Williams’ only touchdown pass of the contest, and a 24-yard strike to Rome Odunze, who led the team with 87 yards on four receptions.
paras.zh: 只要看看威廉姆斯和他的团队在对抗联盟最佳防守（场均允许码数（233.9））时所取得的成绩即可。熊队总共推进了 363 码，其中 237 码是通过大块进攻完成的，其中包括路德·伯登三世 (Luther Burden III) 的 23 码传球，后者接住了威廉姆斯在比赛中唯一的达阵传球，以及罗马·奥敦泽 (Rome Odunze) 的 24 码射门，后者在四次接球中以 87 码领先全队。

paras.en: Williams became the first quarterback to eclipse 200 passing yards against this vaunted defense.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯成为第一个在这种引以为傲的防守下传球码数超过 200 码的四分卫。

paras.en: Then, there’s the ground game, Johnson’s bread and butter as he continues to draw up the right concepts with a disciplined offensive line that executes who D’Andre Swift can plow his way into the end zone three times in the game.
paras.zh: 然后是地面比赛，约翰逊的面包和黄油，因为他继续制定正确的概念和纪律严明的进攻线，执行德安德烈·斯威夫特可以在比赛中三次冲入达阵区的人。

paras.en: But the Bears’ defense are no slouches either, coming into the game ninth in yards allowed and points allowed. With Simmons on board, Chicago was proving there are all-in for this championship window, and the veteran defensive tackle was present throughout his first-ever Bears game.
paras.zh: 但熊队的防守也毫不逊色，在比赛中，允许码数和允许得分排名第九。有了西蒙斯，芝加哥队证明了在这个冠军窗口中可以全力以赴，这位经验丰富的防守截锋在他的第一场熊队比赛中都在场。

paras.en: He finished tied for the team lead in combined tackles (6), while collecting a sack and two tackles for loss. James Lynch also forced a key interception when it was 27-17 with six minutes to play, leading to Swift’s third touchdown of the game.
paras.zh: 他在总铲断数上并列全队第一（6 次），同时还收获了 1 次擒杀和 2 次铲断。比赛还剩 6 分钟时，詹姆斯·林奇 (James Lynch) 还强行拦截了一次关键的拦截，帮助斯威夫特 (Swift) 在比赛中第三次达阵，比分是 27-17。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Sam Darnold and the Seahawks have shown spurts of that Super Bowl-level play that got them the Vince Lombardi Trophy last season. However, it hasn’t been as consistent as they would like.
paras.zh: 与此同时，萨姆·达诺德和海鹰队在上赛季展现了超级碗级别的表现，并为他们赢得了文斯·隆巴迪奖杯。然而，它并没有像他们希望的那样一致。

paras.en: They made a trade themselves before the Bears landed Simmons, acquiring left guard Quenton Nelson from the Indianapolis Colts to beef up their offensive line, help the run game and keep Darnold upright. And with rookie Jadarian Price back from injury, and Zach Charbonnet making his season debut after recovering from an injury last season, the run game was supposed to be better heading into Week 8.
paras.zh: 在熊队得到西蒙斯之前，他们自己进行了交易，从印第安纳波利斯小马队得​​到了左后卫昆顿·尼尔森，以加强他们的进攻线，帮助跑动比赛并让达诺德保持直立。随着新秀贾达里安·普莱斯(Jadarian Price)伤愈复出，扎克·查博内特(Zach Charbonnet)在上赛季伤愈后首次亮相，跑动比赛应该会在进入第8周时表现更好。

paras.en: The Seahawks had just 81 yards rushing, and if it weren’t for another 100-yard-plus game for receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who scored just before the first half ended, this game may have gotten out of hand.
paras.zh: 海鹰队冲球只有81码，如果不是接球手贾克森·史密斯-恩吉巴在上半场结束前又冲球100码以上，这场比赛可能会失控。

paras.en: The Seahawks are still in the hunt with a lot of season left to play, but the Bears made a clear statement in a hostile Seattle environment on Monday night.
paras.zh: 海鹰队仍在寻找机会，还有很多赛季要打，但熊队在周一晚上敌对的西雅图环境中发表了明确的声明。

articles.title: Mamdani threatens to sue Trump admin over ICE's use of city-owned lots for immigration enforcement

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, a Democrat, threatened to sue the Trump administration over Immigration and Customs Enforcement's (ICE) reported use of city-owned parking lots to stage immigration enforcement operations without the city's authorization.
paras.zh: 纽约市市长、民主党人佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 威胁要起诉特朗普政府，因为移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 报告称，未经市政府授权，使用市政府拥有的停车场进行移民执法行动。

paras.en: In a letter addressed to Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, acting ICE Director David Venturella and ICE New York field office Director Kenneth Genalo, Mamdani said he is "deeply troubled" by reports of ICE agents "using property owned by the City of New York to stage enforcement operations," which the mayor said is unauthorized and illegal.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼在写给国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林（Markwayne Mullin）、ICE 代理主任戴维·文图拉（David Venturella）和 ICE 纽约办事处主任肯尼思·杰纳洛（Kenneth Genalo）的信中表示，他对 ICE 特工“利用纽约市拥有的财产进行执法行动”的报道“深感不安”，市长称这是未经授权且非法的。

paras.en: "This use of City property in furtherance of federal immigration enforcement is unauthorized and is therefore illegal, endangers City residents, and sows fear among those who seek to access City property," Mamdani wrote in the letter. "If your agents continue any unauthorized use of these lots, New York City will take legal action to prevent this unlawful commandeering of City property."
paras.zh: 马姆达尼在信中写道：“利用城市财产促进联邦移民执法是未经授权的，因此是非法的，危及城市居民，并在那些寻求获得城市财产的人中播下恐惧的种子。” “如果你的代理人继续未经授权使用这些地块，纽约市将采取法律行动，以防止这种非法征用城市财产的行为。”

paras.en: According to the mayor's letter, ICE agents have reportedly parked their vehicles and conducted meetings in several city-owned, unstaffed parking lots, including in a parking lot at Van Cortlandt Park in the Bronx as well as in parking lots along 111th Street on the west side of Flushing Meadows Corona Park in Queens, which is located next to a city-run preschool and several cultural institutions welcome hundreds of children and families every day.
paras.zh: 根据市长的信，ICE 特工在几个市政府拥有的无人值守的停车场停放车辆并举行会议，其中包括布朗克斯区 Van Cortlandt 公园的停车场，以及皇后区法拉盛梅多斯可罗娜公园西侧 111 街沿线的停车场，该公园毗邻市政府运营的幼儿园和几个文化机构，每天接待数百名儿童和家庭。

paras.en: "ICE has not secured any authorization from the City to use these lots for immigration enforcement. To be clear: the City does not authorize ICE using its property in this manner," Mamdani wrote.
paras.zh: “ICE 尚未获得市政府使用这些土地进行移民执法的任何授权。需要明确的是：市政府并未授权 ICE 以这种方式使用其财产，”马姆达尼写道。

paras.en: "Parking lots connected to City parks are reserved for the safe use and enjoyment of New Yorkers and visitors who wish to use our parks," he continued. "Use of these lots for other purposes, including ICE’s reported use of these lots, amounts to unauthorized activity on City property. Accordingly, you must immediately issue guidance to your agents prohibiting them from using any City lots to stage or conduct enforcement operations."
paras.zh: “与城市公园相连的停车场是为纽约人和希望使用我们公园的游客安全使用和享受而保留的，”他继续说道。 “将这些地块用于其他目的，包括 ICE 报告的对这些地块的使用，相当于对城市财产进行未经授权的活动。因此，您必须立即向您的代理人发出指导，禁止他们使用任何城市地块来开展或开展执法行动。”

paras.en: Mamdani added that New York City "deeply values its immigrant communities and will continue to use all available lawful means to ensure their safety, well-being, and ability to navigate the City and its resources without fear."
paras.zh: 马姆达尼补充说，纽约市“深深重视其移民社区，并将继续使用一切可用的合法手段，确保他们的安全、福祉以及毫无恐惧地驾驭这座城市及其资源的能力。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to the Department of Homeland Security for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道已联系国土安全部征求意见。

paras.en: Last month, Mamdani and other New York Democratic leaders pushed for the city’s private parking lot owners to ban ICE from their properties.
paras.zh: 上个月，马姆达尼和其他纽约民主党领导人敦促该市的私人停车场业主禁止 ICE 进入其物业。

paras.en: "In solidarity with immigrant New Yorkers and in our shared commitment to the City we love, we ask that you do not rent, lend or otherwise make your property available to ICE as a staging area for its enforcement operations," the mayor wrote in a letter to property owners and operators.
paras.zh: 市长在给业主和经营者的一封信中写道：“为了声援纽约移民，并为了我们对我们热爱的城市的共同承诺，我们要求您不要出租、出借或以其他方式将您的房产提供给 ICE 作为其执法行动的集结地。”

paras.en: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., were among more than 100 elected officials who signed on to Mamdani's October letter.
paras.zh: 纽约州参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默和纽约州众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯等 100 多名民选官员签署了马姆达尼 10 月份的信函。

paras.en: Mamdani has previously pushed for ICE to be abolished, including after an ICE agent shot and killed Mexican national Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston in July and after another ICE agent shot and wounded Dominican national Oscar Belgal during an enforcement operation in New York City last month.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼此前曾推动废除 ICE，包括 7 月份一名 ICE 特工在休斯敦枪杀了墨西哥国民洛伦佐·萨尔加多·阿劳霍 (Lorenzo Salgado Araujo)，以及上个月在纽约市的一次执法行动中另一名 ICE 特工枪杀了多米尼加国民奥斯卡·贝尔加尔 (Oscar Belgal)。

articles.title: US reportedly strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island as Vance voices optimism about a deal
articles.author: Jonathan Yerushalmy

paras.en: The US launched limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island late on Monday, according to reports in US media, hours after vice-president JD Vance said he was optimistic diplomatic efforts to end the war were moving in the right direction.
paras.zh: 据美国媒体报道，美国周一晚间对伊朗格什姆岛发动了有限打击，就在几小时前，副总统万斯表示，他对结束战争的外交努力正在朝着正确的方向前进感到乐观。

paras.en: The strikes were reported as being “defensive”, and not thought to be a signal of a return to full hostilities, but came on the eve of crucial midterm elections in which Donald Trump’s Republican party is expected to be punished by voters for the cascading effect the war has had on the US cost of living.
paras.zh: 据报道，这些袭击是“防御性”的，并不被认为是全面敌对状态恢复的信号，但袭击发生在关键的中期选举前夕，预计唐纳德·特朗普领导的共和党将因战争对美国生活成本造成的连锁反应而受到选民的惩罚。

paras.en: When asked earlier on Monday whether he had considered resuming strikes on Iran after Tuesday’s midterm elections, Trump replied “no”.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，当被问及是否考虑在周二中期选举后恢复对伊朗的打击时，特朗普回答说“没有”。

paras.en: Several explosions were heard on Qeshm Island on Monday evening, according to Iranian state media, with local outlets describing their cause as unclear.
paras.zh: 据伊朗官方媒体报道，周一晚间格什姆岛发生多起爆炸，当地媒体称爆炸原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: The strikes – first reported by the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) – targeted surface to air missiles being used against US assets, according to Reuters and the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据路透社和美联社报道，此次袭击是由《华尔街日报》（WSJ）首先报道的，其目标是针对美国资产使用的地对空导弹。

paras.en: US Central Command did not immediately respond to a request for comment from the Reuters news agency, but the WSJ described the attacks as part of a series of strikes carried out against the country in recent weeks that have not been made public.
paras.zh: 美国中央司令部没有立即回应路透社的置评请求，但《华尔街日报》将这些袭击描述为最近几周针对该国发动的一系列袭击的一部分，但这些袭击并未公开。

paras.en: The paper reported the recent strikes had been carried out on a smaller scale and purposefully kept secret by the Trump administration so as not to signal any intent of resuming the military campaign against Iran.
paras.zh: 该报报道称，最近的袭击规模较小，特朗普政府有意保密，以免发出恢复针对伊朗军事行动的意图。

paras.en: The US has targeted Qeshm Island on multiple occasions throughout the war. Positioned in the mouth of the strait of Hormuz, the island has been used in the past to launch attacks on shipping in the waterway.
paras.zh: 整个战争期间，美国多次瞄准格什姆岛。该岛位于霍尔木兹海峡口，过去曾被用来对水道上的船只发动攻击。

paras.en: Despite attacks having ceased in recent weeks, Iran has continued to enforce its closure of the strait by targeting oil tankers, shipping containers and other vessels attempting to transit the waterway.
paras.zh: 尽管袭击在最近几周已经停止，但伊朗继续通过针对油轮、集装箱和其他试图通过该水道的船只来强制关闭该海峡。

paras.en: If confirmed, the attack would mark the first publicly known strike by the US on Iran in weeks. On Monday Vance said that he and Trump were optimistic about securing a deal with Iran, after Tehran revealed indirect negotiations with Washington.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这次袭击将标志着美国几周来首次对伊朗发动公开的袭击。周一，在德黑兰透露与华盛顿进行间接谈判后，万斯表示，他和特朗普对与伊朗达成协议持乐观态度。

paras.en: “The president and I both feel pretty good about the prospects for potentially coming to a negotiated settlement,” Vance told reporters. “We’ve certainly made some progress. We’ll see if we can make some more.”
paras.zh: 万斯对记者表示：“总统和我都对通过谈判达成解决方案的前景感到非常满意。” “我们确实取得了一些进展。我们将看看能否取得更多进展。”

paras.en: Speaking to Fox News hours before the polls opened in the US on Tuesday, Trump continued to play down the significance of the conflict and its effects on the US economy.
paras.zh: 周二美国投票开始前几个小时，特朗普在接受福克斯新闻采访时继续淡化冲突的严重性及其对美国经济的影响。

paras.en: “There’s no war raging. It could happen if they don’t make a deal, but they want to make a deal very badly and there’s a very good chance we make a deal.”
paras.zh: “没有激烈的战争。如果他们不达成协议，这种情况就可能发生，但他们非常想达成协议，而且我们很有可能达成协议。”

paras.en: However, he told host Sean Hannity that the US might still “have to go after Pickaxe mountain” – referring to a fortified underground site in central Iran that is a suspected nuclear facility – but said that it would not be a “big deal” and could be done in “one hour”.
paras.zh: 然而，他告诉主持人肖恩·汉尼蒂，美国可能仍然“必须追击镐山”——指的是伊朗中部一个被怀疑为核设施的强化地下设施——但他表示，这不会是一个“大问题”，可以在“一个小时”内完成。

paras.en: Speaking from Washington in his closing message of the midterms campaign, Trump hailed a sharp drop in oil prices that came as his administration touted a renewed diplomatic efforts being made to end the war. Rising petrol prices have caused by the war have become a signature issue of the midterm elections, with polls showing voters likely to punish Republicans for the effect on the cost of living.
paras.zh: 特朗普在华盛顿发表的中期选举闭幕致辞中对油价大幅下跌表示欢迎，而此时他的政府宣称正在为结束战争做出新的外交努力。战争导致的汽油价格上涨已成为中期选举的一个标志性问题，民意调查显示，选民可能会因为对生活成本的影响而惩罚共和党人。

articles.title: Bullock doesn’t see ‘economy cracking at this point’ – as it happened
articles.author: Achol Arok and Nick Visser

paras.en: The RBA governor, Michele Bullock, said it was “not the news that many Australians want to hear”, but it would prevent “even worse pain down the track”.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行行长米歇尔·布洛克表示，这“不是许多澳大利亚人想听到的消息”，但它将防止“未来出现更严重的痛苦”。

paras.en: The Australian stock market ended higher after the central bank did what it was expected to do and hiked interest rates for the fifth time this calendar year.
paras.zh: 在央行按照预期行事并今年第五次加息后，澳大利亚股市收高。

paras.en: Tim Wilson rejects Gallagher’s blaming of parliament for lack of savings policy
paras.zh: 蒂姆·威尔逊否认加拉格尔指责议会缺乏储蓄政策

paras.en: The shadow treasurer, Tim Wilson, has rejected Katy Gallagher’s accusation that parliament is to blame for the lack of spending-saving policies.
paras.zh: 影子财长蒂姆·威尔逊(Tim Wilson)驳斥了凯蒂·加拉格尔(Katy Gallagher)关于议会应为缺乏支出节约政策负责的指控。

paras.en: Speaking to ABC’s Afternoon Briefing, he said:
paras.zh: 他在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 下午简报时表示：

paras.en: We wrote to the government at the start of the year and said: let’s have a bipartisan approach to reducing government spending. The government rejected that.
paras.zh: 我们在年初写信给政府说：让我们采取两党合作的方法来减少政府支出。政府拒绝了这一点。

paras.en: Every time we have asked them to audit government expenditure to see if it is financing organised crime, they have rejected that.
paras.zh: 每次我们要求他们审计政府支出，看看是否资助有组织犯罪，他们都拒绝了。

paras.en: Wilson said he does not believe the government is committed to delivering net savings.
paras.zh: 威尔逊表示，他不相信政府致力于实现净储蓄。

paras.en: They will never commit to that because, as we know and history shows, for every $2 of savings they claim to find, they go on and spend another $3, and it ends up only stoking inflation further.
paras.zh: 他们永远不会承诺这一点，因为正如我们所知和历史表明的那样，他们声称每节省 2 美元，他们就会继续花费另外 3 美元，最终只会进一步加剧通货膨胀。

paras.en: Katy Gallagher says parliament to blame for lack of government savings
paras.zh: 凯蒂·加拉格尔表示，政府储蓄不足应归咎于议会

paras.en: The finance minister, Katy Gallagher, has blamed the parliament for blocking the government’s attempts to introduce spending-saving policies.
paras.zh: 财政部长凯蒂·加拉格尔 (Katy Gallagher) 指责议会阻止政府试图推出节约开支的政策。

paras.en: Speaking to ABC’s Afternoon Briefing, the Labor minister said:
paras.zh: 劳工部长在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 下午简报时表示：

paras.en: I hear a lot of calls for cuts to government spending. I don’t hear as many specifics about where people would like to see that come from.
paras.zh: 我听到很多要求削减政府开支的呼声。我没有听到太多关于人们希望看到它来自哪里的具体细节。

paras.en: In fact, we’ve got savings in the parliament now that the parliament is refusing to pass.
paras.zh: 事实上，既然议会拒绝通过，我们已经在议会节省了开支。

paras.en: Asked whether the government intends to deliver net savings in the next budget, Gallagher said:
paras.zh: 当被问及政府是否打算在下一个预算中实现净节省时，加拉格尔说：

paras.en: We’ll be making responsible savings decisions, in line with the job we have to do. I say, in the last two updates, our policy decisions line has contributed positively to the budget overall. That shows you the approach that Jim [Chalmers] and I have taken, and we’ll continue to bring that approach to the decisions we’ve got over the next few weeks as we finalise them.
paras.zh: 我们将根据我们必须做的工作做出负责任的储蓄决定。我说，在最近两次更新中，我们的政策决策对整体预算做出了积极贡献。这向您展示了吉姆（查尔默斯）和我所采取的方法，我们将继续将这种方法应用到未来几周内我们最终确定的决策中。

paras.en: It’s not unusual for a finance minister, or a treasurer, or a prime minister to have an ambitious appetite around savings, but we need to work through our processes respectfully.
paras.zh: 对于财政部长、财务主管或总理来说，对储蓄抱有雄心勃勃的胃口并不罕见，但我们需要尊重地完成我们的流程。

paras.en: Bullock says she doesn’t see the ‘economy cracking at this point’
paras.zh: 布洛克表示，她认为“目前经济不会崩溃”

paras.en: Bullock says she doesn’t “see the economy cracking at this point” even though some people will feel like they are experiencing a recession.
paras.zh: 布洛克表示，她“目前还没有看到经济崩溃”，尽管有些人会觉得自己正在经历经济衰退。

paras.en: The decision to raise interest rates for a fifth time this year will face inevitable accusations the RBA is pushing the country into an economic downturn.
paras.zh: 今年第五次加息的决定将不可避免地面临澳大利亚央行正在将国家推入经济低迷的指责。

paras.en: Bullock pushes back against that framing:
paras.zh: 布洛克反驳了这一框架：

paras.en: Our central forecasts do not see us going into recession, but it does see growth slowing quite markedly.
paras.zh: 我们的核心预测并没有看到我们陷入衰退，但确实看到增长明显放缓。

paras.en: It shows that consumption is quite sluggish, and I think that is going to make people feel like it’s a recession because they feel poorer, their spending can’t grow very quickly because their incomes aren’t growing very quickly.
paras.zh: 它表明消费相当低迷，我认为这会让人们感觉这是一场衰退，因为他们感觉更穷，他们的支出无法快速增长，因为他们的收入增长不是很快。

paras.en: Australian share market ends higher after RBA rate hike
paras.zh: 澳洲联储加息后澳洲股市收高

paras.en: The Australian stock market ended higher after the central bank did what it was expected to do and hiked interest rates for the fifth time this calendar year.
paras.zh: 在央行按照预期行事并今年第五次加息后，澳大利亚股市收高。

paras.en: The main S&P/ASX200 index rose 30.3 points, or 0.3%, to 8886.8, as the broader All Ordinaries gained 31.7 points, or 0.4%, to 9008.9.
Most of the market’s 11 sectors were in the green, with the major materials and consumer stocks leading the way, while the energy sector carried most of the loss-makers.
paras.zh: 市场11个板块中大部分上涨，其中主要材料股和消费股领涨，而能源板块则大部分亏损。

paras.en: The Reserve Bank board ended its two-day meeting on monetary policy on Tuesday with a 25 basis point rise in the cash interest rate to 4.85%.
paras.zh: 周二，储备银行董事会结束了为期两天的货币政策会议，将现金利率上调 25 个基点至 4.85%。

paras.en: The Australian dollar was buying 69.77 US cents, down from 70.21 US cents at 5pm on Monday.
paras.zh: 澳元兑换 69.77 美分，低于周一下午 5 点的 70.21 美分。

paras.en: Bullock asked about effect of US-Israel war in Iran on interest rates
paras.zh: 布洛克询问美以战争对伊朗利率的影响

paras.en: Guardian Australia’s economics editor, Patrick Commins, asks Bullock whether the RBA would have raised rates if oil prices had stayed low.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报经济编辑帕特里克·康明斯询问布洛克，如果油价保持在低位，澳大利亚央行是否会加息。

paras.en: In other words, what would have happened had the US and Israel not launched strikes against Iran?
paras.zh: 换句话说，如果美国和以色列没有对伊朗发动打击，会发生什么？

paras.en: Bullock gives a nuanced response, pointing out that Australia already had a problem with “excess demand” that required cooling.
paras.zh: 布洛克给出了细致入微的回应，指出澳大利亚已经存在需要降温的“需求过剩”问题。

paras.en: Now, would that have meant that we had to go up the same amount? I don’t know the answer to that.
paras.zh: 现在，这是否意味着我们必须上涨同样的金额？我不知道答案。

paras.en: It’s possible that it’s caused interest rates to mean they have to be a little bit higher.
paras.zh: 这可能导致利率必须更高一点。

paras.en: Bullock goes on to articulate an economic risk posed by raising inflation expectations caused by high oil prices: as consumers resign themselves to higher prices, businesses lift theirs ahead of anticipated rising costs, creating a self-fulfilling loop that entrenches inflation.
paras.zh: 布洛克接着阐述了高油价导致通胀预期上升所带来的经济风险：随着消费者接受更高的价格，企业在预期成本上涨之前提高价格，从而形成一个自我实现的循环，加剧通胀。

paras.en: RBA independence from government ‘a two-way street’, Bullock says
paras.zh: 布洛克表示，澳洲联储独立于政府是“双向的”

paras.en: Michele Bullock has described independence as a “two-way street”, noting that she doesn’t tell the government what to spend on, and that the government doesn’t tell the RBA what to do with rates.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·布洛克将独立描述为“双向路”，并指出她不会告诉政府该花什么，政府也不会告诉澳大利亚央行如何处理利率。

paras.en: The role of public sector spending in fuelling inflation looms large, with Labor under pressure from critics over five rate hikes this year.
paras.zh: 公共部门支出在推高通胀方面的作用日益凸显，工党今年面临五次加息的批评压力。

paras.en: Bullock says that governments need to decide on how much spending is required to provide for the nation. She says:
paras.zh: 布洛克说，政府需要决定为国家提供多少支出。她说：

paras.en: But that is for governments to decide. Independence is a two-way street. I don’t tell them what to do with fiscal policy. They don’t tell me what to do with interest rates.
paras.zh: 但这是由政府决定的。独立是一条双向路。我不会告诉他们如何处理财政政策。他们没有告诉我如何处理利率。

paras.en: Unemployment and housing concerns behind board split: RBA governor
paras.zh: 董事会分裂背后的失业和住房问题：澳洲联储行长

paras.en: More from Michele Bullock’s press conference:
paras.zh: 米歇尔·布洛克新闻发布会的更多内容：

paras.en: The RBA decision to raise rates was split, with three members of the rate-setting board preferring a hold, while six voted to raise.
paras.zh: 澳洲联储关于加息的决定存在分歧，三名利率制定委员会成员倾向于维持不变，而六名成员则投票支持加息。

paras.en: Bullock says those in favour of a hold were concerned about risks to the economy, including rising unemployment and housing weakness. Bullock said:
paras.zh: 布洛克表示，那些支持持有债券的人担心经济面临的风险，包括失业率上升和住房市场疲软。布洛克说：

paras.en: They felt that there were potential downside risks in these circumstances, particularly since we’d already done four interest rate rises, and maybe we should wait a bit longer to get some more data to test that.
paras.zh: 他们认为在这种情况下存在潜在的下行风险，特别是因为我们已经加息四次，也许我们应该等待更长的时间以获得更多数据来测试这一点。

paras.en: Bullock says market watchers shouldn’t interpret the split decision as a sign the RBA won’t raise further if inflation risks materialise.
paras.zh: 布洛克表示，市场观察人士不应将这一分歧决定视为如果通胀风险出现，澳大利亚央行不会进一步加息的迹象。

paras.en: Michele Bullock addresses media following rate hike decision
paras.zh: 米歇尔·布洛克在加息决定后向媒体发表讲话

paras.en: The RBA governor, Michele Bullock, says “this is not the news that many Australians want to hear, but it is what’s needed to get inflation down”.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行行长米歇尔·布洛克表示，“这不是许多澳大利亚人想听到的消息，但这是降低通胀所需的”。

paras.en: She says “some pain now will prevent even worse pain down the track”.
paras.zh: 她说“现在的一些痛苦可以防止以后出现更严重的痛苦”。

paras.en: I understand that today’s decision is going to be difficult for Australians with mortgages, many of whom are already managing large repayments.
paras.zh: 我知道，对于拥有抵押贷款的澳大利亚人来说，今天的决定将很困难，他们中的许多人已经在管理大笔还款。

paras.en: But households with mortgages are not the only Australians doing it tough. Every household is dealing with higher prices for groceries, electricity, insurance, and other essentials.
paras.zh: 但有抵押贷款的家庭并不是唯一处境艰难的澳大利亚人。每个家庭都面临着食品杂货、电力、保险和其他必需品价格上涨的问题。

paras.en: High inflation is particularly painful for Australians on lower incomes, including people who rent and have little or no savings to fall back on.
paras.zh: 高通胀对于收入较低的澳大利亚人来说尤其痛苦，其中包括那些租房且几乎没有或根本没有储蓄可以依靠的人。

paras.en: The comments were made in opening remarks to journalists in Sydney ahead of questions.
paras.zh: 这些评论是在悉尼记者提问前发表的开场白中发表的。

paras.en: Several economists are interpreting the RBA’s statement accompanying the rate hike as “dovish”, which means further hikes are less likely.
paras.zh: 一些经济学家将澳大利亚央行在加息时发表的声明解读为“鸽派”，这意味着进一步加息的可能性较小。

paras.en: UBS economists describe the decision as “clearly dovish” while Anthony Malouf, economist at Ebury, says there is an “absence of a clear tightening bias”.
paras.zh: 瑞银(UBS)经济学家称这一决定“明显鸽派”，而伊伯里(Ebury)经济学家安东尼·马卢夫(Anthony Malouf)表示，“不存在明显的紧缩倾向”。

paras.en: The Australian dollar also immediately dropped against its US counterpart after the decision, which shows traders do not believe the central bank is, at this stage, looking to hike much further.
paras.zh: 决定公布后，澳元兑美元汇率也立即下跌，这表明交易员不相信央行现阶段打算进一步加息。

paras.en: This could all change if inflation remains elevated, but for the moment, some economists and currency traders believe this could be the last hike, at least for a while.
paras.zh: 如果通胀持续高企，这一切都可能会改变，但目前，一些经济学家和货币交易员认为，这可能是最后一次加息，至少在一段时间内如此。

paras.en: Chalmers says rate hike will be ‘difficult news’ for Australians already paying 'hefty price'
paras.zh: 查尔默斯表示，对于已经付出“高昂代价”的澳大利亚人来说，加息将是“艰难的消息”

paras.en: Jim Chalmers, the treasurer, is speaking now after the RBA’s decision. He said:
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行做出决定后，财务主管吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 发表讲话。他说：

paras.en: Today’s decision was widely expected, but that doesn’t make it any easier for Australian families and businesses to absorb. It will be difficult news for many Australians who are already paying a hefty price for circumstances outside of their control.
paras.zh: 今天的决定是人们普遍预期的，但这并不能让澳大利亚家庭和企业更容易接受。对于许多已经为无法控制的情况付出高昂代价的澳大利亚人来说，这将是一个艰难的消息。

paras.en: He pointed to the ongoing war in the Middle East as a major factor in inflation:
paras.zh: 他指出，中东持续的战争是通货膨胀的一个主要因素：

paras.en: The war’s in its ninth month and its re-escalation is putting sustained upward pressure on inflation.
paras.zh: 战争已进入第九个月，其重新升级给通胀带来了持续的上行压力。

paras.en: It’s weighing on growth and its end can’t come soon enough for the global economy or for Australians facing cost of living pressures.
paras.zh: 它正在拖累经济增长，而且对于全球经济或面临生活成本压力的澳大利亚人来说，它的结束还不够快。

paras.en: Macquarie Bank announces it will pass rate rise on
paras.zh: 麦格理银行宣布将通过加息

paras.en: Macquarie Bank has already announced it will pass on the interest rate rise to mortgage holders.
paras.zh: 麦格理银行已经宣布将把加息转嫁给抵押贷款持有人。

paras.en: The bank said it will increase variable home loans by 0.25%, effective 19 November. It will also increase ongoing variable rates paid on its transactions and savings accounts by 0.25%, a boon to savers. Ben Perham, the head of personal banking, said:
paras.zh: 该银行表示将从 11 月 19 日起将可变住房贷款增加 0.25%。它还会将其交易和储蓄账户支付的持续浮动利率提高 0.25%，这对储户来说是一个福音。个人银行业务主管 Ben Perham 表示：

paras.en: With household budgets already feeling the strain, today’s decision by the RBA will be challenging for many Australians.
paras.zh: 由于家庭预算已经感受到压力，澳大利亚央行今天的决定对许多澳大利亚人来说将是一个挑战。

paras.en: To help our variable home loan customers prepare, we’re again waiting more than two weeks before this latest increase takes effect.
paras.zh: 为了帮助我们的可变住房贷款客户做好准备，我们再次等待两周多的时间才能最新的增加生效。

paras.en: The decision was not a unanimous one: six members of the RBA board voted to raise the cash rate, while three voted to leave it unchanged.
paras.zh: 这一决定并不是一致通过的：澳大利亚央行董事会的六名成员投票决定提高现金利率，而三名成员投票决定维持现金利率不变。

paras.en: The Board is conscious of the period in which inflation has been too high. Given the revised inflation outlook and the continuing upside risks, the Board judged that a further tightening in financial conditions is warranted to support the return of inflation to target.
paras.zh: 董事会意识到通货膨胀过高的时期。鉴于通胀前景的修正和持续的上行风险，理事会认为有必要进一步收紧金融状况，以支持通胀回归目标。

paras.en: The Board will continue to do what it considers necessary to bring inflation sustainably back to target.
paras.zh: 委员会将继续采取其认为必要的措施，使通胀可持续地回到目标水平。

articles.title: Australia’s social media ban ‘ill-thought-out’, Reddit argues in high court challenge
articles.author: Josh Taylor Technology reporter

paras.en: The Australian government’s rush to pass the under-16s social media ban legislation in 2024 led to “ill-thought-out, over-broad legislation” that has since been narrowed after Reddit sued the government, lawyers for the social media company told the high court on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 社交媒体公司的律师周二告诉高等法院，澳大利亚政府急于在 2024 年通过 16 岁以下社交媒体禁令立法，导致了“考虑不周、过于宽泛的立法”，在 Reddit 起诉政府后，该立法的范围缩小了。

paras.en: Reddit, one of the top 10 websites visited in the world, has challenged the teen social media ban on the grounds it impinges the implied freedom of political communication for under-16s.
paras.zh: Reddit 是全球访问量最大的 10 家网站之一，它对青少年社交媒体禁令提出了质疑，理由是它侵犯了 16 岁以下青少年隐含的政治交流自由。

paras.en: In oral arguments before the high court on Tuesday, Reddit’s counsel, Perry Herzfeld SC, argued in the years leading up to the ban legislation, a 2021 parliamentary inquiry on social media had not recommended introducing a ban, with the eSafety commissioner warning the inquiry at the time it would be a “blunt force approach”.
paras.zh: 周二，在高等法院的口头辩论中，Reddit 的律师 Perry Herzfeld SC 辩称，在禁令立法之前的几年里，2021 年议会对社交媒体的调查并未建议引入禁令，电子安全专员当时警告调查，这将是一种“生硬的手段”。

paras.en: When the government announced the ban in 2024, Reddit argued the legislation was introduced and passed within a week, with only 24 hours of submissions allowed.
paras.zh: 当政府于 2024 年宣布这项禁令时，Reddit 辩称该立法是在一周内提出并通过的，只允许在 24 小时内提交。

paras.en: “A process of this kind is likely to lead to ill-thought-out, over-broad legislation,” Herzfeld argued.
paras.zh: 赫茨菲尔德认为：“这种程序可能会导致考虑不周、过于宽泛的立法。”

paras.en: After eSafety announced Reddit would be included in the ban, and Reddit did not accept it met the definition of a social media platform under the law, the company announced the high court challenge to the law in late 2025.
paras.zh: 在 eSafety 宣布 Reddit 将被纳入禁令后，Reddit 不承认其符合法律规定的社交媒体平台的定义，该公司于 2025 年底宣布向高等法院挑战该法律。

paras.en: In March this year, the communications minister, Anika Wells, introduced new rules as part of the legislation that defines additional requirements for social media companies to meet the definition including logged-in features, recommendation features or endless scroll.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月，通信部长阿尼卡·威尔斯 (Anika Wells) 引入了新规则，作为立法的一部分，该立法规定了社交媒体公司满足定义的额外要求，包括登录功能、推荐功能或无限滚动。

paras.en: Herzfeld argued the ban does not address those factors specifically by a broad ban on under-16s accounts, and has argued it would be able to under different legislation – pointing to the digital duty of care legislation currently before the parliament.
paras.zh: 赫茨菲尔德认为，该禁令并没有通过广泛禁止 16 岁以下账户来具体解决这些因素，并认为可以根据不同的立法来解决这些问题，并指出目前正在议会审议的数字谨慎责任立法。

paras.en: Outside the court, Wells told reporters she wasn’t the minister at the time the legislation passed, but said the government’s arguments in response would be made in court.
paras.zh: 威尔斯在法庭外告诉记者，立法通过时她还不是部长，但表示政府的回应论点将在法庭上提出。

paras.en: Since the ban came into effect in December last year, more than 5 million user accounts the platforms understand belong to people aged under 16 across 10 platforms have been suspended or deactivated.
paras.zh: 自去年12月禁令生效以来，10个平台上超过500万个据平台所知属于16岁以下人士的用户账户已被暂停或停用。

paras.en: The platforms currently covered by the ban include Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Kick, X, Twitch and Threads.
paras.zh: 目前禁令涵盖的平台包括 Snapchat、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Instagram、Reddit、Kick、X、Twitch 和 Threads。

paras.en: The case centres around whether the effect of the ban limiting political communications is justified by what the government has said is a “credible risk” of harms such as mental health issues, sleeping problems and eating disorder issues.
paras.zh: 该案件的核心是，限制政治沟通的禁令的效果是否合理，因为政府所说的存在心理健康问题、睡眠问题和饮食失调问题等“可信风险”。

paras.en: Herzfeld told the court on Tuesday the ban prevents teenagers from actively engaging in political communications through subreddits such as r/Australia. While they can still view the content without an account, they can’t make their own posts, comment or upvote content, Reddit argued.
paras.zh: 赫茨菲尔德周二告诉法庭，该禁令阻止青少年通过 r/Australia 等 Reddit 子版块积极参与政治交流。 Reddit 辩称，虽然他们仍然可以在没有帐户的情况下查看内容，但他们无法发布自己的帖子、评论或点赞内容。

paras.en: Justice Jacqueline Gleeson expressed reservations when pointed to examples of high-profile teens being politically engaged in social media – such as 6News’ Leo Puglisi, who began his news site at the age of 11.
paras.zh: 当提到知名青少年在社交媒体上参与政治的例子时，法官杰奎琳·格里森 (Jacqueline Gleeson) 表示保留，例如 6News 的利奥·普格利西 (Leo Puglisi)，他在 11 岁时就创办了自己的新闻网站。

paras.en: Gleeson said the “vast majority of teens the vast majority of time” do not engage in politics while under 16.
paras.zh: 格里森表示，“绝大多数青少年在绝大多数时间”在 16 岁以下时不会参与政治。

paras.en: When asked whether teens were being limited in engaging in political communication on just those platforms covered by the ban, Herzfeld argued the platforms offer teens a much wider audience compared with “shouting on the street” or being interviewed in the media.
paras.zh: 当被问及青少年在禁令所涵盖的平台上参与政治交流是否受到限制时，赫茨菲尔德认为，与“在街上喊叫”或接受媒体采访相比，这些平台为青少年提供了更广泛的受众。

paras.en: Herzfeld said the Australian government had also cited a number of studies in its submissions outlining the “credible risks” of harm that the ban is aiming to address, but none of the studies cited had mentioned Reddit. He conceded Reddit was not arguing the parliament had to wait for scientific consensus on the link between the harmful design features of social media and the harms.
paras.zh: 赫茨菲尔德表示，澳大利亚政府还在其提交的材料中引用了多项研究，概述了该禁令旨在解决的“可信风险”，但所引用的研究均未提及 Reddit。他承认 Reddit 并不是主张议会必须等待科学界就社交媒体的有害设计特征与危害之间的联系达成共识。

paras.en: At the end of its argument on Tuesday, Reddit outlined a number of alternatives the government could have pursued, including the digital duty of care bill currently before the parliament, as well as laws prohibiting push notifications, or limiting the time children can spend on the platform, or requiring child accounts to only be allowed with parental control.
paras.zh: 在周二的辩论结束时，Reddit 概述了政府可以采取的一些替代方案，包括目前正在议会审议的数字谨慎责任法案，以及禁止推送通知、限制儿童在平台上花费的时间、或要求儿童账户只能在家长控制下使用的法律。

paras.en: Government barrister Joanna Davidson SC, told the court the design features outlined in the rules, which she said are designed to maximise engagement on the platforms, are “broadly shared” across all 10 platforms, including Reddit.
paras.zh: 政府大律师 Joanna Davidson SC 告诉法庭，规则中概述的设计特征是为了最大限度地提高平台的参与度，在包括 Reddit 在内的所有 10 个平台上“广泛共享”。

paras.en: Those features include autoplay video, recommendation systems, notifications by default and surfacing the most popular content.
paras.zh: 这些功能包括自动播放视频、推荐系统、默认通知以及显示最流行的内容。

paras.en: Davidson said the platforms encourage users to stay to maximise user engagement and bring in more revenue. Those features can have a “compounding” risk of harm when working together.
paras.zh: 戴维森表示，这些平台鼓励用户留下来，以最大限度地提高用户参与度并带来更多收入。这些功能一起工作时可能会产生“复合”伤害风险。

paras.en: When people keep returning to social media for fear of missing out, it can lead to issues such as a lack of sleep, or an increased likelihood of depression, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，当人们因为害怕错过而不断回到社交媒体时，可能会导致睡眠不足或抑郁的可能性增加等问题。

paras.en: Children are more vulnerable to the risks due to their cognitive stage of development, Davidson said.
paras.zh: 戴维森说，由于儿童的认知发展阶段，他们更容易受到风险的影响。

paras.en: The government will continue to make its argument on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 政府将于周三继续提出论点。

paras.en: The Digital Freedom Project, led by New South Wales Libertarian MP John Ruddick, adopted Reddit’s arguments against the law, and only sought to be heard on the issue of whether as a group advocating for its members it had standing to bring the case.
paras.zh: 由新南威尔士州自由党议员约翰·拉迪克（John Ruddick）领导的数字自由项目采纳了 Reddit 反对该法律的论点，并且只寻求听取其作为一个为其成员辩护的团体是否有资格提起诉讼的问题。

paras.en: The court heard the group had “at least one” member aged between 13 and 15 who was affected by the ban.
paras.zh: 法院获悉，该组织有“至少一名”年龄在 13 至 15 岁之间的成员受到禁令的影响。

paras.en: Ruddick was joined outside the court this morning by the original plaintiff for the case – 16-year-old Noah Jones – and his mother, Renee, as well as One Nation senator Malcolm Roberts. Jones and fellow teen Macey Nyland withdrew as plaintiffs in the case due to the legal cost risk if the case went against them.
paras.zh: 今天早上，拉迪克在法庭外与该案的原告——16 岁的诺亚·琼斯——及其母亲蕾妮以及一国党参议员马尔科姆·罗伯茨一起出庭。琼斯和少年梅西·尼兰 (Macey Nyland) 退出了该案的原告身份，因为如果案件对他们不利，他们将面临法律费用风险。

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's request to stop California counting disputed votes

paras.en: The US Supreme Court has rejected a last-minute request by the Trump administration asking it to intervene in California's midterm election vote count.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院驳回了特朗普政府要求其干预加州中期选举计票的最后一刻请求。

paras.en: The justice department wanted 20,000 ballots to be set aside that it alleged may have been issued to non-US citizens in the state.
paras.zh: 司法部希望搁置 20,000 张选票，据称这些选票可能是发给该州的非美国公民的。

paras.en: Two lower courts had already rejected the request. State election officials had questioned the federal government's claims - saying the process used to identify alleged non-citizens was inaccurate.
paras.zh: 两个下级法院已经驳回了这一请求。州选举官员对联邦政府的说法提出质疑，称用于识别所谓非公民身份的程序不准确。

paras.en: The Monday ruling comes on the eve of the midterms, which will determine which political party controls the US Congress for the last two years of President Donald Trump's second term.
paras.zh: 周一的裁决是在中期选举前夕做出的，这将决定哪个政党在唐纳德·特朗普总统第二任期的最后两年中控制美国国会。

paras.en: The Supreme Court announced its decision in a one-line order, saying it was denying the justice department's request for an injunction.
paras.zh: 最高法院在一份单行命令中宣布了这一决定，称其拒绝了司法部的禁令请求。

paras.en: "The application for injunction pending appeal presented to Justice Kagan and by her referred to the Court is denied," it reads.
paras.zh: 声明中写道：“向卡根法官提交并由她转交法院的禁令申请被拒绝。”

paras.en: Its means rulings made in lower courts will stand and essentially ends the Trump administration's bid to disqualify the ballots.
paras.zh: 这意味着下级法院做出的裁决将有效，并从根本上结束特朗普政府取消选票资格的企图。

paras.en: California is the most populous state in America with some 23 million people on its voting register. As of Sunday night, more than six million mail-in ballots had already been received, according to the California secretary of state's office.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州是美国人口最多的州，选民登记册上约有 2300 万人。据加州国务卿办公室称，截至周日晚间，已收到超过六百万张邮寄选票。

paras.en: The justice department sent letters to the California secretary of state and Los Angeles County Registrar last month, demanding they set aside the ballots of 20,000 registered voters whom the Trump administration "believe" are "likely" non-citizens, according to court documents.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，司法部上个月致函加州国务卿和洛杉矶县登记官，要求他们搁置特朗普政府“认为”“可能”非公民的 2 万名登记选民的选票。

paras.en: About a week later, armed officials from the Department of Homeland Security delivered letters to county officials and employees across California threatening criminal charges if they didn't sequester those ballots.
paras.zh: 大约一周后，国土安全部的武装官员向加州各地的县官员和雇员发出信件，威胁称如果他们不扣押这些选票，将面临刑事指控。

paras.en: In a 22-page brief reviewed by the BBC, the justice department maintained that ballots cast by non-citizens could "debase or dilute valid votes".
paras.zh: 在 BBC 审阅的一份长达 22 页的简报中，司法部坚称非公民投票可能“贬低或淡化有效选票”。

paras.en: On Friday, a federal appeals court declined the government's request to segregate the ballots.
paras.zh: 周五，联邦上诉法院拒绝了政府分离选票的请求。

paras.en: California election officials have questioned the accuracy of the government's claims, and have said the list of names the government has provided is riddled with inaccuracies.
paras.zh: 加州选举官员质疑政府说法的准确性，并表示政府提供的名单充满了不准确之处。

paras.en: They have expressed concern that eligible voters could be disenfranchised and said segregating ballots whilst voting is underway is unfeasible.
paras.zh: 他们对符合资格的选民可能被剥夺选举权表示担忧，并表示在投票期间隔离选票是不可行的。

paras.en: The attempts are a part of a years-long campaign by Trump and his administration to fight alleged voter fraud that they believe is widespread, despite research showing that it is extremely rare.
paras.zh: 这些尝试是特朗普及其政府多年来打击所谓选民欺诈运动的一部分，他们认为这种行为很普遍，尽管研究表明这种情况极为罕见。

paras.en: President Trump has repeatedly claimed that Democrats steal elections by allowing immigrants to vote illegally, and he blames much of it on the so-called "mail-in" or postal voting that is permitted in many Democratic states.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统一再声称民主党通过允许移民非法投票来窃取选举结果，他将这很大程度上归咎于许多民主党州允许的所谓“邮寄”或邮寄投票。

paras.en: Last week in a scathing ruling, district judge David Carter said the government's move in California was indicative of an "ongoing pattern of attempted election interference" on the part of the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 地区法官戴维·卡特上周在一项严厉的裁决中表示，加州政府的举动表明特朗普政府“正在试图干预选举”。

paras.en: The judge added that "never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the executive branch".
paras.zh: 法官补充说，“在美国历史上，联邦政府从未在选举前夕试图强迫州和地方政府放弃自己的宪法选举程序并屈服于行政部门的意愿”。

paras.en: With additional reporting by the BBC's David Willis
paras.zh: BBC 的大卫·威利斯 (David Willis) 进行了补充报道

articles.title: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections

paras.en: The US has launched strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, US officials have told CBS, the BBC's US partner.
paras.zh: 美国官员告诉英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司，美国已经对霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗格什姆岛发动了袭击。

paras.en: Iranian state news agency IRNA reported several explosions on the island on Monday.
paras.zh: 伊朗国家通讯社 IRNA 周一报道了岛上发生的几起爆炸事件。

paras.en: The US officials described the strikes as limited and said they were in response to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) firing upon a US aircraft.
paras.zh: 美国官员称此次袭击有限，并表示这是对伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）向一架美国飞机开火的回应。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted US Central Command (Centcom), the part of the US military responsible for operations in the Middle East, for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系美国中央司令部（Centcom）征求评论，该司令部是美军负责中东行动的部门。

paras.en: It comes ahead of the US midterm elections, which will determine whether the Republicans or Democrats control Congress.
paras.zh: 它发生在美国中期选举之前，这将决定共和党还是民主党控制国会。

paras.en: Trump has been facing falling polling numbers and pressure from within his party to end the war, which began when the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.
paras.zh: 特朗普一直面临着民意调查数字下降和党内要求结束战争的压力，这场战争是从美国和以色列二月份袭击伊朗时开始的。

paras.en: Earlier on Monday, he told reporters that he was in "no rush" to ramp up strikes on Iran.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，他告诉记者，他“不急于”加大对伊朗的打击力度。

paras.en: "One way or the other, we will do something, but there is no rush. We crippled them financially," he told news outlet Axios. "They have no money, no gasoline and their people are getting very tired of it."
paras.zh: 他对新闻媒体 Axios 表示：“不管怎样，我们都会做点什么，但不要着急。我们在经济上削弱了他们的能力。” “他们没有钱，没有汽油，他们的人民对此感到非常厌倦。”

paras.en: He also said the US "might need to go after Pickaxe", a site linked to Iran's nuclear programme, in an interview with Fox News on the eve of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 他还在中期选举前夕接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，美国“可能需要打击与伊朗核计划有关的 Pickaxe”网站。

paras.en: This was "not a big deal" and could be done in "one hour", Trump added.
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，这“没什么大不了的”，可以在“一小时内”完成。

paras.en: There has been mounting speculation in the last few days that the US may resume significant strikes in Iran again after the midterms. But asked by a reporter on Monday if that was the case, Trump said "no".
paras.zh: 过去几天，越来越多的人猜测美国可能会在中期选举后再次恢复对伊朗的大规模打击。但周一被记者问及情况是否如此时，特朗普说“不”。

paras.en: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi told IRNA earlier that "very intensive" talks to try and end the war are under way with the US via mediators.
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇早些时候告诉伊朗伊斯兰通讯社，正在通过调解人与美国进行“非常密集”的谈判，试图结束战争。

paras.en: He also said Tehran was prepared for both diplomatic and military scenarios "more than ever before" and that it was up to the US to choose between a "wise path" of negotiation or the "mistake of military aggression".
paras.zh: 他还表示，德黑兰“比以往任何时候都更有准备”应对外交和军事场景，美国应该在“明智的谈判道路”还是“军事侵略的错误”之间做出选择。

articles.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack

paras.en: North Korea has denied claims that it was behind the record $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) hack of cryptocurrency exchange Binance, calling the allegations "absurd rhetoric".
paras.zh: 朝鲜否认其参与了加密货币交易所币安创纪录的 63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）黑客攻击事件，称这些指控是“荒谬的言论”。

paras.en: Kim Yo Jong, a top Democratic People's Republic of Korea official and the sister of leader Kim Jong Un, said on Tuesday that the accusations are another "sinister attempt" by the US to damage Pyongyang's public image.
paras.zh: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国高级官员、领导人金正恩的妹妹金与正周二表示，这些指控是美国损害平壤公众形象的又一“险恶企图”。

paras.en: The US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), the Secret Service and cyber analysts have said North Korea orchestrated the hack, which has been described as the largest in history.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）、特勤局和网络分析人士表示，朝鲜策划了这起历史上规模最大的黑客攻击事件。

paras.en: This is the latest hack to be linked to North Korea, which has been accused of relying on cyber-crime to help finance its sanctioned economy.
paras.zh: 这是与朝鲜有关的最新黑客攻击，朝鲜被指控依靠网络犯罪为其受制裁的经济提供资金。

paras.en: Blockchain analysts and the FBI have said the attack was led by state-backed hacking group TraderTraitor.
paras.zh: 区块链分析师和联邦调查局表示，这次攻击是由国家支持的黑客组织 TraderTraitor 领导的。

paras.en: The FBI has called on industry partners to help block transactions involving cryptocurrency accounts linked to the group.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 呼吁行业合作伙伴帮助阻止涉及与该组织相关的加密货币账户的交易。

paras.en: "The US has made a trite provocation of linking it with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea again," Kim Yo-jong, the director of North Korea's General Affairs Department, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 朝鲜总务部部长金与正在一份声明中表示，“美国再次将其与朝鲜民主主义人民共和国联系起来，这是一次陈词滥调的挑衅。”

paras.en: "It is a grave political provocation against the DPRK that the US misleads the international public opinion as if all the cyber crimes in different parts of the world are our deeds," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“美国误导国际舆论，仿佛世界各地发生的所有网络犯罪都是我们所为，这是对朝鲜的严重政治挑衅。”

paras.en: But Pyongyang has been blamed for a number of major cyber attacks in recent years - accusations that it has denied.
paras.zh: 但平壤近年来被指责发动了多起重大网络攻击，但平壤否认了这些指控。

paras.en: The TraderTraitor unit, which is also known as the Lazarus Group, was blamed for a then-record $1.5bn hack of crypto exchange Bybit in 2025.
paras.zh: TraderTraitor 部门（也称为 Lazarus Group）被指责在 2025 年对加密货币交易所 Bybit 进行了当时创纪录的 15 亿美元黑客攻击。

paras.en: Pyongyang has systematically built its cyber operations, recruiting promising students from universities and sending them to hacker units overseen by North Korea's intelligence agency, research groups like the S Rajaratnam School of International Studies think tank have said.
paras.zh: 拉惹勒南国际研究学院等智囊团表示，平壤系统性地建立了网络行动，从大学招募有前途的学生，并将他们送到朝鲜情报机构监督的黑客部门。

paras.en: The country has consistently denied such claims.
paras.zh: 该国一贯否认此类说法。

paras.en: Kim Yo Jong said "it is the consistent policy stand of the DPRK government to resolutely oppose all sorts of malicious acts in cyberspace".
paras.zh: 金与正表示，“坚决反对网络空间各种恶意行为是朝鲜政府的一贯政策立场”。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted Binance for comment. Since the hack, the crypto giant has largely focused its public statements on the technical nature of the breach and its response to protect users.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系币安征求意见。自黑客事件发生以来，这家加密货币巨头的公开声明主要集中在漏洞的技术性质及其保护用户的响应上。

paras.en: The company said last week that initial checks indicated that an engineer's laptop had been compromised, enabling an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals.
paras.zh: 该公司上周表示，初步检查表明一名工程师的笔记本电脑已被入侵，攻击者可以进行未经授权的提款。

paras.en: Trading in major cryptocurrencies on Binance has since resumed after the exchange worked with issuers to freeze assets impacted by the hack.
paras.zh: 在币安与发行人合作冻结受黑客影响的资产后，币安上主要加密货币的交易已恢复。

paras.en: A net $5.27bn has been withdrawn from the exchange since transactions resumed on Sunday, according to data posted on Tuesday by Binance. It also said the level of transactions has now stabilised.
paras.zh: 根据币安网周二发布的数据，自周日交易恢复以来，已从该交易所净撤出 52.7 亿美元。它还表示交易水平现已稳定。

paras.en: The company has repeatedly said it would cover all of the losses linked to the attack and that it has so far covered around 95% of the assets stolen in the breach.
paras.zh: 该公司一再表示将承担与此次攻击相关的所有损失，并且迄今为止已承担了此次泄露中被盗资产的约 95%。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理建立了一个矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们合作的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

paras.zh: 一个关键亮点将是新的 LCV 系列，扩大 PRT 在轻型商用车领域的覆盖范围。该公司还展示了其空气减震器、顶部安装件和电机安装件产品线，以及用于卡车、拖车、公共汽车、商用车、水泥搅拌机、房车等的广泛重型应用产品组合。参会者可亲临展位，了解更多信息

articles.title: CIECA Offers Free Webinar on Why Body Shops Rekey Estimate Data
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Industry Electronic Commerce Association (CIECA) will host its next webinar, “Why Shops Rekey Estimate Data — and What Can Be Done About It,” on Thursday, Nov. 12 at 2 p.m. EST.
paras.zh: 碰撞行业电子商务协会 (CIECA) 将于 11 月 12 日星期四下午 2 点举办下一次网络研讨会，题为“商店为何重新计算估计数据密钥以及对此可以采取哪些措施”。美国东部时间。

paras.en: Industry representatives will discuss the prevalence of body shops rekeying estimate data and the impacts. Speakers will include Mike Anderson, owner of Collision Advice; Dan Stander, president of Fix Auto Highlands Ranch and chairman of the Automotive Service Association (ASA); Craig Stevens, director, Solutions Delivery, Automotive Services Group for CCC Intelligent Solutions; and John Yoswick, editor and publisher of CRASH Network.
paras.zh: 行业代表将讨论车身修理厂重新输入估计数据的普遍程度及其影响。演讲者包括碰撞咨询公司 (Collision Advice) 所有者迈克·安德森 (Mike Anderson)； Dan Stander，Fix Auto Highlands Ranch 总裁兼汽车服务协会 (ASA) 主席； Craig Stevens，CCC 智能解决方案汽车服务集团解决方案交付总监；约翰·约斯维克 (John Yoswick)，CRASH Network 的编辑兼出版商。

paras.en: “Shops’ rekeying of insurer-generated estimates continues to be a common practice within the collision repair industry,” said Yoswick, who will share the findings from a CRASH Network survey conducted earlier this year related to the rekeying of estimates and how it compares to the findings of similar surveys dating back to 2022. “The survey looked at the most commonly-cited reasons for the practice, and includes findings related to shops’ awareness and use of available re-keying solutions. One of the most commonly-cited reasons for rekeying is when the insurer uses a different estimating system than the shop.”
paras.zh: Yoswick 表示：“商店对保险公司生成的估算值进行重新生成密钥仍然是碰撞维修行业的常见做法。”他将分享今年早些时候进行的 CRASH Network 一项与估算值重新生成相关的调查结果，以及如何与 2022 年以来的类似调查结果进行比较。“该调查着眼于这种做法最常被引用的原因，并包括与商店对可用重新生成密钥解决方案的认识和使用相关的调查结果。最常见的调查之一最常见的重新生成密钥的原因是保险公司使用与商店不同的估算系统。”

paras.en: During the webinar, Stevens will discuss why rekeying is often a symptom of fragmented workflows and the challenges of moving information across the collision ecosystem. He will also address the industry’s opportunity to reduce redundant work by enabling information to be captured once and used throughout the repair and claims process.
paras.zh: 在网络研讨会期间，史蒂文斯将讨论为什么重新生成密钥通常是分散工作流程的症状，以及在碰撞生态系统中移动信息的挑战。他还将介绍行业通过一次性捕获信息并在整个维修和索赔过程中使用信息来减少冗余工作的机会。

paras.en: “The operational impact of estimate rekeying and how duplicate data entry takes time away from higher-value work,” said Stevens.
paras.zh: 史蒂文斯说：“估算重新输入密钥对运营的影响以及重复的数据输入如何占用高价值工作的时间。”

paras.en: Following insight from Yoswick and Stevens, Anderson and Stander will discuss the challenges of rekeying data, and explore solutions to improve shop efficiency.
paras.zh: 根据约斯威克和史蒂文斯的见解，安德森和斯坦德将讨论重新加密数据的挑战，并探索提高商店效率的解决方案。

paras.en: Mike Anderson is a former multi-shop owner based in Alexandria, Va. He is an Accredited Master Automotive Manager (AMAM) through the Automotive Management Institute (AMi) and helps develop the collision ASE testing for technicians and estimators in the U.S. Anderson has presented to groups nationwide, as well as in Canada, Mexico and Australia. He travels more than 300 days a year, working with collision industry stakeholders. His company, Collision Advice, facilitates 20 groups called the Spartan 300 for OEM-certified shops. Anderson produces a quarterly summary of the latest U.S. trends and statistics for the collision industry, as well as conducts quarterly “Who Pays for What” surveys of over 28,000 collision repair professionals focused on insurer reimbursement.
paras.zh: Mike Anderson 是弗吉尼亚州亚历山大市的前多店老板。他是汽车管理学院 (AMi) 认证的高级汽车经理 (AMAM)，帮助美国的技术人员和估算人员开发碰撞 ASE 测试。Anderson 已向全国以及加拿大、墨西哥和澳大利亚的团体进行了演示。他每年出差 300 多天，与碰撞行业利益相关者合作。他的公司 Collision Advice 为 20 个名为 Spartan 300 的 OEM 认证商店团体提供了便利。 Anderson 对美国碰撞行业的最新趋势和统计数据进行了季度总结，并对 28,000 多名碰撞维修专业人员进行了季度“谁支付什么费用”调查，重点关注保险公司报销。

paras.en: Dan Stander is president of Fix Auto Highlands Ranch in Littleton, Colo., with more than 40 years of collision repair experience. He currently serves as ASA’s national chairman and has contributed to advisory groups for I-CAR, AMi, ASE, Driven Brands and NACE/CARS. He holds Honda/Acura ProFirst and Subaru collision repair certifications. Stander is an Accredited Master Automotive Manager and I-CAR Platinum individual, with a bachelor’s degree in business administration from the University of Colorado Denver. His work focuses on safe, proper repairs, industry education and helping collision repair businesses improve their operations.
paras.zh: Dan Stander 是科罗拉多州利特尔顿 Fix Auto Highlands Ranch 的总裁，拥有 40 多年的碰撞修复经验。他目前担任 ASA 全国主席，并为 I-CAR、AMi、ASE、Driven Brands 和 NACE/CARS 的咨询小组做出了贡献。他拥有本田/讴歌 ProFirst 和斯巴鲁碰撞修复认证。 Stander 是一位经过认证的汽车经理大师和 I-CAR 白金会员，拥有科罗拉多大学丹佛分校工商管理学士学位。他的工作重点是安全、正确的维修、行业教育以及帮助碰撞维修企业改善运营。

paras.en: Craig Stevens is a keynote speaker and industry leader with more than 30 years of experience across both the collision repair and insurance sides of the business. Having served as an estimator, reinspector, parts, production and shop manager, he brings a well-rounded perspective that resonates deeply with the audiences he serves. Known for translating complex ideas into “human speak,” he connects through real-world experience and authentic storytelling. Guided by his philosophy, “Let the appetite feed the recipe,” he delivers practical insights that inspire action and help professionals see what’s truly possible.
paras.zh: 克雷格·史蒂文斯 (Craig Stevens) 是一位主讲人兼行业领导者，在碰撞修复和保险业务方面拥有 30 多年的经验。他曾担任过估算员、复验员、零件、生产和车间经理，他带来了全面的视角，与他所服务的受众产生了深刻的共鸣。他以将复杂的想法转化为“人类语言”而闻名，通过现实世界的经验和真实的故事讲述来联系。在他的理念“让胃口满足食谱”的指导下，他提供了实用的见解，激发行动并帮助专业人士看到什么是真正可能的。

paras.en: To register for the Nov. 12 CIECA webinar, click here.
paras.zh: 要注册参加 11 月 12 日 CIECA 网络研讨会，请点击此处。

articles.title: WIN Opens 2027 Most Influential Women Nominations Nov. 2, 2026
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Women’s Industry Network (WIN) announced that nominations for its 2027 Most Influential Women (MIW) awards will open on Nov. 2, 2026. The announcement will be celebrated live at the annual WIN SEMA Meet Up at 5 p.m. Nov. 3 at the Las Vegas Benihana Westgate Hotel. All are welcome and the event is free. Those who wish to attend can RSVP on the WIN website.
paras.zh: 女性产业网络 (WIN) 宣布，其 2027 年最具影响力女性 (MIW) 奖提名将于 2026 年 11 月 2 日开放。该公告将于下午 5 点在年度 WIN SEMA 聚会上进行现场庆祝。 11 月 3 日，拉斯维加斯 Benihana Westgate 酒店。欢迎各界人士参与，活动免费。希望参加的人可以在 WIN 网站上回复。

paras.en: WIN’s MIW recipients recognize career achievements and industry influence, and nominations are open to women working in any segment of the collision repair industry across the U.S. and Canada. The class of 2027 MIW award recipients will be recognized at the annual WIN Conference May 3-4, 2027 in Portland, Ore., at the Portland Marriott Downtown Waterfront.
paras.zh: WIN 的 MIW 获奖者认可职业成就和行业影响力，提名向在美国和加拿大碰撞修复行业任何领域工作的女性开放。 2027 年 MIW 奖获得者将于 2027 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日在俄勒冈州波特兰市中心海滨波特兰万豪酒店举行的年度 WIN 会议上进行表彰。

paras.en: Official applications for the award are available online here and will be accepted through Monday, Jan. 5, 2027.
paras.zh: 该奖项的正式申请可在此处在线获取，受理截止日期为 2027 年 1 月 5 日星期一。

paras.en: “Our industry thrives because of the women who go above and beyond, not only in their daily operations but in the way they nurture those around them and champion progress,” said Jenny Anderson, chair of the MIW Awards Committee for WIN. “Nominations for our 2027 Most Influential Women award provides a vital opportunity to celebrate excellence across every facet of collision repair — from the shop floor to the executive office. By honoring these women, we are not only recognizing their impact but ensuring a vibrant, inclusive future for all who choose to pursue a career in this field.”
paras.zh: MIW WIN 奖项委员会主席珍妮·安德森 (Jenny Anderson) 表示：“我们行业的蓬勃发展得益于女性的不断超越，不仅在日常运营中，而且在她们培养周围人并倡导进步的方式上。” “2027 年最具影响力女性奖的提名提供了一个重要的机会，以表彰从车间到行政办公室的碰撞修复各个方面的卓越表现。通过向这些女性致敬，我们不仅认识到她们的影响力，而且确保为所有选择在该领域从事职业的人创造一个充满活力、包容性的未来。”

paras.en: Award recipients are selected based on established criteria, including industry influence, professional accomplishments, mentorship and community service. Nominees are reviewed and interviewed by an independent selection committee comprised of industry professionals, past MIW recipients and WIN members who do not currently serve in leadership capacities.
paras.zh: 获奖者的评选依据既定标准，包括行业影响力、专业成就、指导和社区服务。提名者将接受由行业专业人士、过去的 MIW 获得者和目前不担任领导职务的 WIN 成员组成的独立评选委员会的审查和面试。

paras.en: Since its inception in 1999, the MIW program has recognized over 135 women who have enriched the collision repair industry with their leadership, vision and commitment to excellence. WIN acquired stewardship of the MIW program in 2013 and continues to evolve the program to align with WIN’s mission of “driving the future of collision repair by attracting, developing and advancing women.”
paras.zh: 自 1999 年启动以来，MIW 计划已表彰了超过 135 名女性，她们以其领导力、远见和对卓越的承诺丰富了碰撞修复行业。 WIN 于 2013 年获得了 MIW 项目的管理权，并继续发展该项目，以符合 WIN 的使命：“通过吸引、发展和提升女性地位，推动碰撞修复的未来”。

paras.en: In 2026, WIN honored these women in the collision repair industry with the MIW award:
paras.zh: 2026 年，WIN 向碰撞修复行业的这些女性颁发了 MIW 奖：

paras.en: - Angie Babin, vice president, OEM Partnerships & Strategy, Caliber Collision
paras.zh: - Angie Babin，Calibre Collision OEM 合作伙伴与战略副总裁

paras.en: - Brandi Brydges, director of operations, ACX (AutoCanada Collision Centres)
paras.zh: - Brandi Brydges，ACX（加拿大汽车碰撞中心）运营总监

paras.en: - Jeanne Esquivel, North American business development and customer delivery technology leader, Entegral, Powered by Enterprise Mobility
paras.zh: - Jeanne Esquivel，Entegral 北美业务开发和客户交付技术负责人，由 Enterprise Mobility 提供支持

paras.zh: - Kena Dacus，Dacus 汽车车身和碰撞修复公司所有者
