articles.title: Length of rental slightly up in Q3, shop scheduling backlogs down
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Enterprise Mobility reports that overall Length of Rental (LOR) for collision-related rentals in Q3 2026 was 15.5 days, up 0.4 days from Q2 and 0.1 days from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: Enterprise Mobility 报告称，2026 年第三季度碰撞相关租赁的总体租赁时间 (LOR) 为 15.5 天，比第二季度增加 0.4 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加 0.1 天。

paras.en: “This modest rise is notable when comparing Q3 2025’s results to Q3 2024, when overall LOR declined 0.9 days; Q3 2026’s results are the first Q3-over-Q3 increase since 2022,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“将 2025 年第三季度的结果与 2024 年第三季度的结果进行比较时，这一小幅上升值得注意，当时总体 LOR 下降了 0.9 天；2026 年第三季度的结果是自 2022 年以来首次出现环比增长。”

paras.en: “Apart from the early months of the pandemic in 2020, that was the highest percentage of shops reporting such an open schedule in the nearly 10 years since the quarterly “Who Pays” surveys began asking about scheduling backlog,” Yoswick said in the LOR report.
paras.zh: Yoswick 在 LOR 报告中表示：“除了 2020 年疫情爆发的前几个月之外，这是自季度性‘谁付钱’季度调查开始询问排班积压情况以来近 10 年来，报告此类开放排班的商店比例最高的一次。”

paras.en: He added that work in progress (WIP) fell to another new low in Q3 2026, reaching 49% in September, according to CRASH Network’s “Collision Industry Business Perspectives” survey.
paras.zh: 他补充说，根据 CRASH Network 的“碰撞行业商业前景”调查，在制品 (WIP) 在 2026 年第三季度再创新低，9 月份达到 49%。

paras.en: Ryan Mandell, Mitchell International’s vice president of strategy and market intelligence, added that the percentage of parts repaired continued upward in Q3, reaching 17.8% from 16.4% in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 米切尔国际公司战略和市场情报副总裁 Ryan Mandell 补充说，第三季度维修零件的百分比继续上升，从 2025 年第三季度的 16.4% 达到 17.8%。

paras.en: Q3 drivable LOR was 14.6 days, a 0.2-day increase from Q3 2025. Alaska and Rhode Island had the joint-highest LOR at 18.9 days each, followed by Massachusetts at 16.8 days.
paras.zh: 第三季度的可行驶 LOR 为 14.6 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加了 0.2 天。阿拉斯加和罗德岛州的 LOR 并列最高，均为 18.9 天，其次是马萨诸塞州，为 16.8 天。

paras.en: North Dakota had the lowest drivable LOR at 9.8 days, followed by Hawaii (11.2 days) and the District of Columbia (11.4 days).
paras.zh: 北达科他州的可驾驶 LOR 最低，为 9.8 天，其次是夏威夷（11.2 天）和哥伦比亚特区（11.4 天）。

paras.en: Iowa recorded the largest increase, with drivable LOR up 1.7 days year over year to 12.9 days. Georgia (15.6 days) had the largest decrease, down 0.9 days.
paras.zh: 爱荷华州的增幅最大，可行驶 LOR 天数同比增加 1.7 天，达到 12.9 天。格鲁吉亚（15.6 天）降幅最大，减少了 0.9 天。

paras.en: Greg Horn, Chief Industry Relations Officer at PartsTrader, said drivable LOR “aligns closely with parts delivery days.”
paras.zh: PartsTrader 首席行业关系官 Greg Horn 表示，可行驶的 LOR“与零件交付天数密切相关”。

paras.en: Non-drivable LOR didn’t change compared to Q3 2025, remaining at 21.2 days.
paras.zh: 与 2025 年第三季度相比，不可行驶的 LOR 没有变化，仍为 21.2 天。

paras.en: Alaska had the highest non-drivable LOR at 30 days, followed by West Virginia at 26.3 days and Wyoming at 24.4 days. West Virginia (21.2 days) recorded its largest decrease, down 3.1 days from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加的不可驾驶 LOR 最高，为 30 天，其次是西弗吉尼亚州，为 26.3 天，怀俄明州为 24.4 天。西弗吉尼亚州（21.2 天）降幅最大，比 2025 年第三季度减少了 3.1 天。

paras.en: Total loss claim LOR was 14.2 days, a 0.3-day increase above Q3 2025. West Virginia had the highest total loss LOR at 18.1 days, followed by New Hampshire at 17.4 days and Rhode Island at 17.2 days. South Dakota had the lowest total loss LOR at 11.3 days.
paras.zh: 总损失索赔 LOR 为 14.2 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加了 0.3 天。西弗吉尼亚州的总损失 LOR 最高，为 18.1 天，其次是新罕布什尔州，为 17.4 天，罗德岛州为 17.2 天。南达科他州的总损失 LOR 最低，为 11.3 天。

paras.en: “Total Loss frequency rose again to 21.0%, up from 20.3% in Q3 2025,” said Mandell in the report. “With more borderline vehicles ending up as write-offs, this contributes to some of the reduction in repairable claims volume the industry has been experiencing.”
paras.zh: 曼德尔在报告中表示：“总损失频率再次上升至 21.0%，高于 2025 年第三季度的 20.3%。” “随着越来越多的边缘车辆最终被报废，这导致了该行业可修复索赔量的部分减少。”

paras.en: According to JD Power’s 2026 U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, overall customer satisfaction decreases by 12 points (on a 1,000-point scale) due to total loss determinations, and increases by 4 points when damages are repairable.
paras.zh: 根据 JD Power 的 2026 年美国汽车索赔满意度研究，总体客户满意度因全损确定而下降 12 分（满分 1,000 分），而当损坏可修复时则增加 4 分。

paras.en: Overall, the report found that 26% of auto insurance claims were classified as total losses in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago.
paras.zh: 总体而言，该报告发现，到 2026 年，26% 的汽车保险索赔被归类为总损失，而四年前这一比例仅为 16%。

paras.en: In the Q3 LOR report, Mandell adds that average first-party deductibles are declining, down to $809 in Q3 from $844 in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 在第三季度 LOR 报告中，Mandell 补充道，第一方平均免赔额正在下降，从 2025 年第三季度的 844 美元降至第三季度的 809 美元。

paras.en: “This may be an indicator that we are seeing more consumers switch insurance carriers as more competitive rates enter the ecosystem,” Mandell said. “This carrier switching is a catalyst for consumers to improve their coverage as they are able to attain a more favorable premium and thereby reduce their deductible or add back first-party coverages. Both of which are signs that we may see gradual increases in claims volumes in the near future.”
paras.zh: 曼德尔说：“这可能表明，随着更具竞争力的费率进入生态系统，我们看到越来越多的消费者更换保险公司。” “这种运营商转换是消费者改善保险范围的催化剂，因为他们能够获得更优惠的保费，从而减少免赔额或增加第一方保险范围。这两者都表明我们可能会在不久的将来看到索赔量逐渐增加。”

paras.en: The Q3 Quarterly Insurance Signals Intelligence Report from JD Power and TransUnion shows auto insurance carrier switching increased even though year-over-year (YoY) shopping was flat.
paras.zh: JD Power 和 TransUnion 发布的第三季度保险信号情报报告显示，尽管同比 (YoY) 购物量持平，但汽车保险公司的转换却有所增加。

paras.en: The latest report shows shopping reached 13.2% and switching 5.1%, both up 0.6 percentage points from Q2.
paras.zh: 最新报告显示，购物率达到13.2%，转换率为5.1%，均较第二季度上升0.6个百分点。

paras.en: A recent LexisNexis Risk Solutions whitepaper details survey findings on auto insurance shopping trends, stating that 72% of consumers who shopped for auto insurance are open to switching carriers. Of those, 17% said they were definitely seeking a new auto insurance company.
paras.zh: 最近的 LexisNexis Risk Solutions 白皮书详细介绍了有关汽车保险购买趋势的调查结果，指出购买汽车保险的消费者中有 72% 愿意更换保险公司。其中，17% 的人表示他们肯定正在寻找一家新的汽车保险公司。

articles.title: SCRS booth invites SEMA attendees to compete for ‘best welder’ and ‘best refinisher’
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: SEMA Show attendees are once again asked to compete in a virtual reality welding and refinishing competition to win prizes for their favorite automotive trade school at the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) booth this week.
paras.zh: 本周，SEMA 展会的与会者再次被要求在碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 展台参加虚拟现实焊接和修补漆比赛，为他们最喜欢的汽车贸易学校赢得奖品。

paras.en: From Tuesday through Friday, visitors at the SCRS booth can take part in a fully immersive welding and refinishing competition powered by Skillveri’s virtual and mixed-reality training technology. The booth is located in the Upper South Hall, Booth #31147.
paras.zh: 从周二到周五，SCRS 展位的参观者可以参加由 Skillveri 的虚拟和混合现实培训技术提供支持的完全沉浸式焊接和修补比赛。展位位于上南大厅，展位号：31147。

paras.en: The competition will sort out the “best of the best” daily from 9:30–11:30 a.m. and 1–4:30 p.m. Winners will be announced via SCRS’s Facebook and LinkedIn pages Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 比赛将于每天上午 9:30–11:30 和下午 1–4:30 选出“最佳中的最佳”。获奖者名单将于周五下午通过 SCRS 的 Facebook 和 LinkedIn 页面公布。

paras.en: No pre-registration is needed, and it is open to students, instructors, and repair professionals. Participants can visit the SCRS booth during competition hours to compete in either the welding category, refinishing category, or both.
paras.zh: 无需预先注册，并向学生、教师和维修专业人员开放。参赛者可以在比赛期间参观 SCRS 展位，参加焊接类别、修补漆类别或两者的比赛。

paras.en: Attendees will compete for the titles of “Best Welder” and “Best Refinisher.” Finalists will receive a Full Series Pass to the 2027 SCRS Repairer Driven Education program at the SEMA Show.
paras.zh: 参加者将争夺“最佳焊工”和“最佳修补工”的称号。决赛入围者将获得 SEMA 展会上 2027 年 SCRS 维修驱动教育计划的全系列通行证。

paras.en: Each winner will also select a U.S.-based automotive trade school to receive an equipment and training package made possible by Skillveri, Southern California Collision Equipment, Milwaukee Tool, and CAR-O-LINER.
paras.zh: 每位获奖者还将选择一家位于美国的汽车贸易学校，以获得由 Skillveri、Southern California Collision Equipment、Milwaukee Tool 和 CAR-O-LINER 提供的设备和培训包。

paras.en: - First Place Welding and Refinishing Finalists: Their selected school will receive a complete Skillveri virtual and mixed-reality training system, including a lifetime software license, VR headset, specialized welding or spray painting equipment, laptop, and supporting hardware.
paras.zh: - 焊接和修补决赛第一名入围者：他们选择的学校将获得完整的 Skillveri 虚拟和混合现实培训系统，包括终身软件许可证、VR 耳机、专用焊接或喷漆设备、笔记本电脑和支持硬件。

paras.en: - Second Place Welding Finalist: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Weld Test Cart and Bench Mount Combo for welding.
paras.zh: - 第二名焊接决赛入围者：他们选择的学校将获得 Goliath Carts 焊接测试车和用于焊接的台式安装组合。

paras.en: - Second Place Refinish Finalists: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Painters Toolbox.
paras.zh: - 第二名修补决赛入围者：他们选择的学校将收到一个歌利亚车画家工具箱。

paras.en: - Third Place Finalists: Their selected schools will receive an extensive Milwaukee Tool equipment package featuring M12 and M18 FUEL cordless power tools, impact wrenches, ratchets, sanders, grinders, lighting, and specialty automotive repair equipment. The collection also includes extensive socket, wrench, and hand tool sets, along with a modular PACKOUT storage and organization system.
paras.zh: - 第三名决赛入围者：他们选定的学校将获得广泛的 Milwaukee Tool 设备包，其中包括 M12 和 M18 FUEL 无线电动工具、冲击扳手、棘轮、打磨机、研磨机、照明和专业汽车维修设备。该系列还包括丰富的套筒、扳手和手动工具套件，以及模块化 PACKOUT 存储和整理系统。

paras.en: - Third Place Tie: CAR-O-LINER has provided a WEL32 MIG-MAG welding machine. If no third-place tie occurs, the welding machine will be added to the first-place welding award.
paras.zh: - 第三名：CAR-O-LINER 提供了一台 WEL32 MIG-MAG 焊机。如果没有出现并列第三名的情况，则该焊机将被添加到第一名焊接奖中。

paras.en: SCRS also recently announced that members now have flexible access to the Skillveri Chroma through an exclusive rental program.
paras.zh: SCRS 最近还宣布，会员现在可以通过独家租赁计划灵活使用 Skillveri Chroma。

paras.en: The member benefit lets SCRS collision repair businesses evaluate new hires, run short-term training workshops, and build technician skills without the cost, mess, or material waste of live paint, an SCRS press release states.
paras.zh: SCRS 新闻稿称，会员福利使 SCRS 碰撞修复企业可以评估新员工、举办短期培训研讨会并培养技术人员技能，而不会产生现场油漆的成本、混乱或材料浪费。

paras.en: Next door to the SCRS booth, Spanesi is also giving away $40,000 in prizes at Booth #31173.
paras.zh: 在 SCRS 展位的隔壁，Spanesi 还在 31173 号展位赠送了 40,000 美元的奖品。

paras.en: Collision repair professionals visiting Spanesi Booth Nov. 3–6 can explore equipment and participate in an interactive experience focused on improving repair workflows and productivity, a Spanesi press release states.
paras.zh: Spanesi 新闻稿称，11 月 3 日至 6 日参观 Spanesi 展位的碰撞修复专业人员可以探索设备并参与专注于改进修复工作流程和生产力的互动体验。

paras.en: “Spanesi Collision Course transforms a traditional booth visit into a hands-on experience where attendees can explore equipment, discover practical ways to improve repair processes in their own shops, and unlock prizes along the way,” according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“Spanesi 碰撞课程将传统的展位参观转变为实践体验，参与者可以探索设备，发现改进自己商店维修流程的实用方法，并在此过程中解锁奖品。”

paras.en: Attendees scan a QR code on the show floor or at the booth to register. They then explore stations throughout the booth featuring measuring, structural repair, refinishing, and more.
paras.zh: 与会者在展会现场或展位扫描二维码进行登记。然后，他们探索整个展位的工作站，包括测量、结构修复、修补等。

paras.en: “As participants visit stations, they’ll unlock a spin on a prize wheel featuring tools, industry-related gift cards, Spanesi merch, and other prizes,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“当参与者访问车站时，他们将解锁奖品轮盘，其中包括工具、行业相关礼品卡、Spanesi 商品和其他奖品。”

paras.en: Participants who complete all stations qualify for six prize drawings, and one winner will receive a Touch V6 Portable measuring system valued at more than $40,000. Five additional winners will each receive $1,000 in Spanesi equipment credits. Winners will be selected in on-site drawings on Friday.
paras.zh: 完成所有站的参与者有资格获得六张抽奖机会，一名获胜者将获得价值超过 40,000 美元的 Touch V6 便携式测量系统。另外五名获奖者将每人获得 1,000 美元的 Spanesi 设备积分。获奖者将于周五在现场抽奖中选出。

articles.title: Two-thirds of used car buyers concerned about undisclosed damage
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Over two-thirds of used car buyers are concerned about hidden faults or undisclosed damage, according to a new United Kingdom survey completed by Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel.
paras.zh: Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel 在英国完成的一项新调查显示，超过三分之二的二手车购买者担心隐藏的故障或未公开的损坏。

paras.en: Hidden faults or undisclosed damage was the largest concern identified in the survey of 2,025 buyers, according to Cazoo.
paras.zh: Cazoo 表示，在对 2,025 名买家进行的调查中发现，隐藏的故障或未公开的损坏是最大的担忧。

paras.en: Overall, only around a third (35.5%) of used car buyers trust dealers and more than half expect friction as part of their buying experience, the survey found. Another 16.5% said they do not trust dealers and the remaining 48% are sitting on the fence.
paras.zh: 调查发现，总体而言，只有约三分之一（35.5%）的二手车买家信任经销商，超过一半的人认为摩擦是他们购买体验的一部分。另有 16.5% 的人表示不信任经销商，其余 48% 的人持观望态度。

paras.en: Other concerns buyers have include an unclear vehicle history (45%), being overcharged (41%), and pushy sales tactics (36%).
paras.zh: 买家担心的其他问题包括车辆历史不明确（45%）、收费过高（41%）和咄咄逼人的销售策略（36%）。

paras.en: Buyers said dealers could build trust by making a full vehicle history report available (61%), including independent vehicle inspections or warranties (42%), clear no-haggle pricing (42%), and verified customer reviews (40%).
paras.zh: 买家表示，经销商可以通过提供完整的车辆历史报告（61%）来建立信任，包括独立的车辆检查或保修（42%）、明确的无讨价还价的定价（42%）和经过验证的客户评论（40%）。

paras.en: Thirty-two percent of buyers said they value dealer accreditation from a trade body and 18% value photographs or videos of dealerships.
paras.zh: 32% 的买家表示他们看重贸易机构对经销商的认证，18% 的买家看重经销商的照片或视频。

paras.en: “Our latest Consumer Insight Panel identifies the role dealers can play in recognizing how trust can address the pain points experienced by many used car buyers,” Lucy Tugby, Cazoo chief marketing officer, says in the release. “Time and again we see how the best performing used car dealers are the ones with processes in place to ensure vehicles are described accurately and sold with independent inspections and warranties.”
paras.zh: Cazoo 首席营销官露西·塔格比 (Lucy Tugby) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们最新的消费者洞察小组确定了经销商在认识到信任如何解决许多二手车购买者所经历的痛点方面可以发挥的作用。” “我们一次又一次地看到，表现最好的二手车经销商是那些拥有适当流程以确保车辆得到准确描述并在销售时经过独立检查和保修的经销商。”

paras.en: Independent inspections of used vehicles is one suggestion the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) gives to consumers who are concerned their vehicles could have a counterfeit airbag.
paras.zh: 对二手车进行独立检查是美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 向担心其车辆可能装有假冒安全气囊的消费者提出的一项建议。

paras.en: NHTSA identified an 11th death caused by a specific banned counterfeit airbag part in September.
paras.zh: NHTSA 于 9 月份确认了第 11 起死亡事件，原因是特定的违禁假冒安全气囊部件造成的。

paras.en: It is the first death involving one of the replacement airbag inflators installed in a Chevrolet Equinox, according to a NHTSA release. The previous 10 deaths and three serious injuries happened in Chevrolet Malibu and Hyundai Sonata vehicles.
paras.zh: 据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 发布的消息，这是第一起涉及雪佛兰 Equinox 车上安装的替换安全气囊充气机的死亡事件。此前发生的 10 人死亡和 3 人重伤事故均发生在雪佛兰 Malibu 和现代 Sonata 车辆上。

paras.en: Each deadly crash involved vehicles that had the original frontal driver airbag inflators replaced with a defective and likely illegally imported inflator marked with the identifier DTN60DB, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，每起致命事故都涉及车辆将原来的正面驾驶员安全气囊充气机更换为有缺陷且可能非法进口的充气机，其标识符为 DTN60DB。

paras.en: Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) board member, said during a Collision Industry Conference (CIC) in July that NHTSA’s investigation has uncovered how dangerous counterfeit parts find their way into vehicles.
paras.zh: 汽车反假冒委员会 (A2C2) 董事会成员 Teena Bohi 在 7 月份的碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 上表示，NHTSA 的调查发现了危险的假冒零部件是如何进入车辆的。

paras.en: “Up until the point that a counterfeit product gets installed in the vehicle, everything about it is legal,” she added.
paras.zh: “直到假冒产品安装在车上之前，一切都是合法的，”她补充道。

paras.en: The vehicles are typically fleet vehicles or self-insured vehicles that were at some point totaled, Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说，这些车辆通常是车队车辆或在某个时候被总计的自保车辆。

paras.en: “The totaling of a vehicle isn’t a cut-and-dried process,” Bohi says. “The value is driven depending on whether it is self-insured, the state the vehicle was in, the insurer’s own practices, processes, and thresholds. There is a lot that goes into just determining if the vehicle is totaled.”
paras.zh: “车辆的总计并不是一个现成的过程，”Bohi 说。 “该价值取决于车辆是否自我保险、车辆所处的状态、保险公司自己的做法、流程和阈值。确定车辆是否报废需要考虑很多因素。”

paras.en: Next, the vehicle often goes to an auction. If it is a public auction, an airbag deployment will possibly be reported to the National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS). The system is a database meant to prevent the resale of stolen vehicles and track unsafe salvage cars. If the vehicle goes to a wholesale or private auction, the previous crash information is not always captured, she said.
paras.zh: 接下来，车辆经常去拍卖。如果是公开拍卖，安全气囊的部署情况可能会报告给国家机动车辆所有权信息系统（NMVTIS）。该系统是一个数据库，旨在防止被盗车辆的转售并跟踪不安全的报废车辆。她说，如果车辆进行批发或私人拍卖，以前的碰撞信息并不总是能够被捕获。

paras.en: After the repair, vehicles are retitled, and the process can vary state to state, including the inspection process, Bohi says. Many don’t require airbag inspections.
paras.zh: 博希说，维修后，车辆将被重新命名，而且各州的流程可能有所不同，包括检查流程。许多不需要安全气囊检查。

paras.en: “There are a lot of gaps where attention could be focused that could help address these types of issues,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说：“有很多差距值得关注，这有助于解决此类问题。”

paras.en: NHTSA “urges” owners of used vehicles that have previously been in a crash since 2020 to have their vehicles inspected. It also “urges” used vehicle owners and buyers to learn their vehicle’s history and ensure it has genuine airbag inflators.
paras.zh: NHTSA“敦促”自 2020 年以来曾发生过碰撞事故的二手车车主对车辆进行检查。它还“敦促”二手车车主和买家了解其车辆的历史，并确保其配备正品安全气囊充气机。

paras.en: “If a vehicle has been in a previous crash where the air bag deployed, it should be inspected by a reputable mechanic immediately to ensure the air bag is a legitimate replacement equivalent to the original,” NHTSA says in the release. “Owners should not attempt to inspect their air bag themselves. If a vehicle is found to have a DTN60DB inflator, it should not be driven until the inflator is replaced with genuine parts.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 在新闻稿中表示：“如果车辆在之前发生过事故且安全气囊展开，则应立即由信誉良好的机械师对其进行检查，以确保安全气囊是与原始安全气囊相同的合法替代品。” “车主不应尝试自行检查安全气囊。如果发现车辆有 DTN60DB 充气机，则不应驾驶该车，除非用正品零件更换充气机。”

paras.en: Technicians looking for guidance on identifying a DTN airbag can also refer to an NHTSA document. The document outlines the materials and design characteristics that can be used to indicate whether an airbag is a counterfeit. DTN airbags are also often marked with DTN60DB. Yet, it can be hard to identify DTN airbags when they’re still installed in a vehicle.
paras.zh: 寻求识别 DTN 安全气囊指导的技术人员也可以参考 NHTSA 文件。该文件概述了可用于表明安全气囊是否为假冒产品的材料和设计特征。 DTN 安全气囊也常标有 DTN60DB。然而，当 DTN 安全气囊仍然安装在车辆上时，很难识别它们。

paras.en: Bohi said the council has reached out to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) and the Department of Transportation (DOT) to get clarification on those processes.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，该委员会已联系酒精、烟草、枪械和爆炸物局 (ATF) 和交通部 (DOT)，以澄清这些流程。

paras.en: “How do you safely handle these things, and what do you do if you get one? Because there are special permits to transport or get rid of these things if there is a counterfeit because we don’t know what’s in them. It’s an unknown explosive, potentially,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: “如何安全地处理这些东西？如果收到了，该怎么办？因为如果有假货，我们需要特殊许可证才能运输或销毁这些东西，因为我们不知道里面有什么。这可能是一种未知的爆炸物，”博希说。

paras.en: NHTSA’s technician guidance does offer warnings that strongly advise technicians not to electronically probe or electrify airbag connecting terminals because they can detonate and cause serious injury or death.
paras.zh: NHTSA 的技术人员指南确实提供了警告，强烈建议技术人员不要对安全气囊连接端子进行电子探测或通电，因为它们可能会爆炸并导致严重伤害或死亡。

paras.en: Bud Center, I-CAR director of technical products and curriculum, previously told Repairer Driven News that electronic probes can be used to deploy a removed airbag. However, if a repairer believes an airbag is counterfeit, they should contact the vehicle’s OEM and ask for instructions.
paras.zh: I-CAR 技术产品和课程总监 Bud Center 此前告诉 Repairer Driven News，电子探针可用于部署拆下的安全气囊。然而，如果维修人员认为安全气囊是假冒的，他们应该联系车辆的原始设备制造商并寻求指示。

paras.en: “You want to make sure you are not going to deploy something that is unsafe,” Center said.
paras.zh: “你要确保不会部署不安全的东西，”中心说。

paras.en: Center dives into the issue of counterfeit parts from the collision shop level in an I-CAR Repairers Realm series.
paras.zh: 中心在 I-CAR 维修领域系列中从碰撞车间层面深入研究假冒零件问题。

paras.en: Nearly all OEMs and many major aftermarket parts companies have people within their organizations who can answer questions concerning products, Bohi said.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，几乎所有原始设备制造商和许多主要售后零部件公司的组织内都有可以回答有关产品问题的人员。

paras.en: If an owner has a vehicle with one of these suspect inflators, they should contact their local Homeland Security Investigations office or FBI field office to report it or submit an online complaint to the National Intellectual Property Rights Coordination Center.
paras.zh: 如果车主的车辆装有这些可疑充气机之一，他们应该联系当地的国土安全调查办公室或联邦调查局外地办事处进行报告或向国家知识产权协调中心提交在线投诉。

paras.en: Owners should also contact NHTSA online or by calling the agency’s Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time.
paras.zh: 车主还应在线联系 NHTSA 或致电该机构的车辆安全热线 888-327-4236，周一至周五上午 8 点至晚上 8 点。东部时间。

articles.title: Brake Job 101: 2004-2013 Mazda 3
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The 2004-2013 Mazda 3 is based on the Ford global C1 platform, shared with the European Ford Focus and Volvo S40. Nothing is really groundbreaking about the mechanical brake system, but not paying attention to the details can end in a post-brake-job comeback.
paras.zh: 2004-2013年的马自达3基于福特全球C1平台，与欧洲福特福克斯和沃尔沃S40共享。机械制动系统并没有什么真正突破性的，但不注意细节可能会导致制动后卷土重来。

paras.en: A key service issue concerns the hydraulics and ABS system. The older the car, the greater the chance the brake fluid has not been serviced. Over time this can cause issues with the ABS hydraulic control unit.
paras.zh: 一个关键的服务问题涉及液压系统和 ABS 系统。汽车越旧，制动液未保养的可能性就越大。随着时间的推移，这可能会导致 ABS 液压控制单元出现问题。

paras.en: For almost 10 years, Mazda used the same caliper, pad and rotor design. Pads should be replaced when there is 2mm or less of friction material. If the rotors are any thicker, they have enough material on them to last at least one turning on the lathe. The runout specification for these vehicles is .002” and disc thickness variation should be far below .0005”.
paras.zh: 近 10 年来，马自达一直使用相同的卡钳、刹车片和转子设计。当摩擦材料有2mm以下时应更换垫片。如果转子较厚，则其上有足够的材料，足以在车床上至少转动一圈。这些车辆的跳动规格为 0.002”，盘厚度变化应远低于 0.0005”。

paras.en: Mazda claims repeated panic braking may raise the temperature in some portions of the disc plate by approx. 1,000°C (l,832°F). This temperature is almost near impossible to achieve this side of a high-speed police chase.
paras.zh: 马自达声称，反复紧急制动可能会使制动盘某些部分的温度升高约 10 度。 1,000°C (l,832°F)。这种温度对于高速警察追捕来说几乎是不可能实现的。

paras.en: The calipers mount to the brackets using caliper guide pins with Allen heads. The sleeves and boots should be disassembled, cleaned and lubricated every time the brakes are replaced. The torque for the guide pins is 21 ft./lbs. and the caliper bracket bolts should be tightened to 75 ft./lbs.
paras.zh: 使用带内六角头的卡钳导销将卡钳安装到支架上。每次更换制动器时，应将套筒和靴子拆开、清洗和润滑。导销的扭矩为 21 英尺/磅。卡钳支架螺栓应拧紧至 75 英尺/磅。

paras.en: All Mazda3 models have rear disc brakes. The calipers mount to the brackets using caliper guide pins with Allen heads. The sleeves and boots should be disassembled, cleaned and lubricated every time the brakes are replaced. The torque for the guide pins is 21 ft./lbs. and the caliper bracket bolts should be tightened to 55 ft./lbs.
paras.zh: 所有 Mazda3 车型均配备后盘式制动器。使用带内六角头的卡钳导销将卡钳安装到支架上。每次更换制动器时，应将套筒和靴子拆开、清洗和润滑。导销的扭矩为 21 英尺/磅。卡钳支架螺栓应拧紧至 55 英尺/磅。

paras.en: Mazda uses a hand brake that is incorporated into the rear caliper, and a couple of systems are employed to retract rear pistons. The later-model cars require the familiar method of turning the piston clockwise while applying pressure, where others will have a plug on the back side of the caliper that provides access for an Allen wrench to facilitate retracting the piston. Be careful as you retract the piston.
paras.zh: 马自达使用集成在后卡钳中的手制动器，并采用几个系统来缩回后活塞。后期型号的汽车需要采用熟悉的方法，在施加压力的同时顺时针转动活塞，而其他型号的汽车则在卡钳的背面有一个塞子，为内六角扳手提供了通道，以便于缩回活塞。缩回活塞时要小心。

paras.en: After the pads are replaced, pump the pedal and adjust the parking brake mechanism in the rear calipers. If the level has too much travel, perform the following steps:
paras.zh: 更换刹车片后，踩下踏板并调整后卡钳中的驻车制动机构。如果水平仪行程太大，请执行以下步骤：

paras.en: - Remove the service hole cover of the rear console.
paras.zh: - 拆下后控制台的维修孔盖。

paras.en: - Turn the adjusting nut and adjust the parking brake lever.
paras.zh: - 转动调节螺母并调节驻车制动杆。

paras.en: - After adjustment, pull the parking brake lever one notch and verify that the parking brake warning light illuminates and the rear brakes do not drag.
paras.zh: - 调整后，将驻车制动杆拉一档，并确认驻车制动警告灯亮起且后制动器不拖曳。

paras.en: The Mazda3 comes in two styles, ABS and ABS with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC). Both systems connect to other vehicle components via a high-speed serial data bus. The DSC system ties more components together (like a yaw/pitch sensor and steering position sensor) onto the bus.
paras.zh: Mazda3 有两种类型：ABS 和带动态稳定控制 (DSC) 的 ABS。两个系统都通过高速串行数据总线连接到其他车辆组件。 DSC 系统将更多组件（如偏航/俯仰传感器和转向位置传感器）连接到总线上。

paras.en: If you are seeing communication-related DTCs, it is essential that you fully diagnose problems with the system before you start replacing sensors and modules. Some of these vehicles have been on the road for more than six years and the connections will be starting to corrode and fret.
paras.zh: 如果您看到与通信相关的 DTC，则在开始更换传感器和模块之前必须全面诊断系统问题。其中一些车辆已经在路上行驶了六年多，连接处将开始腐蚀和磨损。

paras.en: One of the main facilitators of ABS/DCS problems are the connectors, especially under the hood where the control/modulator unit connects. Being able to measure values at the connectors and observe data on a scan tool is essential for diagnosing problems.
paras.zh: ABS/DCS 问题的主要推动因素之一是连接器，尤其是在控制/调制器单元连接的引擎盖下。能够测量连接器处的值并观察扫描工具上的数据对于诊断问题至关重要。

paras.en: The biggest ABS issue with the three generations of Mazda 3 is power. With some higher mileage vehicles, the battery cables, wiring from the power distribution box or the ground connection (behind the driver’s side headlight at G02) can have enough resistance so the voltage drops below 8 volts. When this happens, the ABS module cuts control and the electronic brake distribution system is disabled.
paras.zh: 三代马自达3的ABS最大的问题就是动力。对于一些里程较高的车辆，电池电缆、配电箱接线或接地连接（G02 处驾驶员侧前灯后面）可能具有足够的电阻，因此电压降至 8 伏以下。发生这种情况时，ABS 模块会切断控制，电子制动分配系统将被禁用。

paras.en: If a modulator/control unit is replaced, the pressure sensors must be recalibrated with a scan tool that is able to communicate with the chassis/ABS module. If this is not performed, it can result in brake failure and lock up.
paras.zh: 如果更换调制器/控制单元，则必须使用能够与底盘/ABS 模块通信的扫描工具重新校准压力传感器。如果不执行此操作，可能会导致制动失灵和锁止。

paras.en: If you have DTCs C1141, C1142, C1143, C1144, C1233, C1234, C1235 or C1236 (ABS wheel-speed sensor/ABS sensor rotor), chances are something is wrong with the wheel bearings. Another cause for these codes could be an accumulation of metal debris on the sensor. The front bearings are press-in cartridge-style units. Rear wheel bearings are hub units. In the front, the tone ring, or encoder, is on the inner seal of the bearing and the sensor is mounted in the knuckle. The parameters for these codes to be set include abnormalities in the signal such as a weak signal or large differences in the value when compared to the other sensors.
paras.zh: 如果您有 DTC C1141、C1142、C1143、C1144、C1233、C1234、C1235 或 C1236（ABS 轮速传感器/ABS 传感器转子），则车轮轴承可能出现问题。造成这些代码的另一个原因可能是传感器上金属碎片的堆积。前轴承是压入式盒式单元。后轮轴承是轮毂单元。在前面，音环或编码器位于轴承的内密封件上，传感器安装在转向节中。要设置的这些代码的参数包括信号异常，例如信号较弱或与其他传感器相比值存在较大差异。

paras.en: If you have DTCs C1145, C1155, C1165 or C1175 (open sensor), it could be damaged wiring or a failed sensor that is the problem. If you have more than one, chances are there is a problem with the connection at the control unit or in the front or rear harnesses of the sensors.
paras.zh: 如果您有 DTC C1145、C1155、C1165 或 C1175（传感器开路），则问题可能是接线损坏或传感器故障。如果您有多个，则控制单元或传感器前后线束的连接可能存在问题。

paras.en: These DTCs will usually clear themselves after repairs are made and the vehicle is driven above 6.2 mph when the self-diagnostic check is performed.
paras.zh: 这些 DTC 通常会在维修后自行清除，并且在执行自诊断检查时车辆行驶速度高于 6.2 英里/小时。

paras.en: Some customers may report a slight clunk, bang or jolt from the front of the vehicle. This concern will most likely occur during the vehicle’s first forward movement and after the vehicle sits for a few hours and/or a cold soak. This is a normal operating noise of the ABS system.
paras.zh: 一些客户可能会报告车辆前部发出轻微的沉闷声、撞击声或摇晃声。这种问题很可能发生在车辆第一次向前移动期间以及车辆停放几个小时和/或冷浸之后。这是 ABS 系统的正常工作噪音。

paras.en: If you encounter a customer complaint for this concern, explain that the noise comes from the ABS/TCS/DSC “Malfunction Detection Function” initial check. The initial check is a necessary function to ensure the normal operation of the ABS/TCS/DSC system. This initial test function occurs during the vehicle’s first forward movement and when the vehicle reaches approximately 6.2 mph.
paras.zh: 如果您遇到客户对此问题的投诉，请解释噪音来自 ABS/TCS/DSC“故障检测功能”初始检查。初始检查是保证ABS/TCS/DSC系统正常工作的必要功能。该初始测试功能发生在车辆第一次向前移动且时速达到约 6.2 英里/小时时。

articles.title: Dipstick Replacement Sensors: How They Work
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: GM has taken a lot of guff recently for eliminating the dipstick on some of their newer V8 engines and replacing it with a sensor. Let’s talk about how those sensors actually work, and how and when they measure the oil level.
paras.zh: 通用汽车公司最近因取消一些较新的 V8 发动机上的量油尺并用传感器取代而受到了很多批评。让我们谈谈这些传感器的实际工作原理，以及它们如何以及何时测量油位。

paras.en: It’s not like, for example, a brake master cylinder that has a float and a level that turns on the light on the dash when it reaches a certain level. These sensors are ultrasonic. In other words, it’s sending out a sound wave into the oil pan and determining the oil level that way.
paras.zh: 例如，它不像具有浮子和水平仪的制动主缸，当达到一定水平时，仪表板上的灯会打开。这些传感器是超声波传感器。换句话说，它向油底壳发出声波并以此方式确定油位。

paras.en: How does it know when to measure the level of oil in the oil pan? If you’re using a dipstick, the vehicle would be parked, it probably wouldn’t be running, and that’s when you’re checking the oil level. The sensor works the same way: It’s only measuring the oil level at certain instances. Let’s say it’s in Park when you first start up. Let’s say you’re sitting at a traffic light; that is when it’s measuring the level.
paras.zh: 它如何知道何时测量油底壳中的油位？如果您使用量油尺，车辆将被停放，可能不会运行，此时您需要检查油位。传感器的工作方式相同：它仅在某些情况下测量油位。假设您第一次启动时位于公园。假设您正坐在红绿灯前；那是它测量液位的时候。

paras.en: For more on sensors and how they work, including oxygen and TPMS sensors, watch the video above.
paras.zh: 有关传感器及其工作原理（包括氧气和 TPMS 传感器）的更多信息，请观看上面的视频。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by Auto Value and Bumper To Bumper.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Auto Value 和 Bumper To Bumper 赞助。

articles.title: Corey Bartlett Wins AWDA’s Excellence in Education Award
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented the 2026 Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education, to Corey Bartlett, CEO of Auto Parts Headquarters (APH) based in St. Cloud, MN. The award was presented on November 1st by AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr at AWDA’s 2026 Annual Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于明尼苏达州圣克劳德的汽车零部件总部 (APH) 首席执行官科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 颁发了 2026 年 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖。该奖项于 11 月 1 日由 AWDA 副主席 Young Suhr 在拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: AWDA’s Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education is presented annually to an aftermarket company or individual that demonstrates outstanding commitment to education and training, either within their organization or throughout the industry. Given in memory of former AWDA Chairman Art Fisher, the award grants scholarships in the name of the award winner to two students enrolled in the automotive aftermarket management program at Northwood University.
paras.zh: AWDA 的 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖每年颁发给在其组织内或整个行业内表现出对教育和培训做出杰出承诺的售后公司或个人。为了纪念 AWDA 前主席 Art Fisher，该奖项以获奖者的名义向诺斯伍德大学汽车售后市场管理项目的两名学生提供奖学金。

paras.en: Corey Bartlett has shown a unique interest in education from the day he began working professionally for APH. Within his first ten years, he reorganized staff and increased training for employees. Leading by example, he himself completed the University of the Aftermarket’s Leadership 2010 at Ohio State University, and he earned his AAP and MAAP designations at the University of the Aftermarket in 2002 and 2009 respectively.
paras.zh: 从科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 开始在 APH 专业工作的那天起，他就表现出了对教育的独特兴趣。在他上任的头十年里，他重组了员工并加强了对员工的培训。他以身作则，于 2010 年在俄亥俄州立大学完成了售后市场大学领导力课程，并分别于 2002 年和 2009 年在售后市场大学获得了 AAP 和 MAAP 称号。

paras.en: “Corey has shown incredible initiative in supporting training and continuing education,” said John R. Washbish, president and CEO of the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “Through his leadership roles and example, he has consistently improved the education and standards of his staff, the Alliance, and the industry as a whole.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车零部件联盟总裁兼首席执行官 John R. Washbish 表示：“科里在支持培训和继续教育方面表现出了令人难以置信的主动性。通过他的领导作用和榜样，他不断提高员工、联盟以及整个行业的教育和标准。”

paras.en: Now as CEO, Bartlett primarily oversees the operations of the business and has continued to emphasize education. As the company expanded to include medium, heavy duty, and agricultural aspects, Bartlett and his managers developed a 101 class to further educate his staff about the new aspects of the business. He partnered with a local technical college to provide hands-on experience, and the company saw nearly 100% participation among its 1,200 employees.
paras.zh: 现在，作为首席执行官，巴特利特主要负责监督业务运营，并继续强调教育。随着公司业务扩展到中型、重型和农业领域，Bartlett 和他的经理们开发了 101 课程，以进一步教育员工了解业务的新方面。他与当地一所技术学院合作，提供实践经验，公司 1,200 名员工的参与率接近 100%。

paras.en: While serving as board liaison of the Alliance’s Sales & Marketing Committee, Bartlett oversaw the group’s scholarship program and helped create the Technician of the Year program.
paras.zh: 在担任联盟销售与营销委员会的董事会联络员期间，巴特利特负责监督该集团的奖学金计划，并帮助创建了年度技术员计划。

paras.en: Outside of the Alliance and APH, Bartlett has chaired the Automotive Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA) Board of Governors, serves as a mentor for the Young Auto Care Networking Group (YANG), and has been a generous supporter and active proponent of the Auto Care Political Action Committee since 2015. He was named the AWDA Pursuit of Excellence honoree in 2017.
paras.zh: 除了联盟和 APH 之外，巴特利特还担任汽车仓库经销商协会 (AWDA) 理事会主席、青年汽车护理网络团体 (YANG) 的导师，并且自 2015 年以来一直是汽车护理政治行动委员会的慷慨支持者和积极支持者。他于 2017 年被评为 AWDA 追求卓越奖得主。

paras.en: Bartlett is involved in his local community, enthusiastically supporting WACOSA – a nonprofit organization that helps adults with disabilities connect with local businesses – through Chili Cook Off efforts with his father, and opening up APH facilities for use by local nonprofits.
paras.zh: Bartlett 积极参与当地社区活动，通过与父亲一起开展 Chili Cook Off 活动，热情支持 WCOSA（一家帮助残疾人与当地企业建立联系的非营利组织），并开放 APH 设施供当地非营利组织使用。

articles.title: Servicing Volkswagen Electronic Parking Brakes
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The majority of Volkswagen vehicles sold in the past decade have electronic parking brakes. However, most customers don’t even realize that the vehicle has an electronic parking brake, because the system engages and disengages the parking brake automatically on most vehicles. But, when the system fails and turns on the light or has a warning in the driver information center, then the customer will notice.
paras.zh: 过去十年销售的大多数大众汽车都配备了电子驻车制动器。然而，大多数客户甚至没有意识到车辆有电子驻车制动器，因为大多数车辆上的系统会自动接合和释放驻车制动器。但是，当系统出现故障并打开灯或在驾驶员信息中心发出警告时，客户就会注意到。

paras.en: If you are doing a brake job on a vehicle with an electronic parking brake, you will need a scan tool with the proper software for the parking brake system to retract the calipers, adjust and perform diagnostics. There are no shortcuts on YouTube. You can find videos that involve removing the electric motor, jumping connectors and disassembling the parking brake mechanism. But, these methods are very risky and can damage the vehicle and kill productivity. Unapproved methods will set malfunction codes, and the worst-case scenario is that you could damage the unit.
paras.zh: 如果您要对配备电子驻车制动器的车辆进行制动作业，您将需要一个带有适合驻车制动系统软件的扫描工具，以缩回卡钳、调整和执行诊断。 YouTube 上没有捷径。您可以找到涉及拆卸电动机、跳接连接器和拆卸驻车制动机构的视频。但是，这些方法风险很大，可能会损坏车辆并降低生产力。未经批准的方法会设置故障代码，最坏的情况是您可能会损坏设备。

paras.en: The VW system that was installed on many of its platforms starting in 2004 is an example of a system that requires a scan tool to replace the rear brake pads.
paras.zh: 从 2004 年开始在其许多平台上安装的大众系统就是一个需要扫描工具来更换后刹车片的系统的例子。

paras.en: The system has stepper motors on the back of the caliper that actuate the piston. The motor can be removed from the caliper, though the ignition should be switched off for at least 30 seconds before removing the connector.
paras.zh: 该系统在卡钳背面装有步进电机，用于驱动活塞。电机可以从卡钳上拆下，但在拆下连接器之前应关闭点火装置至少 30 秒。

paras.en: The motor is sealed to the caliper with an o-ring around the spindle. The condition of this o-ring is critical for the life of the motor and should be lightly lubricated with brake fluid. If the o-ring fails, water and debris will be one step closer to the motor gears.
paras.zh: 电机通过主轴周围的 O 形圈密封至卡钳。该 O 形圈的状况对于电机的使用寿命至关重要，应使用制动液进行轻微润滑。如果 O 形圈失效，水和碎屑就会离电机齿轮更近一步。

paras.en: The spindle on the caliper can be rocked slightly with a torx bit so the motor seats in the spindle. Don’t force the motor assembly onto the caliper, because damage to the housing can occur.
paras.zh: 可以用梅花钻头稍微摇动卡尺上的主轴，以便将电机固定在主轴中。请勿将电机组件强行安装到卡钳上，因为可能会损坏外壳。

paras.en: On recent platforms, VW have outfitted the motors with a sensor that can measure brake pad wear and adjust the pads for the least amount of drag. During this adjustment on some vehicles, the pad thickness is calculated. The system counts the number of rotations of the motor with a hall effect sensor inside the unit.
paras.zh: 在最新的平台上，大众汽车为电机配备了传感器，可以测量刹车片的磨损情况并调整刹车片以获得最小的阻力。在某些车辆的调整过程中，会计算垫厚度。该系统通过装置内部的霍尔效应传感器来计算电机的转数。

paras.en: Inspecting the caliper, hardware and motors may not give you a complete picture of what is happening with these systems. Having access to a scan tool can reduce diagnostic time.
paras.zh: 检查卡钳、硬件和电机可能无法让您全面了解这些系统发生的情况。使用扫描工具可以减少诊断时间。

paras.en: The OEMs have built-in bi-directional protocols to retract the parking brake so the pads can be replaced. A dedicated brake tool or enhanced scan tool is able to command these protocols and interrogate the module for codes and faults.
paras.zh: 原始设备制造商具有内置的双向协议来缩回驻车制动器，以便更换刹车片。专用制动工具或增强型扫描工具能够命令这些协议并询问模块的代码和故障。

paras.en: The Electronic Parking Brake Module (EPBM) is the module on the CAN bus of most vehicles equipped with this system. Any missing data for vehicle speed, gear position or brake pedal input will cause a problem with the system.
paras.zh: 电子驻车制动模块 (EPBM) 是大多数配备此系统的车辆的 CAN 总线上的模块。任何车速、档位或制动踏板输入数据的缺失都会导致系统出现问题。

paras.en: Some systems use information from the electric parking brake to track shoe and pad wear. The system will count the number of turns the actuator makes or the position of the stepper motor to determine the thickness of the friction material.
paras.zh: 一些系统使用来自电动驻车制动器的信息来跟踪蹄片和刹车片的磨损情况。系统将计算执行器的转数或步进电机的位置，以确定摩擦材料的厚度。

paras.en: If you do find yourself working on a vehicle whose electronic parking brake will not disengage, the first thing to do is look at the basics. Some systems require that the doors be shut and the brake pedal depressed. Some models may even require the seat belt to be buckled. Simple items like a defective brake pedal or door switch may hinder operation. Also, in some cases, the button may be defective. On some vehicles, the operation of the switch can be verified with a scan tool.
paras.zh: 如果您确实发现自己正在维修一辆电子驻车制动器无法松开的车辆，那么首先要做的就是了解基础知识。某些系统要求关闭车门并踩下制动踏板。有些车型甚至可能需要扣上安全带。制动踏板或门开关有缺陷等简单的部件可能会妨碍操作。此外，在某些情况下，按钮可能有缺陷。在某些车辆上，可以使用扫描工具验证开关的操作。

articles.title: MEYLE to Bring Back Scholarship Fundraiser at AAPEX 2026
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: MEYLE announced that it will bring its German license plate fundraiser to raise money for Northwood University scholarships back to AAPEX 2026 (Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas).
paras.zh: MEYLE 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026（11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯）举行德国车牌筹款活动，为诺斯伍德大学奖学金筹集资金。

paras.en: MEYLE will host the fundraiser at its exhibit at the show, featuring a German license plate stamping machine. Visitors can create custom MEYLE-branded plates in exchange for donations benefiting Northwood students.
paras.zh: MEYLE 将在展会上的展位上举办筹款活动，展出一台德国车牌冲压机。参观者可以制作定制的 MEYLE 品牌盘子，以换取惠及诺斯伍德学生的捐款。

paras.en: Last year’s initiative generated $9,171 in donations. MEYLE supplemented that amount with a $5,000 matching contribution, bringing the total to $14,171.
paras.zh: 去年的倡议筹集了 9,171 美元的捐款。 MEYLE 补充了 5,000 美元的配套捐款，使总额达到 14,171 美元。

paras.en: Northwood Student Receives First MEYLE Scholarship
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德学生获得首届梅尔奖学金

paras.en: Earlier this year, Quinn Balcam became the first recipient of the MEYLE scholarship. Balcam, an automotive aftermarket management major from Bloomington, Indiana, serves as president of Northwood’s student aftermarket club.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，奎因·巴尔卡姆（Quinn Balcam）成为第一位获得梅尔奖学金的人。巴尔卡姆是来自印第安纳州布卢明顿的汽车售后市场管理专业学生，担任诺斯伍德学生售后市场俱乐部的主席。

paras.en: MEYLE notes that Balcam has demonstrated his industry commitment through multiple internships and leadership in the Northwood University International Auto Show’s aftermarket division. He has also participated in events including AAPEX, SEMA and Heavy-Duty Aftermarket Week.
paras.zh: MEYLE 指出，Balcam 通过在诺斯伍德大学国际汽车展售后市场部门的多次实习和领导，展示了他的行业承诺。他还参加了 AAPEX、SEMA 和重型售后市场周等活动。

paras.en: “Seeing the funds raised at AAPEX translate into scholarship support for a student like Quinn illustrates why partnerships like this are so important,” said James O’Dell, director of aftermarket education at Northwood University. “The automotive aftermarket needs talented, motivated young professionals, and MEYLE is helping our students gain both the financial support and industry connections they need to succeed.”
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学售后教育总监詹姆斯·奥戴尔 (James O'Dell) 表示：“看到 AAPEX 筹集的资金转化为对 Quinn 这样的学生的奖学金支持，这说明了为什么这样的合作伙伴关系如此重要。” “汽车售后市场需要有才华、积极进取的年轻专业人士，MEYLE 正在帮助我们的学生获得成功所需的财务支持和行业联系。”

articles.title: How Brake-Based Traction Control Helps AWD
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Many all-wheel-drive (AWD) systems reached the market during the 1990s, as the SUV boom gave automakers an opportunity to sell profitable light trucks. Many early SUVs used transfer cases, limited-slip or locking differentials, and locking hubs adapted from the automakers’ truck platforms. As buyers began asking for four-wheel-drive capability in smaller, more fuel-efficient vehicles, automakers developed lighter AWD systems for passenger cars and crossovers.
paras.zh: 许多全轮驱动 (AWD) 系统在 20 世纪 90 年代进入市场，SUV 的繁荣给汽车制造商提供了销售有利可图的轻型卡车的机会。许多早期的 SUV 使用分动箱、限滑或锁止差速器以及源自汽车制造商卡车平台的锁止轮毂。随着买家开始要求更小、更省油的车辆具有四轮驱动能力，汽车制造商为乘用车和跨界车开发了更轻的全轮驱动系统。

paras.en: Sending power to all four wheels is possible with either a longitudinal or transverse engine. A transverse layout can send power from the transaxle through a power takeoff unit and driveshaft to the rear axle. Depending on the design, the system may use a center differential, a coupling, or another device to manage the front-to-rear torque distribution. One feature these systems may lack, compared with traditional four-wheel-drive hardware, is a mechanical differential lock or limited-slip differential.
paras.zh: 使用纵向或横向发动机可以向所有四个车轮发送动力。横向布局可以将动力从变速驱动桥通过动力输出装置和驱动轴传送至后轴。根据设计，系统可能使用中央差速器、联轴器或其他设备来管理前后扭矩分配。与传统的四轮驱动硬件相比，这些系统可能缺乏的一项功能是机械差速锁或限滑差速器。

paras.en: Engineers found another way to improve traction: use the ABS hardware to apply a brake at a slipping wheel. This brake-based traction control can make an open differential behave somewhat like a limited-slip differential in low-traction conditions.
paras.zh: 工程师找到了另一种提高牵引力的方法：使用 ABS 硬件对打滑的车轮进行制动。这种基于制动的牵引力控制可以使开式差速器在低牵引力条件下表现得有点像限滑差速器。

paras.en: An open differential allows the drive wheels to turn at different speeds while cornering. The ring gear turns the differential case, which carries small spider gears. Those gears mesh with side gears connected to the axle shafts. An open differential delivers similar torque to both axle shafts, but the torque available is limited by the wheel with less grip. If one tire is on a slippery surface, it can spin while the other tire receives too little torque to move the vehicle effectively.
paras.zh: 开放式差速器允许驱动轮在转弯时以不同的速度转动。环形齿轮转动差速器壳，差速器壳带有小星形齿轮。这些齿轮与连接到车轴的侧齿轮啮合。开放式差速器向两个车轴提供相似​​的扭矩，但可用扭矩受到抓地力较小的车轮的限制。如果一个轮胎位于光滑的表面上，它可能会打滑，而另一个轮胎接收的扭矩太小而无法有效地移动车辆。

paras.en: Brake-based traction control addresses this by applying the brake at the spinning wheel. The added resistance creates a reaction torque through the differential, allowing more usable torque to reach the wheel with better grip. The system does not lock the differential mechanically, but it can produce a limited-slip effect. Some AWD systems also use brake control to manage wheelspin across the front and rear axles; the exact strategy depends on the vehicle’s driveline and control system.
paras.zh: 基于制动的牵引力控制通过在旋转的车轮上施加制动来解决这个问题。增加的阻力通过差速器产生反作用扭矩，从而使更多可用扭矩以更好的抓地力到达车轮。该系统不会机械锁定差速器，但可以产生限滑效果。一些全轮驱动系统还使用制动控制来管理前轴和后轴的车轮打滑；确切的策略取决于车辆的传动系统和控制系统。

paras.en: The system makes quick adjustments based on wheel-speed signals. Depending on the vehicle, it may apply the brakes, reduce engine torque, or use both strategies to control wheelspin. Some drivers may feel or hear the brakes operating during a traction event. On some vehicles, limited brake-based traction functions remain active even when the driver switches off part of the stability-control system.
paras.zh: 该系统根据轮速信号进行快速调整。根据车辆的不同，它可能会施加制动，降低发动机扭矩，或同时使用这两种策略来控制车轮打滑。一些驾驶员可能会在牵引事件期间感觉到或听到制动器正在操作。在某些车辆上，即使驾驶员关闭部分稳定性控制系统，基于制动的有限牵引功能仍保持活动状态。

paras.en: Brake-based traction control has limits compared with a four-wheel-drive system equipped with mechanically locking differentials. Brake application creates heat, and traction may be reduced if the system reaches its operating limits. Still, for drivers who encounter snow, mud, or other slippery conditions occasionally, the system can make a substantial difference.
paras.zh: 与配备机械锁定差速器的四轮驱动系统相比，基于制动的牵引力控制具有局限性。制动时会产生热量，如果系统达到其运行极限，牵引力可能会降低。尽管如此，对于偶尔遇到雪、泥或其他湿滑状况的驾驶员来说，该系统可以发挥很大的作用。

paras.en: These systems do not have differential clutches that require service, but brake-based traction control adds activity to the brakes and ABS hydraulic control unit. Follow the manufacturer’s brake-fluid specification and service interval. Some vehicles require a low-viscosity DOT 4 fluid so the hydraulic system can respond as designed; use it only when specified for that application.
paras.zh: 这些系统没有需要维修的差速离合器，但基于制动器的牵引力控制增加了制动器和 ABS 液压控制单元的活动。遵循制造商的制动液规格和保养周期。有些车辆需要低粘度 DOT 4 液压油，以便液压系统能够按设计响应；仅当为该应用程序指定时才使用它。

paras.en: Replacement brake pads should perform similarly to the original pads across the operating temperature range. A pad with different friction behavior may affect braking response and the system’s ability to control wheelspin.
paras.zh: 在工作温度范围内，替换刹车片的性能应与原始刹车片相似。具有不同摩擦行为的刹车片可能会影响制动响应和系统控制车轮打滑的能力。

paras.en: Wheel-speed sensors are another service consideration. If a sensor or its circuit provides an inaccurate signal, the system may limit its operation or disable traction-control functions. That can reduce the vehicle’s ability to manage wheelspin in snow, mud or ice. Check for ABS and traction-control codes, inspect the sensor wiring and tone or encoder rings, and verify wheel-speed data before condemning a sensor.
paras.zh: 轮速传感器是另一个服务考虑因素。如果传感器或其电路提供不准确的信号，系统可能会限制其操作或禁用牵引力控制功能。这会降低车辆在雪、泥或冰中控制车轮打滑的能力。检查 ABS 和牵引力控制代码，检查传感器接线和音调或编码器环，并在报废传感器之前验证轮速数据。

articles.title: The Effect of Thin Brake Fluid on Vehicle Systems
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Lower-viscosity brake fluid plays a growing role in modern brake systems. Today’s vehicles require brake fluid to move quickly through hydraulic control units that support ABS, stability control, traction control and several ADAS braking functions.
paras.zh: 低粘度制动液在现代制动系统中发挥着越来越重要的作用。当今的车辆需要制动液快速流过液压控制单元，以支持 ABS、稳定性控制、牵引力控制和多种 ADAS 制动功能。

paras.en: Modern brake systems use faster valves, tighter internal passages and more frequent automatic brake interventions than systems used 20 years ago.
paras.zh: 与 20 年前使用的系统相比，现代制动系统使用更快的阀门、更紧密的内部通道和更频繁的自动制动干预。

paras.en: As a result, many late-model vehicles require lower-viscosity brake fluid. The goal is to maintain efficient fluid movement at low temperatures so the hydraulic unit can build and release pressure quickly.
paras.zh: 因此，许多新型车辆需要较低粘度的制动液。目标是在低温下保持高效的流体运动，以便液压装置可以快速建立和释放压力。

paras.en: Lower-Viscosity Brake Fluid Supports Faster Response
paras.zh: 较低粘度的制动液支持更快的响应

paras.en: The ABS hydraulic unit is used, not only during panic stops, but for electronic stability control, traction control, adaptive cruise control, collision mitigation braking and automatic emergency braking.
paras.zh: ABS 液压装置不仅用于紧急停车期间，还用于电子稳定性控制、牵引力控制、自适应巡航控制、碰撞缓解制动和自动紧急制动。

paras.en: Inside the hydraulic control unit, brake fluid moves through small valves and narrow passages. Lower viscosity allows pressure to increase and decrease faster, helping the system make quicker and more precise braking corrections.
paras.zh: 在液压控制单元内部，制动液流经小阀门和狭窄通道。较低的粘度允许压力更快地增加和减少，帮助系统更快、更精确地进行制动修正。

paras.en: Brake fluid condition is also important. Moisture contamination can increase viscosity, lower the boiling point and raise corrosion risk.
paras.zh: 制动液状况也很重要。水分污染会增加粘度、降低沸点并增加腐蚀风险。

paras.en: Technicians should use the exact brake fluid specified by the vehicle manufacturer and replace it according to the proper service information.
paras.zh: 技术人员应使用车辆制造商指定的制动液，并根据正确的维修信息进行更换。

articles.title: AAPEX Announces Show and Exhibit Floor Enhancements
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) announced an improved floor plan for the exhibit halls, along with enhancements to the show. Central to the improved layout is the all-new AAPEX Forum, which optimizes the show’s exhibitor segmentation capacity, first introduced last year.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场产品博览会 (AAPEX) 宣布改进展厅平面图，并对展会进行改进。布局改进的核心是去年首次推出的全新 AAPEX 论坛，该论坛优化了展会的参展商细分能力。

paras.en: Traditionally, exhibitor booths were segmented by one of a dozen overarching product or service categories; however, some supplementary sections were still needed to carry an overflow of exhibitors. The new layout for 2026, including the AAPEX Forum, enables the show to keep all exhibitors of a given section together and eliminates the need for overflow areas.
paras.zh: 传统上，参展商的展位按照十几个主要产品或服务类别之一进行划分。然而，仍然需要一些补充展区来容纳过多的参展商。 2026 年的新布局（包括 AAPEX 论坛）使展会能够将特定部分的所有参展商聚集在一起，并消除了溢出区域的需要。

paras.en: The segmentation was implemented at the request of buyers who frequent the show and wanted to meet all possible suppliers in a single location – without having to traverse back and forth across the 500,000 square feet of show-floor space. It also proved beneficial to exhibitors who could more efficiently set up meetings with more prospective buyers.
paras.zh: 这种细分是应经常参加展会并希望在一个地点与所有可能的供应商会面的买家的要求而实施的，而无需在 500,000 平方英尺的展厅空间中来回穿梭。事实证明，这对参展商来说是有益的，他们可以更有效地与更多潜在买家举行会议。

paras.en: “The new layout was well-received among attendees; AAPEX earned the highest net promoter score (NPS), a standard measure of customer satisfaction, that it’s ever received following last year’s show,” said MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers Vice President of Events Liz Goad. “AAPEX strives for continuous improvement, and we have worked with exhibitors and buyers alike to create a plan that’s easy to navigate and fosters a high-energy business atmosphere.”
paras.zh: “新的布局受到了与会者的好评；继去年展会之后，AAPEX 获得了最高的净推荐值 (NPS)，这是衡量客户满意度的标准指标，”MEMA 售后供应商活动副总裁 Liz Goad 说道。 “AAPEX 致力于持续改进，我们与参展商和买家共同制定了一个易于操作并营造高活力商业氛围的计划。”

articles.title: Valvoline Launches Children’s Miracle Network Fundraiser
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Valvoline Inc. launched its annual in-store fundraising campaign benefiting Children’s Miracle Network. Throughout November, customers at participating Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Great Canadian Oil Change and Oil Changers locations can donate. The campaign supports children and families in their local communities.
paras.zh: Valvoline Inc. 发起了年度店内筹款活动，为 Children's Miracle Network 提供资助。整个 11 月，参与​​ Valvoline Instant Oil Change、Great Canadian Oil Change 和 Oil Changers 活动地点的客户都可以捐款。该活动为当地社区的儿童和家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Valvoline Marks 17 Years of Supporting Children’s Hospitals
paras.zh: 胜牌纪念支持儿童医院 17 周年

paras.en: This year marks Valvoline Inc.’s 17th year supporting Children’s Miracle Network, a partnership that began in 2009. Throughout the partnership, Valvoline Inc. and its customers have contributed nearly $10 million to children’s hospitals through fundraising efforts.
paras.zh: 今年是胜牌公司支持儿童奇迹网络的第 17 个年头，这一合作始于 2009 年。在整个合作过程中，胜牌公司及其客户通过筹款活动向儿童医院捐赠了近 1000 万美元。

paras.en: “Supporting the communities we serve is an important part of who we are at Valvoline Inc.,” said Lori Flees, president and CEO, Valvoline Inc. “For 17 years, our team members and customers have helped make a difference for children and families through Children’s Miracle Network. We’re proud to continue that tradition and invite our customers to join us again this year.”
paras.zh: Valvoline Inc. 总裁兼首席执行官 Lori Flees 表示：“支持我们所服务的社区是我们 Valvoline Inc. 的重要组成部分。17 年来，我们的团队成员和客户通过 Children’s Miracle Network 帮助改变了儿童和家庭的生活。我们很自豪能够延续这一传统，并邀请我们的客户今年再次加入我们。”

paras.en: Customers who visit participating service centers during the campaign can donate to Children’s Miracle Network. Local children’s hospitals will receive 100% of the proceeds.
paras.zh: 活动期间访问参与服务中心的顾客可以向儿童奇迹网络捐款。当地儿童医院将获得100%的收益。

paras.en: Customers who donate will receive a coupon for 10% off a future service. Anyone can support the campaign with an online donation at https://www.helpmakemiracles.org/Valvoline2026.
paras.zh: 捐赠的客户将收到一张优惠券，可在未来的服务中享受 10% 的折扣。任何人都可以通过在线捐款支持该活动：https://www.helpmakemiracles.org/Valvoline2026。

paras.en: “Valvoline Inc. team members and customers prove what is possible when a community rallies around local children’s hospitals,” said Aimee Daily, Ph.D., president and CEO of Children’s Miracle Network. “Their generosity provides care teams with essential resources and gives families hope when it is needed most. We are grateful for Valvoline Inc.’s continued partnership as we launch this campaign and work together to make big change for all kids.”
paras.zh: “胜牌公司的团队成员和客户证明，当社区团结在当地儿童医院周围时，一切皆有可能，”儿童奇迹网络总裁兼首席执行官 Aimee Daily 博士说道。 “他们的慷慨为护理团队提供了必要的资源，并在最需要的时候给家庭带来希望。我们感谢胜牌公司在我们发起这项活动时的持续合作，并共同努力为所有孩子带来巨大的改变。”

paras.en: Children’s Miracle Network raises funds for member children’s hospitals across the U.S. and Canada. These hospitals provide care to millions of children and families each year.
paras.zh: 儿童奇迹网络为美国和加拿大的成员儿童医院筹集资金。这些医院每年为数百万儿童和家庭提供护理。

articles.title: The Right to Repair is Under Threat
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: As vehicles become more advanced, manufacturers are restricting access to essential repair tools, parts and software. These barriers drive up costs, limit consumer choice and put independent repair shops at risk.
paras.zh: 随着车辆变得更加先进，制造商正在限制使用必要的维修工具、零件和软件。这些障碍增加了成本，限制了消费者的选择，并使独立维修店面临风险。

paras.en: Share your experience. Fill out our “Can’t Repair It? Report It!” survey and tell us about the repair barriers you’ve faced. Together, we can protect the right to repair and ensure fair access to automotive repair for everyone.
paras.zh: 分享您的经验。填写我们的“无法修复？报告！”调查并告诉我们您遇到的维修障碍。我们可以共同保护维修权，并确保每个人都能公平地获得汽车维修服务。

paras.en: - Restricted access to diagnostic software and repair information: Independent repair shops struggle to access the data necessary for repairs.
paras.zh: - 对诊断软件和维修信息的访问受到限制：独立维修店很难获取维修所需的数据。

paras.en: - Proprietary parts: Some vehicle components are designed to work only with authorized dealers.
paras.zh: - 专有部件：某些车辆部件设计为只能与授权经销商合作。

paras.en: - Third-party repair limitations: Consumers are forced into using costly dealership services instead of trusted local repair shops.
paras.zh: - 第三方维修限制：消费者被迫使用昂贵的经销商服务，而不是值得信赖的当地维修店。

paras.en: Every repair restriction impacts consumers, technicians and independent shop owners. By reporting your experience, you help to:
paras.zh: 每项维修限制都会影响消费者、技术人员和独立店主。通过报告您的经历，您可以帮助：

paras.en: - Show the real-world impact: Personal stories highlight the need for legislative action.
paras.zh: - 展示现实世界的影响：个人故事强调了立法行动的必要性。

paras.en: - Support fair competition: Ensuring all repair shops have access to tools, parts and software keeps repair costs reasonable.
paras.zh: - 支持公平竞争：确保所有维修店都能获得工具、零件和软件，使维修成本保持合理。

paras.en: - Protect consumer choice: Everyone deserves the freedom to choose where they get their vehicles repaired.
paras.zh: - 保护消费者的选择：每个人都应该自由选择修理车辆的地点。

paras.en: Scan the QR code or click here to report your experience.
paras.zh: 扫描二维码或点击此处报告您的体验。

articles.title: What About the Scratch?
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Vehicle scratch repairs depend on the depth of the damage. Counter professionals can recommend polishing compounds and buffing pads for minor clear-coat scratches. Deeper scratches that penetrate the base coat require touch-up paint and clear coat.
paras.zh: 车辆划痕修复取决于损坏的深度。柜台专业人士可以推荐抛光剂和抛光垫来处理轻微的透明涂层划痕。穿透底漆的较深划痕需要补漆和清漆。

paras.en: For more extensive repairs, customers may need 2,000-grit sandpaper and progressively finer polishing pads. Caution customers against machine polishing near edges.
paras.zh: 对于更广泛的维修，客户可能需要 2,000 目砂纸和越来越细的抛光垫。提醒客户不要对边缘附近进行机器抛光。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Dayco Expands Radiator Hose Line With 283 New Parts
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Dayco is expanding its radiator hose line in response to key market indicators and growing demand. The company supplies engine products and drive systems to the automotive, industrial and aftermarket industries. The expansion will introduce 283 new hoses for complex vehicle applications.
paras.zh: Dayco 正在扩大其散热器软管产品线，以应对关键的市场指标和不断增长的需求。该公司为汽车、工业和售后市场行业提供发动机产品和驱动系统。此次扩建将推出 283 种用于复杂车辆应用的新软管。

paras.en: Dayco Targets 90% Radiator Hose Coverage
paras.zh: Dayco 的目标是散热器软管覆盖率达到 90%

paras.en: The expansion will increase Dayco’s radiator hose coverage to 90% of vehicles in operation (VIO) by March 2027. That represents a 20% increase since 2025. Dayco will make 66 applications available in November and another 40 by year-end. The company will launch the remaining applications by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
paras.zh: 此次扩建将使 Dayco 的散热器软管覆盖率在 2027 年 3 月之前达到运营车辆 (VIO) 的 90%。这意味着自 2025 年以来增加了 20%。Dayco 将在 11 月提供 66 个应用程序，到年底将提供 40 个应用程序。该公司将于 2027 年第一季度末推出剩余的应用程序。

paras.en: The new part numbers include simple and branched hoses that meet stringent original equipment specifications for fit, form and function.
paras.zh: 新零件号包括简单软管和分支软管，符合严格的原始设备规格、形状和功能。

paras.en: Industry trends helped drive Dayco’s hose line expansion. These include more vehicles approaching cooling system maintenance intervals. Today’s downsized turbocharged and high-performance engines also place greater demands on cooling systems and surrounding components.
paras.zh: 行业趋势帮助推动了 Dayco 软管生产线的扩张。其中包括更多车辆接近冷却系统维护间隔。当今的小型涡轮增压和高性能发动机也对冷却系统和周边部件提出了更高的要求。

paras.en: “Between strong market drivers related to maintenance as well as an increase in demand, we prioritized an aggressive go-to-market strategy so we could introduce a significant number of new hose applications over the next several months,” said Jerry Reeves, head of product management for Dayco N.A. “This enables us to help our customers capture immediate market share while also enhancing our core value proposition.”
paras.zh: Dayco N.A. 产品管理主管 Jerry Reeves 表示：“在与维护相关的强劲市场驱动因素以及需求增长之间，我们优先考虑了积极的市场进入战略，以便我们可以在未来几个月内推出大量新的软管应用。这使我们能够帮助我们的客户立即占领市场份额，同时增强我们的核心价值主张。”

paras.en: Dayco’s automotive hose line includes simple and branched designs for radiators, heaters, exhaust vents, fuel systems and other applications.
paras.zh: Dayco 的汽车软管系列包括用于散热器、加热器、排气口、燃油系统和其他应用的简单和分支设计。

paras.en: The company uses EPDM compounds and other materials to manufacture hoses for transferring fluids or gases. These hoses serve applications involving corrosive substances and high-pressure environments.
paras.zh: 该公司使用 EPDM 化合物和其他材料来制造用于传输流体或气体的软管。这些软管适用于涉及腐蚀性物质和高压环境的应用。

paras.en: For more information on Dayco’s complete hose line, visit the company’s website.
paras.zh: 有关 Dayco 完整软管系列的更多信息，请访问该公司的网站。

articles.title: 'Now you actually have a blood test': Psychiatry's bible, the DSM, is getting upgraded to include biological markers. A psychiatrist explains what that means for mental health.
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: For decades, psychiatrists and other mental health professionals have used the "Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders," or DSM, to diagnose patients with conditions such as major depression, anorexia and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). To reach diagnoses, mental health practitioners identify symptoms via interview, case history, questionnaire, or observation to paint a clinical picture.
paras.zh: 几十年来，精神科医生和其他心理健康专业人士一直使用《精神疾病诊断和统计手册》（DSM）来诊断患有重度抑郁症、厌食症和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）等疾病的患者。为了做出诊断，心理健康从业者通过访谈、病史、问卷或观察来识别症状，以绘制临床图景。

paras.en: But for the next version of this "psychiatry bible", the DSM-6, scientists are planning to add other factors into the diagnostic criteria.
paras.zh: 但对于这本“精神病学圣经”的下一个版本——DSM-6，科学家们正计划在诊断标准中添加其他因素。

paras.en: Dr. Anand Kumar, a psychiatrist who served for two years on the DSM Strategy Committee, says one of the most important potential changes is the introduction of biological factors into the diagnostic framework. While Kumar, the head of the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Illinois Chicago, no longer serves on the committee, he was influential in discussions about how biology could be incorporated into the DSM-6. Some of these biological factors include data from genome-wide association studies of hundreds or thousands of genes that each increase the risk of a mental disorder by a tiny amount. Other biological factors include signs of inflammation or immune-system dysfunction that may show up in blood tests or brain scans.
paras.zh: 在 DSM 战略委员会任职两年的精神病学家阿南德·库马尔博士表示，最重要的潜在变化之一是将生物因素引入诊断框架。虽然伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校精神病学系主任库马尔不再担任委员会成员，但他在有关如何将生物学纳入 DSM-6 的讨论中具有影响力。其中一些生物因素包括来自数百或数千个基因的全基因组关联研究的数据，每个基因都会略微增加精神障碍的风险。其他生物因素包括血液检查或脑部扫描中可能出现的炎症或免疫系统功能障碍的迹象。

paras.en: Live Science spoke to Kumar about how this update to the DSM could change the way mental disorders are understood and potentially help improve treatment.
paras.zh: Live Science 与 Kumar 讨论了 DSM 的更新如何改变人们对精神障碍的理解方式，并可能有助于改善治疗。

paras.en: Dr. Kumar is the Lizzie Gilman Professor and Head of the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Illinois at Chicago. Dr. Kumar's research focuses on late-life depression and mental disorders of the elderly, including Alzheimer's disease. He has served as Treasurer, Program Committee Chair, and President of the American Association for Geriatric Psychiatry (2004-2005). Dr. Kumar is Associate Editor of the American Journal for Geriatric Psychiatry and has served as reviewer for numerous NIH review committees.
paras.zh: Kumar 博士是伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的 Lizzie Gilman 教授兼精神病学系主任。库马尔博士的研究重点是晚年抑郁症和老年人的精神障碍，包括阿尔茨海默病。他曾担任美国老年精神病学协会财务主管、项目委员会主席和主席（2004-2005 年）。 Kumar 博士是《美国老年精神病学杂志》的副主编，并担任多个 NIH 审查委员会的审稿人。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry: How is the DSM-6 going to be different from the DSM-5?
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry：DSM-6 与 DSM-5 有何不同？

paras.en: Anand Kumar: Up to this point, the distinctions between the different major groups — who has clinical depression, or what we call major depression; who has an eating disorder; who has PTSD, etc. — have been based exclusively on clinical grounds: You meet certain criteria, and you fall into this category. If you meet some other criteria, you fall into another category.
paras.zh: 阿南德·库马尔（Anand Kumar）：到目前为止，不同主要群体之间的区别——谁患有临床抑郁症，或者我们所说的重度抑郁症？谁患有饮食失调症；患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）等的人——完全基于临床理由：你符合某些标准，你就属于这一类。如果您满足其他一些标准，您就会属于另一个类别。

paras.en: An attempt that's being made now, one of the major attempts for the next DSM, is to introduce biological factors into the manual.
paras.zh: 现在正在做的一个尝试，是下一个DSM的主要尝试之一，就是将生物因素引入到手册中。

paras.en: The idea is not new. It's been discussed in the past, but it was difficult to get a consensus on what goes in and what should not go in. That's still going to be tricky, but at least there's a broad acknowledgement that the time is ready to start introducing biology into the DSM.
paras.zh: 这个想法并不新鲜。过去已经讨论过这个问题，但很难就什么应该纳入、什么不应该纳入达成共识。这仍然很棘手，但至少人们普遍承认，现在是时候开始将生物学引入 DSM 了。

paras.en: It's very likely that, at the end of it, there will be meaningful changes in a positive kind of way. It's not going to make everyone happy. There are going to be gaps, but the idea is to incrementally improve this and make it more modern as we go along.
paras.zh: 最终很可能会以积极的方式发生有意义的变化。这不会让每个人都高兴。会有差距，但我们的想法是逐步改进这一点，并随着我们的进展使其更加现代化。

paras.en: KHC: What sort of biological markers have you seen that we can actually correlate with these disorders?
paras.zh: KHC：您发现了哪些生物标志物实际上可以与这些疾病相关联？

paras.en: AK: What the committee is doing is taking a more nuanced approach. Outside the realm of Alzheimer's disease, which I'll get into in a minute, there are no clear-cut diagnostic biomarkers — meaning no blood tests or brain scans that you can look at and say, "This person has a diagnosis of depression," or "This person has PTSD," or "This person has schizophrenia."
paras.zh: AK：委员会正在采取更细致的方法。在阿尔茨海默氏病领域之外（我稍后会介绍），没有明确的诊断生物标志物，这意味着没有血液测试或脑部扫描可以让你看到并说“这个人被诊断为抑郁症”或“这个人患有创伤后应激障碍”或“这个人患有精神分裂症”。

paras.en: The committee talked about how, in addition to biological biomarkers, there's a concept of biological factors. What I mean by that is biological pathways and mechanisms that have a role in the development of a particular disorder, but the findings have not crystallized into a laboratory test.
paras.zh: 委员会讨论了除了生物标志物之外，还有生物因素的概念。我的意思是生物途径和机制在特定疾病的发展中发挥作用，但这些发现尚未具体化为实验室测试。

paras.en: For example, immunology — the study of the body's response to a variety of stresses, including infections and others — has been shown to be impactful in about 30% of cases of major depression. Yet there is no single biological laboratory test that is currently available that can be used [to diagnose immune-mediated depression] in clinical practice. So these come under the category of what we call biological factors.
paras.zh: 例如，免疫学——研究身体对各种压力（包括感染和其他压力）的反应——已被证明对大约 30% 的重度抑郁症病例有影响​​。然而，目前还没有一种生物实验室测试可用于临床实践[诊断免疫介导的抑郁症]。所以这些都属于我们所说的生物因素的范畴。

paras.en: In the Alzheimer's disease field there are clear-cut biomarkers. There are now blood tests for proteins called tau and amyloid that have been approved by the FDA [Food and Drug Administration] as biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease. Meaning, if you have a clinical picture and a mental-status exam consistent with intellectual decline, you must have a positive biomarker test to be categorized as having definitive Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 在阿尔茨海默病领域有明确的生物标志物。现在可以对 tau 蛋白和淀粉样蛋白进行血液检测，这些蛋白已被 FDA（美国食品和药物管理局）批准作为阿尔茨海默病的生物标志物。这意味着，如果您的临床表现和精神状态检查与智力下降一致，则您必须进行阳性生物标志物测试才能被归类为患有明确的阿尔茨海默氏病。

paras.en: And that's new. Ten or 15 years back, there were brain scans, and if you did a lumbar puncture, you could find these proteins in the spinal fluid. But those are invasive. Now you actually have a blood test.
paras.zh: 这是新的。十年或十五年前，进行了脑部扫描，如果进行腰椎穿刺，就可以在脊髓液中找到这些蛋白质。但这些都是侵入性的。现在您实际上进行了血液检查。

paras.en: But that degree of precision, for lack of a better term, is not available in the other branches of psychiatry. Nonetheless, there are clues that other pathways and mechanisms are involved.
paras.zh: 但由于缺乏更好的术语，这种程度的精确性在精神病学的其他分支中是不具备的。尽管如此，有线索表明还涉及其他途径和机制。

paras.en: I mentioned immunology as one. Another big elephant in the room is genetics.
paras.zh: 我提到免疫学就是其中之一。房间里的另一头大象是遗传学。

paras.en: Most people think of genetics as an abnormal gene or a mutation — meaning a gene switches or changes and confers increased risk — as one mutation causing one disease. That's how most people in the general public think about mutations: They cause disease.
paras.zh: 大多数人认为遗传学是一种异常基因或突变（意味着基因转换或改变并导致风险增加），一种突变会导致一种疾病。这就是大多数公众对突变的看法：它们会导致疾病。

paras.en: But when you get into complex diseases like heart disease and diabetes, there are multiple genes involved. And diseases may or may not be caused by a gene. Abnormal genes may or may not cause the disease, but they increase risk.
paras.zh: 但当你患上心脏病和糖尿病等复杂疾病时，就会涉及多个基因。疾病可能是也可能不是由基因引起的。异常基因可能会也可能不会导致疾病，但它们会增加风险。

paras.en: With mental disorders, the situation becomes immensely more complicated. It's not just a few genes here and there. There are hundreds of genes, each increasing the risk for depression, schizophrenia and anxiety disorders by a small amount.
paras.zh: 对于精神障碍，情况变得更加复杂。这不仅仅是这里那里的一些基因。有数百个基因，每个基因都会少量增加患抑郁症、精神分裂症和焦虑症的风险。

paras.en: So while there is no single genetic test that can now be used, large numbers of genes have consistently been shown — and many of the recent studies are strong — to be associated with certain disorders. But because there's no single gene or small group of genes, we cannot walk away from the science. Complexity doesn't mean we throw our hands up and say, "Well, it's all too much."
paras.zh: 因此，虽然现在还没有可以使用的单一基因测试，但大量的基因一直被证明——而且最近的许多研究都很有力——与某些疾病有关。但因为不存在单一基因或一小群基因，所以我们不能放弃科学。复杂并不意味着我们举手说：“好吧，这一切都太多了。”

paras.en: It may seem overwhelming, but genetic profiles are better understood today than they were 20 years ago. So that's something else this committee is thinking about and I think should take into account going forward: to somehow incorporate that into the diagnostic categories.
paras.zh: 这似乎令人难以接受，但与 20 年前相比，今天人们对基因谱有了更好的了解。因此，这是该委员会正在考虑的其他事情，我认为未来应该考虑到：以某种方式将其纳入诊断类别。

paras.en: KHC: Do you think there's any sort of risk with adding those biological factors into the DSM?
paras.zh: KHC：您认为将这些生物因素添加到 DSM 中是否存在任何风险？

paras.en: AK: I don't think so, because if you think about genetics, it's not going to be introduced as a biological test.
paras.zh: AK：我不这么认为，因为如果你考虑遗传学，它不会被作为生物测试引入。

paras.en: Most folks know that mental disorders, like other medical disorders, run in families. And genetics is the most plausible explanation for that. What this does, I hope, is introduce a degree of more comprehensive description of these disorders. So when a busy clinician looks at it, it confirms what they already suspected: There's a family history here, and family history means genetics.
paras.zh: 大多数人都知道，精神疾病和其他疾病一样，有家族遗传性。遗传学是对此最合理的解释。我希望，它的作用是对这些疾病进行一定程度的更全面的描述。因此，当忙碌的临床医生查看它时，它证实了他们已经怀疑的事情：这里有家族史，而家族史意味着遗传。

paras.en: It's complex, many genes are involved, and it produces a better characterization of this. The diagnosis is still going to remain clinical, but this provides a biological context, very much like, say, diabetes or heart disease.
paras.zh: 它很复杂，涉及许多基因，并且它可以更好地描述这一点。诊断仍然是临床诊断，但这提供了生物学背景，非常像糖尿病或心脏病。

paras.en: Genes and environment cause a variety of medical disorders. With heart disease, there's no one gene. When cardiologists develop a risk profile for heart disease, it includes genes, other physiological factors such as BMI, which is the weight-height ratio, diet and a variety of environmental factors.
paras.zh: 基因和环境会导致多种医学疾病。对于心脏病来说，不存在任何一种基因。当心脏病专家制定心脏病风险预测时，它包括基因、其他生理因素（例如体重指数（BMI）、饮食和各种环境因素）。

paras.en: That degree of classification is missing today in mental health and psychiatry. We hope this is a first step in correcting, if you will, those conceptions about what causes these disorders.
paras.zh: 如今，心理健康和精神病学领域缺少这种程度的分类。如果您愿意的话，我们希望这是纠正这些疾病病因的第一步。

paras.en: KHC: How would you end up using this in a psychiatrist's office to guide treatment?
paras.zh: KHC：您最终会如何在精神科医生的办公室中使用它来指导治疗？

paras.en: AK: I can give you one possible example. I'm reaching a bit.
paras.zh: AK：我可以举一个可能的例子。我已经达到一点点了

paras.en: There's a term commonly used in clinical psychiatry and psychology called comorbidity. What it means is that people who are diagnosed with depression also have anxiety, or people who are diagnosed with an anxiety disorder also have substance abuse or alcoholism in general.
paras.zh: 临床精神病学和心理学中常用一个术语，称为共病。这意味着被诊断患有抑郁症的人也患有焦虑症，或者被诊断患有焦虑症的人通常也患有药物滥用或酗酒。

paras.en: That is not coincidental. It's not something that we just somehow find. A lot of these disorders share genes.
paras.zh: 这并非巧合。这不是我们随便找到的东西。许多这些疾病都有相同的基因。

paras.en: For example, about 45%, roughly, of patients diagnosed with a major mood disorder also have an anxiety disorder. And you flip that around: About 45%, roughly, of patients diagnosed with an anxiety disorder — it could be generalized anxiety disorder, what we call PTSD, or a phobia — also have a mood disorder.
paras.zh: 例如，大约 45% 被诊断患有严重情绪障碍的患者也患有焦虑症。你反过来看：大约 45% 被诊断患有焦虑症（可能是广泛性焦虑症，我们称之为 PTSD 或恐惧症）的患者也患有情绪障碍。

paras.en: I think when clinicians classify them together, not as the same disorder but as sharing a lot of psychological as well as genetic risk, clinicians should be on the lookout for both. A patient with a mood disorder, for example, could either now or at some later point develop an anxiety disorder. Or someone with an anxiety disorder is at risk for substance abuse.
paras.zh: 我认为，当临床医生将它们分类在一起时，不是将它们归为同一种疾病，而是将其归为共享许多心理和遗传风险的疾病，临床医生应该同时留意这两种疾病。例如，患有情绪障碍的患者现在或以后的某个时候可能会患上焦虑症。或者患有焦虑症的人有滥用药物的风险。

paras.en: So treatments need to be tailored a little more broadly. I'm hoping that'll be something clinicians think about when they talk to patients and their families.
paras.zh: 因此，治疗方法需要进行更广泛的调整。我希望临床医生在与患者及其家人交谈时能够考虑到这一点。

paras.en: KHC: What do you think is the most unique aspect, from your perspective, of this upcoming DSM-6?
paras.zh: KHC：从您的角度来看，您认为即将推出的 DSM-6 最独特的方面是什么？

paras.en: AK: My bias is the biology. I say this because a lot of the other things, the cultural factors, etc., are largely appreciated, and they'll be better characterized. Some things like cognitive changes, such as working memory and attention [tests], are not unique to any given disorder.
paras.zh: AK：我的偏见是生物学。我这样说是因为很多其他的事情，文化因素等等，在很大程度上得到了重视，并且它们将得到更好的表征。有些事情，例如认知变化，例如工作记忆和注意力[测试]，并不是任何特定疾病所独有的。

paras.en: - Adversity shaped our evolution as a species. People raised in it may have underrecognized strengths because of it.
paras.zh: - 逆境塑造了我们作为一个物种的进化。在这种环境中长大的人可能因此而没有得到充分认识。

paras.en: - Ancient 'alien-like' skulls have been found on every continent but Antarctica. Anthropologists are starting to figure out why.
paras.zh: - 除南极洲外，每个大陆都发现了古代“类似外星人”的头骨。人类学家开始找出原因。

paras.en: - Could psilocybin treat brain injuries? Neuroscientist explains how psychedelics could fill a gap in head trauma care
paras.zh: - 裸盖菇素可以治疗脑损伤吗？神经科学家解释迷幻药如何填补头部创伤护理的空白

paras.en: Biology will be qualitatively new when introduced into the DSM, and I hope it's done well. I hope that they do it appropriately, and I think they will [do it] correctly.
paras.zh: 当生物学被引入 DSM 时，将会产生质的新变化，我希望它能做得很好。我希望他们做得适当，而且我认为他们会正确地做。

paras.en: It's not going to be perfect, but it's going to be a first step. I think introducing the idea that genetics, immunology and other factors are very important in the causation of mental disorders, and explain some of the phenomena that we previously could not find an explanation for, is — I hate to use the word "leapfrog" — but that's kind of what it is.
paras.zh: 这不会是完美的，但这将是第一步。我认为引入遗传学、免疫学和其他因素在精神障碍的病因中非常重要的想法，并解释一些我们以前无法找到解释的现象，是——我讨厌使用“蛙跳”这个词——但事实就是这样。

paras.en: It moves the field conceptually forward, and not as a slow, steady, gradual increase. For the DSM, it would be an important step forward.
paras.zh: 它从概念上推动了该领域的发展，而不是缓慢、稳定、渐进的增长。对于 DSM 来说，这将是向前迈出的重要一步。

paras.en: This interview has been condensed and edited lightly for clarity.
paras.zh: 为了清晰起见，本次采访经过了精简和轻微编辑。

Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
