paras.en: The debris was scattered across sports fields, businesses and homes in the area, officials told a news conference on Monday, possible evidence that the plane broke up before it hit the ground.
paras.zh: 官员们在周一的新闻发布会上表示，碎片散落在该地区的运动场、企业和住宅中，这可能证明飞机在落地前就解体了。

paras.en: The NTSB confirmed that after the jet took off from Austin, the crew transmitted to air traffic control that they were encountering ice and moderate turbulence.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会证实，飞机从奥斯汀起飞后，机组人员向空中交通管制中心报告称，他们遇到了结冰和中度湍流。

paras.en: "We are picking up precipitation, requesting to climb to 37,000 feet if able," the crew said.
paras.zh: “我们正在收集降水，如果可能的话，我们请求爬升到 37,000 英尺，”机组人员说。

paras.en: NTSB member Tom Chapman said that less than 30 seconds later, the plane began to descend and the crew issued a mayday call.
paras.zh: NTSB成员汤姆·查普曼表示，不到30秒后，飞机开始下降，机组人员发出求救信号。

paras.en: The transmission then became "unintelligible", he said, adding that: "Sadly, all aboard were lost."
paras.zh: 他说，传输信息随后变得“难以理解”，并补充道：“可悲的是，船上所有人都失踪了。”

paras.en: Flight analysis indicates the jet was plummeting hundreds of feet per second before crashing.
paras.zh: 飞行分析表明，这架飞机在坠毁前以每秒数百英尺的速度垂直下降。

paras.en: In air traffic control audio, a crew member can be heard declaring an emergency, shouting "we are in an overspeed condition descending 20,000ft per minute", before saying, "we are going to crash into the ground".
paras.zh: 在空中交通管制音频中，可以听到一名机组人员宣布紧急情况，大喊“我们处于每分钟下降 20,000 英尺的超速状态”，然后又说“我们将坠落到地面”。

paras.en: About 35 seconds after the initial mayday announcement, the last remark from the cockpit appears to be "we're out of time".
paras.zh: 在最初的求救消息发布后大约 35 秒，驾驶舱内的最后一句话似乎是“我们没时间了”。

paras.en: Filgueiras's mother, Camila Corteleti, confirmed to US media that her daughter had died in the fireball.
paras.zh: 菲尔盖拉斯的母亲卡米拉·科尔特莱蒂向美国媒体证实，她的女儿在火球中丧生。

paras.en: Corteleti told the New York Times: "She loved the freedom. It was completely different seeing the world from the top."
paras.zh: 科特莱蒂告诉《纽约时报》：“她热爱自由。从高处看世界是完全不同的。”

paras.en: In a 2023 interview with a local news affiliate of CBS News, Filgueiras spoke proudly of receiving her pilot's licence while still a senior in high school.
paras.zh: 2023 年，菲尔盖拉斯在接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻的当地新闻附属机构采访时，自豪地谈到自己在高中四年级时就获得了飞行员执照。

paras.en: "I like being different than everyone," she said. "Some people think that it's weird that I can fly planes, but I can't drive a car, I mean I can but, a lot of people think it's funny."
paras.zh: “我喜欢与每个人不同，”她说。 “有些人认为我可以开飞机，但我不能开车，这很奇怪，我的意思是我可以，但是，很多人认为这很有趣。”

paras.en: None of the other eight people on board has been identified.
paras.zh: 机上其他八人的身份尚未确定。

paras.en: The NTSB said that ice and turbulence were factors in the crash.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，冰和湍流是导致坠机的因素。

paras.en: Officials are also trying to find out whether a cockpit voice recorder was on board at the time of the crash and if it can be recovered.
paras.zh: 官员们还在试图查明坠机时机上是否有驾驶舱录音机以及是否可以恢复。

paras.en: The NTSB said determining the probable cause of the crash will be a "lengthy investigatory process".
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，确定坠机的可能原因将是一个“漫长的调查过程”。

paras.en: As part of the investigation, the NTSB is working with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), representatives from Learjet as well as meteorologists and air traffic control experts.
paras.zh: 作为调查的一部分，国家运输安全委员会正在与美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA)、里尔喷气机公司的代表以及气象学家和空中交通管制专家合作。

paras.en: Recovering the wreckage from the crater on the roadway will be a "daunting challenge", said Timothy Monville, an air safety investigator with the NTSB.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 航空安全调查员蒂莫西·蒙维尔 (Timothy Monville) 表示，从道路上的弹坑中打捞残骸将是一项“艰巨的挑战”。

paras.en: He added that an individual who was in a vehicle near the crash site sustained a leg injury.
paras.zh: 他补充说，事故现场附近一辆汽车内的一名人员腿部受伤。

paras.en: Unverified footage posted on social media shows what appears to be a dash-camera recording of the moment of the crash.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的未经证实的视频显示，行车记录仪似乎记录了事故发生的瞬间。

paras.en: "When you see that video, it's a jarring thing," Florida Governor Ron DeSantis told reporters at a news conference on Sunday. "It's like a missile coming down, and a massive explosion, debris going everywhere."
paras.zh: “当你看到这段视频时，这是一件令人震惊的事情，”佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯在周日的新闻发布会上告诉记者。 “这就像一枚导弹坠落，然后发生大规模爆炸，碎片散得到处都是。”

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash as a "horrific tragedy".
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲称这次事故是一场“可怕的悲剧”。

paras.en: The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened on Military Trail, a six-lane road lined with businesses and restaurants.
paras.zh: 棕榈滩县治安官办公室表示，事故发生在军事步道上，这是一条六车道的道路，两旁都是企业和餐馆。

paras.en: Thunderstorms had been reported in the area at the time of the crash.
paras.zh: 据报道坠机时该地区有雷暴。

paras.en: Trump was at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday morning, and departed from an airport nearby on Air Force One about an hour before the crash.
paras.zh: 周日早上，特朗普在海湖庄园，并在坠机事件发生前大约一小时乘坐空军一号从附近的机场出发。

articles.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president

paras.en: A court in South Africa has found a man guilty of stealing more than $500,000 (Â£372,822) in cash from a farm owned by South African president Cyril Ramaphosa, in a case that mired the head of state in an impeachment saga.
paras.zh: 南非一家法院判定一名男子从南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨 (Cyril Ramaphosa) 拥有的农场盗窃了超过 50 万美元（合 372,822 英镑）的现金，此案使国家元首陷入弹劾传奇。

paras.en: Imanuwela David was found guilty of theft on Monday, as well as conspiracy to commit housebreaking with intent to steal at Phala Phala farm in the Limpopo province in 2020.
paras.zh: 周一，伊马努韦拉·大卫 (Imanuwela David) 被判犯有盗窃罪，并于 2020 年在林波波省的 Phala Phala 农场合谋入室盗窃。

paras.en: Froliana Joseph, a cleaner at the property, was also found guilty of conspiracy to commit housebreaking with intent to steal.
paras.zh: 该物业的清洁工弗洛丽安娜·约瑟夫 (Froliana Joseph) 也被判犯有串谋入室盗窃罪。

paras.en: Her brother, Ndilinasho Joseph, was acquitted on all charges.
paras.zh: 她的兄弟恩迪利纳肖·约瑟夫 (Ndilinasho Joseph) 所有指控均被无罪释放。

paras.en: David was accused of breaking into the cattle farm in February 2020 and taking $580,000 (Â£432,000) in cash from a sofa on the property. David then went on a spending spree, buying a range of cars including three Mercedes - among them one for his girlfriend - a Porsche, two Volkswagens as well as diamond-encrusted Rolex watches and a house.
paras.zh: 大卫被指控于 2020 年 2 月闯入养牛场，并从农场的沙发上拿走了 58 万美元（43.2 万英镑）现金。随后，大卫开始疯狂消费，购买了一系列汽车，包括三辆奔驰（其中一辆是给他女朋友的）、一辆保时捷、两辆大众汽车以及镶钻劳力士手表和一栋房子。

paras.en: David told the court he had made the money through businesses including diamonds and Bitcoin, claims the court rejected. The court also found that David was the only one of the two convicted who had any of the stolen cash in his bank account.
paras.zh: 大卫告诉法庭，他是通过钻石和比特币等业务赚到钱的，但法庭驳回了这一说法。法院还发现，大卫是两名被定罪者中唯一一个在银行账户中存有被盗现金的人。

paras.en: Pre-sentencing will take place on 13 November.
paras.zh: 预判将于 11 月 13 日进行。

paras.en: There have been many twists and turns in what is known as the Farmgate scandal.
paras.zh: 所谓的“农场门”丑闻经历了许多曲折。

paras.en: The theft was largely unknown until 2022 when it was brought to light by Arthur Fraser, South Africa's former intelligence chief and an ally for the former president Jacob Zuma, when he claimed that Ramaphosa hid the theft from the police and tax authorities.
paras.zh: 这起盗窃案直到 2022 年才被南非前情报局长、前总统雅各布·祖马的盟友阿瑟·弗雷泽曝光，当时他声称拉马福萨向警方和税务机关隐瞒了这起盗窃案。

paras.en: Ramaphosa admitted the theft took place but denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 拉马福萨承认发生了盗窃事件，但否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: An independent panel that same year found Ramaphosa could have questions to answer over the burglary. MPs voted against establishing an impeachment inquiry.
paras.zh: 同年，一个独立小组发现拉马福萨可能对入室盗窃案有疑问需要回答。议员们投票反对建立弹劾调查。

paras.en: In May this year, the constitutional court ruled that parliament had acted unlawfully by shelving the panel's report, and in July Ramaphosa blocked the parliamentary inquiry through a provincial court.
paras.zh: 今年5月，宪法法院裁定议会搁置该小组报告的行为非法，7月拉马福萨通过省法院阻止了议会调查。

articles.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says

paras.en: At least 26 people were killed after Russian bombs hit an aid distribution centre, in an attack that Ukraine's leader has called "utterly horrific".
paras.zh: 俄罗斯炸弹袭击了一个援助物资分发中心，造成至少 26 人死亡，乌克兰领导人称这次袭击“极其可怕”。

paras.en: Five people were injured and 27 initially reported missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit the village of Komyshuvakha in the southern Zaporizhzhia region, regional head Mykhailo Semikin said.
paras.zh: 地区负责人米哈伊洛·塞米金 (Mykhailo Semikin) 表示，至少 9 枚 3000 公斤重的空投炸弹袭击了扎波罗热州南部地区的 Komyshuvakha 村，造成 5 人受伤，27 人初步报告失踪。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that after the first strike on the local school "used for humanitarian needs", there was a second attack on the place where people were sheltering.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，在当地“用于人道主义需求”的学校遭受第一次袭击之后，人们避难的地方又发生了第二次袭击。

paras.en: He posted a video showing a huge crater left after Monday's attack, and rescuer teams searching through the rubble.
paras.zh: 他发布了一段视频，显示周一袭击后留下一个巨大的弹坑，救援人员正在废墟中搜寻。

paras.en: The Russian military has not publicly commented.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军方尚未公开发表评论。

paras.en: Zelensky initially put the death toll at 18, but Ukraine's state emergencies service DSNS later said 24 people, including two rescuers and four police officers, were confirmed to have been killed.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基最初称死亡人数为18人，但乌克兰国家紧急服务机构DSNS后来表示，确认有24人死亡，其中包括两名救援人员和四名警察。

paras.en: In his video address late on Monday, Zelensky said 26 people were now known to have died.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在周一晚间的视频讲话中表示，目前已知有 26 人死亡。

paras.en: He earlier said that "the Russians could not have been unaware that the local residents who remained in Komyshuvakha received humanitarian aid there every week" on Monday.
paras.zh: 他早些时候表示，“俄罗斯人不可能不知道，留在科梅舒瓦哈的当地居民每周都会在那里接受人道主义援助”。

paras.en: "This is yet another proof that Russia does not want any de-escalation."
paras.zh: “这再次证明俄罗斯不希望局势缓和。”

paras.en: He said that after a recent successful joint Russian-Ukrainian operation to evacuate civilians from the Russia-occupied southern city of Oleshky during a temporary ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump, "there was a moment when the next steps could show that peace is possible".
paras.zh: 他说，在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的临时停火期间，俄罗斯和乌克兰最近成功从俄罗斯占领的南部城市奥列什基撤离平民，“有那么一刻，下一步行动可能表明和平是可能的”。

paras.en: "With such killings, Russia is sending the exact opposite signal - Russia is counting on further killings," Zelensky said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基说：“通过此类杀戮，俄罗斯发出了完全相反的信号——俄罗斯指望进一步杀戮。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Semikin described the Russian attack as a "terrible tragedy" for the village, confirming that "people are still under the rubble".
paras.zh: 与此同时，塞米金将俄罗斯的袭击描述为该村庄的一场“可怕的悲剧”，并证实“人们仍然在废墟下”。

paras.en: He said rescue teams were working at the scene, but they had been forced to halt their operation a number of times because of Russian drone attacks in the area.
paras.zh: 他说，救援队正在现场开展工作，但由于俄罗斯无人机袭击该地区，他们多次被迫停止行动。

paras.en: A day of mourning has been declared for Tuesday across the entire Zaporizhzhia region.
paras.zh: 整个扎波罗热地区宣布周二为哀悼日。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

paras.en: Teams from Ukraine, Russia and the US are due to resume peace talks in the next few days after negotiations were suspended in February, with Moscow stepping up attacks as Kyiv virtually ran out of Western-supplied interceptors to defend against missiles.
paras.zh: 乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国的谈判在二月份暂停后，预计将在未来几天内恢复和平谈判，莫斯科加大了攻击力度，因为基辅几乎耗尽了西方提供的拦截导弹。

paras.en: However, no major breakthrough is expected at the talks that are likely to be held in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 然而，预计在阿联酋阿布扎比举行的会谈不会取得重大突破。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将出现在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精确性，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: Michigan Auto Body Association Celebrates Inaugural Open House
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Michigan Auto Body Association (MABA) held its inaugural event, an open house hosted by America’s Most Wanted 4×4, on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026. The afternoon program ran from 1 to 6 p.m. and drew members, prospective members and vendors eager to learn what the new association is all about.
paras.zh: 密歇根汽车车身协会 (MABA) 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日星期五举行了首届活动，这是由美国最想要的 4×4 主办的开放日活动。下午的活动从下午 1 点到 6 点进行。并吸引了渴望了解新协会的会员、潜在会员和供应商。

paras.en: MABA announced its official founding as a statewide professional association and its affiliation with the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) late last year.
paras.zh: 去年年底，MABA 宣布正式成立全州范围的专业协会，并加入碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS)。

paras.en: The day opened with a “meet the board” session, where attendees asked board members why the association was formed, how the bard came together and where MABA is headed. As an affiliate of SCRS, MABA then welcomed Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of SCRS, for a virtual introduction. Schulenburg welcomed MABA and its members to the SCRS partnership and highlighted benefits popular with independent collision repairers, including SCRS’s health care program and 401(k) offering.
paras.zh: 这一天以“与董事会会面”会议开始，与会者询问董事会成员为何成立该协会、吟游诗人如何走到一起以及 MABA 的发展方向。作为 SCRS 的附属机构，MABA 随后迎来了 SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 进行虚拟介绍。 Schulenburg 对 MABA 及其成员加入 SCRS 合作伙伴关系表示欢迎，并强调了受独立碰撞维修商欢迎的好处，包括 SCRS 的医疗保健计划和 401(k) 产品。

paras.en: Stephanie Sheppard of CARS Co-Op followed with an overview of another MABA member benefit, one designed to help Michigan collision repairers save money on day-to-day purchases. Host America’s Most Wanted 4×4 then led attendees on a tour of its facility and shared the story of its rapid growth in a specialized segment of the industry.
paras.zh: CARS Co-Op 的 Stephanie Sheppard 随后概述了另一项 MABA 会员福利，该福利旨在帮助密歇根州碰撞维修人员节省日常采购费用。 Host America’s Most Wanted 4×4 随后带领与会者参观了其设施，并分享了其在行业专业领域快速发展的故事。

paras.en: MABA was co-founded by Don Speace and Dustin DeLongpre of Axalta.
paras.zh: MABA 由艾仕得 (Axalta) 的唐·斯皮斯 (Don Speace) 和达斯汀·德隆普 (Dustin DeLongpre) 共同创立。

paras.en: “This was a dream come true,” said Speace. “As we followed up with and helped our customers, we kept hearing the same thing over and over: Michigan needs a voice. We need someone representing our collision repair industry here in Michigan, like our colleagues have in other states. So here we are! Dustin and I did the background work and helped form the founding board based on what leaders across our industry told us. With a lot of hard work, we launched the association just a couple of months ago, and here we are today.”
paras.zh: “这是梦想成真，”斯皮斯说。 “当我们跟进并帮助客户时，我们不断听到同样的事情：密歇根州需要发出声音。我们需要有人代表密歇根州的碰撞修复行业，就像我们在其他州的同事一样。所以我们来了！达斯汀和我做了背景工作，并根据我们行业领导者告诉我们的内容帮助组建了创始委员会。经过大量的努力，我们在几个月前成立了该协会，今天我们在这里。”

paras.en: “I think the industry had a very successful event today,” said Jason Taylor, chair of MABA. “Members, member candidates and vendors all came out to see what MABA is about, and from the conversations I’ve had, they were impressed. When it was time to meet the board, they had questions we need to follow up on, and that’s exactly what we were hoping for. We want to hear from our industry and learn what we need to do to make things happen. In that respect, this was a very good start.”
paras.zh: “我认为今天该行业举办了一次非常成功的活动，”MABA 主席杰森·泰勒 (Jason Taylor) 说道。 “会员、会员候选人和供应商都出来了解 MABA 的内容，从我的谈话中，他们印象深刻。当与董事会会面时，他们提出了我们需要跟进的问题，而这正是我们所希望的。我们希望听到我们行业的声音，了解我们需要做什么才能实现这一目标。从这方面来说，这是一个非常好的开始。”

paras.en: “This event showed both the desire and the need within our industry,” said Joe Townsend, treasurer of MABA. “A number of vendors quickly stepped up as sponsors, giving back to the industry in a way they trust will make it better. I’m very appreciative and pleased with today’s turnout. We had more than 100 registrants in just over a month since we announced the event, with only a few last-minute no-shows. That speaks volumes.”
paras.zh: “这次活动展示了我们行业内的愿望和需求，”MABA 财务主管 Joe Townsend 说道。 “许多供应商迅速成为赞助商，以他们相信会让行业变得更好的方式回馈行业。我对今天的参与人数感到非常感激和满意。自我们宣布举办该活动以来，在短短一个多月的时间里，我们就有了 100 多名注册者，只有少数人在最后一刻缺席。这很说明问题。”

paras.en: Attendee questions gave the board clear direction. Brian Johnson, vice chair of MABA, pointed to one that stood out: how will MABA decide which legislation to pursue when points of view differ?
paras.zh: 与会者提出的问题为董事会提供了明确的方向。 MABA 副主席布莱恩·约翰逊 (Brian Johnson) 指出了一个突出的问题：当观点不同时，MABA 将如何决定推行哪项立法？

paras.en: “We don’t have that answer at this moment, but it will definitely be discussed at our next board meeting,” said Johnson. “We’ve been focused on putting our infrastructure in place: meeting the legal requirements of running an association, building budgets, setting goals and making it a priority to secure a strong lobbyist to represent us in Lansing. Now it’s time to get into the details, so hearing these questions was exciting.”
paras.zh: 约翰逊表示：“我们目前还没有答案，但肯定会在下次董事会会议上讨论这个问题。” “我们一直专注于建立我们的基础设施：满足运营协会的法律要求、制定预算、设定目标，并优先考虑确保有一位强有力的游说者在兰辛代表我们。现在是时候了解细节了，所以听到这些问题令人兴奋。”

paras.en: Taylor added that another question, how will members be kept up to date and given a voice, “reinforced what the board has said all along. We need to include our members and keep them educated and informed. Frankly, that’s why we’re here.”
paras.zh: 泰勒补充说，另一个问题，即成员如何了解最新情况并获得发言权，“强化了董事会一直以来所说的内容。我们需要让我们的成员参与进来，让他们接受教育和了解情况。坦率地说，这就是我们在这里的原因。”

paras.en: Secretary Scott Webster was encouraged by how closely shop owners engaged with the presentations.
paras.zh: 斯科特·韦伯斯特部长对店主与演示的密切参与感到鼓舞。

paras.en: “We worked through a few technical difficulties, but afterward I saw attendees sitting down with Stephanie from CARS Co-Op to ask questions,” said Webster. “That kind of engagement reassures us that we’re doing the right thing for the right reasons.” He added with a laugh, “I enjoyed networking with my peers, and even more, enjoying a meeting without having to take the minutes for a change.”
paras.zh: “我们解决了一些技术难题，但后来我看到与会者与来自 CARS Co-Op 的斯蒂芬妮坐下来提出问题，”韦伯斯特说。 “这种参与让我们确信我们正在出于正确的理由做正确的事情。”他笑着补充道，“我喜欢与同事交流，更喜欢开会，而不必花时间做改变。”

paras.en: The open house wrapped up with pizza, beverages and time for attendees to network.
paras.zh: 开放日以披萨、饮料和与会者交流的时间结束。

paras.en: MABA plans to build on the open house’s momentum with more events in the first quarter of 2027. Dates, locations and programs will be announced in the coming weeks. Collision repair professionals, vendors and industry partners are encouraged to watch for updates at michiganaba.org and on MABA’s social media channels, and to reach out about membership and sponsorship opportunities.
paras.zh: MABA 计划借助开放日的势头，在 2027 年第一季度举办更多活动。日期、地点和项目将在未来几周内公布。我们鼓励碰撞修复专业人士、供应商和行业合作伙伴关注 michiganaba.org 和 MABA 社交媒体渠道的最新动态，并寻求会员资格和赞助机会。

articles.title: SCRS Recognizes Car-O-Liner as RDE, OEM Summit Sponsor at SEMA 2026
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) is recognizing Car-O-Liner, part of the Total Shop Solutions family of Snap-on brands, as a sponsor of the Repairer Driven Education (RDE) series and the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit during the 2026 SEMA Show Nov. 3-6 in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 认可 Car-O-Liner（Snap-on 品牌 Total Shop Solutions 系列的一部分）作为维修驱动教育 (RDE) 系列和 11 月 3 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯举行的 2026 年 SEMA 展会期间 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会的赞助商。

paras.en: “Precise measurement and proper repair procedures are the foundation of a safe repair, and that only becomes more true as vehicles grow more sophisticated,” said Doug Bortz, sales manager, North America for Car-O-Liner. “Supporting SCRS and the RDE series is one way we help repairers keep pace. We’re proud to return as sponsors, and we look forward to seeing the industry come together in Las Vegas to learn from the people building these vehicles.”
paras.zh: Car-O-Liner 北美销售经理 Doug Bortz 表示：“精确的测量和正确的维修程序是安全维修的基础，随着车辆变得越来越复杂，这一点只会变得更加正确。” “支持 SCRS 和 RDE 系列是我们帮助维修商跟上步伐的一种方式。我们很自豪能够作为赞助商再次回归，我们期待看到该行业齐聚拉斯维加斯，向制造这些车辆的人们学习。”

paras.en: Car-O-Liner will exhibit in the Snap-on booth in the Upper South Hall, booth no. 32017.
paras.zh: Car-O-Liner 将在上南厅的 Snap-on 展位展出，展位号为 111。 32017。

paras.en: OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit Schedule
paras.zh: OEM碰撞修复技术峰会日程

paras.en: The OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit takes place Thursday, Nov. 5 from 12:30-4:30 p.m. The three-session program follows vehicle safety from national objectives through vehicle engineering and into the collision repair process, and SCRS encourages attendees to experience the sessions as a connected series.
paras.zh: OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会将于 11 月 5 日星期四中午 12:30-4:30 举行。这个三场会议的计划遵循从国家目标到车辆工程再到碰撞修复过程的车辆安全，SCRS 鼓励与会者以一系列相互关联的方式体验这些会议。

paras.en: The afternoon opens with “The National Safety Objective: Safer Vehicles, Safer Roads” from 12:30-1:30 p.m., featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Deputy Administrator Lee White. White will present the agency’s vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies and data-driven research, then join SCRS Executive Director Aaron Schulenburg for a one-on-one conversation on the role of repair in maintaining vehicle safety.
paras.zh: 下午 12:30 至 1:30 的主题为“国家安全目标：更安全的车辆、更安全的道路”，由国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 副局长 Lee White 主持。 White 将介绍该机构的车辆和道路安全优先事项、新兴交通技术和数据驱动的研究，然后与 SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 就维修在维护车辆安全中的作用进行一对一对话。

paras.en: From 2–3 p.m., “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirement to Real-World Performance” brings together safety and ADAS engineering leaders from General Motors, Rivian and Ford Motor Company. Panelists will explain how automakers translate safety objectives into vehicle technologies, establish performance requirements and evaluate whether those technologies produce measurable real-world benefits. Panelists include Michael Carpenter and Jameson Collins of General Motors, Byung Joo (BJ) Kim of Rivian and Jeremy Nelson of Ford Motor Company.
paras.zh: 下午 2 点至 3 点，“设计安全效益：从要求到实际性能”汇聚了来自通用汽车、Rivian 和福特汽车公司的安全和 ADAS 工程领导者。小组成员将解释汽车制造商如何将安全目标转化为车辆技术、制定性能要求并评估这些技术是否产生可衡量的现实效益。小组成员包括通用汽车公司的 Michael Carpenter 和 Jameson Collins、Rivian 的 Byung Joo (BJ) Kim 和福特汽车公司的 Jeremy Nelson。

paras.en: The final session, “Preserving the Safety System: Sensors, Calibration and Repairability,” from 3:30-4:30 p.m., brings that progression directly into the collision repair facility. Engineers from General Motors, Ford and Rivian will examine what today’s sensors can do, what can affect their performance and how engineering requirements become repair procedures and calibration strategies. Participants include Steven Vance and Chad Zagorski of General Motors, Brian Perkins of Ford Motor Company and Ryan Davenport of Rivian.
paras.zh: 最后一场会议“保护安全系统：传感器、校准和可修复性”于下午 3:30 至 4:30 进行，将这一进程直接带入碰撞修复设施。来自通用汽车、福特和 Rivian 的工程师将研究当今传感器的功能、影响其性能的因素以及工程要求如何成为维修程序和校准策略。参与者包括通用汽车公司的 Steven Vance 和 Chad Zagorski、福特汽车公司的 Brian Perkins 和 Rivian 的 Ryan Davenport。

paras.en: Panelists will also explore how variables introduced by a collision or repair, including sensor position, wheel alignment, ride height and replacement glass, can influence what a vehicle’s sensing systems perceive, and what a repair facility must do to confidently determine that safety systems have been restored to the performance the manufacturer intended.
paras.zh: 小组成员还将探讨碰撞或维修引入的变量（包括传感器位置、车轮定位、行驶高度和更换玻璃）如何影响车辆传感系统的感知，以及维修机构必须采取哪些措施才能自信地确定安全系统已恢复到制造商预期的性能。

paras.en: “Snap-on and CAR-O-LINER have made showing up for collision repairers a priority year after year, from the show floor to our classrooms,” said Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of SCRS. “This year they are even providing functional equipment as part of the efforts to expand the show floor opportunities within the ADAS Showcase. We’re grateful to partners who invest in our programs, because they understand it gives repairers a direct line to the engineers behind the vehicles and the safety systems they are responsible for restoring.”
paras.zh: SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 表示：“从展厅到教室，Snap-on 和 CAR-O-LINER 年复一年地把出现在碰撞修复人员面前作为优先事项。” “今年，他们甚至提供了功能性设备，作为扩大 ADAS 展示区展示机会的努力的一部分。我们感谢投资我们项目的合作伙伴，因为他们明白，这让维修人员可以直接联系车辆背后的工程师以及他们负责恢复的安全系统。”

paras.en: Register for all three OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit sessions here.
paras.zh: 在此注册参加所有三场 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。

paras.en: Attendees looking for the best overall value can register for the RDE Full Series Pass, which includes Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, all three Thursday OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit sessions and the SCRS Afterparty.
paras.zh: 寻求最佳整体价值的与会者可以注册 RDE 全系列通行证，其中包括周二和周三的 RDE 会议、IDEAS 碰撞展示、周四所有三场 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会会议以及 SCRS 余兴派对。

paras.en: For additional information about SCRS and Repairer Driven Education, visit scrs.com/rde.
paras.zh: 有关 SCRS 和维修人员驱动教育的更多信息，请访问 scrs.com/rde。

paras.en: RDE is made possible with support from a wide array of companies: 3M Automotive Aftermarke; AirPro Diagnostics; AkzoNobel; Axalta; Blue Vista Data; Car-O-Liner; CCC; Enterprise; Hunter Engineering; I-CAR; KECO; KPA; Milwaukee; Reliable Automotive Equipment; Revv; Southern California Collision Equipment; Spanesi; Toyota Certified Collision; and SEMA.
paras.zh: RDE 的实现得益于众多公司的支持：3M Automotive Aftermarke； AirPro 诊断；阿克苏诺贝尔；艾仕得；蓝色远景数据；汽车-O-Liner； CCC；企业;亨特工程； I-CAR；凯科；韩国PA；密尔沃基；可靠的汽车设备；修订版；南加州碰撞设备；斯帕内西；丰田碰撞认证；和SEMA。

paras.en: For more information about SCRS or to join as a member, visit scrs.com, call (877) 841-0660 or e-mail [email protected].
paras.zh: 有关 SCRS 的更多信息或加入会员，请访问 scrs.com、致电 (877) 841-0660 或发送电子邮件 [email protected]。

paras.en: To register for RDE at the SEMA Show, visit scrs.com/rde.
paras.zh: 要在 SEMA 展会上注册 RDE，请访问 scrs.com/rde。

articles.title: Total Loss Auto Claims Weigh on Insurance Customer Satisfaction
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: How satisfied are auto insurance customers in that moment of truth when they need to file a claim? According to the recently released JD Power 2026 U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, that depends on whether the damage is repairable or not.
paras.zh: 当汽车保险客户需要提出索赔时，他们的满意度如何？根据最近发布的 JD Power 2026 年美国汽车索赔满意度研究，这取决于损坏是否可以修复。

paras.en: This year, overall customer satisfaction with the auto insurance claims process improves 4 points (on a 1,000-point scale) when damages are repairable but declines 12 points when vehicles are deemed a total loss, marking a third consecutive year of declining satisfaction for total loss claims. Overall, 26% of auto insurance claims were classified as total losses in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago as vehicle repairs become more costly, more customers keep their vehicles on the road longer and higher deductibles remove smaller repairs from the claim process.
paras.zh: 今年，当损坏可修复时，客户对汽车保险索赔流程的整体满意度提高了 4 个百分点（满分 1,000 分），但当车辆被视为全损时，客户满意度下降了 12 个百分点，这标志着全损索赔满意度连续第三年下降。总体而言，到 2026 年，26% 的汽车保险索赔被归类为总损失，而四年前这一比例仅为 16%，因为车辆维修成本变得更高，更多的客户将车辆在路上行驶的时间更长，以及更高的免赔额从索赔流程中消除了较小的维修。

paras.en: “A complex mix of trends are conspiring to make this an incredibly challenging market environment for managing auto insurance claims customer satisfaction,” said Mark Garrett, director of global insurance intelligence at JD Power. “On the positive side, rates are coming down and repair cycle times have improved dramatically, so customers who can have their vehicles fixed are showing high levels of satisfaction with the claims experience. However, persistent affordability challenges have many customers keeping vehicles longer or making changes to their policy, such as dropping rental coverage or taking on higher insurance deductibles. Additionally, many customers are upside down on their auto loans, which means the payoff in a total loss scenario can be less than they owe on their vehicles. All of these can make for a poor customer experience in the event of a total loss.”
paras.zh: JD Power 全球保险情报总监马克·加勒特 (Mark Garrett) 表示：“复杂的趋势组合在一起，使汽车保险理赔客户满意度管理变得极具挑战性的市场环境。” “从积极的一面来看，费率正在下降，维修周期时间也显着改善，因此能够修好车辆的客户对索赔体验表现出很高的满意度。然而，持续的负担能力挑战使许多客户延长车辆保有时间或改变他们的保单，例如降低租赁保险或承担更高的保险免赔额。此外，许多客户的汽车贷款出现倒挂，这意味着在全损情况下的回报可能低于他们对车辆的欠款。所有这些都会导致客户体验不佳。完全损失。”

paras.en: The following are some key findings of the 2026 study:
paras.zh: 以下是 2026 年研究的一些主要发现：

paras.en: - Overall satisfaction split based on vehicle repairability: The overall auto claims customer satisfaction score is 700, which is unchanged from last year. Satisfaction scores diverge sharply, however, depending on whether the vehicle is able to be repaired. Overall satisfaction improves 4 points year over year when vehicles are repaired and declines 12 points year over year when vehicles are deemed a total loss. Satisfaction with total losses has continued to trend down for a third consecutive year, declining 46 points since 2023.
paras.zh: - 基于车辆可修复性的总体满意度划分：汽车理赔客户满意度总体得分为 700 分，与去年持平。然而，满意度分数差异很大，具体取决于车辆是否能够修理。当车辆被修复时，总体满意度同比提高 4 个百分点；当车辆被视为全损时，总体满意度同比下降 12 个百分点。对总损失的满意度连续第三年下降，自 2023 年以来下降了 46 个百分点。

paras.en: - Effects of total losses exacerbated by macroeconomic trends: More than one-fourth (26%) of auto insurance claims resulted in a total loss in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago. Total loss customer satisfaction scores are lowest (490) when the amount paid by the insurer does not cover the amount the customer still owes on their vehicle loan. Among total loss customers with loans on their vehicles, 25% received payouts that were less than what they owed on their vehicle.
paras.zh: - 宏观经济趋势加剧了总损失的影响：到 2026 年，超过四分之一 (26%) 的汽车保险索赔会导致总损失，而四年前这一比例仅为 16%。当保险公司支付的金额不足以弥补客户仍欠车辆贷款的金额时，全损客户满意度得分最低 (490)。在拥有车辆贷款的全损失客户中，25% 的人收到的付款少于他们所欠车辆的金额。

paras.en: - Repair cycle times improve significantly: When vehicles can be repaired, the likelihood of getting them repaired quickly is getting much easier. Claim volumes are down sharply, so shops have more capacity for repair work, resulting in average repair cycle times of just 15.3 days through the first quarter of 2026, a reduction of 10 days from the first quarter of 2024.
paras.zh: - 维修周期时间显着缩短：当车辆可以维修时，快速维修的可能性就会变得更加容易。索赔量大幅下降，因此商店有更多的维修工作能力，导致到 2026 年第一季度的平均维修周期时间仅为 15.3 天，比 2024 年第一季度减少了 10 天。

paras.en: - Room to improve on cross-channel communications: Overall customer satisfaction scores are highest (804) when customers completely agree that their insurer provided a seamless experience across channels. Satisfaction scores are lowest (390) when customers disagree with that statement, which often results from not understanding explanations, using multiple channels to ask questions or digital tools not working as expected. Currently, insurers are delivering a seamless cross-channel experience just 54% of the time, one of the lowest-performing key performance indicators in the study.
paras.zh: - 跨渠道沟通的改进空间：当客户完全同意他们的保险公司提供了跨渠道的无缝体验时，总体客户满意度得分最高 (804)。当客户不同意该陈述时，满意度得分最低 (390)，这通常是由于不理解解释、使用多种渠道提问或数字工具未按预期工作造成的。目前，保险公司提供无缝跨渠道体验的比例仅为 54%，这是该研究中表现最低的关键绩效指标之一。

paras.en: Amica ranks highest in overall customer satisfaction with a score of 775. Nationwide (743) ranks second and Automobile Club of Southern CA (AAA) (740) ranks third.
paras.zh: Amica 以 775 分的总体客户满意度排名最高。全国范围内 (743) 排名第二，南加州汽车俱乐部 (AAA) (740) 排名第三。

paras.en: The U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study examines the auto claims experiences of customers from the largest insurance providers throughout the U.S. across eight dimensions (in order of importance): trust; fairness of settlement; people; time to settle claim; communication; ease of resolving claim; ease of starting claim; and digital channels. The 2026 study is based on responses from 8,261 auto insurance customers who settled a claim within the past nine months prior to participating in the survey. It was fielded from September 2025 through August 2026. The study excludes claimants whose vehicle incurred only glass/windshield damage or was stolen, or who only filed a roadside assistance claim.
paras.zh: 美国汽车索赔满意度研究从八个维度（按重要性排序）检查了美国最大的保险公司客户的汽车索赔体验：信任；结算的公平性；人们;解决索赔的时间；沟通;易于解决索赔；易于开始索赔；和数字频道。 2026 年的研究基于 8,261 名汽车保险客户的回复，这些客户在参与调查之前的过去 9 个月内解决了索赔。该调查从 2025 年 9 月到 2026 年 8 月进行。该研究不包括车辆仅发生玻璃/挡风玻璃损坏或被盗的索赔人，或仅提出路边援助索赔的索赔人。

paras.en: For more information about the U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, click here.
paras.zh: 有关美国汽车索赔满意度研究的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: Audi plans to build first U.S. plant in Georgia
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Audi plans to build its first U.S. plant in Georgia at the Middle Georgia Mega Site. Construction is slated to begin in 2027.
paras.zh: 奥迪计划在佐治亚州中部佐治亚巨型基地建造其第一家美国工厂。建设预计于 2027 年开始。

paras.en: A press release announcing the new project doesn’t include square footage, but it notes the $4 billion plant will be one of the brand’s largest production footprints globally. Annual assembly capacity will be 200,000 vehicles. Production is planned to begin in the early 2030s, “focused on Audi’s premium SUVs tailored to North American customers and designed to unlock significant growth potential in one of the world’s most important premium markets.”
paras.zh: 宣布新项目的新闻稿并未包括建筑面积，但指出这座耗资 40 亿美元的工厂将成为该品牌全球最大的生产基地之一。年组装能力为20万辆。生产计划于 2030 年代初期开始，“专注于为北美客户量身定制的奥迪高端 SUV，旨在释放全球最重要的高端市场之一的巨大增长潜力。”

paras.en: The release adds that “the investment marks a long-term commitment to the United States and will establish North America as a major pillar of Audi’s global production network.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿补充道，“这项投资标志着对美国的长期承诺，并将使北美成为奥迪全球生产网络的主要支柱。”

paras.en: “This project is a key element of a broader growth strategy focused on customer needs, a compelling product portfolio, and a more competitive business model,” the release states. “The investment is part of a long-term strategy for profitable growth.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“该项目是更广泛的增长战略的关键要素，该战略专注于客户需求、引人注目的产品组合和更具竞争力的商业模式。” “这项投资是盈利增长长期战略的一部分。”

paras.en: Gernot Döllner, Audi AG Board of Management chairman, states in the release that the goal is “building a stronger Audi business in America — not simply about building a factory.”
paras.zh: 奥迪公司管理委员会主席格诺特·多尔纳 (Gernot Döllner) 在新闻稿中表示，其目标是“在美国建立更强大的奥迪业务，而不仅仅是建造一家工厂。”

paras.en: “We have much greater ambitions for Audi in America,” he said. “The United States is one of the world’s most important premium markets, and we have not yet realized our full potential. We are determined to change that — with premium products, a stronger brand, and a competitive local production base.”
paras.zh: “我们对奥迪在美国市场抱有更大的抱负，”他说。 “美国是世界上最重要的高端市场之一，我们尚未充分发挥潜力。我们决心通过优质产品、更强大的品牌和具有竞争力的本地生产基地来改变这一现状。”

paras.en: Audi says Georgia provides an investment-ready site, a skilled workforce, an established automotive supplier network, and strong logistics infrastructure.
paras.zh: 奥迪表示，佐治亚州提供了一个可供投资的场地、熟练的劳动力、成熟的汽车供应商网络和强大的物流基础设施。

paras.en: Audi hints at future U.S. investments in the release “as the brand continues to deepen its commitment to the American market.”
paras.zh: 奥迪暗示，“随着该品牌继续深化对美国市场的承诺”，未来将在美国投资。

paras.en: “Audi is building its future in America,” said Vito Paladino, Audi of America president, in the release. “As part of our larger U.S. strategy, we are focused on becoming an even more significant player in this market. This investment signifies the brand’s commitment to our customers, dealers, employees, and communities across the country.”
paras.zh: “奥迪正在美国打造自己的未来，”奥迪美国总裁维托·帕拉迪诺在新闻稿中表示。 “作为我们更大的美国战略的一部分，我们致力于成为这个市场上更重要的参与者。这项投资标志着该品牌对全国各地的客户、经销商、员工和社区的承诺。”

articles.title: Georgia insurance commissioner incumbent and former state legislator face off for position
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Two candidates are running for a four-year term as Georgia Commissioner of Insurance and Safety Fire on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 两名候选人将于 11 月 3 日竞选佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，任期四年。

paras.en: Incumbent John King, a Republican, is running against Keisha Waites, a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.
paras.zh: 现任共和党人约翰·金正在与前州众议员、亚特兰大市议员凯莎·韦特斯竞选。

paras.en: King was appointed to the position in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022, according to his campaign website.
paras.zh: 据他的竞选网站称，金于 2019 年被任命为该职位，并于 2022 年当选完成任期。

paras.en: The website adds that he retired from the U.S. Army as a major general and also previously served as the chief of the Doraville Police Department.
paras.zh: 该网站补充说，他以少将身份从美国陆军退役，此前还曾担任多拉维尔警察局局长。

paras.en: “As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, General King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable,” the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称：“作为佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，金将军打破了现状，将佐治亚州家庭放在第一位，并追究了当权者的责任。”

paras.en: King says that his office fields 10,000 complaints from Georgians per year and has recovered more than $100 million from insurance companies.
paras.zh: 金表示，他的办公室每年都会收到 10,000 起格鲁吉亚人的投诉，并已从保险公司追回超过 1 亿美元。

paras.en: “When insurance companies try to take advantage of Georgians, we’re there,” King says on the website. “Since 2019, my office has leveled more than $22 million in fines against insurance companies, including the single largest fine in Georgia history at $5 million. Now, I’m fighting to increase the maximum initial fines allowed.”
paras.zh: 金在网站上表示：“当保险公司试图利用格鲁吉亚人的利益时，我们就会介入。” “自 2019 年以来，我的办公室已对保险公司处以超过 2200 万美元的罚款，其中包括佐治亚州历史上最大的单笔罚款 500 万美元。现在，我正在努力提高允许的最高初始罚款额。”

paras.en: The office has delivered tort and lawsuit reform in the state, his website claims.
paras.zh: 他的网站称，该办公室已在该州实施侵权和诉讼改革。

paras.en: “When disaster strikes, we’re there,” he says. “Over the last six years, my team has responded to natural disasters throughout Georgia, deploying teams on the ground and setting up claims villages to connect storm victims directly with providers.”
paras.zh: “当灾难来袭时，我们就在那里，”他说。 “在过去的六年里，我的团队应对了佐治亚州各地的自然灾害，在当地部署了团队并建立了索赔村，将风暴受害者与提供者直接联系起来。”

paras.en: Waites previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
paras.zh: 据 LinkedIn 介绍，维特斯此前曾担任美国小企业管理局灾难援助部门的灾难预备役人员/商业贷款专家，并在联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 担任过多个职务。

paras.en: “This combination — federal disaster work, state legislation, and citywide governance — directly aligns with the mission of the Georgia Office of Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner: protecting families through fair regulation, consumer services, rate review, and oversight of insurers and agents,” Waites’ website states. “I stand on a foundation of public service and legislative victories. The people of Georgia deserve proven leadership; look at the record, look at the results.”
paras.zh: 韦特斯的网站称：“这种结合——联邦灾难工作、州立法和全市治理——与佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员办公室的使命直接一致：通过公平监管、消费者服务、费率审查以及对保险公司和代理人的监督来保护家庭。” “我站在公共服务和立法胜利的基础上。佐治亚州人民应该得到经过验证的领导力；看看记录，看看结果。”

paras.en: Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
paras.zh: 韦茨表示，冻结利率举措是重中之重。这包括积极审查和挑战不合理的汽车和家庭保险费率上涨。

paras.en: She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 她还希望通过投资现代设备并为佐治亚州的农村和服务欠缺的社区提供更快的响应时间，结束邮政编码和信用评分歧视。

paras.en: Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
paras.zh: 韦特斯的另一个优先事项是建立“消费者欺诈打击部队”，以保护老年人和弱势家庭免受掠夺性保险诈骗。

paras.en: An Insurify analysis says the next Georgia commissioner will play a key role in market oversight and consumer protection as home insurance costs continue rising in the state. It found that the state’s average annual home insurance premium increased by 25% from 2023 to mid-2026.
paras.zh: Insurify 的一项分析称，随着该州家庭保险成本持续上涨，下一任佐治亚州专员将在市场监管和消费者保护方面发挥关键作用。研究发现，从 2023 年到 2026 年中期，该州平均每年家庭保险保费增加了 25%。

paras.en: “Georgia recently passed a massive insurance bill imposing expanded regulations on insurers to help protect consumers and, among other things, expanding the insurance commissioner’s authority,” Insurify says. “For example, effective Jan. 1, 2027, the commissioner will be able to increase penalties and factor an insurer’s claims conduct history into rate review decisions. And the insurance commissioner elected in November will be the first to exercise the new authority.”
paras.zh: Insurify 表示：“佐治亚州最近通过了一项大规模的保险法案，扩大了对保险公司的监管，以帮助保护消费者，并扩大保险专员的权力。” “例如，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，专员将能够加大处罚力度，并将保险公司的索赔行为历史纳入费率审查决定中。11 月当选的保险专员将是第一个行使新权力的人。”

articles.title: LKQ replaces CEO, announces Q3 losses
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: LKQ replaces Justin Jude, after a little over two years as president and CEO, as the company announces a net loss of $16 million to $32 million in its third quarter.
paras.zh: LKQ 接替贾斯汀·裘德 (Justin Jude) 担任总裁兼首席执行官两年多后，该公司宣布第三季度净亏损 1600 万美元至 3200 万美元。

paras.en: The company’s shares fell Friday to $17.42 at close, a 22.47% decline, after the announcement of its Q3 and administrative changes. The shares continued to hold close to Friday’s closing price early this week.
paras.zh: 在宣布第三季度业绩和行政变动后，该公司股价周五收盘下跌 22.47%，至 17.42 美元。本周初，该股继续维持在接近周五收盘价的水平。

paras.en: Salvatore A. Abbate, CEO of Veritiv Corp., will start as president and CEO Dec. 15, LKQ says. It added that Jude departed from the company Oct. 23.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，Veritiv Corp. 首席执行官 Salvatore A. Abbate 将于 12 月 15 日就任总裁兼首席执行官。它还补充说，裘德于 10 月 23 日离开公司。

paras.en: “LKQ’s performance, particularly in Europe, has fallen significantly short of the board’s expectations, and the board is taking decisive action to address it,” said John Mendel, chairman of the board, in the release. “We have strong conviction in LKQ’s business and its potential to create significant value for shareholders. Sal is a proven operator with a track record of driving performance in complex distribution businesses, and A&M brings deep experience in operational improvement. Together with LKQ’s talented teams, we are focused on improving execution and delivering improved results for our stakeholders.”
paras.zh: 董事会主席 John Mendel 在新闻稿中表示：“LKQ 的业绩，尤其是在欧洲的业绩，明显低于董事会的预期，董事会正在采取果断行动来解决这个问题。” “我们对 LKQ 的业务及其为股东创造巨大价值的潜力充满信心。Sal 是一位久经考验的运营商，在复杂的分销业务中拥有推动业绩的记录，而 A&M 在运营改进方面拥有丰富的经验。与 LKQ 的才华横溢的团队一起，我们致力于提高执行力并为我们的利益相关者提供更好的结果。”

paras.en: Mendel and Sue Grove, chair of the audit committee, will cover the president and CEO duties until Abbate assumes the role, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，孟德尔和审计委员会主席苏格罗夫将承担总裁和首席执行官的职责，直到阿巴特就任这一职位。

paras.en: Preliminary financial results show LKQ’s revenue dropped in Q3 to $3.32 billion, from $3.50 billion in Q3 2025, the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充道，初步财务结果显示，LKQ 第三季度的收入从 2025 年第三季度的 35 亿美元下降至 33.2 亿美元。

paras.en: Parts and services organic revenue declined 5.4%.
paras.zh: 零部件和服务有机收入下降 5.4%。

paras.en: The company’s net loss includes $111 million of non-cash impairment charges compared with a net income of $178 million in Q3 2025, according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，该公司的净亏损包括 1.11 亿美元的非现金减值费用，而 2025 年第三季度的净利润为 1.78 亿美元。

paras.en: “The third quarter results primarily reflect underperformance in the Europe segment, including operational disruptions associated with the ERP implementation in Germany and volume declines in the United Kingdom and Benelux,” the release states. “While Specialty was modestly below expectations, the shortfall was more limited, and North America performed in line with the company’s expectations despite softer market conditions.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“第三季度业绩主要反映了欧洲市场的表现不佳，包括德国 ERP 实施带来的运营中断以及英国和比荷卢经济联盟的销量下降。” “虽然特种业务略低于预期，但缺口更为有限，尽管市场状况疲软，北美地区的表现仍符合公司的预期。”

paras.en: LKQ is withdrawing its full-year 2026 guidance, last updated in July, due to the Q3 results and the appointment of Abbate, the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充道，由于第三季度的业绩和 Abbate 的任命，LKQ 将撤回上次更新于 7 月的 2026 年全年指引。

paras.en: The company also announced that Andy Hamilton is departing from his role as president and managing director of LKQ Europe in the news release. It adds that the board has engaged Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) to advise the company on its European operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还在新闻稿中宣布安迪·汉密尔顿 (Andy Hamilton) 将辞去 LKQ Europe 总裁兼董事总经理的职务。它补充说，董事会已聘请 Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) 就该公司的欧洲业务提供建议。

paras.en: Abbate brings three decades of experience leading large, complex distribution and industrial businesses, according to an LKQ release.
paras.zh: 据 LKQ 发布的消息称，Abbate 拥有三十年领导大型复杂分销和工业企业的经验。

paras.en: “As CEO of Veritiv Corporation, he led a significant transformation of the company, with its share price increasing more than 13-fold during his tenure, culminating in its $2.6 billion sale to Clayton, Dubilier & Rice in 2023,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“作为 Veritiv 公司的首席执行官，他领导了公司的重大转型，公司股价在他任职期间上涨了 13 倍以上，最终于 2023 年以 26 亿美元的价格出售给了 Clayton, Dubilier & Rice。”

paras.en: He previously served as Veritiv’s chief operating officer and chief commercial officer. He also previously held senior leadership roles at Andersen Windows & Doors, Solutia (now East Chemical Company, and Armstrong World Industries, according to the release.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任 Veritiv 的首席运营官和首席商务官。据新闻稿称，他此前还曾在 Andersen Windows & Doors、Solutia（现为 East Chemical Company）和 Armstrong World Industries 担任高级领导职务。

paras.en: LKQ says that Abbate’s experience “aligns closely with LKQ’s strategic and operational priorities.” It adds that he has led high-volume, multi-site distribution businesses where pricing, procurement and supply chain discipline are critical to performance.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，Abbate 的经验“与 LKQ 的战略和运营重点密切相关”。它还补充说，他领导过大批量、多地点的分销业务，其中定价、采购和供应链纪律对业绩至关重要。

paras.en: The release adds that Abbate has led portfolio transformations focused on margin improvement and cash generation.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充说，阿巴特领导了专注于利润率提高和现金生成的投资组合转型。

paras.en: “After a thorough search, the Board concluded that Sal is the right leader for LKQ at this moment,” Mendel said. “He is a disciplined operator and people-centered leader, who has transformed a complex distribution business, improved margins and created significant value for shareholders. Sal brings the operating rigor, commercial instincts and sense of urgency we need to sharpen execution across our businesses and unlock the full potential of LKQ. On behalf of the Board, I also want to thank Justin for his years of service and contributions to LKQ.”
paras.zh: “经过彻底的调查，董事会得出结论，萨尔是目前 LKQ 的正确领导者，”孟德尔说。 “他是一位纪律严明的经营者和以人为本的领导者，他改变了复杂的分销业务，提高了利润率，并为股东创造了巨大的价值。Sal 带来了我们所需的运营严谨性、商业本能和紧迫感，以提高我们整个业务的执行力并释放 LKQ 的全部潜力。我还要代表董事会感谢 Justin 多年来对 LKQ 的服务和贡献。”

paras.en: LKQ said that it expected positive business growth for aftermarket parts during its second quarter earnings call.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，预计在第二季度财报电话会议上售后零部件业务将出现积极增长。

paras.en: Jude said insurance carriers are looking for ways to cut costs and the easiest way to do so is by using more alternative parts and improving cycle times.
paras.zh: 裘德说，保险公司正在寻找削减成本的方法，最简单的方法是使用更多替代零件并缩短周期时间。

paras.en: “A lot more business is being driven to the MSOs [multi-shop operators] right now,” Jude said. “Now, MSOs are the bigger customers. They get the best prices. But at the end of the day, they do use more alternative parts than a non-MSO rooftop, so we see a bigger share of opportunity for our wallet to grow with those guys.”
paras.zh: “现在，更多的业务正在转向 MSO（多商店运营商），”Jude 说。 “现在，MSO 是更大的客户。他们获得最优惠的价格。但归根结底，他们确实比非 MSO 屋顶使用更多的替代部件，因此我们看到我们的钱包有更大的机会与这些人一起成长。”

paras.en: Alternative parts usage (APU) was more than 40% for the second quarter, Jude said. He added this surpasses a previous record from last quarter.
paras.zh: Jude 表示，第二季度替代零件使用率 (APU) 超过 40%。他补充说，这超过了上季度的记录。

paras.en: Photo of LKQ Euro Car Parts courtesy LKQ
paras.zh: LKQ 欧洲汽车零件照片由 LKQ 提供

articles.title: Dipstick Replacement Sensors: How They Work
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: GM has taken a lot of guff recently for eliminating the dipstick on some of their newer V8 engines and replacing it with a sensor. Let’s talk about how those sensors actually work, and how and when they measure the oil level.
paras.zh: 通用汽车公司最近因取消一些较新的 V8 发动机上的量油尺并用传感器取代而受到了很多批评。让我们谈谈这些传感器的实际工作原理，以及它们如何以及何时测量油位。

paras.en: It’s not like, for example, a brake master cylinder that has a float and a level that turns on the light on the dash when it reaches a certain level. These sensors are ultrasonic. In other words, it’s sending out a sound wave into the oil pan and determining the oil level that way.
paras.zh: 例如，它不像具有浮子和水平仪的制动主缸，当达到一定水平时，仪表板上的灯会打开。这些传感器是超声波传感器。换句话说，它向油底壳发出声波并以此方式确定油位。

paras.en: How does it know when to measure the level of oil in the oil pan? If you’re using a dipstick, the vehicle would be parked, it probably wouldn’t be running, and that’s when you’re checking the oil level. The sensor works the same way: It’s only measuring the oil level at certain instances. Let’s say it’s in Park when you first start up. Let’s say you’re sitting at a traffic light; that is when it’s measuring the level.
paras.zh: 它如何知道何时测量油底壳中的油位？如果您使用量油尺，车辆将被停放，可能不会运行，此时您需要检查油位。传感器的工作方式相同：它仅在某些情况下测量油位。假设您第一次启动时位于公园。假设您正坐在红绿灯前；那是它测量液位的时候。

paras.en: For more on sensors and how they work, including oxygen and TPMS sensors, watch the video above.
